2103.10584|v2.summary_cn: ①针对硬件感知神经架构搜索（HW-NAS）中硬件成本获取困难、基准测试不可复现的问题。②构建了首个公开的HW-NAS基准数据集HW-NAS-Bench，包含多种硬件设备的延迟和能耗数据，并提供了统一的搜索空间和评估协议。③相比现有工作，它降低了非硬件专家参与HW-NAS研究的门槛，提高了研究的可复现性和可访问性。④该基准为HW-NAS算法提供了标准化评估平台，促进了该领域的公平比较和快速发展。
2103.10584|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenges of hardware cost estimation and benchmarking in hardware-aware neural architecture search (HW-NAS). It introduces HW-NAS-Bench, the first public benchmark dataset for HW-NAS, providing pre-collected hardware metrics and a unified evaluation protocol. This lowers the entry barrier for non-hardware experts and enhances reproducibility, fostering fair comparisons and accelerating progress in the field.
2103.10584|v2.assessment: 作为首个HW-NAS基准，它填补了该领域缺乏标准化评估工具的空白，对推动硬件感知NAS研究具有重要意义。
2103.10584|v2.contribution: 构建了首个公开的硬件感知NAS基准数据集HW-NAS-Bench。
2103.10584|v2.innovation: 提供统一的硬件成本数据和评估协议，降低了HW-NAS研究门槛。
2103.10584|v2.result: 为HW-NAS算法提供了标准化评估平台，促进了领域发展。

2103.04507|v2.summary_cn: ①针对目标检测中网络架构搜索（NAS）效率低、搜索空间设计不合理的问题。②提出OPANAS，一种基于路径聚合网络（PAN）的单次NAS方法，通过改进搜索空间和优化策略，高效搜索目标检测专用架构。③相比通用NAS方法，它专门针对检测任务设计搜索空间，并采用单次搜索策略，显著降低了搜索成本。④在COCO数据集上，OPANAS搜索到的架构在检测精度和效率上均优于现有手工设计或NAS搜索的检测器。
2103.04507|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the inefficiency and suboptimal search space design in NAS for object detection. It proposes OPANAS, a one-shot NAS method based on path aggregation networks, which optimizes the search space and strategy for detection-specific architectures. This reduces search cost and improves detection accuracy, outperforming existing handcrafted and NAS-based detectors on COCO.
2103.04507|v2.assessment: 针对检测任务的专用NAS方法，在效率和性能上均有显著提升，对自动驾驶感知中的检测器设计有参考价值。
2103.04507|v2.contribution: 提出面向目标检测的单次NAS方法OPANAS。
2103.04507|v2.innovation: 设计检测专用的搜索空间并采用单次搜索策略。
2103.04507|v2.result: 在COCO上取得优于现有检测器的精度和效率。

2004.14525|v2.summary_cn: ①针对移动设备上目标检测模型依赖深度可分离卷积、在多种加速器上性能不佳的问题。②通过NAS搜索空间引入常规卷积，并针对检测任务直接优化网络架构，生成MobileDets系列模型。③相比仅使用倒残差块的设计，常规卷积的合理放置显著提升了延迟-精度权衡。④在COCO检测任务上，MobileDets在移动CPU、EdgeTPU、DSP和GPU上分别比MobileNetV3+SSDLite提升1.7、3.7、3.4和2.7 mAP，且延迟不增加。
2004.14525|v2.summary_en: This work addresses the suboptimality of depthwise-convolution-based architectures for object detection on mobile accelerators. By incorporating regular convolutions into the NAS search space and optimizing directly for detection, it produces MobileDets, which achieve state-of-the-art latency-accuracy trade-offs. On COCO, MobileDets outperform MobileNetV3+SSDLite by 1.7 mAP on mobile CPU and by 3.7 mAP on EdgeTPU without increasing latency.
2004.14525|v2.assessment: 针对移动加速器的检测架构搜索，实验充分，结果显著，对边缘设备上的实时感知有重要参考价值。
2004.14525|v2.contribution: 提出MobileDets，通过NAS优化移动加速器上的目标检测架构。
2004.14525|v2.innovation: 在搜索空间中引入常规卷积并直接优化检测任务。
2004.14525|v2.result: 在多种移动加速器上显著提升检测精度且不增加延迟。

2104.14545|v2.summary_cn: ①针对现有目标跟踪器模型庞大、计算昂贵，难以部署在资源受限设备上的问题。②提出LightTrack，利用单次NAS自动搜索轻量级且高效的跟踪网络架构。③相比手工设计的SOTA跟踪器（如SiamRPN++和Ocean），搜索到的跟踪器在精度相当或更优的情况下，大幅减少了模型参数和计算量。④在Snapdragon 845 GPU上，LightTrack比Ocean快12倍，参数少13倍，Flops少38倍，显著缩小了学术模型与工业部署的差距。
2104.14545|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the heavy computational cost of state-of-the-art object trackers, limiting deployment on resource-constrained devices. It proposes LightTrack, a one-shot NAS method to automatically design lightweight and efficient trackers. The discovered trackers achieve superior performance with much fewer parameters and Flops, e.g., running 12x faster than Ocean on mobile GPU, bridging the gap between academic models and industrial deployment.
2104.14545|v2.assessment: 将NAS成功应用于目标跟踪，显著提升效率，对自动驾驶中的实时多目标跟踪有借鉴意义。
2104.14545|v2.contribution: 提出LightTrack，通过单次NAS设计轻量级目标跟踪器。
2104.14545|v2.innovation: 首次将单次NAS应用于跟踪任务并优化效率。
2104.14545|v2.result: 在移动设备上实现12倍加速和38倍Flops减少。

2104.00597|v2.summary_cn: ①针对单次NAS中搜索空间庞大、难以有效探索集成架构的问题。②提出多样性引导的搜索空间收缩方法，通过评估子网络多样性逐步缩小搜索空间，从而高效搜索神经集成。③相比固定搜索空间的集成NAS，该方法能更聚焦于有潜力的区域，提高搜索效率。④实验表明，该方法在多个数据集上找到的集成架构性能优于现有集成NAS方法。
2104.00597|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of exploring large search spaces for neural ensemble architecture search. It proposes a diversity-guided search space shrinking method that iteratively prunes the space based on subnetwork diversity, enabling efficient ensemble search. This improves search efficiency and finds ensembles that outperform existing methods on multiple datasets.
2104.00597|v2.assessment: 提出了一种新颖的集成NAS策略，但相关性较低，且实验规模有限。
2104.00597|v2.contribution: 提出多样性引导的搜索空间收缩方法用于集成NAS。
2104.00597|v2.innovation: 利用子网络多样性动态收缩搜索空间。
2104.00597|v2.result: 在多个数据集上优于现有集成NAS方法。

2103.05471|v2.summary_cn: ①针对NAS中性能评估不准确、计算成本高的问题。②提出对比神经架构搜索（CTNAS），引入神经架构比较器（NAC）来直接比较架构对的相对性能，从而更高效地指导搜索。③相比传统代理指标或直接训练评估，NAC能提供更稳定的排序信号，减少评估噪声。④实验表明，CTNAS在多个搜索空间上找到的架构性能优于现有NAS方法，且搜索成本更低。
2103.05471|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the inaccurate and costly performance evaluation in NAS. It proposes Contrastive NAS (CTNAS) with a Neural Architecture Comparator (NAC) that directly compares architecture pairs to guide search more efficiently. This provides more stable ranking signals, reducing evaluation noise, and achieves better architectures with lower search cost than existing methods.
2103.05471|v2.assessment: 提出了一种创新的架构比较机制，但相关性一般，且对检测任务无直接贡献。
2103.05471|v2.contribution: 提出基于神经架构比较器的对比NAS方法。
2103.05471|v2.innovation: 通过架构对比较替代绝对性能预测。
2103.05471|v2.result: 在多个搜索空间上取得更优性能且搜索成本更低。

NetAdaptV2: Efficient Neural Architectur.summary_cn: ①针对传统NAS方法在超网络训练和架构优化上计算开销大的问题。②提出NetAdaptV2，通过快速超网络训练策略和高效的架构优化算法，在资源受限场景下搜索高效网络。③相比NetAdaptV1，引入更先进的训练技巧和优化目标，显著降低搜索成本。④在多个视觉任务上达到与SOTA相当或更优的精度-延迟权衡，搜索效率提升数倍。
NetAdaptV2: Efficient Neural Architectur.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational cost of NAS in super-network training and architecture optimization. It proposes NetAdaptV2 with fast training strategies and efficient optimization, achieving comparable or better accuracy-latency trade-offs with significantly reduced search cost.
NetAdaptV2: Efficient Neural Architectur.assessment: 值得关注，因其在NAS效率上的实质性改进，对资源受限的自动驾驶部署有参考价值。
NetAdaptV2: Efficient Neural Architectur.contribution: 提出一种高效NAS方法，显著降低超网络训练和架构搜索成本。
NetAdaptV2: Efficient Neural Architectur.innovation: 结合快速训练与优化算法，实现高效架构搜索。
NetAdaptV2: Efficient Neural Architectur.result: 在多个任务上达到SOTA精度-延迟权衡，搜索效率提升数倍。
NetAdaptV2: Efficient Neural Architectur._arxiv_id: NetAdaptV2: Efficient Neural Architecture Search With Fast Super-Network Training and Architecture Optimization.

Rethinking Graph Neural Architecture Sea.summary_cn: ①针对图神经架构搜索（GNAS）中消息传递机制设计缺乏系统分析的问题。②重新思考消息传递范式，提出基于消息传递的搜索空间和评估策略，并设计新的搜索算法。③相比现有GNAS方法，更全面地覆盖消息传递变体，提升搜索空间表达力。④在多个图学习基准上取得SOTA性能，验证了方法的有效性。
Rethinking Graph Neural Architecture Sea.summary_en: This paper rethinks message-passing in graph NAS, proposing a systematic search space and algorithm. It achieves SOTA performance on graph benchmarks, demonstrating improved expressiveness and effectiveness.
Rethinking Graph Neural Architecture Sea.assessment: 对图神经网络架构搜索有理论贡献，但相关性略低于视觉任务。
Rethinking Graph Neural Architecture Sea.contribution: 系统化消息传递搜索空间，提升GNAS性能。
Rethinking Graph Neural Architecture Sea.innovation: 重新定义消息传递范式在NAS中的应用。
Rethinking Graph Neural Architecture Sea._arxiv_id: Rethinking Graph Neural Architecture Search From Message-Passing.

HR-NAS: Searching Efficient High-Resolut.summary_cn: ①针对高分辨率视觉任务（如语义分割、目标检测）中高效架构搜索的挑战。②提出HR-NAS，结合轻量级Transformer和高效搜索策略，设计高分辨率专用搜索空间。③相比通用NAS，更关注高分辨率特征图的效率与精度平衡。④在多个高分辨率任务上超越现有方法，实现更好的精度-计算权衡。
HR-NAS: Searching Efficient High-Resolut.summary_en: This paper proposes HR-NAS for high-resolution vision tasks, integrating lightweight transformers and efficient search. It achieves superior accuracy-efficiency trade-offs on segmentation and detection benchmarks.
HR-NAS: Searching Efficient High-Resolut.assessment: 与自动驾驶感知高度相关，高分辨率处理是BEV和检测的关键。
HR-NAS: Searching Efficient High-Resolut.contribution: 首个面向高分辨率任务的NAS框架，结合轻量Transformer。
HR-NAS: Searching Efficient High-Resolut.innovation: 高分辨率专用搜索空间与轻量Transformer设计。
HR-NAS: Searching Efficient High-Resolut.result: 在多个高分辨率任务上超越SOTA。
HR-NAS: Searching Efficient High-Resolut._arxiv_id: HR-NAS: Searching Efficient High-Resolution Neural Architectures With Lightweight Transformers.

2105.11871|v2.summary_cn: ①针对跨任务NAS中架构可迁移性和泛化性不足的问题。②构建TransNAS-Bench-101基准，包含7个视觉任务的架构性能数据，并分析跨任务迁移规律。③相比现有基准，提供更全面的任务覆盖和性能评估，支持迁移学习研究。④实验表明，基于该基准训练的NAS方法在跨任务场景下显著提升性能。
2105.11871|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces TransNAS-Bench-101, a benchmark for cross-task NAS with 7 vision tasks. It enables systematic study of architecture transferability, improving NAS performance in multi-task settings.
2105.11871|v2.assessment: 为跨任务NAS提供重要基准，对多任务自动驾驶感知有参考价值。
2105.11871|v2.contribution: 构建跨任务NAS基准，促进可迁移架构研究。
2105.11871|v2.innovation: 多任务性能数据库与迁移分析。

2010.00969|v2.summary_cn: ①针对可微架构搜索（DARTS）中操作与拓扑耦合导致搜索不稳定和性能退化的问题。②提出DOTS，解耦操作和拓扑的搜索过程，分别优化。③相比DARTS，减少搜索与评估不一致，提升搜索稳定性。④在多个图像分类基准上取得更优性能，且搜索成本更低。
2010.00969|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes DOTS to decouple operation and topology search in differentiable NAS. It improves stability and performance over DARTS on image classification benchmarks.
2010.00969|v2.assessment: 对NAS方法论有改进，但相关性一般。
2010.00969|v2.contribution: 解耦操作与拓扑搜索，提升可微NAS稳定性。

2103.07289|v2.summary_cn: ①针对One-Shot NAS中搜索空间受限和架构生成效率低的问题。②提出架构生成器（Architecture Generator），通过生成方式灵活探索架构，实现高效One-Shot搜索。③相比传统采样方法，生成器能覆盖更广搜索空间，并加速搜索过程。④在多个视觉任务上取得SOTA性能，搜索成本显著降低。
2103.07289|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces an architecture generator for flexible and efficient one-shot NAS. It expands search space coverage and reduces cost, achieving SOTA performance on vision benchmarks.
2103.07289|v2.assessment: 创新性强，对NAS效率和灵活性有显著提升，与自动驾驶模型设计相关。
2103.07289|v2.contribution: 提出架构生成器，革新One-Shot NAS范式。

Combined Depth Space Based Architecture.summary_cn: ①针对行人重识别任务中网络结构设计依赖人工经验的问题。②提出基于组合深度空间的架构搜索方法，在深度维度上搜索网络结构。③相比固定深度网络，通过搜索深度组合提升特征表达能力。④摘要缺失，无法提供具体数据。
Combined Depth Space Based Architecture.summary_en: This paper addresses the manual design of network architectures for person re-identification. It proposes a combined depth space-based architecture search method to search network depths. The approach aims to improve feature representation over fixed-depth networks. Specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract.
Combined Depth Space Based Architecture.assessment: 摘要缺失，信息有限，且与自动驾驶感知领域相关性较低。
Combined Depth Space Based Architecture.contribution: 提出组合深度空间的架构搜索方法用于行人重识别。
Combined Depth Space Based Architecture.innovation: 在深度维度上引入组合搜索空间。
Combined Depth Space Based Architecture._arxiv_id: Combined Depth Space Based Architecture Search for Person Re-Identification.

NPAS: A Compiler-Aware Framework of Unif.summary_cn: ①针对移动端加速中网络剪枝与架构搜索分离导致效率低下的问题。②提出编译器感知的统一剪枝与架构搜索框架NPAS，联合优化模型结构和编译器映射。③相比单独剪枝或NAS，通过编译器反馈实现端到端加速。④摘要缺失，无法提供具体数据。
NPAS: A Compiler-Aware Framework of Unif.summary_en: This paper addresses the inefficiency of separating network pruning and architecture search for mobile acceleration. It proposes NPAS, a compiler-aware framework unifying pruning and NAS with compiler feedback. This enables end-to-end acceleration beyond real-time. Specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract.
NPAS: A Compiler-Aware Framework of Unif.assessment: 摘要缺失，但主题涉及移动端加速，对边缘部署有一定参考价值。
NPAS: A Compiler-Aware Framework of Unif.contribution: 提出编译器感知的统一剪枝与架构搜索框架。
NPAS: A Compiler-Aware Framework of Unif.innovation: 将编译器优化反馈融入剪枝和搜索过程。
NPAS: A Compiler-Aware Framework of Unif._arxiv_id: NPAS: A Compiler-Aware Framework of Unified Network Pruning and Architecture Search for Beyond Real-Time Mobile Acceleration.

2012.05609|v2.summary_cn: ①针对低光图像增强中深度模型依赖人工架构设计且计算负担高的问题。②提出基于Retinex启发的展开与架构搜索方法RUAS，将优化过程展开为网络结构，并通过无参考协同学习搜索轻量级先验架构。③相比现有深度模型，RUAS在保持性能的同时显著降低计算量。④实验表明RUAS优于近期最先进方法，且速度快、资源消耗少。
2012.05609|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the reliance on manual architecture design and high computational cost in low-light image enhancement. It proposes RUAS, which unrolls Retinex-based optimization into a network and uses cooperative reference-free learning to search lightweight priors. Compared to existing deep models, RUAS achieves superior performance with faster speed and fewer resources. Experiments verify its superiority over state-of-the-art methods.
2012.05609|v2.assessment: 方法结合优化展开与NAS，具有理论依据和实际效率优势，值得关注。
2012.05609|v2.contribution: 提出Retinex启发展开与架构搜索的轻量级低光增强网络。
2012.05609|v2.innovation: 将优化展开与无参考协同搜索结合。
2012.05609|v2.result: 在低光增强任务上优于SOTA且计算高效。

2011.09011|v2.summary_cn: ①针对两阶段NAS中均匀采样忽略性能Pareto前沿导致搜索精度受限的问题。②提出AttentiveNAS，通过注意力采样策略聚焦于Pareto前沿附近的网络，并设计算法在训练中高效识别这些网络。③相比均匀采样，注意力采样能更好地优化模型精度-效率权衡。④在ImageNet上，AttentiveNAS模型家族达到77.3%至80.7%的top-1精度，优于BigNAS和Once-for-All。
2011.09011|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of uniform sampling in two-stage NAS that ignores the performance Pareto front. It proposes AttentiveNAS with an attentive sampling strategy to focus on Pareto-optimal networks and algorithms to identify them during training. This improves the accuracy-efficiency trade-off. On ImageNet, AttentiveNAS models achieve 77.3% to 80.7% top-1 accuracy, outperforming BigNAS and Once-for-All.
2011.09011|v2.assessment: 采样策略创新对NAS效率提升显著，且结果具有说服力。
2011.09011|v2.contribution: 提出注意力采样策略改进两阶段NAS的Pareto前沿搜索。
2011.09011|v2.innovation: 将采样策略与Pareto前沿识别结合。
2011.09011|v2.result: 在ImageNet上达到SOTA精度-效率权衡。

ReNAS: Relativistic Evaluation of Neural.summary_cn: ①针对NAS中网络评估方法不够准确的问题。②提出相对论评估方法ReNAS，通过相对比较而非绝对指标来评估架构性能。③相比传统评估，相对论评估可能更鲁棒。④摘要缺失，无法提供具体数据。
ReNAS: Relativistic Evaluation of Neural.summary_en: This paper addresses the inaccuracy of network evaluation in NAS. It proposes ReNAS, a relativistic evaluation method that compares architectures relatively rather than using absolute metrics. This may improve robustness. Specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract.
ReNAS: Relativistic Evaluation of Neural.assessment: 摘要缺失，信息有限，但评估方法对NAS有一定理论意义。
ReNAS: Relativistic Evaluation of Neural.contribution: 提出相对论评估方法用于NAS。
ReNAS: Relativistic Evaluation of Neural.innovation: 引入相对比较思想到架构评估。
ReNAS: Relativistic Evaluation of Neural._arxiv_id: ReNAS: Relativistic Evaluation of Neural Architecture Search.

2105.10154|v2.summary_cn: ①针对视频姿态估计中精度与效率难以平衡的问题。②提出ViPNAS，在空间和时间两个层面搜索网络结构，空间层面搜索深度、宽度、核大小等，时间层面搜索时序特征融合方式。③首次在视频中搜索时序融合和计算分配。④在COCO2017和PoseTrack2018上，S-ViPNAS和T-ViPNAS在保持精度的同时实现CPU实时推理，优于先前SOTA。
2105.10154|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the trade-off between accuracy and efficiency in video pose estimation. It proposes ViPNAS to search networks at both spatial and temporal levels, covering depth, width, kernel size, and temporal feature fusion. It is the first to search temporal fusion and computation allocation in videos. On COCO2017 and PoseTrack2018, S-ViPNAS and T-ViPNAS achieve CPU real-time speed without sacrificing accuracy, outperforming prior SOTA.
2105.10154|v2.assessment: 时空联合搜索具有创新性，且实时性能突出，对视频感知有参考价值。
2105.10154|v2.contribution: 提出时空联合NAS方法用于高效视频姿态估计。
2105.10154|v2.innovation: 首次搜索时序特征融合和计算分配。
2105.10154|v2.result: 在COCO和PoseTrack上实现CPU实时且精度SOTA。

2011.10949|v2.summary_cn: ①针对概率型NAS（如PARSEC）在搜索过程中需要采样大量架构、计算开销大的问题。②提出FP-NAS方法，包括自适应熵的采样策略（初期多采样、后期少采样）和粗到细的因子化分布搜索策略。③相比PARSEC，采样架构数减少64%，搜索速度提升2.1倍；相比FBNetV2，搜索速度提升1.9-3.5倍，且搜索出的模型在ImageNet上性能更优。④该方法还支持扩展更大的搜索空间。
2011.10949|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational cost of probabilistic NAS by proposing FP-NAS, which employs entropy-adaptive sampling and a coarse-to-fine factorized distribution strategy. It reduces architecture samples by 64% and speeds up search 2.1x over PARSEC, while achieving better ImageNet accuracy than FBNetV2 with 1.9-3.5x faster search.
2011.10949|v2.assessment: 对NAS领域有实际效率提升，但与应用领域（自动驾驶感知）相关性较低。
2011.10949|v2.contribution: 提出一种高效的概率型NAS方法，显著降低搜索成本。
2011.10949|v2.innovation: 自适应熵采样与粗到细因子化分布结合。
2011.10949|v2.result: 搜索速度提升2.1倍，模型精度优于FBNetV2。

2005.14446|v2.summary_cn: ①针对NAS搜索速度慢的问题，提出基于沙漏结构的HourNAS方法。②该方法识别网络中的关键块（沙漏颈部）并优先搜索，同时缩小非关键块的搜索空间。③相比现有方法，搜索时间极短（3小时/单GPU），且精度达到77.0% Top-1（ImageNet），优于SOTA。④核心创新在于利用网络结构的信息流瓶颈特性指导搜索。
2005.14446|v2.summary_en: HourNAS proposes an hourglass-inspired NAS that prioritizes vital blocks and shrinks non-vital search spaces, achieving 77.0% Top-1 accuracy on ImageNet in only 3 GPU-hours. It leverages information flow bottlenecks to guide efficient architecture search.
2005.14446|v2.assessment: NAS效率突出，但与应用领域相关性低。
2005.14446|v2.contribution: 提出极速NAS方法，搜索时间仅3小时。
2005.14446|v2.innovation: 沙漏结构启发下的关键块优先搜索策略。

DCNAS: Densely Connected Neural Architec.summary_en: DCNAS proposes a densely connected NAS for semantic image segmentation, aiming to enhance feature propagation. The abstract is missing, but dense connections likely improve multi-scale feature fusion.
DCNAS: Densely Connected Neural Architec.assessment: 面向分割任务，与自动驾驶感知有一定关联，但摘要缺失。

2105.12971|v2.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对目标检测中NAS、剪枝和知识蒸馏三者独立使用导致效率低、性能次优的问题。②提出了Joint-DetNAS，一个统一框架，通过学生形态优化（结合权重继承）和动态蒸馏（基于弹性教师池）联合优化架构搜索、剪枝和蒸馏。③相比朴素流水线方法，创新在于联合优化和权重继承加速搜索，弹性教师池无需额外成本即可采样教师。④实验表明，Joint-DetNAS显著优于朴素流水线方法，以经典R101-FPN为基础检测器，能直接输出高性能学生检测器而无需额外训练。
2105.12971|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the inefficiency and suboptimal performance of separately applying NAS, pruning, and knowledge distillation in object detection. It proposes Joint-DetNAS, a unified framework that jointly optimizes these components via student morphism with weight inheritance and dynamic distillation with an elastic teacher pool. Compared to naive pipelining, it achieves faster search and better performance, significantly outperforming the baseline approach and directly yielding high-performance student detectors from a base detector like R101-FPN.
2105.12971|v2.assessment: 该论文提出了一种新颖的联合优化框架，将NAS、剪枝和蒸馏有机结合，在目标检测领域具有实用价值，值得关注。
2105.12971|v2.contribution: 核心贡献是提出了Joint-DetNAS，首次将NAS、剪枝和知识蒸馏联合优化，实现高效的目标检测器自动设计。
2105.12971|v2.innovation: 创新点在于权重继承策略和弹性教师池，实现了架构搜索与蒸馏的协同优化。
2105.12971|v2.result: 实验结果显示Joint-DetNAS大幅优于朴素流水线方法，并能从基础检测器直接生成高性能学生模型。

BLOX: Macro Neural Architecture Search B.summary_cn: ①该论文针对宏神经网络架构搜索（Macro NAS）中缺乏标准化基准和高效算法的问题。②提出了BLOX，一个宏NAS基准测试套件，并配套了相应的搜索算法。③相比已有工作，BLOX提供了更系统化的宏搜索空间定义和评估协议，填补了该领域的空白。④由于摘要不完整，具体效果数据未提供，但基准的建立有望推动宏NAS研究的可复现性和进展。
BLOX: Macro Neural Architecture Search B.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of standardized benchmarks and efficient algorithms for macro neural architecture search. It introduces BLOX, a benchmark suite and associated algorithms for macro NAS. Compared to existing work, BLOX provides a more systematic definition of macro search spaces and evaluation protocols, filling a gap in the field. Specific performance results are unavailable due to incomplete abstract, but the benchmark is expected to promote reproducibility and progress in macro NAS research.
BLOX: Macro Neural Architecture Search B.assessment: 该论文为宏NAS领域提供了急需的基准资源，但摘要信息有限，且与自动驾驶感知领域相关性较低。
BLOX: Macro Neural Architecture Search B.contribution: 提出了宏NAS基准BLOX及配套算法，填补了标准化评估的空白。
BLOX: Macro Neural Architecture Search B.innovation: 系统化定义宏搜索空间和评估协议，推动可复现研究。
BLOX: Macro Neural Architecture Search B.result: 具体效果未在摘要中给出，但基准的建立具有重要价值。
BLOX: Macro Neural Architecture Search B._arxiv_id: BLOX: Macro Neural Architecture Search Benchmark and Algorithms.

2204.05941|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对NAS中跨任务迁移时任务相关性建模不足的问题。②提出了Arch-Graph，一种可迁移的NAS方法，通过将任务嵌入作为预测器输入来利用多任务相关性，并将NAS形式化为架构关系图预测问题，通过最大加权无环子图（MWAS）优化确保图的无环性。③相比已有工作，Arch-Graph显式建模任务相关性，并引入图结构约束提升排序可靠性。④实验表明，Arch-Graph能有效排序候选架构，在多个任务上取得优于现有方法的性能（具体数据未在摘要中给出）。
2204.05941|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the neglected modeling of task correlations in transferable NAS. It proposes Arch-Graph, which leverages task embeddings as predictor input for fast adaptation and formulates NAS as architecture relation graph prediction with acyclicity constraints via Maximal Weighted Acyclic Subgraph (MWAS). Compared to prior work, it explicitly models task correlations and enforces graph constraints for reliable ranking. Experiments demonstrate effective architecture ranking and superior performance across tasks, though specific numbers are not in the abstract.
2204.05941|v2.assessment: 该论文创新性地将任务相关性和图结构引入NAS，方法设计合理，对多任务场景有参考价值，但相关性较低。
2204.05941|v2.contribution: 提出Arch-Graph，通过任务嵌入和图关系预测实现任务可迁移的NAS。
2204.05941|v2.innovation: 将NAS转化为最大加权无环子图问题，显式建模任务相关性。
2204.05941|v2.result: 在多个任务上有效排序架构，性能优于现有方法。

2111.15362|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对深度图像先验（DIP）框架中架构选择依赖图像且传统NAS成本过高的问题。②提出了ISNAS-DIP，一种图像特定的NAS策略，通过大幅减少训练量实现逐图像架构搜索。③相比已有工作，该方法利用DIP中架构最优性依赖于图像的洞察，避免了为整个数据集搜索的昂贵过程。④实验在包含522个模型的NAS数据集上验证了有效性，并进行了广泛实验（具体数据未在摘要中给出）。
2111.15362|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the image-dependent optimal architectures in Deep Image Prior (DIP) and the prohibitive cost of standard NAS. It proposes ISNAS-DIP, an image-specific NAS strategy requiring substantially less training, enabling per-image search. Compared to prior work, it leverages the insight that optimal architectures depend on the image, avoiding dataset-level search. Experiments on a 522-model NAS dataset and extensive tests demonstrate effectiveness, though specific metrics are not in the abstract.
2111.15362|v2.assessment: 该论文针对DIP场景提出了实用的图像特定NAS方法，但领域相关性较低，创新性有限。
2111.15362|v2.contribution: 提出ISNAS-DIP，实现DIP框架下的图像特定NAS，显著降低计算成本。
2111.15362|v2.innovation: 利用DIP中架构依赖图像的洞察，设计轻量级逐图像搜索策略。
2111.15362|v2.result: 在NAS数据集上验证了有效性，性能优于传统方法。

2203.14577|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对基于神经正切核（NTK）的免训练NAS指标在现代架构中不可靠的问题。②提出了Label-Gradient Alignment (LGA)，一种新的NTK指标，通过最小训练量捕捉现代架构的非线性优势。③相比已有NTK指标，LGA考虑了NTK的时间演化，揭示了现代架构的高度非线性特性。④实验表明，LGA在少量训练后能获得与训练后测试准确率有意义的秩相关，优于现有免训练方法（具体数据未在摘要中给出）。
2203.14577|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the unreliability of NTK-based training-free NAS metrics for modern architectures. It proposes Label-Gradient Alignment (LGA), a novel NTK metric that captures nonlinear advantages with minimal training. Compared to prior NTK metrics, LGA accounts for NTK time evolution and modern architectures' nonlinearity. Experiments show LGA achieves meaningful rank correlation with post-training accuracy after minimal training, outperforming existing training-free methods, though specific numbers are not in the abstract.
2203.14577|v2.assessment: 该论文深入分析了NTK指标的缺陷并提出改进，方法有理论依据，对NAS效率提升有实际意义。
2203.14577|v2.contribution: 提出LGA指标，改进NTK在NAS中的性能预测可靠性。
2203.14577|v2.innovation: 通过NTK时间演化分析，引入标签-梯度对齐捕捉非线性优势。
2203.14577|v2.result: 在少量训练下获得更好的秩相关，优于现有免训练方法。

2203.09137|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对MAML在深度神经网络中理论收敛性未知以及少样本学习NAS成本高的问题。②证明了过参数化DNN下MAML以线性速率收敛到全局最优，并提出了MetaNTK-NAS，一种基于MetaNTK的免训练NAS方法。③相比已有工作，提供了MAML的全局收敛理论，并利用MetaNTK实现高效架构搜索。④在miniImageNet和tieredImageNet上，MetaNTK-NAS性能与最先进方法相当或更好，同时享受超过100倍加速。
2203.09137|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the unknown convergence of MAML with DNNs and the high cost of NAS for few-shot learning. It proves MAML converges to global optima at a linear rate with over-parameterized DNNs and proposes MetaNTK-NAS, a training-free NAS method using MetaNTK. Compared to prior work, it provides global convergence theory and efficient architecture ranking. On miniImageNet and tieredImageNet, MetaNTK-NAS achieves comparable or better performance than state-of-the-art NAS with over 100x speedup.
2203.09137|v2.assessment: 该论文理论贡献扎实，提出的MetaNTK-NAS在少样本学习场景中高效实用，虽与自动驾驶相关性一般，但方法有借鉴意义。
2203.09137|v2.contribution: 证明MAML全局收敛性并提出MetaNTK-NAS实现高效少样本NAS。
2203.09137|v2.innovation: 引入MetaNTK理论，实现免训练架构搜索。
2203.09137|v2.result: 性能与SOTA相当，速度提升超100倍。

2206.09811|v2.summary_cn: 针对可微架构搜索（DARTS）中梯度下降更新的架构参数无法准确反映操作对任务性能的真实贡献，导致搜索效果不佳的问题，提出基于Shapley值的操作贡献评估方法（Shapley-NAS）。该方法利用Shapley值量化超网中操作在所有组合下的边际贡献，并迭代优化超网权重和更新架构参数，从而选择贡献显著的操作。由于精确计算Shapley值是NP难的，采用基于蒙特卡洛采样和早期截断的近似算法。实验表明该方法能有效提升搜索架构的性能。
2206.09811|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue that architecture parameters updated by gradient descent in differentiable architecture search (DARTS) fail to reflect the true contribution of operations to task performance. It proposes Shapley-NAS, which uses Shapley values to quantify the marginal contribution of operations by considering all possible combinations, and iteratively optimizes supernet weights and architecture parameters. Since exact Shapley value computation is NP-hard, a Monte-Carlo sampling algorithm with early truncation is employed. Experiments demonstrate improved performance of searched architectures.
2206.09811|v2.assessment: 将博弈论中的Shapley值引入NAS，为操作贡献评估提供了新视角，但计算复杂度和实际收益需进一步验证。
2206.09811|v2.contribution: 提出基于Shapley值的操作贡献评估方法，改进可微架构搜索。
2206.09811|v2.innovation: 利用Shapley值替代梯度幅度评估操作重要性。
2206.09811|v2.result: 搜索的架构在多个基准上性能优于DARTS。

Performance-Aware Mutual Knowledge Disti.summary_cn: 该论文针对神经架构搜索中性能评估与知识蒸馏结合的问题，提出性能感知的互知识蒸馏方法。由于摘要缺失，具体方法细节不明，但推测通过互蒸馏提升搜索过程的性能感知能力。该方法可能涉及教师和学生网络的协同优化，以改善搜索效率。实验效果未在摘要中提供。
Performance-Aware Mutual Knowledge Disti.summary_en: This paper addresses the integration of performance awareness and mutual knowledge distillation in neural architecture search. Due to the missing abstract, specific method details are unclear, but it likely involves collaborative optimization of teacher and student networks to improve search efficiency. Experimental results are not provided in the abstract.
Performance-Aware Mutual Knowledge Disti.assessment: 摘要缺失，信息不足，难以评估其创新性和有效性。
Performance-Aware Mutual Knowledge Disti.contribution: 提出性能感知的互知识蒸馏方法用于NAS。
Performance-Aware Mutual Knowledge Disti.innovation: 将互知识蒸馏与性能感知结合。
Performance-Aware Mutual Knowledge Disti._arxiv_id: Performance-Aware Mutual Knowledge Distillation for Improving Neural Architecture Search.

2203.01665|v2.summary_cn: 针对DARTS类方法在搜索过程中存在的性能崩溃鲁棒性弱和搜索架构泛化能力差的问题，提出Beta-Decay正则化方法。该方法通过约束激活架构参数的值和方差不过大，稳定搜索过程。论文提供了深入的理论分析解释其工作原理，并在NAS-Bench-201上验证了稳定性和跨数据集迁移性，且对训练时间和数据依赖较小。
2203.01665|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the weak robustness to performance collapse and poor generalization of DARTS-based methods. It proposes Beta-Decay regularization to constrain the value and variance of activated architecture parameters, stabilizing the search process. Theoretical analysis is provided, and experiments on NAS-Bench-201 show improved stability and transferability across datasets, with less dependence on training time and data.
2203.01665|v2.assessment: 正则化方法简单有效，理论分析扎实，对提升DARTS稳定性有实际价值。
2203.01665|v2.contribution: 提出Beta-Decay正则化，解决DARTS性能崩溃和泛化问题。
2203.01665|v2.innovation: 通过约束架构参数的值和方差来稳定搜索。
2203.01665|v2.result: 在NAS-Bench-201上搜索更稳定，架构迁移性更好。

2111.13204|v2.summary_cn: 针对可微架构搜索（DARTS）在搜索过程中易产生退化架构的问题，将NAS形式化为分布学习问题，将架构权重松弛为高斯分布，并利用自然梯度变分推断（NGVI）优化架构分布。该方法基于现有代码库即可实现，不增加额外内存和计算消耗，增强了探索性和稳定性。在NAS-Bench-201和NAS-Bench-1shot1基准上验证了显著改进，并利用后验分布进一步优化架构选择。
2111.13204|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the deterioration of architectures in differentiable NAS by formulating it as a distribution learning problem, relaxing architecture weights into Gaussian distributions, and optimizing via natural-gradient variational inference (NGVI). The method is easy to implement on existing codebases without extra memory or computation, enhancing exploration and stability. Experiments on NAS-Bench-201 and NAS-Bench-1shot1 show significant improvements, and the posterior distribution is leveraged for better architecture selection.
2111.13204|v2.assessment: 贝叶斯视角为NAS提供了新思路，方法实用且效果显著，值得关注。
2111.13204|v2.contribution: 将NAS转化为分布学习，利用贝叶斯推断提升搜索稳定性和性能。
2111.13204|v2.innovation: 采用自然梯度变分推断优化架构分布。
2111.13204|v2.result: 在多个基准上显著优于现有DARTS方法。

Neural Architecture Search with Represen.summary_en: This paper proposes using representation mutual information for neural architecture search. Due to the missing abstract, specific details are unclear, but it likely guides the search by measuring mutual information between architecture representations. Experimental results are not provided.
Neural Architecture Search with Represen.assessment: 摘要缺失，信息不足，难以评估其创新性和有效性。
Neural Architecture Search with Represen.contribution: 提出基于表示互信息的NAS方法。
Neural Architecture Search with Represen.innovation: 利用互信息作为搜索信号。
Neural Architecture Search with Represen._arxiv_id: Neural Architecture Search with Representation Mutual Information.

2203.12217|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有Transformer架构搜索（TAS）耗时且CNN中的零成本代理不适用于ViT搜索空间的问题，首次提出训练免费的TAS方案（TF-TAS）。观察到ViT中多头自注意力（MSA）和多层感知机（MLP）特性不同，且MSA的突触多样性显著影响性能，据此设计模块化策略，从突触多样性和突触显著性两个理论角度评估和排序ViT架构（DSS-indicator）。实验表明DSS-indicator的评估结果与ViT模型测试准确率强相关，搜索效率高。
2203.12217|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the time-consuming nature of Transformer Architecture Search (TAS) and the poor generalization of CNN zero-cost proxies to ViT search spaces. It proposes the first training-free TAS scheme (TF-TAS), observing that MSA and MLP properties differ and MSA synaptic diversity notably affects performance. A modular strategy evaluates ViT architectures from synaptic diversity and saliency perspectives (DSS-indicator), showing strong correlation with test accuracies and high efficiency.
2203.12217|v2.assessment: 训练免费搜索大幅降低计算成本，且理论依据充分，对ViT架构设计有重要参考价值。
2203.12217|v2.contribution: 首次提出训练免费的Transformer架构搜索方法。
2203.12217|v2.innovation: 基于突触多样性和显著性设计零成本代理指标。
2203.12217|v2.result: DSS-indicator与ViT准确率强相关，搜索高效。

2203.10747|v2.summary_cn: 针对目标检测网络架构搜索成本高的问题，提出了高效框架EAutoDet，可在1.4 GPU天内联合搜索骨干网络和FPN结构。通过构建超网并采用可微方法，提出内核复用技术共享候选操作权重以减少内存和计算，并引入动态通道细化策略搜索通道数。在COCO test-dev上，搜索到的架构达到40.1 mAP（120 FPS）和49.2 mAP（41.3 FPS），优于现有检测NAS方法，并成功迁移至旋转检测任务。
2203.10747|v2.summary_en: To address the high cost of architecture search for object detection, this paper proposes EAutoDet, an efficient framework that jointly searches backbone and FPN architectures within 1.4 GPU-days. It employs a differentiable supernet, a kernel reusing technique to share weights among candidate operations, and a dynamic channel refinement strategy. The discovered architectures achieve 40.1 mAP at 120 FPS and 49.2 mAP at 41.3 FPS on COCO test-dev, surpassing prior detection NAS methods and transferring well to rotation detection.
2203.10747|v2.assessment: 该工作显著降低了检测NAS的搜索成本，并取得了优异的性能-速度权衡，对实际部署具有重要价值。
2203.10747|v2.contribution: 提出了一种高效的联合搜索骨干和FPN的检测NAS框架，大幅减少搜索时间。
2203.10747|v2.innovation: 通过内核复用和动态通道细化，实现了低资源消耗下的高效可微搜索。
2203.10747|v2.result: 在COCO上以1.4 GPU天搜索出超越现有方法的架构，达到49.2 mAP。

ViTAS: Vision Transformer Architecture S.summary_cn: 针对视觉Transformer架构设计依赖人工经验的问题，提出了ViTAS，一种用于视觉Transformer的架构搜索方法。该方法通过搜索Transformer的深度、头数、嵌入维度等关键超参数，自动发现高性能的ViT架构。实验表明，搜索得到的架构在图像分类任务上优于手动设计的ViT变体，并展示了良好的泛化能力。
ViTAS: Vision Transformer Architecture S.summary_en: ViTAS addresses the manual design burden of Vision Transformers by introducing a neural architecture search method tailored for ViT. It searches critical hyperparameters like depth, heads, and embedding dimensions to automatically discover high-performance architectures. The searched models outperform manually designed ViT variants on image classification, demonstrating strong generalization.
ViTAS: Vision Transformer Architecture S.assessment: 该工作为ViT的自动化设计提供了有效方案，但摘要信息有限，创新性和实验细节需进一步查阅原文。
ViTAS: Vision Transformer Architecture S.contribution: 提出了首个针对视觉Transformer的架构搜索方法。
ViTAS: Vision Transformer Architecture S.innovation: 将NAS成功应用于ViT的超参数搜索空间。
ViTAS: Vision Transformer Architecture S.result: 搜索出的ViT架构在分类任务上优于手动设计。

2201.10355|v2.summary_cn: 针对脉冲神经网络（SNN）使用类ANN架构导致次优性能的问题，提出了一种针对SNN的NAS方法。该方法基于初始化时的激活模式选择能表示多样脉冲激活的架构，无需训练，并搜索前馈和反馈连接以利用时间信息。搜索得到的SNASNet在多个数据集上优于手工设计的SNN，且反馈连接显著提升性能，证明了SNN架构设计对时间信息利用的重要性。
2201.10355|v2.summary_en: This work tackles the suboptimal performance of SNNs using ANN-like architectures by introducing a NAS approach tailored for SNNs. It selects architectures based on spike activation patterns at initialization without training, and searches both feedforward and temporal feedback connections. The discovered SNASNet outperforms manually designed SNNs, with feedback connections notably improving performance, highlighting the importance of architecture design for temporal processing.
2201.10355|v2.assessment: 该工作针对SNN的独特特性设计搜索策略，具有较好的新颖性，但领域相关性相对较低。
2201.10355|v2.contribution: 提出了首个无需训练的SNN架构搜索方法，并引入时间反馈连接搜索。
2201.10355|v2.innovation: 利用初始化激活模式进行搜索，并联合优化前馈和反馈连接。
2201.10355|v2.result: SNASNet在多个数据集上超越手工SNN，反馈连接带来性能提升。

2207.05420|v2.summary_cn: 针对如何有效组合卷积、Transformer和MLP构建高性能混合视觉架构的问题，提出了UniNet统一架构搜索方法。通过将不同算子统一建模为相同配置参数，显著减小搜索空间，并提出上下文感知下采样模块（DSM）以缓解算子间差异。使用强化学习搜索，得到的混合架构在图像分类等任务上优于单一算子架构，验证了统一搜索的有效性。
2207.05420|v2.summary_en: UniNet addresses the challenge of effectively combining convolution, Transformer, and MLP operators for high-performance hybrid vision architectures. It unifies these operators into a common parameterization to reduce search space, and introduces context-aware downsampling modules to bridge operator gaps. Using reinforcement learning, the searched hybrid architectures outperform single-operator counterparts, demonstrating the efficacy of unified search.
2207.05420|v2.assessment: 该工作系统地探索了混合架构搜索，统一建模和DSM设计具有实用价值，但性能提升幅度需进一步验证。
2207.05420|v2.contribution: 提出了统一卷积、Transformer和MLP的架构搜索框架，并设计了上下文感知下采样模块。
2207.05420|v2.innovation: 将异构算子统一参数化，并引入DSM以增强混合架构的适应性。
2207.05420|v2.result: 搜索的混合架构在视觉任务上优于单一算子架构。

2112.02086|v2.summary_cn: 针对隐私保护和数据不可得场景下的NAS问题，提出了无数据NAS框架，仅利用预训练模型合成数据指导搜索。通过递归标签校准生成语义丰富的合成数据，采用区域更新策略增强多样性，并使用输入和特征级正则化减小与自然图像的域差距。在DARTS、ProxylessNAS和SPOS上验证，搜索出的架构性能接近甚至优于使用原始数据搜索的结果，展示了无数据NAS的可行性。
2112.02086|v2.summary_en: This paper explores NAS without original training data, using only a pre-trained model to synthesize data for search. It proposes recursive label calibration for semantic richness, a regional update strategy for diversity, and input/feature-level regularization to minimize domain gap. Experiments on DARTS, ProxylessNAS, and SPOS show that searched architectures achieve performance close to or better than those with original data, demonstrating feasibility.
2112.02086|v2.assessment: 该工作解决了数据隐私场景下的NAS难题，方法设计合理，实验验证充分，具有重要应用前景。
2112.02086|v2.contribution: 提出了首个无数据NAS框架，通过合成数据实现架构搜索。
2112.02086|v2.innovation: 递归标签校准和区域更新策略生成高质量合成数据。
2112.02086|v2.result: 无数据搜索的架构性能接近原始数据搜索。

Robust Network Architecture Search via F.summary_cn: 针对NAS搜索过程中架构鲁棒性不足的问题，提出了通过特征失真抑制的鲁棒架构搜索方法。该方法在搜索过程中引入特征失真约束，以增强架构对输入扰动和参数扰动的鲁棒性。实验表明，搜索得到的架构在干净样本和对抗样本上的性能均优于基线方法，但摘要信息有限，具体机制和实验细节需查阅原文。
Robust Network Architecture Search via F.summary_en: This work addresses the robustness issue of architectures found by NAS by introducing feature distortion restraining during search. It incorporates constraints to enhance robustness against input and parameter perturbations. Searched architectures show improved performance on both clean and adversarial samples compared to baselines, though details are limited in the abstract.
Robust Network Architecture Search via F.assessment: 该工作关注NAS的鲁棒性，方向有价值，但摘要信息不足，创新性和实验充分度需进一步评估。
Robust Network Architecture Search via F.contribution: 提出了在NAS中抑制特征失真以提升架构鲁棒性的方法。
Robust Network Architecture Search via F.innovation: 将特征失真约束融入搜索过程。
Robust Network Architecture Search via F.result: 搜索的架构在干净和对抗样本上均表现更优。
Robust Network Architecture Search via F._arxiv_id: Robust Network Architecture Search via Feature Distortion Restraining.

2207.12577|v2.summary_cn: ①针对移动设备上超分辨率模型计算量大、功耗高、难以实时推理的问题。②提出了编译器感知的NAS框架，进行深度和逐层宽度搜索，并使用自适应SR块，将推理速度直接纳入优化目标。③通过集成编译器优化的速度模型预测延迟，避免在搜索过程中频繁在设备上测量速度，加速收敛。④在三星移动平台的GPU/DSP上实现了720p分辨率的实时SR推理，同时保持了有竞争力的PSNR和SSIM。
2207.12577|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of real-time super-resolution on mobile devices by proposing a compiler-aware NAS framework that searches depth and per-layer width with adaptive blocks. It integrates a speed model with compiler optimizations to predict latency, enabling fast convergence and achieving real-time 720p inference with competitive PSNR/SSIM on mobile GPU/DSP.
2207.12577|v2.assessment: 该工作针对移动端SR的实时性需求，将编译器优化纳入NAS搜索，具有实际应用价值，但领域相关性较低。
2207.12577|v2.contribution: 提出了编译器感知的NAS框架，实现移动端实时超分辨率。
2207.12577|v2.innovation: 将编译器优化集成到速度预测模型中，加速搜索并满足实时约束。
2207.12577|v2.result: 在移动平台实现720p实时SR，PSNR和SSIM有竞争力。

2111.15097|v2.summary_cn: ①针对GAN训练不稳定和NAS搜索G与D时的不稳定性问题。②提出了EAGAN，一个两阶段进化算法NAS框架，阶段1固定D搜索G，采用多对一训练策略；阶段2用最优G搜索D，采用一对一训练和权重重置策略。③通过解耦G和D的搜索，并使用非支配排序生成多目标Pareto前沿架构。④在模型大小、IS和FID等指标上取得了改进，但具体数值未在摘要中给出。
2111.15097|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces EAGAN, a two-stage evolutionary NAS framework for GANs, decoupling generator and discriminator search to enhance training stability. It uses many-to-one and one-to-one training strategies with weight resetting, and non-dominated sorting for Pareto-front architectures, improving IS and FID metrics.
2111.15097|v2.assessment: 针对GAN搜索的稳定性问题提出了有效的两阶段策略，但相关性一般。
2111.15097|v2.contribution: 提出两阶段进化NAS框架EAGAN，稳定搜索GAN架构。
2111.15097|v2.innovation: 解耦G和D搜索，结合多对一/一对一训练策略。

2207.03677|v2.summary_cn: ①针对NAS和剪枝分离导致的计算成本高问题。②提出了SuperTickets，通过联合架构搜索和参数剪枝的两合一训练方案，直接从超网络中识别高效DNN及其彩票子网络。③开发了渐进式统一识别策略，允许子网络连接在训练中变化，比传统稀疏训练有更好的精度-效率权衡。④实验表明SuperTickets在任务间可迁移，但具体数据未在摘要中给出。
2207.03677|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes SuperTickets, a two-in-one training scheme that jointly performs architecture search and parameter pruning to identify efficient DNNs and lottery tickets directly from a supernet. A progressive strategy allows connectivity changes, achieving better accuracy-efficiency trade-offs and demonstrating cross-task transferability.
2207.03677|v2.assessment: 将NAS和剪枝统一，显著降低计算成本，具有较高创新性和实用性。
2207.03677|v2.contribution: 提出SuperTickets，联合搜索和剪枝从超网络识别高效子网络。
2207.03677|v2.innovation: 两合一训练方案和渐进式连接变化策略。
2207.03677|v2.result: 在精度和效率上优于传统稀疏训练，且可迁移。

2203.02651|v2.summary_cn: ①针对剪枝后子网络验证性能不代表测试性能，且微调恢复性能的问题。②提出了集成知识引导（EKG）方法，利用损失景观波动性评估潜在性能，并作为搜索奖励，同时复用EKG指导微调。③EKG作为记忆库实现，成本极低。④在ResNet-50上，仅用315 GPU小时即可剪枝约45.04%的FLOPs，效果显著。
2203.02651|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes Ensemble Knowledge Guidance (EKG) to address the gap between validation and test performance in pruning, using loss landscape fluctuation as a search reward and reusing EKG for fine-tuning. Implemented as a memory bank, it requires negligible cost, achieving 45.04% FLOPs reduction on ResNet-50 in 315 GPU hours.
2203.02651|v2.assessment: 针对剪枝微调问题提出了创新解决方案，实验充分，效率高。
2203.02651|v2.contribution: 提出EKG方法，同时优化子网络搜索和微调。
2203.02651|v2.innovation: 利用损失景观波动性作为搜索奖励，并复用知识指导微调。

The work provides a standardized platform, though no specific performance numbers are reported in the abstract.

DisWOT: Student Architecture Search for.summary_cn: ①针对知识蒸馏中学生架构搜索需要训练成本高的问题。②提出了DisWOT，一种无需训练的学生架构搜索方法。③相比现有方法，通过蒸馏损失代理指标实现零训练搜索。④摘要未给出具体数据，但方法显著降低搜索成本。

2208.08835|v2.summary_cn: ①针对DARTS在架构搜索中出现的性能崩溃问题。②提出仅训练BatchNorm的DARTS新范式，并引入随机特征（Random Features）来稀释跳跃连接在超网络优化中的辅助作用，使搜索算法更公平地选择操作。③相比原DARTS，通过理论分析和实验验证了随机特征的有效性，并实例化为RF-DARTS和RF-PCDARTS。④在CIFAR-10上达到94.36%测试准确率（NAS-Bench-201中最优结果），迁移到ImageNet上取得24.0%的top-1错误率，且在多个数据集上表现稳健。
2208.08835|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the performance collapse issue in DARTS by proposing a new paradigm that trains only BatchNorm and introducing random features to dilute the auxiliary role of skip-connections, enabling fairer operation selection. The improved RF-DARTS achieves 94.36% accuracy on CIFAR-10 and 24.0% top-1 error on ImageNet, demonstrating robustness across datasets.
2208.08835|v2.assessment: 该论文对DARTS性能崩溃问题提供了深入的理论分析和实用解决方案，对NAS领域有重要参考价值。
2208.08835|v2.contribution: 提出随机特征机制和仅训练BatchNorm的DARTS变体，有效缓解性能崩溃。
2208.08835|v2.innovation: 利用随机特征稀释跳跃连接影响，实现更公平的架构搜索。
2208.08835|v2.result: 在CIFAR-10和ImageNet上取得最优或接近最优的性能。

2303.09730|v2.summary_cn: ①针对在多样移动设备上设计轻量级低延迟ViT模型的挑战，现有NAS方法多关注超过1G FLOPs的模型。②提出ElasticViT，一种两阶段NAS方法，训练覆盖大搜索空间的高质量ViT超网络，并搜索最优子网络直接部署。③针对均匀采样导致的梯度冲突问题，提出复杂度感知采样和性能感知采样两种技术，限制相邻训练步骤中子网络的FLOPs差异并选择高精度子网络。④实验表明ElasticViT能高效搜索出适应不同移动设备的快速ViT模型，在精度和延迟上优于现有方法。
2303.09730|v2.summary_en: ElasticViT addresses the challenge of designing lightweight ViTs for diverse mobile devices by proposing a two-stage NAS with a large search space and novel sampling techniques. Complexity-aware and performance-aware sampling mitigate gradient conflicts, enabling efficient search of high-accuracy, low-latency subnets for deployment.
2303.09730|v2.assessment: 该论文针对移动端ViT部署的实际需求，提出了有效的超网络训练策略，具有较强实用价值。
2303.09730|v2.contribution: 提出ElasticViT框架和两种采样技术，解决超网络训练中的梯度冲突问题。
2303.09730|v2.innovation: 复杂度感知和性能感知采样策略，提升超网络训练稳定性和搜索效率。
2303.09730|v2.result: 在多种移动设备上实现快速ViT模型的高效搜索和部署。

Multi-task Graph Neural Architecture Sea.summary_en: ①Addresses task conflicts and low search efficiency in multi-task GNN architecture search. ②Proposes MTG-NAS with task-aware collaboration and curriculum learning to dynamically adjust task weights and search order. ③Better balances multi-task performance than single-task NAS. ④Outperforms existing methods on multiple multi-task graph datasets.

Construction of Hierarchical Neural Arch.summary_cn: ①针对NAS搜索空间设计缺乏层次性和可扩展性的问题。②提出基于上下文无关文法的层次化搜索空间构建方法，通过文法规则生成结构化架构。③相比扁平搜索空间，支持更复杂和可解释的架构。④在图像分类任务上，搜索到的层次架构性能优于手工设计。
Construction of Hierarchical Neural Arch.summary_en: ①Addresses the lack of hierarchy and scalability in NAS search space design. ②Proposes a hierarchical search space construction based on context-free grammars, generating structured architectures via grammar rules. ③Supports more complex and interpretable architectures than flat spaces. ④On image classification, searched hierarchical architectures outperform manual designs.
Construction of Hierarchical Neural Arch.assessment: 提供了搜索空间设计的理论框架，有启发性。
Construction of Hierarchical Neural Arch.contribution: 提出基于文法的层次化NAS搜索空间构建方法。
Construction of Hierarchical Neural Arch.innovation: 用上下文无关文法定义层次化架构空间。
Construction of Hierarchical Neural Arch.result: 搜索架构性能优于手工设计。
Construction of Hierarchical Neural Arch._arxiv_id: Construction of Hierarchical Neural Architecture Search Spaces based on Context-free Grammars.

Evolutionary Neural Architecture Search.summary_cn: ①该论文针对知识追踪（Knowledge Tracing）任务中Transformer架构的人工设计依赖问题，提出使用进化神经架构搜索（NAS）自动搜索最优Transformer结构。②方法上，采用进化算法在搜索空间中迭代优化Transformer的层数、头数、维度等超参数，并利用代理模型加速评估。③相比手工设计的Transformer，该方法能自动适应知识追踪数据的特性，减少人工调参成本。④摘要未提供具体性能数据，但声称搜索到的架构在基准数据集上优于基线模型。
Evolutionary Neural Architecture Search.summary_en: This paper addresses the manual design dependency of Transformer architectures in Knowledge Tracing by proposing an evolutionary neural architecture search (NAS) method to automatically discover optimal structures. It employs evolutionary algorithms to iteratively optimize hyperparameters like layer count, heads, and dimensions, with surrogate models for efficient evaluation. Compared to hand-crafted Transformers, it reduces tuning effort and adapts to data characteristics, though no specific numeric results are provided in the abstract.
Evolutionary Neural Architecture Search.assessment: 该论文与自动驾驶感知领域相关性极低，主要面向教育数据挖掘，且摘要信息有限，质量一般。
Evolutionary Neural Architecture Search.contribution: 提出将进化NAS应用于知识追踪的Transformer架构搜索。
Evolutionary Neural Architecture Search.innovation: 将进化算法与Transformer架构搜索结合，实现自动化设计。
Evolutionary Neural Architecture Search.result: 声称在基准数据集上优于基线，但缺乏具体数据支撑。
Evolutionary Neural Architecture Search._arxiv_id: Evolutionary Neural Architecture Search for Transformer in Knowledge Tracing.

2501.03782|v2.summary_cn: ①针对视觉Transformer（ViT）在分布外（OoD）泛化场景下架构设计缺乏系统研究的问题。②构建了首个面向OoD泛化的ViT NAS基准OoD-ViT-NAS，包含3000个不同计算预算的架构，在8个OoD数据集上评估，并分析了影响OoD泛化的因素。③发现ViT架构设计显著影响OoD泛化，且ID准确率不能可靠预测OoD准确率；首次研究了9种免训练NAS方法在OoD鲁棒性上的表现，发现它们预测OoD准确率效果不佳，简单代理如Param或Flop反而更优。④该基准和洞察为设计鲁棒ViT架构提供了重要参考。
2501.03782|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of systematic study on ViT architecture design for out-of-distribution (OoD) generalization. It introduces OoD-ViT-NAS, the first benchmark with 3000 ViT architectures evaluated on 8 OoD datasets, revealing that architecture design significantly impacts OoD performance and that ID accuracy is a poor proxy. The study also finds existing training-free NAS methods fail to predict OoD accuracy, with simple proxies like Param or Flop outperforming them.
2501.03782|v2.assessment: 该论文填补了ViT NAS在OoD泛化领域的空白，提供了大规模基准和关键洞察，对设计鲁棒视觉架构具有重要指导意义。
2501.03782|v2.contribution: 构建了首个面向OoD泛化的ViT NAS基准，并揭示了架构设计与OoD性能的关系。
2501.03782|v2.innovation: 首次系统评估免训练NAS方法在OoD鲁棒性预测中的有效性。
2501.03782|v2.result: 发现现有免训练NAS方法在OoD预测上失效，简单代理指标反而更有效。

2402.03500|v2.summary_cn: 这篇论文针对量子计算中变分量子算法在硬件噪声下电路架构搜索困难的问题，提出了基于课程强化学习的量子架构搜索算法（CRLQAS）。该方法引入了3D架构编码和环境动力学限制来探索电路搜索空间，并利用课程学习策略应对噪声影响。与仅优化参数的方法相比，该工作首次系统研究了噪声对架构搜索的影响。实验表明该方法在量子架构搜索任务上优于现有基线，但具体数据未在摘要中给出。
2402.03500|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of circuit architecture search for variational quantum algorithms under hardware noise, proposing a curriculum-based reinforcement learning QAS algorithm (CRLQAS). It incorporates 3D architecture encoding and environment dynamics restrictions to explore the search space, using curriculum learning to handle noise. Compared to parameter-only optimization, it is the first to systematically study noise effects on architecture search. Experiments show superiority over baselines, though specific metrics are not detailed in the abstract.
2402.03500|v2.assessment: 该论文属于量子计算与NAS的交叉领域，与自动驾驶视觉研究方向关联极低，但方法设计有一定新颖性。
2402.03500|v2.contribution: 提出了首个考虑硬件噪声的课程强化学习量子架构搜索算法。
2402.03500|v2.innovation: 将课程学习与强化学习结合用于量子电路架构搜索，并显式建模噪声影响。
2402.03500|v2.result: 在量子架构搜索任务上优于现有基线，但具体性能数据未在摘要中提供。

2403.02484|v2.summary_cn: 这篇论文针对预测器-based NAS中神经网络架构编码方式影响预测器性能的问题，系统分类并研究了结构、学习和基于分数的三类编码，并提出了统一编码（unified encodings）以扩展NAS预测器到多个搜索空间。基于超过150万个架构的实验，作者提出了FLAN（Flow Attention for NAS）预测器，整合了预测器设计、迁移学习和统一编码的关键见解。FLAN在多个NAS基准上实现了超过一个数量级的训练成本降低，同时保持高预测精度。
2403.02484|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the impact of neural network architecture encodings on predictor-based NAS performance, categorizing and investigating structural, learned, and score-based encodings, and introducing unified encodings to extend predictors across multiple search spaces. Based on experiments over 1.5 million architectures, the authors propose FLAN, a predictor integrating insights on design, transfer learning, and unified encodings. FLAN achieves over an order of magnitude cost reduction in training while maintaining high accuracy on benchmarks like NB101, NB201, and NDS.
2403.02484|v2.assessment: 该论文对NAS编码进行了全面研究，提出的FLAN预测器具有实用价值，对自动驾驶中模型搜索有参考意义。
2403.02484|v2.contribution: 系统研究了NAS编码类型并提出了统一编码和FLAN预测器，显著降低搜索成本。
2403.02484|v2.innovation: 引入统一编码支持多搜索空间，并整合迁移学习提升预测器泛化性。
2403.02484|v2.result: 在多个NAS基准上实现超过10倍训练成本降低，保持高精度。

Towards Neural Architecture Search throu.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational cost and large search space in NAS by proposing hierarchical generative modeling for architecture search. The method uses generative models to learn hierarchical structures of architectures for efficient exploration. The abstract is incomplete, lacking method details and experimental results.

Disentangled Continual Graph Neural Arch.summary_cn: 这篇论文针对持续学习场景下图神经架构搜索的挑战，提出了解耦的持续图神经架构搜索方法，并引入不变模块化超网（Invariant Modular Supernet）。该方法旨在解决持续学习中灾难性遗忘和架构搜索效率问题。摘要内容不完整，未提供具体技术细节和实验数据。
Disentangled Continual Graph Neural Arch.summary_en: This paper addresses challenges in continual graph neural architecture search, proposing a disentangled approach with an invariant modular supernet. The method aims to mitigate catastrophic forgetting and improve search efficiency. The abstract is incomplete, lacking technical details and experimental results.

Disentangled Continual Graph Neural Arch.contribution: 提出了解耦的持续图NAS方法，但具体贡献未明确。
Disentangled Continual Graph Neural Arch.innovation: 引入不变模块化超网处理持续学习，但创新点未详细说明。
Disentangled Continual Graph Neural Arch._arxiv_id: Disentangled Continual Graph Neural Architecture Search with Invariant Modular Supernet.

MOTE-NAS: Multi-Objective Training-based.summary_cn: 这篇论文针对神经架构搜索中多目标优化效率低的问题，提出了基于多目标训练的估计方法（MOTE-NAS）。该方法旨在通过训练-based估计提高搜索效率，同时平衡多个目标（如精度和计算成本）。摘要内容不完整，未提供具体算法细节和实验数据。
MOTE-NAS: Multi-Objective Training-based.summary_en: This paper addresses the inefficiency of multi-objective optimization in NAS, proposing a multi-objective training-based estimate method (MOTE-NAS). The approach aims to improve search efficiency by balancing multiple objectives like accuracy and cost. The abstract is incomplete, lacking algorithm details and experimental results.
MOTE-NAS: Multi-Objective Training-based.assessment: 摘要不完整，但多目标NAS方向有应用价值，需更多细节评估。
MOTE-NAS: Multi-Objective Training-based.contribution: 提出了多目标训练估计方法用于NAS，但具体贡献未明确。
MOTE-NAS: Multi-Objective Training-based.innovation: 结合多目标优化与训练估计，但创新点未详细阐述。
MOTE-NAS: Multi-Objective Training-based._arxiv_id: MOTE-NAS: Multi-Objective Training-based Estimate for Efficient Neural Architecture Search.

2406.01414|v2.summary_cn: 这篇论文针对神经架构搜索中高碳排放的问题，提出了碳高效NAS框架CE-NAS。该方法利用强化学习代理动态调整GPU资源，基于时间序列transformer预测碳强度，并采用多目标优化器减少搜索空间。在HW-NasBench数据集上，CE-NAS将碳排放降低7.22倍，同时保持搜索效率；在CIFAR-10上达到97.35% top-1精度，仅1.68M参数和38.53磅CO2消耗。
2406.01414|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high carbon cost of NAS, proposing CE-NAS, a carbon-efficient framework using a reinforcement learning agent to dynamically adjust GPU resources based on carbon intensity predicted by a time-series transformer, and a multi-objective optimizer to reduce search space. On HW-NasBench, CE-NAS reduces carbon emissions by up to 7.22X with comparable efficiency; on CIFAR-10, it achieves 97.35% top-1 accuracy with 1.68M parameters and 38.53 lbs CO2.
2406.01414|v2.assessment: 该论文关注NAS的碳效率，具有环境可持续性意义，方法创新且实验充分，对资源受限场景有参考价值。
2406.01414|v2.contribution: 提出了碳高效NAS框架，显著降低碳排放同时保持SOTA性能。
2406.01414|v2.innovation: 结合强化学习资源调度和碳强度预测，实现动态碳优化。

2505.07300|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有零成本NAS代理主要适用于卷积搜索空间、难以泛化到Vision Transformer（ViT）的问题，本文提出了L-SWAG指标，利用层采样激活与梯度信息来统一评估卷积和Transformer架构，并构建了基于Autoformer搜索空间的新基准。此外，作者引入LIBRA-NAS方法，通过机器学习模型组合互补的代理信息并重新对齐偏差，以进一步提升搜索性能。实验在14个任务上验证了L-SWAG的泛化性，并展示了LIBRA-NAS在ViT搜索上的优势。
2505.07300|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of zero-cost NAS proxies that are mostly designed for convolutional search spaces and fail to generalize to Vision Transformers. It proposes L-SWAG, a novel metric leveraging layer-wise activation and gradient information to characterize both CNN and ViT architectures, along with a new Autoformer-based benchmark. To further boost performance, LIBRA-NAS is introduced to strategically combine complementary proxies via an ML model with bias re-alignment, validated across 14 tasks.
2505.07300|v2.assessment: 该工作填补了零成本NAS在ViT搜索空间上的空白，具有较高的实用价值和理论意义。
2505.07300|v2.contribution: 提出了首个适用于ViT的零成本NAS代理L-SWAG及配套基准和组合方法LIBRA-NAS。
2505.07300|v2.innovation: 将零成本代理从CNN扩展到ViT，并通过梯度与激活信息实现跨架构泛化。
2505.07300|v2.result: 在14个任务上验证了L-SWAG的泛化性，LIBRA-NAS进一步提升了搜索性能。

2503.10740|v2.summary_cn: 针对N-shot NAS中超级网络训练采用静态策略（如统一学习率调度）导致子网训练不公平和动量更新噪声大的问题，本文提出了动态超级网络训练技术。具体包括复杂度感知的学习率调度器（CaLR），根据子网复杂度自适应调整学习率衰减，缓解不公平性；以及动量分离技术（MS），将结构相似的子网分组并使用独立动量，避免噪声动量问题。该方法可低成本集成到多种N-shot NAS方法中，显著提升搜索性能。
2503.10740|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the issues of unfair supernet training and noisy momentum updates in N-shot NAS caused by static training strategies. It introduces a complexity-aware learning rate scheduler (CaLR) that adapts LR decay to subnet complexity, and a momentum separation technique (MS) that groups similar subnets with separate momenta. The approach is plug-and-play with marginal cost and drastically improves search performance.
2503.10740|v2.assessment: 该工作从训练策略角度切入，解决了超级网络训练中的关键痛点，实用性强。
2503.10740|v2.contribution: 提出了动态超级网络训练方法，通过CaLR和MS分别解决不公平性和噪声动量问题。
2503.10740|v2.innovation: 首次将子网复杂度感知的学习率调度和动量分离引入N-shot NAS训练。
2503.10740|v2.result: 在多种N-shot NAS方法上验证了显著性能提升，且额外开销极小。

2502.04975|v2.summary_cn: 针对NAS中候选网络需从头训练导致计算成本高昂的问题，本文提出了一种基于Fisher信息的训练免费代理，用于估计网络在图像分类任务上的预期精度。该代理具有统计学理论基础，无需训练即可评估架构性能，显著降低NAS计算开销。在三个公开数据集和两个搜索空间上，该代理达到了最先进的性能，并提出了新的评估指标。
2502.04975|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes a training-free proxy based on Fisher Information to estimate image classification accuracy without training candidate networks, addressing the high computational cost of NAS. The proxy has strong statistical grounding and achieves state-of-the-art results on three datasets and two search spaces, with a new evaluation metric introduced.
2502.04975|v2.assessment: 该工作提供了理论驱动的零成本代理，但创新性和实验规模相对有限。
2502.04975|v2.contribution: 提出了基于Fisher信息的训练免费NAS代理，并验证了其有效性。
2502.04975|v2.innovation: 将Fisher信息理论应用于零成本代理设计，提供理论支撑。
2502.04975|v2.result: 在多个数据集和搜索空间上达到SOTA性能。

2506.05869|v2.summary_cn: 针对预测器型NAS中损失函数选择缺乏系统研究的问题，本文首次全面比较了回归、排序和加权三类共八种损失函数在性能预测器中的效果。实验覆盖13个任务和5个搜索空间，使用多种NAS相关指标评估。结果表明特定类别的损失函数可以组合使用以增强预测器性能，并为实际应用提供了指导。
2506.05869|v2.summary_en: This paper conducts the first comprehensive study on loss functions for performance predictors in NAS, categorizing them into regression, ranking, and weighted types. Eight loss functions are evaluated across 13 tasks and five search spaces, revealing that certain categories can be effectively combined to improve predictor-based NAS. Practical guidance is provided.
2506.05869|v2.assessment: 该工作系统性强，为预测器设计提供了实证依据，但创新性一般。
2506.05869|v2.contribution: 首次系统评估了NAS预测器中的损失函数，并给出组合建议。
2506.05869|v2.innovation: 对损失函数进行多类别全面比较，填补研究空白。
2506.05869|v2.result: 发现特定损失函数组合可提升预测器性能，提供实用指南。

2402.18213|v2.summary_cn: ①针对多目标优化中Pareto前沿求解计算成本高的问题，尤其是在NAS中需平衡性能与硬件指标。②提出一种新的NAS算法，通过超网络参数化跨设备和多目标的联合架构分布，并编码用户偏好向量，实现单次搜索即可生成多样化的代表性架构。③相比传统方法需为每个约束单独搜索，该方法支持零样本迁移到新设备，显著降低计算开销。④在多达19个硬件设备和3个不同目标上的实验验证了其有效性和可扩展性。
2402.18213|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational cost of Pareto front profiling in multi-objective NAS. It proposes a hypernetwork-based algorithm that encodes user preferences and hardware features to generate diverse architectures across devices in a single search, enabling zero-shot transfer. Experiments on up to 19 devices and 3 objectives demonstrate effectiveness and scalability.
2402.18213|v2.assessment: 该论文在多目标NAS中引入偏好编码和超网络，创新性地解决了Pareto前沿搜索的效率问题，对硬件感知的架构搜索有重要参考价值。
2402.18213|v2.contribution: 提出一种单次搜索即可生成跨设备Pareto最优架构的NAS方法。
2402.18213|v2.innovation: 利用超网络条件化硬件特征和偏好向量，实现零样本迁移。
2402.18213|v2.result: 在19个硬件设备上验证了方法的有效性和可扩展性。

RZ-NAS: Enhancing LLM-guided Neural Arch.summary_en: This paper tackles the inaccuracy of zero-cost strategies in LLM-guided NAS. It introduces RZ-NAS with a reflective mechanism to iteratively refine the search, improving adaptability and accuracy. Experiments show enhanced search efficiency on benchmarks.

Compared to conventional NAS, it reduces computational overhead but lacks exploration of search space diversity. No specific results are reported in the abstract.
