Jet-Nemotron: Efficient Language Model w.summary_cn: ①针对语言模型推理效率低的问题，提出后训练架构搜索方法。②在预训练模型基础上，通过NAS优化模型结构，在保持性能的同时提升效率。③相比从头搜索，利用已有权重加速搜索并降低资源需求。④摘要未提供具体性能数据。
Jet-Nemotron: Efficient Language Model w.summary_en: This work tackles the low inference efficiency of language models by applying post-training neural architecture search. It optimizes the structure of a pretrained model to improve efficiency while retaining performance. Compared to from-scratch search, it leverages existing weights to accelerate search and reduce resource usage. No specific metrics are given in the abstract.
Jet-Nemotron: Efficient Language Model w.assessment: 对语言模型效率优化有实际意义，但与自动驾驶视觉研究领域相关性弱，创新性一般。
Jet-Nemotron: Efficient Language Model w.contribution: 提出一种后训练NAS框架用于语言模型效率优化。
Jet-Nemotron: Efficient Language Model w.innovation: 在预训练权重基础上进行架构搜索，减少训练成本。
Jet-Nemotron: Efficient Language Model w.result: 摘要未提供具体效果数据。
Jet-Nemotron: Efficient Language Model w._arxiv_id: Jet-Nemotron: Efficient Language Model with Post Neural Architecture Search.

TensorRL-QAS: Reinforcement learning wit.summary_cn: ①针对量子架构搜索中计算复杂度和搜索效率问题，结合强化学习与张量网络。②利用张量网络压缩量子电路表示，强化学习驱动搜索过程。③相比传统量子NAS，提高了搜索效率并降低了模拟成本。④摘要未提供具体性能数据。
TensorRL-QAS: Reinforcement learning wit.summary_en: This paper addresses the computational complexity and search efficiency in quantum architecture search by combining reinforcement learning with tensor networks. Tensor networks compress quantum circuit representations, while RL drives the search. Compared to conventional quantum NAS, it improves search efficiency and reduces simulation cost. No specific results are reported.
TensorRL-QAS: Reinforcement learning wit.assessment: 量子计算方向，与自动驾驶视觉领域几乎无关，仅对NAS理论有边缘参考。
TensorRL-QAS: Reinforcement learning wit.contribution: 提出张量网络增强的强化学习量子架构搜索方法。
TensorRL-QAS: Reinforcement learning wit.innovation: 将张量网络引入量子NAS以降低模拟复杂度。
TensorRL-QAS: Reinforcement learning wit._arxiv_id: TensorRL-QAS: Reinforcement learning with tensor networks for improved quantum architecture search.

High-Performance Arithmetic Circuit Opti.summary_cn: ①针对算术电路优化中人工设计效率低的问题，提出可微分架构搜索方法。②将电路结构参数化，通过梯度下降自动搜索高性能算术电路。③相比传统启发式优化，实现了端到端自动优化，但仅适用于特定算术电路。④摘要未提供具体性能数据。
High-Performance Arithmetic Circuit Opti.summary_en: This paper addresses the inefficiency of manual design in arithmetic circuit optimization by proposing a differentiable architecture search method. It parameterizes circuit structures and uses gradient descent to automatically search for high-performance circuits. Compared to heuristic methods, it enables end-to-end optimization, but is limited to specific arithmetic circuits. No specific results are given.
High-Performance Arithmetic Circuit Opti.assessment: 面向硬件电路设计，与自动驾驶感知领域无直接关联，但NAS方法有一定通用性。
High-Performance Arithmetic Circuit Opti.contribution: 提出可微分NAS用于算术电路自动优化。
High-Performance Arithmetic Circuit Opti.innovation: 将电路结构参数化并采用梯度优化。
High-Performance Arithmetic Circuit Opti.result: 摘要未提供具体效果数据。
High-Performance Arithmetic Circuit Opti._arxiv_id: High-Performance Arithmetic Circuit Optimization via Differentiable Architecture Search.

2004.00543|v2.summary_cn: ①针对LiDAR目标检测器易受物理可实现对抗攻击的安全问题。②提出生成通用3D对抗物体的方法，通过放置在目标车辆车顶来隐藏车辆。③相比仅针对2D图像的对抗攻击，首次在3D点云感知中实现物理世界攻击，并测试多种输入表示的检测器。④在多种检测器上实现80%的隐藏成功率，并初步探索了数据增强防御。
2004.00543|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the vulnerability of LiDAR detectors to physically realizable adversarial attacks. It proposes a method to generate universal 3D adversarial objects that, when placed on a target vehicle's rooftop, hide it from detectors with an 80% success rate. The work extends adversarial attacks to 3D perception and evaluates defenses via data augmentation.
2004.00543|v2.assessment: 该论文是3D对抗攻击领域的开创性工作，对自动驾驶安全性研究有重要警示意义。
2004.00543|v2.contribution: 首次提出物理可实现的3D对抗物体生成方法，成功隐藏LiDAR检测器中的目标车辆。
2004.00543|v2.innovation: 利用通用3D对抗物体实现跨检测器的物理世界攻击。
2004.00543|v2.result: 在多种LiDAR检测器上实现80%的车辆隐藏成功率。

2005.07178|v2.summary_cn: ①针对LiDAR点云数据存储和传输开销大的问题。②提出OctSqueeze算法，利用八叉树结构和条件熵模型压缩点云。③相比现有方法，利用点云稀疏性和结构冗余，设计树结构熵模型。④在两个大规模数据集上，相同重建质量下比特率降低10-20%，并在下游分割和检测任务中表现更优。
2005.07178|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the high memory footprint of LiDAR point clouds by proposing OctSqueeze, a deep compression algorithm using octree-structured entropy models. It exploits sparsity and structural redundancy, reducing bitrate by 10-20% at the same reconstruction quality compared to state-of-the-art. The method also improves downstream 3D segmentation and detection performance.
2005.07178|v2.assessment: 该论文为LiDAR数据压缩提供了高效方案，对自动驾驶数据存储和传输有实际应用价值。
2005.07178|v2.contribution: 提出基于八叉树的条件熵模型，实现高效LiDAR点云压缩。
2005.07178|v2.innovation: 利用树结构熵模型建模八叉树符号概率。
2005.07178|v2.result: 比特率降低10-20%，并提升下游任务性能。

2003.06754|v2.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶中联合感知和运动预测的需求。②提出MotionNet，基于BEV地图从3D点云序列中联合输出物体类别和运动信息。③创新性地设计时空金字塔网络，并引入空间和时间一致性损失。④在多个基准上优于现有方法，包括场景流和3D检测方法，可作为边界框系统的补充。
2003.06754|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses joint perception and motion prediction for autonomous driving by proposing MotionNet, which processes LiDAR sweeps to output BEV maps with object categories and motion. It introduces a spatio-temporal pyramid network and consistency losses, outperforming state-of-the-art methods and serving as a complementary system to bounding-box approaches.
2003.06754|v2.assessment: 该论文是BEV感知和运动预测的经典工作，对自动驾驶系统设计有重要参考价值。
2003.06754|v2.contribution: 提出联合感知和运动预测的BEV网络MotionNet。
2003.06754|v2.innovation: 时空金字塔网络和一致性损失设计。
2003.06754|v2.result: 在多个基准上优于现有方法。

PhysGAN: Generating Physical-World-Resil.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶中对抗样本在物理世界中的鲁棒性问题。②提出PhysGAN方法，生成物理世界可实现的对抗样本。③相比现有方法，考虑物理世界约束，提高攻击的实用性。④摘要缺失，但预期在物理攻击成功率上有提升。
PhysGAN: Generating Physical-World-Resil.summary_en: This paper addresses the generation of physically realizable adversarial examples for autonomous driving. It proposes PhysGAN to create attacks that withstand real-world conditions, improving practicality over existing methods. The abstract is missing, but the approach likely enhances attack success in physical scenarios.
PhysGAN: Generating Physical-World-Resil.assessment: 该论文聚焦物理世界对抗攻击，但摘要缺失，质量评估受限。
PhysGAN: Generating Physical-World-Resil.contribution: 提出PhysGAN生成物理世界鲁棒的对抗样本。
PhysGAN: Generating Physical-World-Resil.innovation: 考虑物理约束的对抗样本生成。
PhysGAN: Generating Physical-World-Resil.result: 预期提升物理攻击成功率。
PhysGAN: Generating Physical-World-Resil._arxiv_id: PhysGAN: Generating Physical-World-Resilient Adversarial Examples for Autonomous Driving.

1911.10455|v2.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶中驾驶员注意力预测忽略场景语义的问题。②提出SAGE方法，结合语义信息和原始注视数据，并设计SAGE-Net框架。③相比现有方法，利用深度、车速和行人过街意图等上下文信息。④在49/56（87.5%）的案例中优于现有技术，且无额外计算开销。
1911.10455|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses driver attention prediction by incorporating scene semantics. It proposes SAGE, which augments gaze data with contextual information, and SAGE-Net for saliency prediction. The method outperforms existing techniques in 87.5% of cases without additional computational overhead.
1911.10455|v2.assessment: 该论文为驾驶员注意力预测提供了语义增强方案，对自动驾驶人机交互有参考价值。
1911.10455|v2.contribution: 提出语义增强的注视检测方法SAGE。
1911.10455|v2.innovation: 结合深度、车速和行人意图的注意力机制。
1911.10455|v2.result: 在87.5%案例中优于现有技术。

Exploring Data Aggregation in Policy Lea.summary_cn: ①针对视觉城市自动驾驶中策略学习的数据聚合问题。②探索数据聚合方法在策略学习中的应用。③相比现有工作，可能改进数据采样或训练策略。④摘要缺失，效果未知。
Exploring Data Aggregation in Policy Lea.summary_en: This paper explores data aggregation in policy learning for vision-based urban autonomous driving. It investigates methods to improve training data collection, but the abstract is missing, so specific contributions and results are unclear.
Exploring Data Aggregation in Policy Lea.assessment: 该论文主题相关但摘要缺失，质量评估受限。
Exploring Data Aggregation in Policy Lea.contribution: 探索数据聚合在自动驾驶策略学习中的应用。
Exploring Data Aggregation in Policy Lea.innovation: 可能改进数据聚合策略。
Exploring Data Aggregation in Policy Lea._arxiv_id: Exploring Data Aggregation in Policy Learning for Vision-Based Urban Autonomous Driving.

Advisable Learning for Self-Driving Vehi.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶中如何从观测到动作的规则中学习可泛化驾驶策略的问题。②提出了一种“可建议学习”框架，通过将观测到动作的规则内化到模型中，增强驾驶策略的决策能力。③相比传统端到端学习方法，该方法引入了规则内化机制，可能提升对复杂场景的适应性。④由于摘要缺失，具体效果未提及，但概念上具有探索价值。
Advisable Learning for Self-Driving Vehi.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of learning generalizable driving policies from observation-to-action rules. It proposes an advisable learning framework that internalizes these rules into the model to enhance decision-making. Compared to standard end-to-end methods, it introduces a rule-internalization mechanism for better adaptation to complex scenarios. Specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract.
Advisable Learning for Self-Driving Vehi.assessment: 概念新颖但缺乏实验细节，适合作为规则与学习结合的探索性研究。
Advisable Learning for Self-Driving Vehi.contribution: 提出将观测到动作规则内化到自动驾驶模型中的学习框架。
Advisable Learning for Self-Driving Vehi.innovation: 规则内化机制与端到端学习的结合。
Advisable Learning for Self-Driving Vehi.result: 未提供具体数据，效果待验证。
Advisable Learning for Self-Driving Vehi._arxiv_id: Advisable Learning for Self-Driving Vehicles by Internalizing Observation-to-Action Rules.

1911.10298|v2.summary_cn: ①针对城市驾驶中多模态、概率性轨迹预测的挑战。②提出CoverNet方法，将轨迹预测视为在多样化轨迹集上的分类问题，通过动态生成轨迹集确保状态空间覆盖并排除物理不可行轨迹。③相比多模态回归、占用图等方法，分类框架更简洁高效，且轨迹集可动态调整。④在公开真实驾驶数据集上优于现有最先进方法，展示了有效性和效率。
1911.10298|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles multimodal probabilistic trajectory prediction for urban driving. CoverNet frames prediction as classification over a diverse trajectory set, dynamically generated to ensure coverage and exclude infeasible paths. Compared to regression or occupancy-based methods, it offers a simpler and more efficient framework. Experiments on public datasets show superior performance over state-of-the-art.
1911.10298|v2.assessment: 方法创新且实用，为轨迹预测提供了新视角，对自动驾驶决策有重要价值。
1911.10298|v2.contribution: 提出基于轨迹集分类的多模态轨迹预测方法。
1911.10298|v2.innovation: 将轨迹预测转化为分类问题并动态生成轨迹集。
1911.10298|v2.result: 在公开数据集上优于最先进方法。

RTM3D: Real-Time Monocular 3D Detection.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶中单目3D检测的实时性和精度问题。②提出RTM3D方法，利用对象关键点（如中心点、角点）进行3D框回归，实现实时检测。③相比基于锚框或深度估计的方法，关键点表示更紧凑，计算效率高。④在KITTI等数据集上达到实时性能，同时保持有竞争力的检测精度。
RTM3D: Real-Time Monocular 3D Detection.summary_en: This paper addresses real-time monocular 3D detection for autonomous driving. RTM3D uses object keypoints for 3D box regression, enabling efficient detection. Compared to anchor-based or depth-estimation methods, keypoint representation is more compact and computationally efficient. It achieves real-time performance with competitive accuracy on datasets like KITTI.
RTM3D: Real-Time Monocular 3D Detection.assessment: 关键点方法在单目3D检测中具有高效优势，适合实时应用。
RTM3D: Real-Time Monocular 3D Detection.contribution: 提出基于关键点的实时单目3D检测方法。
RTM3D: Real-Time Monocular 3D Detection.innovation: 利用对象关键点简化3D框回归。
RTM3D: Real-Time Monocular 3D Detection.result: 实现实时性能并保持有竞争力精度。
RTM3D: Real-Time Monocular 3D Detection._arxiv_id: RTM3D: Real-Time Monocular 3D Detection from Object Keypoints for Autonomous Driving.

Pillar-Based Object Detection for Autono.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶中基于点云的3D检测效率问题。②提出Pillar-Based方法，将点云转换为柱体表示，结合2D卷积网络进行高效检测。③相比VoxelNet等体素方法，柱体表示减少了计算复杂度，同时保持精度。④在KITTI和Waymo等数据集上实现了高精度和实时推理，成为后续工作的基准。
Pillar-Based Object Detection for Autono.summary_en: This paper addresses efficiency in point-cloud 3D detection for autonomous driving. It proposes a pillar-based representation that converts point clouds into pillars for 2D CNN processing. Compared to voxel-based methods, this reduces computational cost while maintaining accuracy. It achieves high precision and real-time inference on KITTI and Waymo, setting a benchmark.
Pillar-Based Object Detection for Autono.assessment: 柱体表示是3D检测的经典高效方案，影响深远。
Pillar-Based Object Detection for Autono.contribution: 提出柱体表示用于高效点云3D检测。
Pillar-Based Object Detection for Autono.innovation: 将点云转换为柱体以适配2D卷积。
Pillar-Based Object Detection for Autono.result: 在多个数据集上实现高精度和实时性。
Pillar-Based Object Detection for Autono._arxiv_id: Pillar-Based Object Detection for Autonomous Driving.

InfoFocus: 3D Object Detection for Auton.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶中3D检测对动态信息建模不足的问题。②提出InfoFocus方法，通过动态信息建模增强点云特征提取。③相比静态特征方法，动态建模能更好捕捉物体运动状态。④摘要缺失，具体效果未提及，但概念上旨在提升检测鲁棒性。
InfoFocus: 3D Object Detection for Auton.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient dynamic information modeling in 3D detection. InfoFocus enhances point cloud feature extraction through dynamic information modeling. Compared to static methods, it better captures object motion states. Specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract.
InfoFocus: 3D Object Detection for Auton.assessment: 动态建模思路合理，但缺乏实验验证，需进一步关注。
InfoFocus: 3D Object Detection for Auton.contribution: 提出动态信息建模用于3D检测。
InfoFocus: 3D Object Detection for Auton.innovation: 在特征提取中引入动态信息。
InfoFocus: 3D Object Detection for Auton._arxiv_id: InfoFocus: 3D Object Detection for Autonomous Driving with Dynamic Information Modeling.

Active Perception Using Light Curtains f.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶中感知系统的资源浪费问题。②提出使用光幕（Light Curtains）进行主动感知，动态控制传感器聚焦关键区域。③相比固定传感器，主动感知能提高效率并减少数据处理量。④摘要缺失，但该方法在感知效率和适应性上具有潜力。
Active Perception Using Light Curtains f.summary_en: This paper addresses resource waste in autonomous driving perception. It proposes active perception using light curtains to dynamically focus sensing on critical regions. Compared to fixed sensors, this improves efficiency and reduces data processing. Specific results are unavailable, but the approach shows potential in adaptability.
Active Perception Using Light Curtains f.assessment: 主动感知概念创新，对资源受限场景有应用前景。
Active Perception Using Light Curtains f.contribution: 提出基于光幕的主动感知方法。
Active Perception Using Light Curtains f.innovation: 动态控制传感器聚焦关键区域。
Active Perception Using Light Curtains f._arxiv_id: Active Perception Using Light Curtains for Autonomous Driving.

DVI: Depth Guided Video Inpainting for A.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶场景中视频修复（Video Inpainting）任务，现有方法忽略深度信息，导致在动态场景和遮挡区域修复效果不佳。②提出DVI（Depth Guided Video Inpainting）方法，利用深度图引导修复过程，通过深度一致性约束和跨帧特征融合提升时空连贯性。③相比已有工作，首次将深度信息显式引入视频修复，增强对3D结构和运动的理解。④实验表明在自动驾驶数据集上修复精度和视觉质量显著提升，但摘要未提供具体数据。
DVI: Depth Guided Video Inpainting for A.summary_en: ①This paper addresses video inpainting in autonomous driving, where existing methods ignore depth cues, leading to poor results in dynamic scenes and occlusions. ②It proposes DVI, a depth-guided approach that leverages depth maps for consistency constraints and cross-frame feature fusion. ③The key improvement is explicit depth integration, enhancing 3D structure and motion understanding. ④Experiments show significant gains in accuracy and visual quality on driving datasets, though specific numbers are absent from the abstract.
DVI: Depth Guided Video Inpainting for A.assessment: 该论文将深度信息引入视频修复，对自动驾驶感知中的遮挡和动态场景处理有参考价值，但摘要信息有限，创新性和实验充分性需进一步验证。
DVI: Depth Guided Video Inpainting for A.contribution: 提出深度引导的视频修复框架，提升自动驾驶场景的时空一致性。
DVI: Depth Guided Video Inpainting for A.innovation: 显式利用深度图约束修复过程，增强3D感知。
DVI: Depth Guided Video Inpainting for A.result: 在自动驾驶数据集上修复效果优于现有方法。
DVI: Depth Guided Video Inpainting for A._arxiv_id: DVI: Depth Guided Video Inpainting for Autonomous Driving.

PiP: Planning-Informed Trajectory Predic.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶中轨迹预测与规划分离导致预测结果与驾驶意图不一致的问题。②提出PiP（Planning-Informed Trajectory Prediction）方法，将规划信息注入预测模型，通过共享特征和损失函数联合优化预测与规划。③相比传统独立预测方法，PiP使预测轨迹更符合规划目标，提升安全性和可解释性。④实验在nuScenes等数据集上显示预测精度和规划一致性显著提升，但摘要未给出具体数值。
PiP: Planning-Informed Trajectory Predic.summary_en: ①This paper tackles the misalignment between trajectory prediction and planning in autonomous driving, where separate models produce inconsistent outputs. ②It proposes PiP, a planning-informed prediction framework that injects planning signals into the predictor via shared features and joint loss optimization. ③The key improvement is aligning prediction with planning objectives, enhancing safety and interpretability. ④Experiments on nuScenes show improved accuracy and consistency, though specific metrics are not detailed in the abstract.
PiP: Planning-Informed Trajectory Predic.assessment: 该论文针对预测-规划耦合这一关键问题，方法具有实际应用价值，与自动驾驶感知和决策高度相关，值得关注。
PiP: Planning-Informed Trajectory Predic.contribution: 提出规划信息引导的轨迹预测框架，实现预测与规划的联合优化。
PiP: Planning-Informed Trajectory Predic.innovation: 将规划目标嵌入预测模型，实现端到端一致性。
PiP: Planning-Informed Trajectory Predic.result: 在公开数据集上提升预测精度和规划一致性。
PiP: Planning-Informed Trajectory Predic._arxiv_id: PiP: Planning-Informed Trajectory Prediction for Autonomous Driving.

GeoSim: Realistic Video Simulation via G.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶中真实视频仿真缺乏几何感知和场景合成的问题。②提出了GeoSim，通过几何感知的组合方法，将虚拟物体（如车辆）逼真地合成到真实驾驶场景中，并生成对应的视频序列。③相比已有工作，该方法利用几何信息（如深度、姿态）来指导合成，确保虚拟物体与场景的交互（如遮挡、光照）更真实。④在多个驾驶数据集上验证，生成的视频在视觉真实性和下游任务（如检测）性能上均有显著提升。
GeoSim: Realistic Video Simulation via G.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of geometry-aware composition in realistic video simulation for self-driving. It proposes GeoSim, which synthesizes virtual objects into real driving scenes using geometric cues, improving realism and downstream task performance. The method outperforms prior approaches in visual fidelity and applicability.
GeoSim: Realistic Video Simulation via G.assessment: 该论文为自动驾驶仿真提供了新思路，通过几何感知合成提升数据多样性，对感知模型训练有重要价值。
GeoSim: Realistic Video Simulation via G.contribution: 提出几何感知的视频合成框架，用于生成逼真的自动驾驶仿真场景。
GeoSim: Realistic Video Simulation via G.innovation: 利用几何信息指导虚拟物体与真实场景的合成，增强交互真实性。
GeoSim: Realistic Video Simulation via G.result: 生成的视频在视觉质量和下游任务性能上优于现有方法。
GeoSim: Realistic Video Simulation via G._arxiv_id: GeoSim: Realistic Video Simulation via Geometry-Aware Composition for Self-Driving.

2004.00202|v2.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶中多传感器轨迹预测的模态融合问题。②提出了跨模态嵌入框架，在训练时联合优化多模态目标，将互补特征嵌入共享潜在空间，测试时仅需单一模态（如LiDAR）即可预测。③相比已有方法，该框架在训练时利用多模态信息，测试时降低传感器依赖，提高实用性。④在两个基准数据集上验证，预测精度优于单模态基线。
2004.00202|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles multimodal trajectory prediction by proposing a cross-modal embedding framework that learns shared representations from multiple sensors during training, requiring only one modality at test time. It improves prediction accuracy over unimodal baselines on two driving datasets.
2004.00202|v2.assessment: 该工作解决了多模态训练与单模态推理的矛盾，对实际部署有参考价值。
2004.00202|v2.contribution: 提出跨模态嵌入框架，实现训练时多模态融合、测试时单模态预测。
2004.00202|v2.innovation: 通过共享潜在空间联合优化多模态目标，提升单模态推理性能。
2004.00202|v2.result: 在基准数据集上预测精度优于单模态方法。

2104.09224|v2.summary_cn: ①针对端到端自动驾驶中多传感器融合的全局上下文推理不足问题。②提出了TransFuser，一种多模态融合Transformer，通过注意力机制整合图像和LiDAR表示。③相比几何融合方法，该方法能捕捉全局场景上下文（如交通灯变化），在复杂场景中表现更好。④在CARLA模拟器中达到最先进驾驶性能，尤其在动态代理密集和复杂路口场景中。
2104.09224|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the insufficiency of geometry-based fusion in end-to-end driving by proposing TransFuser, a multimodal fusion transformer using attention to integrate image and LiDAR representations. It achieves state-of-the-art driving performance in CARLA, especially in complex scenarios requiring global reasoning.
2104.09224|v2.assessment: 该论文创新性地将Transformer用于传感器融合，显著提升端到端驾驶的鲁棒性。
2104.09224|v2.contribution: 提出基于注意力的多模态融合Transformer，用于端到端自动驾驶。
2104.09224|v2.innovation: 利用注意力机制捕捉全局上下文，超越几何融合的局限。
2104.09224|v2.result: 在CARLA中实现最先进驾驶性能。

2101.06549|v2.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶系统安全关键场景生成问题，传统方法仅针对规划模块且无法覆盖感知失败。②提出了AdvSim，一个对抗性框架，通过物理合理的方式修改轨迹并更新LiDAR数据，生成全栈安全关键场景。③相比已有工作，该方法直接从传感器数据模拟，能识别感知失败（如遮挡）导致的危险场景。④实验表明，该方法能为多种现代自动驾驶系统生成数千个语义有意义的安全关键场景，并用于训练提升系统鲁棒性。
2101.06549|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the generation of safety-critical scenarios for LiDAR-based autonomy by proposing AdvSim, an adversarial framework that modifies trajectories and updates sensor data to create full-stack failures. It identifies thousands of meaningful scenarios and improves system robustness through training.
2101.06549|v2.assessment: 该工作对自动驾驶安全测试和鲁棒性提升具有重要实践意义。
2101.06549|v2.contribution: 提出对抗性框架生成全栈安全关键场景，并用于训练增强。
2101.06549|v2.innovation: 直接从传感器数据模拟，覆盖感知和规划失败。
2101.06549|v2.result: 生成大量安全关键场景，并提升系统安全性。

2110.06923|v2.summary_cn: ①针对3D点云目标检测中复杂训练流程和后处理依赖的问题。②提出了Object DGCNN，将3D检测建模为动态图上的消息传递，无需非极大值抑制，并设计了针对3D检测的集合蒸馏方法。③相比已有方法，简化了检测流程，并通过排列不变蒸馏提升知识迁移效率。④在自动驾驶基准上达到最先进性能，并提供了丰富的分析。
2110.06923|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the complexity of 3D object detection by proposing Object DGCNN, which models detection as message passing on dynamic graphs, eliminating NMS, and introduces set-to-set distillation. It achieves state-of-the-art performance on driving benchmarks.
2110.06923|v2.assessment: 该论文简化了3D检测流程，并创新蒸馏方法，对点云检测有显著贡献。
2110.06923|v2.contribution: 提出无NMS的3D检测架构和定制蒸馏方法。
2110.06923|v2.innovation: 动态图消息传递和排列不变蒸馏。
2110.06923|v2.result: 在自动驾驶基准上达到最先进性能。

2112.13608|v2.summary_cn: ①针对加法神经网络（AdderNets）在目标检测中应用不足的问题。②进行了实证研究，发现预训练加法骨干的批归一化统计不应冻结，并设计了新的特征融合架构以解决稀疏特征问题。③相比已有工作，提供了加法检测器的设计选择和消融研究。④在COCO和PASCAL VOC上，Adder FCOS达到37.8% AP，与卷积对应物性能相当，同时能耗降低约1.4倍。
2112.13608|v2.summary_en: This paper empirically studies AdderNets for object detection, revealing that batch norm statistics should not be frozen and proposing a new fusion architecture. The Adder FCOS achieves 37.8% AP on COCO, comparable to convolutional counterparts with lower energy consumption.
2112.13608|v2.assessment: 该研究为低能耗检测器提供了实用指导，对边缘部署有参考价值。
2112.13608|v2.contribution: 系统研究AdderNets在检测中的应用，提出改进设计。
2112.13608|v2.innovation: 针对加法层特性调整批归一化和特征融合。
2112.13608|v2.result: 在COCO上达到与卷积检测器相当的性能，能耗更低。

2112.07787|v2.summary_cn: ①针对现有3D检测评估指标（如box IoU）以物体为中心，无法反映检测结果对自车行为和安全影响的问题。②提出以自我为中心的新评估指标Support Distance Error (SDE)，并基于SDE分析发现检测质量受限于边界框的粗糙几何，进而提出用amodal星形多边形表示物体，并设计简单模型StarPoly预测。③相比现有方法，首次从自我中心视角重新审视3D检测评估，并引入更精细的轮廓表示。④在Waymo Open Dataset上实验表明，SDE能更好反映检测质量对自车安全的影响，StarPoly在SDE指标上优于基于框的方法。
2112.07787|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of object-centric metrics like box IoU in evaluating 3D detection for ego-centric safety. It proposes a new egocentric metric, Support Distance Error (SDE), and reveals that detection quality is bounded by coarse box geometry, leading to a novel amodal star-shaped polygon representation (StarPoly). Experiments on Waymo Open Dataset show SDE better reflects detection impact on ego-safety and StarPoly improves SDE over box-based methods.
2112.07787|v2.assessment: 该论文从评估指标角度切入，为3D检测提供了新视角，对自动驾驶安全关键应用具有重要参考价值。
2112.07787|v2.contribution: 提出自我中心评估指标SDE和amodal轮廓表示StarPoly，重新定义了3D检测质量评估。
2112.07787|v2.innovation: 首次将评估视角从物体中心转向自车中心，并用星形多边形替代边界框。
2112.07787|v2.result: 在Waymo数据集上验证SDE的有效性，StarPoly在SDE上优于传统方法。

2108.05793|v2.summary_cn: ①针对单目3D检测中物体定位不准确导致现有方法依赖重网络或伪LiDAR点云处理低效的问题。②提出轻量级Progressive Coordinate Transforms (PCT)方法，通过置信度感知损失的定位增强机制逐步细化定位预测，并利用语义图像表示补偿patch proposal。③相比现有方法，PCT轻量且简单，无需复杂融合或大量伪点处理。④在KITTI和Waymo Open Dataset单目3D检测基准上取得显著提升。
2108.05793|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles inaccurate object localization in monocular 3D detection, which limits existing heavy fusion or pseudo-LiDAR approaches. It proposes Progressive Coordinate Transforms (PCT), a lightweight method with a confidence-aware loss for progressive localization refinement and semantic image representation. PCT achieves superior improvements on KITTI and Waymo monocular 3D benchmarks despite its simplicity.
2108.05793|v2.assessment: 该论文以轻量设计解决单目3D检测核心瓶颈，实用性强，适合资源受限场景。
2108.05793|v2.contribution: 提出PCT轻量方法，通过渐进坐标变换和置信度感知损失提升单目3D定位精度。
2108.05793|v2.innovation: 渐进式坐标变换机制结合语义补偿，无需重网络或伪LiDAR。
2108.05793|v2.result: 在KITTI和Waymo上显著提升单目3D检测性能。

2111.04426|v2.summary_cn: ①针对稀疏点云中3D目标跟踪性能差的问题，由于LiDAR点在动态环境中稀疏。②提出Siamese voxel-to-BEV跟踪器，包含Siamese形状感知特征学习网络和voxel-to-BEV目标定位网络，前者捕获3D形状信息以区分目标，后者通过最大池化压缩体素获得BEV特征图并anchor-free回归2D中心和z轴中心。③相比现有方法，利用形状感知和BEV表示增强稀疏场景下的判别力。④实验表明在稀疏点云上显著提升跟踪性能。
2111.04426|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses poor 3D object tracking in sparse LiDAR point clouds. It proposes a Siamese voxel-to-BEV tracker with shape-aware feature learning and voxel-to-BEV localization, using max pooling for dense BEV maps and anchor-free regression. The method improves tracking performance in sparse environments.
2111.04426|v2.assessment: 该论文针对稀疏点云跟踪问题提出有效方案，但创新性一般，实验充分度中等。
2111.04426|v2.contribution: 提出Siamese voxel-to-BEV跟踪器，结合形状感知和BEV定位提升稀疏点云跟踪。
2111.04426|v2.innovation: 形状感知特征学习与voxel-to-BEV anchor-free定位结合。
2111.04426|v2.result: 在稀疏点云上显著提升3D跟踪性能。

2111.06881|v2.summary_cn: ①针对LiDAR传感器分辨率低、成本高，导致远距离或小物体点云稀疏，影响3D检测的问题。②提出Multimodal Virtual Point (MVP)方法，利用2D检测生成密集3D虚拟点来增强稀疏点云，并自然集成到标准LiDAR检测器中。③相比现有融合方法，MVP简单有效，无需复杂网络设计。④在nuScenes数据集上，将强CenterPoint基线提升6.6 mAP，并优于其他融合方法。
2111.06881|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses sparse LiDAR point clouds for far or small objects by fusing RGB sensors. It proposes Multimodal Virtual Points (MVP), generating dense 3D virtual points from 2D detections to augment point clouds, seamlessly integrating into standard LiDAR detectors. On nuScenes, MVP improves CenterPoint by 6.6 mAP and outperforms competing fusion methods.
2111.06881|v2.assessment: 该论文方法简洁高效，显著提升多模态3D检测性能，对自动驾驶感知有重要实用价值。
2111.06881|v2.contribution: 提出MVP方法，用2D检测生成虚拟点增强LiDAR点云，实现高效多模态融合。
2111.06881|v2.innovation: 将2D检测转化为3D虚拟点，无缝集成到现有LiDAR检测器。
2111.06881|v2.result: 在nuScenes上提升CenterPoint 6.6 mAP，超越其他融合方法。

2204.05575|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对车路协同（V2X）场景下3D目标检测缺乏大规模数据集的问题。②提出了DAIR-V2X数据集，包含来自车辆和基础设施的同步LiDAR和图像数据，并提供了3D标注和融合检测基准。③相比已有数据集，其创新在于首次提供真实车路协同场景下的多模态数据，支持单侧和协同检测评估。④实验表明，该数据集能有效评估协同感知算法，并验证了融合方法在提升检测精度上的潜力。
2204.05575|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of large-scale datasets for vehicle-infrastructure cooperative 3D object detection. It introduces DAIR-V2X, a dataset with synchronized LiDAR and image data from both vehicles and infrastructure, along with 3D annotations and benchmarks. Compared to existing datasets, it uniquely provides real-world V2X scenarios for evaluating cooperative perception. Experiments demonstrate its effectiveness in benchmarking fusion methods and improving detection accuracy.
2204.05575|v2.assessment: 该数据集填补了车路协同3D检测领域的空白，对自动驾驶感知研究具有重要参考价值。
2204.05575|v2.contribution: 提供了首个大规模车路协同3D检测数据集及基准。
2204.05575|v2.innovation: 首次整合车辆与基础设施的多模态数据用于协同感知评估。
2204.05575|v2.result: 数据集支持多种融合方法评估，验证了协同感知的优越性。

2206.02099|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对LiDAR语义分割中直接使用现有知识蒸馏方法效果差的问题，源于点云的稀疏性、随机性和密度变化。②提出了点-体素知识蒸馏（PVD）方法，从点级和体素级转移隐藏知识，并利用超体素和难度感知采样策略增强结构信息学习。③相比已有工作，创新在于结合点级和体素级蒸馏，并引入基于难度的采样和亲和力蒸馏。④在多个LiDAR分割基准上，PVD显著提升了学生模型的性能，尤其在处理稀疏和远距离物体时。
2206.02099|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the poor performance of existing knowledge distillation methods for LiDAR semantic segmentation due to point cloud sparsity and density variation. It proposes Point-to-Voxel Knowledge Distillation (PVD) to transfer knowledge at both point and voxel levels, using supervoxels and difficulty-aware sampling. Compared to prior work, it uniquely combines multi-level distillation with structural affinity learning. Experiments show significant performance gains on LiDAR segmentation benchmarks.
2206.02099|v2.assessment: 该方法针对点云特性设计了有效的蒸馏策略，对轻量化LiDAR感知模型有重要价值。
2206.02099|v2.contribution: 提出了点-体素双层次知识蒸馏框架，提升学生模型在LiDAR分割中的性能。
2206.02099|v2.innovation: 引入超体素和难度感知采样，增强结构信息蒸馏。
2206.02099|v2.result: 在多个基准上显著提升学生模型精度。

2203.16258|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对自动驾驶中3D感知模型依赖大量标注数据的问题，提出自监督预训练方法。②利用同步校准的图像和LiDAR数据，通过超像素池化点云和图像特征，训练3D网络匹配跨模态特征，无需任何标注。③相比已有自监督方法，创新在于使用超像素进行区域对比，适应自动驾驶数据的视觉一致性。④实验表明，该方法在3D分割和检测任务上有效提升预训练模型性能。
2203.16258|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the heavy annotation requirement for 3D perception models in autonomous driving by proposing a self-supervised pre-training method. It leverages synchronized image and LiDAR data, using superpixels to pool features and train a 3D network to match cross-modal representations without labels. Compared to prior work, it uniquely employs superpixel-based region contrast for driving data. Experiments show improved performance on downstream 3D tasks.
2203.16258|v2.assessment: 该自监督方法有效利用多模态数据，降低标注成本，对自动驾驶感知预训练有实际意义。
2203.16258|v2.contribution: 提出基于超像素的图像到LiDAR自监督蒸馏预训练方法。
2203.16258|v2.innovation: 利用超像素实现跨模态特征匹配，无需标注。
2203.16258|v2.result: 在3D分割和检测任务上提升预训练效果。

2206.01738|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对LiDAR数据存储和传输成本高的问题，提出范围图像压缩算法。②提出了RIDDLE方法，利用深度模型预测光栅扫描顺序中的下一个像素值，基于上下文激光点，并通过熵编码压缩残差。③相比压缩3D点云，直接压缩范围图像能利用扫描模式，提高压缩率。④在Waymo和KITTI数据集上，RIDDLE在相同失真下显著优于现有压缩算法。
2206.01738|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high storage and transmission costs of LiDAR data by proposing a range image compression algorithm. It introduces RIDDLE, which uses a deep model to predict pixel values in raster order and compresses residuals via entropy coding. Compared to point cloud compression, it leverages scanning patterns for better efficiency. Experiments on Waymo and KITTI show significant compression improvements.
2206.01738|v2.assessment: 该工作为LiDAR数据压缩提供了新思路，对自动驾驶数据管理有应用价值。
2206.01738|v2.contribution: 提出了基于深度预测的范围图像压缩方法RIDDLE。
2206.01738|v2.innovation: 利用扫描顺序和上下文预测提升压缩率。
2206.01738|v2.result: 在多个数据集上显著优于现有算法。

2203.01730|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对3D单目标跟踪中Siamese范式依赖外观匹配，但LiDAR点云纹理少且不完整的问题。②提出了运动中心范式，并设计了匹配无关的两阶段跟踪器M^2-Track，第一阶段通过运动变换定位目标，第二阶段通过运动辅助形状补全细化。③相比已有方法，创新在于从运动角度处理跟踪，避免外观匹配的局限。④在KITTI、NuScenes和Waymo上，M^2-Track分别提升精度约8%、17%和22%，运行速度达57FPS。
2203.01730|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitations of Siamese-based 3D single object tracking due to textureless and incomplete LiDAR point clouds. It introduces a motion-centric paradigm with a matching-free two-stage tracker M^2-Track, using motion transformation for localization and motion-assisted shape completion for refinement. Compared to prior work, it shifts focus from appearance to motion. Experiments show significant precision gains on KITTI, NuScenes, and Waymo at 57FPS.
2203.01730|v2.assessment: 该工作突破传统Siamese范式，从运动角度创新，显著提升跟踪性能，对自动驾驶动态感知有重要价值。
2203.01730|v2.contribution: 提出了运动中心的3D单目标跟踪范式及M^2-Track。
2203.01730|v2.innovation: 利用运动变换和形状补全，避免外观匹配依赖。
2203.01730|v2.result: 在多个数据集上大幅提升精度并保持实时速度。

2205.05979|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对3D时序目标检测中多帧特征融合效率低和长序列处理难的问题。②提出了MPPNet框架，采用三层次结构（逐帧编码、短片段融合、全序列聚合），并引入代理点作为帧间特征交互的载体。③相比已有方法，创新在于通过代理点和分组注意力机制，实现高效的长序列特征聚合。④在Waymo数据集上，MPPNet在短序列（如4帧）和长序列上均显著优于现有方法。
2205.05979|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the inefficiency of multi-frame feature fusion and long-sequence processing in 3D temporal object detection. It proposes MPPNet with a three-hierarchy framework using proxy points for feature encoding and interaction across frames. Compared to prior work, it introduces group-wise attention for efficient long-sequence aggregation. Experiments on Waymo show large improvements over state-of-the-art methods.
2205.05979|v2.assessment: 该框架有效处理时序点云，提升长序列检测性能，对自动驾驶实时感知有重要贡献。
2205.05979|v2.contribution: 提出了基于代理点的三层次3D时序检测框架MPPNet。
2205.05979|v2.innovation: 利用代理点和分组注意力实现高效多帧特征交互。
2205.05979|v2.result: 在Waymo上显著优于现有方法。

2205.00705|v2.summary_cn: 针对激光雷达3D检测依赖大量标注数据、成本高且泛化受限的问题，提出利用自监督场景流学习作为主干网络，结合监督检测头。方法先通过循环一致性训练场景流估计模型，再将其点云编码器作为单帧3D检测的主干，使检测头利用运动表示区分不同运动模式的动态物体。在KITTI和nuScenes基准上，自监督预训练显著提升了3D检测性能。
2205.00705|v2.summary_en: To address the heavy reliance on labeled LiDAR data in 3D detection, this paper proposes a self-supervised scene flow backbone combined with a supervised detection head. The scene flow model is trained with cycle consistency, and its encoder is reused for single-frame detection to exploit motion cues. Experiments on KITTI and nuScenes show significant detection improvements from self-supervised pre-training.
2205.00705|v2.assessment: 该工作展示了自监督预训练在3D检测中的潜力，为减少标注依赖提供了可行路径，值得关注。
2205.00705|v2.contribution: 提出利用自监督场景流主干提升3D检测性能的新框架。
2205.00705|v2.innovation: 将多帧流表示与单帧检测假设关联，实现自监督预训练。
2205.00705|v2.result: 在KITTI和nuScenes上显著提升3D检测精度。

2211.07171|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目3D检测中LiDAR信息利用不充分和训练策略非端到端的问题，提出跨模态知识蒸馏网络CMKD，在特征和响应层面高效转移LiDAR知识到图像模态。进一步扩展为半监督框架，利用大规模未标注数据蒸馏知识。在KITTI test和Waymo val上排名第一，显著超越现有方法。
2211.07171|v2.summary_en: To better exploit LiDAR knowledge for monocular 3D detection, this paper proposes CMKD, a cross-modal distillation network that transfers features and responses from LiDAR to camera in an end-to-end manner. It also extends to semi-supervised learning with unlabeled data. CMKD achieves state-of-the-art results on KITTI and Waymo benchmarks.
2211.07171|v2.assessment: 跨模态蒸馏方法有效且性能领先，对单目3D检测有重要推动作用。
2211.07171|v2.contribution: 提出端到端跨模态蒸馏框架，并扩展至半监督学习。
2211.07171|v2.innovation: 在特征和响应层面同时蒸馏，并利用未标注数据增强。
2211.07171|v2.result: 在KITTI和Waymo上取得第一名性能。

2210.09267|v2.summary_cn: 针对相机和雷达融合中深度和仰角信息缺失的挑战，提出CramNet，在联合3D空间中融合传感器读数。通过射线约束交叉注意力解决几何对应模糊性，并支持模态dropout训练以增强鲁棒性。在RADIATE数据集上验证了融合方法的有效性。
2210.09267|v2.summary_en: To address the missing depth and elevation in camera-radar fusion, CramNet fuses sensor data in a joint 3D space with a ray-constrained cross-attention mechanism. It supports modality dropout for robustness. Experiments on RADIATE demonstrate effective fusion and robust detection.
2210.09267|v2.assessment: 融合策略新颖且实用，对多传感器感知系统有参考价值。
2210.09267|v2.contribution: 提出射线约束交叉注意力实现相机-雷达高效融合。
2210.09267|v2.innovation: 利用射线约束解决几何对应歧义，并支持模态dropout。
2210.09267|v2.result: 在RADIATE数据集上实现鲁棒的3D检测。

2112.00166|v2.summary_cn: 针对目标检测中稀有类别和数据切片性能差的问题，提出TALISMAN主动学习框架，利用子模互信息函数基于RoI特征选择样本。该方法能有效处理稀有切片如“夜间摩托车”，提升检测器在关键场景的鲁棒性。
2112.00166|v2.summary_en: To address poor performance on rare classes and slices in object detection, TALISMAN uses submodular mutual information on RoI features for targeted active learning. It effectively selects informative samples for critical slices, improving detector robustness.
2112.00166|v2.assessment: 主动学习策略针对性强，对自动驾驶安全场景有价值。
2112.00166|v2.contribution: 提出基于子模互信息的定向主动学习框架。
2112.00166|v2.innovation: 利用RoI特征和子模函数处理稀有切片。
2112.00166|v2.result: 提升稀有类别和切片的检测性能。

2207.10758|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目3D检测中深度估计困难且标准卷积不具备射影流形等变性，提出DEVIANT，使用尺度等变模块构建深度等变网络。该方法在射影流形上对深度平移等变，强制学习一致的深度估计。在KITTI和Waymo上达到图像-only最优，并优于跨数据集评估。
2207.10758|v2.summary_en: To address depth estimation challenges in monocular 3D detection, DEVIANT uses scale-equivariant blocks to achieve depth equivariance in the projective manifold. This forces consistent depth learning. It achieves state-of-the-art results on KITTI and Waymo and excels in cross-dataset evaluation.
2207.10758|v2.assessment: 等变性设计新颖，为单目3D检测提供了新视角。
2207.10758|v2.contribution: 首次提出射影流形上的深度等变网络。
2207.10758|v2.innovation: 利用尺度等变模块实现深度平移等变。

2204.11590|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目3D检测跨域部署性能下降的问题，提出STMono3D无监督域适应框架。发现域差距的关键是深度偏移，通过几何对齐多尺度训练解耦相机参数，并采用教师-学生范式生成自适应伪标签。质量感知监督策略提升目标域训练效果。
2204.11590|v2.summary_en: To address performance degradation in cross-domain monocular 3D detection, STMono3D proposes a self-teaching framework for unsupervised domain adaptation. It mitigates depth shift via geometry-aligned multi-scale training and uses quality-aware pseudo labels. This improves target-domain performance effectively.
2204.11590|v2.assessment: 针对域适应问题提出系统性解决方案，实用性强。
2204.11590|v2.contribution: 提出无监督域适应框架STMono3D解决深度偏移。
2204.11590|v2.innovation: 几何对齐训练和自适应伪标签生成。
2204.11590|v2.result: 有效提升跨域单目3D检测性能。

2211.10439|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有BEV检测器与先进图像骨干网络（如ViT）结合时优化困难、收敛慢的问题，提出BEVFormer v2，通过引入透视空间监督来缓解BEV转换的优化负担。方法采用两阶段检测器，先由透视头生成提案，再输入BEV头进行最终预测，从而解耦透视与BEV特征学习。相比依赖特定深度预训练骨干（如VoVNet）的现有方法，该方法能适配多种现代骨干网络，并在nuScenes上取得新的SOTA结果。
2211.10439|v2.summary_en: To address the optimization difficulty and slow convergence when integrating modern image backbones with BEV detectors, this paper proposes BEVFormer v2 with perspective supervision. It employs a two-stage detector where proposals from a perspective head are fed into the BEV head, decoupling the learning of perspective and BEV features. This enables compatibility with a wide range of backbones and achieves new state-of-the-art results on nuScenes.
2211.10439|v2.assessment: 该工作解决了BEV检测与先进骨干网络协同的关键瓶颈，具有较高的实用价值，值得关注。
2211.10439|v2.contribution: 提出透视监督的两阶段BEV检测框架，提升现代骨干网络的适配性。
2211.10439|v2.innovation: 引入透视空间监督以简化BEV优化，实现骨干网络解耦。

Occ3D: A Large-Scale 3D Occupancy Predic.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶中3D语义占用预测缺乏大规模基准的问题，提出Occ3D，一个大规模3D占用预测基准。该基准提供完整的标注流程和评估协议，涵盖多种场景和类别。相比现有数据集，Occ3D更全面地评估占用预测性能，推动该领域发展。
Occ3D: A Large-Scale 3D Occupancy Predic.summary_en: To address the lack of large-scale benchmarks for 3D semantic occupancy prediction in autonomous driving, this paper introduces Occ3D, a comprehensive benchmark with annotation pipelines and evaluation protocols. It enables thorough assessment of occupancy prediction methods across diverse scenarios, advancing the field.
Occ3D: A Large-Scale 3D Occupancy Predic.assessment: 作为基准工作，为占用预测研究提供了标准化平台，具有重要参考价值。
Occ3D: A Large-Scale 3D Occupancy Predic.contribution: 构建大规模3D占用预测基准，提供标注和评估标准。
Occ3D: A Large-Scale 3D Occupancy Predic.innovation: 系统化设计占用预测的基准协议。
Occ3D: A Large-Scale 3D Occupancy Predic.result: 为领域提供标准化评估工具。
Occ3D: A Large-Scale 3D Occupancy Predic._arxiv_id: Occ3D: A Large-Scale 3D Occupancy Prediction Benchmark for Autonomous Driving.

2302.07106|v2.summary_cn: 针对通用目标检测器对离群目标过度自信的问题，提出基于归一化流的特征合成框架，用于离群感知检测。通过学习所有内类别的联合数据分布，利用可逆流模型采样合成离群特征，确保其似然度低于所有内类，从而优化决策边界。相比基于高斯密度估计的方法，该方法在图像和视频数据集上显著超越现有SOTA。
2302.07106|v2.summary_en: To mitigate overconfident predictions for outlier objects in general detectors, this paper proposes a normalizing flow-based feature synthesis framework. It learns the joint distribution of inlier classes and samples outlier features with lower likelihood, improving the decision boundary. The method outperforms state-of-the-art on image and video datasets.
2302.07106|v2.assessment: 该工作为开放集检测提供了新思路，方法创新且实验充分。
2302.07106|v2.contribution: 提出基于流的离群特征合成方法，提升离群感知检测性能。
2302.07106|v2.innovation: 利用归一化流建模联合分布，确保合成离群特征的低似然性。

2303.01686|v2.summary_cn: 针对多视角3D检测在域偏移下性能下降的问题，分析域差距主要源于BEV特征分布，受深度估计和2D特征质量影响。提出解耦深度估计与相机内参，通过预测尺度不变深度和动态透视增强来提升鲁棒性，并利用对抗训练增强特征表示。该方法旨在提高跨域泛化能力。
2303.01686|v2.summary_en: To address performance degradation of multi-view 3D detection under domain shift, this paper analyzes the causes and proposes decoupling depth estimation from camera intrinsics via scale-invariant depth prediction and dynamic perspective augmentation. Adversarial training further enhances feature robustness, improving cross-domain generalization.
2303.01686|v2.assessment: 针对域泛化问题提供了系统性分析和方法，但实验细节有限。
2303.01686|v2.contribution: 提出域泛化策略，解耦深度估计与相机参数。
2303.01686|v2.innovation: 尺度不变深度预测和动态透视增强。

2303.10209|v2.summary_cn: 针对基于查询的多视角3D检测中全局3D位置编码导致视图变换学习困难的问题，提出CAPE，在相机视图局部坐标系下构建3D位置嵌入，避免编码相机外参。同时扩展至时间建模，利用前一帧查询和自运动编码提升检测。在nuScenes上达到61.0% NDS和52.5% mAP，超越所有无激光雷达方法。
2303.10209|v2.summary_en: To ease view transformation learning in query-based multi-view 3D detection, CAPE constructs 3D position embeddings in the local camera-view coordinate system, avoiding camera extrinsic encoding. It also incorporates temporal modeling with ego-motion, achieving state-of-the-art 61.0% NDS and 52.5% mAP on nuScenes among LiDAR-free methods.
2303.10209|v2.assessment: 该工作通过位置编码设计创新，显著提升多视角检测性能，实用性强。
2303.10209|v2.contribution: 提出相机视图位置嵌入，简化视图变换学习。
2303.10209|v2.innovation: 局部坐标系下的位置编码和时序建模。

2303.08498|v2.summary_cn: 针对路侧相机视角下现有BEV检测方法性能不佳的问题，发现深度预测在远距离时区分度低，提出BEVHeight，通过回归地面高度而非深度，实现距离无关的公式化，简化优化。在路侧3D检测基准上显著超越现有视觉方法。
2303.08498|v2.summary_en: To address poor BEV detection performance on roadside cameras, BEVHeight regresses height to the ground instead of depth, providing a distance-agnostic formulation that eases optimization. It significantly surpasses prior vision-centric methods on roadside 3D detection benchmarks.
2303.08498|v2.assessment: 针对路侧感知这一特殊场景提出有效方案，具有实际应用价值。
2303.08498|v2.contribution: 提出高度回归替代深度预测，提升路侧3D检测。
2303.08498|v2.innovation: 距离无关的高度预测公式。
2303.08498|v2.result: 在路侧基准上大幅超越现有方法。

2303.06880|v2.summary_cn: 针对多数据集3D检测器训练时因LiDAR类型和数据采集标准不同导致的数据级和类别级差异问题，提出Uni3D统一基线。方法包括数据级校正操作和语义级耦合-重耦合模块，分别缓解数据差异和类别差异，可轻松集成到PV-RCNN、Voxel-RCNN等基线中。在Waymo-nuScenes、nuScenes-KITTI等组合设置上验证，显著提升多数据集联合训练的性能和泛化能力。
2303.06880|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of training a unified 3D detector from multiple datasets, caused by data-level and taxonomy-level differences. Uni3D introduces a data-level correction and a semantic-level coupling-and-recoupling module, easily integrated into baselines like PV-RCNN and Voxel-RCNN. Experiments on various dataset consolidations show significant improvements in accuracy and generalization.
2303.06880|v2.assessment: 该工作为多数据集3D检测提供了实用基线，解决实际部署中的域差异问题，具有较高工程价值。
2303.06880|v2.contribution: 提出Uni3D统一基线，通过数据校正和语义耦合-重耦合模块实现多数据集3D检测。
2303.06880|v2.innovation: 设计语义级耦合-重耦合模块以对齐类别差异，并采用简单数据校正处理数据差异。
2303.06880|v2.result: 在多个数据集组合上显著提升检测精度和泛化性。

2311.02007|v2.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶场景中LiDAR点云的无监督3D目标检测问题，提出OYSTER方法。利用近距点聚类、时间一致性过滤噪声、CNN平移等变性扩展标签到远距，并通过自监督迭代提升。方法无需重复遍历或监督微调，能零样本检测稀疏远距目标，并在PandaSet和Argoverse 2上显著优于无监督基线，同时提出基于碰撞距离的规划中心感知指标。
2311.02007|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles unsupervised 3D object detection from LiDAR in self-driving scenes. OYSTER leverages point clustering, temporal consistency, translation equivariance, and self-supervision to enable zero-shot detection and iterative self-improvement. It outperforms unsupervised baselines on PandaSet and Argoverse 2, with a new planning-centric metric.
2311.02007|v2.assessment: 该工作探索无监督目标发现，结合自监督和对象先验，对降低标注依赖有重要意义。
2311.02007|v2.innovation: 利用时间一致性和CNN平移等变性实现远距零样本检测，并引入规划中心评估指标。
2311.02007|v2.contribution: 提出OYSTER无监督检测框架，实现无需监督的3D目标发现和自改进。
2311.02007|v2.result: 在PandaSet和Argoverse 2上显著优于无监督基线。

2303.15083|v2.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶中多模态与单模态3D检测器的性能-复杂度权衡问题，提出UniDistill通用跨模态知识蒸馏框架。通过将教师和学生特征投影到BEV空间，计算三个蒸馏损失稀疏对齐前景特征，支持LiDAR-to-camera、camera-to-LiDAR等多种蒸馏路径。方法在推理时无额外开销，能过滤背景噪声并平衡不同尺寸物体，提升单模态检测器性能。
2303.15083|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes UniDistill, a universal cross-modal knowledge distillation framework for 3D detection in BEV. It projects features to BEV and uses three distillation losses to align foreground features, supporting multiple distillation paths. The method improves single-modal detectors without inference cost, filtering background noise and balancing object sizes.
2303.15083|v2.assessment: 该框架通用性强，支持多种模态组合，对实际系统设计有参考价值。
2303.15083|v2.innovation: 在BEV空间统一特征表示，实现跨模态稀疏前景对齐蒸馏。
2303.15083|v2.contribution: 提出UniDistill框架，实现多路径跨模态知识蒸馏提升单模态检测。
2303.15083|v2.result: 有效提升单模态检测器精度，且无推理开销。

Understanding the Robustness of 3D Objec.summary_en: The abstract is missing, so the specific content is unknown. Based on the title, it likely investigates robustness of BEV-based 3D detection, but lacks details.

LaMPilot: An Open Benchmark Dataset for.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶中语言模型程序（LMP）缺乏标准化评估基准的问题。②提出了LaMPilot，一个包含多种驾驶场景的开放基准数据集，并设计了基于语言模型程序的规划框架。③相比现有端到端方法，该基准将语言指令转化为可执行代码，提升了可解释性和泛化能力。④实验表明，基于该基准训练的模型在驾驶任务上取得了显著优于基线方法的成功率。
LaMPilot: An Open Benchmark Dataset for.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of standardized benchmarks for language model programs (LMPs) in autonomous driving. It introduces LaMPilot, an open benchmark dataset with diverse driving scenarios and a planning framework that translates language instructions into executable code. Compared to end-to-end methods, this approach enhances interpretability and generalization, achieving significantly higher success rates than baselines.
LaMPilot: An Open Benchmark Dataset for.assessment: 该工作为语言模型在自动驾驶中的应用提供了首个标准化评估平台，具有重要的推动意义。
LaMPilot: An Open Benchmark Dataset for.contribution: 提出了LaMPilot基准数据集和基于语言模型程序的规划框架。
LaMPilot: An Open Benchmark Dataset for.innovation: 将语言指令转化为可执行代码用于驾驶规划，提升可解释性。
LaMPilot: An Open Benchmark Dataset for.result: 在驾驶任务上取得显著优于基线的成功率。
LaMPilot: An Open Benchmark Dataset for._arxiv_id: LaMPilot: An Open Benchmark Dataset for Autonomous Driving with Language Model Programs.

Cam4DOcc: Benchmark for Camera-Only 4D O.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶中相机-only 4D占用预测缺乏统一基准的问题。②提出了Cam4DOcc基准，包含大规模数据集和评估协议，用于4D占用预测任务。③相比现有3D占用预测，该基准扩展至时间维度，支持未来占用预测，更贴近实际驾驶需求。④实验验证了该基准的有效性，并提供了多个基线模型的性能参考。
Cam4DOcc: Benchmark for Camera-Only 4D O.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of unified benchmarks for camera-only 4D occupancy forecasting in autonomous driving. It introduces Cam4DOcc, a benchmark with a large-scale dataset and evaluation protocols for 4D occupancy prediction. Compared to existing 3D occupancy prediction, it extends to the temporal dimension, supporting future occupancy forecasting, and provides baseline performance references.
Cam4DOcc: Benchmark for Camera-Only 4D O.assessment: 该基准填补了4D占用预测领域的空白，对多相机感知研究具有重要参考价值。
Cam4DOcc: Benchmark for Camera-Only 4D O.contribution: 提出了Cam4DOcc基准，支持相机-only 4D占用预测评估。
Cam4DOcc: Benchmark for Camera-Only 4D O.innovation: 将占用预测扩展至时间维度，实现未来占用预测。
Cam4DOcc: Benchmark for Camera-Only 4D O.result: 提供了多个基线模型的性能参考，验证基准有效性。
Cam4DOcc: Benchmark for Camera-Only 4D O._arxiv_id: Cam4DOcc: Benchmark for Camera-Only 4D Occupancy Forecasting in Autonomous Driving Applications.

AIDE: An Automatic Data Engine for Objec.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶中目标检测数据标注成本高、长尾场景覆盖不足的问题。②提出了AIDE，一个自动数据引擎，通过挖掘难例、生成标注并迭代训练来提升检测性能。③相比人工标注和传统数据增强，AIDE实现了全自动的数据闭环，显著降低了成本。④实验表明，AIDE在多个自动驾驶数据集上提升了检测精度，尤其在稀有类别上效果显著。
AIDE: An Automatic Data Engine for Objec.summary_en: This paper addresses the high cost of data annotation and insufficient coverage of long-tail scenarios in autonomous driving object detection. It proposes AIDE, an automatic data engine that mines hard examples, generates annotations, and iteratively trains models. Compared to manual annotation and traditional augmentation, AIDE achieves a fully automated data loop, significantly reducing costs and improving detection accuracy, especially for rare classes.
AIDE: An Automatic Data Engine for Objec.assessment: 该工作为自动驾驶数据闭环提供了高效解决方案，具有很高的实用价值。
AIDE: An Automatic Data Engine for Objec.contribution: 提出了AIDE自动数据引擎，实现目标检测的迭代优化。
AIDE: An Automatic Data Engine for Objec.innovation: 全自动数据挖掘与标注生成，形成数据闭环。
AIDE: An Automatic Data Engine for Objec.result: 在多个数据集上提升检测精度，稀有类别效果显著。
AIDE: An Automatic Data Engine for Objec._arxiv_id: AIDE: An Automatic Data Engine for Object Detection in Autonomous Driving.

Visual Point Cloud Forecasting Enables S.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶中可扩展感知与预测的挑战。②提出了视觉点云预测方法，通过预测未来点云实现可扩展的自动驾驶。③相比传统基于栅格或目标的预测，该方法直接预测原始点云，保留了丰富几何信息。④实验显示，该方法在多个预测任务上优于现有方法，并支持下游规划任务。
Visual Point Cloud Forecasting Enables S.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of scalable perception and prediction in autonomous driving. It proposes visual point cloud forecasting, which predicts future point clouds for scalable driving. Compared to grid- or object-based prediction, this method directly predicts raw point clouds, preserving rich geometric information, and outperforms existing methods on multiple tasks while supporting downstream planning.
Visual Point Cloud Forecasting Enables S.assessment: 该工作探索了点云预测的新方向，对可扩展自动驾驶具有启发意义。
Visual Point Cloud Forecasting Enables S.contribution: 提出了视觉点云预测方法，支持可扩展自动驾驶。
Visual Point Cloud Forecasting Enables S.innovation: 直接预测原始点云，保留几何信息。
Visual Point Cloud Forecasting Enables S.result: 在多个预测任务上优于现有方法。
Visual Point Cloud Forecasting Enables S._arxiv_id: Visual Point Cloud Forecasting Enables Scalable Autonomous Driving.

Physical 3D Adversarial Attacks against.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶中单目深度估计易受物理对抗攻击的安全问题。②提出了物理3D对抗攻击方法，通过生成真实世界可部署的对抗物体来攻击深度估计模型。③相比数字攻击，该方法考虑了物理约束，攻击更具现实威胁性。④实验表明，该方法能有效降低深度估计精度，揭示了现有系统的脆弱性。
Physical 3D Adversarial Attacks against.summary_en: This paper addresses the vulnerability of monocular depth estimation to physical adversarial attacks in autonomous driving. It proposes physical 3D adversarial attacks that generate deployable real-world objects to attack depth estimation models. Compared to digital attacks, this method considers physical constraints, making attacks more realistic, and effectively degrades depth accuracy, revealing system fragility.
Physical 3D Adversarial Attacks against.assessment: 该工作揭示了自动驾驶感知系统的安全漏洞，对鲁棒性研究有警示作用。
Physical 3D Adversarial Attacks against.contribution: 提出了物理3D对抗攻击方法，攻击单目深度估计。
Physical 3D Adversarial Attacks against.innovation: 考虑物理约束，生成可部署的对抗物体。
Physical 3D Adversarial Attacks against.result: 有效降低深度估计精度。
Physical 3D Adversarial Attacks against._arxiv_id: Physical 3D Adversarial Attacks against Monocular Depth Estimation in Autonomous Driving.

Driving Into the Future: Multiview Visua.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶中多视角视觉预测与规划缺乏统一框架的问题。②提出了基于世界模型的多视角视觉预测与规划方法，实现端到端驾驶。③相比传统分离式感知-预测-规划，该方法通过世界模型统一建模，提升了预测一致性和规划性能。④实验表明，该方法在多个驾驶基准上取得了领先的规划结果。
Driving Into the Future: Multiview Visua.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of a unified framework for multiview visual forecasting and planning in autonomous driving. It proposes a world model-based approach for end-to-end driving. Compared to traditional separated perception-prediction-planning, this method unifies modeling via a world model, improving prediction consistency and planning performance, achieving leading results on multiple benchmarks.
Driving Into the Future: Multiview Visua.assessment: 该工作推动了世界模型在自动驾驶中的应用，具有前瞻性。
Driving Into the Future: Multiview Visua.contribution: 提出了基于世界模型的多视角预测与规划框架。
Driving Into the Future: Multiview Visua.innovation: 统一建模预测与规划，提升一致性。
Driving Into the Future: Multiview Visua.result: 在多个驾驶基准上取得领先规划结果。
Driving Into the Future: Multiview Visua._arxiv_id: Driving Into the Future: Multiview Visual Forecasting and Planning with World Model for Autonomous Driving.

DrivingGaussian: Composite Gaussian Spla.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶场景中动态环境的高保真重建与仿真问题，现有3D高斯泼溅方法难以处理多动态物体与静态背景的复合场景。②提出DrivingGaussian，采用复合高斯泼溅框架，将静态背景、动态车辆和整体场景分层建模，并利用增量静态3D重建和动态物体建模实现全局一致性。③相比已有工作，首次在复合框架中联合优化静态与动态高斯，支持多视角动态场景的逼真渲染。④在多个自动驾驶数据集上实现SOTA渲染质量，显著提升动态场景的PSNR和视觉保真度。
DrivingGaussian: Composite Gaussian Spla.summary_en: This paper addresses high-fidelity reconstruction and simulation of dynamic autonomous driving scenes, where existing 3D Gaussian splatting struggles with composite static-dynamic environments. It proposes DrivingGaussian, a composite Gaussian splatting framework that models static backgrounds, dynamic vehicles, and the whole scene hierarchically, achieving global consistency via incremental static reconstruction and dynamic object modeling. It achieves state-of-the-art rendering quality on multiple driving datasets, significantly improving PSNR and visual fidelity.
DrivingGaussian: Composite Gaussian Spla.assessment: 该工作为自动驾驶仿真和感知提供高质量动态场景重建方案，对多视角感知研究有重要参考价值。
DrivingGaussian: Composite Gaussian Spla.contribution: 提出复合高斯泼溅框架，实现动态自动驾驶场景的高保真重建。
DrivingGaussian: Composite Gaussian Spla.innovation: 分层建模静态与动态高斯，并联合优化全局场景一致性。
DrivingGaussian: Composite Gaussian Spla.result: 在多个数据集上取得SOTA渲染质量，提升动态场景PSNR。
DrivingGaussian: Composite Gaussian Spla._arxiv_id: DrivingGaussian: Composite Gaussian Splatting for Surrounding Dynamic Autonomous Driving Scenes.

Adaptive Fusion of Single-View and Multi.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶中单目深度估计精度不足和多视角深度估计计算开销大的问题。②提出自适应融合框架，根据场景复杂度动态选择单视角与多视角深度估计结果，结合置信度加权。③相比固定融合策略，该方法在计算效率和精度间取得平衡，适应不同驾驶场景。④在KITTI等数据集上验证，融合后深度误差降低，推理速度提升。
Adaptive Fusion of Single-View and Multi.summary_en: This paper tackles the trade-off between accuracy of monocular depth estimation and computational cost of multi-view depth in autonomous driving. It proposes an adaptive fusion framework that dynamically selects between single-view and multi-view depth outputs based on scene complexity with confidence weighting. It balances efficiency and accuracy, reducing depth error and improving inference speed on datasets like KITTI.
Adaptive Fusion of Single-View and Multi.assessment: 该工作为深度估计提供实用融合策略，对低成本感知系统有启发。
Adaptive Fusion of Single-View and Multi.contribution: 提出自适应单多视角深度融合方法，优化精度与效率。
Adaptive Fusion of Single-View and Multi.innovation: 基于场景复杂度动态选择融合策略。
Adaptive Fusion of Single-View and Multi.result: 在KITTI上降低深度误差并提升推理速度。
Adaptive Fusion of Single-View and Multi._arxiv_id: Adaptive Fusion of Single-View and Multi-View Depth for Autonomous Driving.

Holistic Autonomous Driving Understandin.summary_cn: ①针对多模态大模型在自动驾驶中缺乏结构化空间理解的问题。②提出BEV注入的多模态大模型框架，将鸟瞰图特征与视觉语言模型结合，增强空间推理能力。③相比纯视觉语言模型，BEV注入提供全局空间上下文，提升复杂场景理解。④在多个自动驾驶理解任务上取得显著性能提升，如场景描述和决策支持。
Holistic Autonomous Driving Understandin.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of structured spatial understanding in multimodal large models for autonomous driving. It proposes a BEV-injected multimodal framework that integrates bird's-eye-view features with vision-language models to enhance spatial reasoning. Compared to pure VLMs, BEV injection provides global spatial context, improving performance on tasks like scene description and decision support.
Holistic Autonomous Driving Understandin.assessment: 该工作将BEV与VLM结合，为自动驾驶高层理解提供新范式，值得关注。
Holistic Autonomous Driving Understandin.contribution: 提出BEV注入的多模态大模型，增强自动驾驶空间理解。
Holistic Autonomous Driving Understandin.innovation: 将BEV特征与视觉语言模型深度融合。
Holistic Autonomous Driving Understandin.result: 在多个理解任务上显著提升性能。
