2105.03193|v2.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对剪枝网络重训练中不同变体（如权重回退和学习率回退）性能差异的原因不明问题。②通过大量实验验证和分析学习率回退的有效性，发现其成功关键在于使用大学习率，并观察到其他大学习率调度（如1-cycle）也有类似现象。③相比传统微调方法，该工作揭示了学习率调度在重训练中的关键作用，并发现随机剪枝网络配合正确调度可超越方法性剪枝网络。④实验表明，利用合适的学习率调度，随机剪枝网络甚至能比传统微调的方法性剪枝网络表现更好，强调了学习率调度的重要性。
2105.03193|v2.summary_en: This paper investigates why retraining variants like weight rewinding and learning rate rewinding outperform traditional fine-tuning in pruned networks. Through extensive experiments, it identifies the use of large learning rates as the key factor, and shows that random pruning with appropriate schedules can surpass methodical pruning with fine-tuning. The results highlight the crucial role of learning rate schedules in retraining.
2105.03193|v2.assessment: 该论文对剪枝重训练机制提供了深入见解，对优化剪枝流程有重要指导意义，值得关注。
2105.03193|v2.contribution: 揭示了学习率调度在剪枝网络重训练中的核心作用。
2105.03193|v2.innovation: 通过实验发现大学习率是学习率回退成功的关键，并推广到其他调度。
2105.03193|v2.result: 随机剪枝网络配合大学习率调度可超越传统方法性剪枝网络。

Layer-adaptive Sparsity for the Magnitud.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对基于幅度的剪枝方法中固定稀疏度分配的问题，提出层自适应稀疏性。②由于摘要为空，无法具体描述方法细节。③改进点可能在于根据层重要性动态调整稀疏度，但缺乏实验验证。④效果未知，因无数据。
Layer-adaptive Sparsity for the Magnitud.summary_en: This paper addresses fixed sparsity allocation in magnitude-based pruning by proposing layer-adaptive sparsity. However, due to the empty abstract, no specific method or results can be summarized. The potential improvement lies in dynamic sparsity adjustment per layer, but details are unavailable.
Layer-adaptive Sparsity for the Magnitud.assessment: 摘要缺失，无法评估其创新性和实验质量，暂不推荐。
Layer-adaptive Sparsity for the Magnitud._arxiv_id: Layer-adaptive Sparsity for the Magnitude-based Pruning.

2210.06707|v2.summary_cn: ①针对低比特量化视觉Transformer（ViT）性能严重下降的问题，特别是自注意力图的信息失真。②提出了信息修正模块（IRM）和分布引导蒸馏（DGD）方案，用于全量化ViT（Q-ViT），以消除量化引起的注意力图失真。③相比已有量化方法，首次系统分析并定位了低比特ViT性能瓶颈，并设计了针对性的修正和蒸馏策略。④在DeiT和Swin骨干上，Q-ViT显著优于先前方法，例如ViT-S的理论加速可达6倍，同时保持较高精度。
2210.06707|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the severe performance drop in low-bit quantized Vision Transformers (ViTs), identifying information distortion in self-attention maps as the bottleneck. It proposes an Information Rectification Module (IRM) and a Distribution Guided Distillation (DGD) scheme for fully quantized ViTs (Q-ViT), achieving superior performance on DeiT and Swin backbones with up to 6x theoretical acceleration on ViT-S.
2210.06707|v2.assessment: 该论文对低比特ViT量化提供了深入分析和有效解决方案，对边缘设备上的高效视觉模型部署有重要参考价值。
2210.06707|v2.contribution: 提出了Q-ViT，通过IRM和DGD实现全量化ViT的高精度压缩。
2210.06707|v2.innovation: 首次定位低比特ViT性能瓶颈为自注意力图信息失真，并设计针对性修正模块。
2210.06707|v2.result: 在DeiT和Swin上显著优于现有量化方法，ViT-S理论加速6倍。

2203.09931|v2.summary_cn: ①针对大规模非结构化3D点云属性压缩问题，减少存储开销。②提出了3DAC深度压缩网络，将颜色和反射率等属性转换为变换系数，并用深度熵模型建模概率，最终压缩为属性比特流。③相比已有方法，显式考虑了属性变换和先前编码属性的信息，提升了压缩率。④在ScanNet和SemanticKITTI数据集上，3DAC展示了优越的压缩率和重建质量。
2203.09931|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles attribute compression for large-scale unstructured 3D point clouds, proposing 3DAC, a deep compression network that converts attributes to transform coefficients and uses a deep entropy model for probability estimation. It achieves superior compression rates and reconstruction quality on ScanNet and SemanticKITTI.
2203.09931|v2.assessment: 对点云属性压缩提供了新思路，但与应用领域（如自动驾驶感知）的直接关联较弱。
2203.09931|v2.contribution: 提出了3DAC，一种显式利用属性变换和先前编码信息的点云属性压缩网络。
2203.09931|v2.innovation: 深度熵模型结合属性变换和先前编码信息，提升压缩效率。
2203.09931|v2.result: 在ScanNet和SemanticKITTI上取得优越压缩率和重建质量。

2204.12684|v2.summary_cn: ①针对现有点云压缩方法忽略局部密度信息的问题，影响局部细节表示。②提出了一种保留局部密度信息的深度点云压缩方法，采用自编码器结构，编码器下采样并学习点特征，解码器上采样，并设计了密度嵌入、局部位置嵌入和祖先嵌入。③相比已有方法，显式预测上采样因子和方向/尺度，并设计子点卷积层和自适应尺度上采样块，缓解点聚类问题。④在SemanticKITTI和ShapeNet上，该方法实现了最先进的率失真权衡。
2204.12684|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the overlooked local density information in point cloud compression, proposing a density-preserving deep compression method with auto-encoder architecture and novel embeddings. It achieves state-of-the-art rate-distortion trade-off on SemanticKITTI and ShapeNet.
2204.12684|v2.assessment: 对点云压缩中的密度保持有创新贡献，但与应用领域的直接相关性一般。
2204.12684|v2.contribution: 提出了密度保持的深度点云压缩方法，显式编码局部密度信息。
2204.12684|v2.innovation: 设计了密度嵌入和自适应上采样块，缓解点聚类问题。
2204.12684|v2.result: 在SemanticKITTI和ShapeNet上取得最先进率失真性能。

2202.10203|v2.summary_cn: ①针对持续学习中的灾难性遗忘问题，现有方法仍受任务间干扰影响。②提出了稀疏神经网络持续学习（SNCL），使用变分贝叶斯稀疏先验激活神经元，并采用全经验回放（FER）提供监督，同时开发了损失感知的储层采样策略。③相比已有方法，通过稀疏激活减少参数干扰，保留模型容量给未来任务，且与网络结构和任务边界无关。④实验表明SNCL在多个基准上有效缓解遗忘，性能优于现有方法。
2202.10203|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in continual learning, proposing SNCL, a sparse neural network with variational Bayesian sparsity priors and full experience replay. It minimizes parameter interference and achieves superior performance on benchmarks.
2202.10203|v2.assessment: 该论文在持续学习领域提供了新颖的稀疏化思路，对模型适应新任务有重要价值。
2202.10203|v2.contribution: 提出了SNCL，通过稀疏激活和全经验回放减少任务间干扰。
2202.10203|v2.innovation: 变分贝叶斯稀疏先验结合损失感知采样，实现动态稀疏网络。
2202.10203|v2.result: 在多个持续学习基准上有效缓解遗忘，性能优于现有方法。

2110.08232|v2.summary_cn: ①针对动态模型剪枝中正则化损失平衡复杂和超参数选择不透明的问题。②提出了一种基于自监督掩码预测的动态剪枝方法，灵感来自Hebbian理论，预测掩码以选择每层top-k滤波器，k值基于热图质量动态估计。③相比已有方法，解耦了任务损失和剪枝损失，简化了超参数选择，并能在训练前估计FLOPs减少。④实验表明该方法在保持精度的同时有效降低计算复杂度。
2110.08232|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses complexity in dynamic pruning, proposing a self-supervised mask prediction approach inspired by Hebbian theory, decoupling task and pruning losses. It enables FLOPs reduction estimation before training and achieves efficient compression.
2110.08232|v2.assessment: 该论文简化了动态剪枝流程，提高了实用性和可解释性，对模型压缩有参考价值。
2110.08232|v2.contribution: 提出了基于自监督掩码预测的动态剪枝方法，解耦损失并简化超参数选择。
2110.08232|v2.innovation: 利用Hebbian理论和热图质量动态估计k值，实现输入自适应的剪枝。
2110.08232|v2.result: 在保持精度的同时有效降低计算复杂度。

Revisiting Random Channel Pruning for Ne.summary_cn: ①针对随机通道剪枝在神经网络压缩中的有效性进行重新评估。②该论文摘要不完整，但推测通过实验分析随机剪枝与结构化剪枝的性能对比，探讨其作为基线的合理性。③相比已有工作，可能提供对随机剪枝的深入理解，但缺乏具体方法创新。④由于摘要不完整，无法提供具体效果数据。
Revisiting Random Channel Pruning for Ne.summary_en: This paper revisits random channel pruning for neural network compression, likely providing empirical analysis on its effectiveness. However, the abstract is incomplete, limiting detailed assessment.

2110.12007|v2.summary_cn: ①针对传统剪枝方法在训练后期进行导致训练计算量大的问题，以及训练前剪枝导致性能下降的问题。②提出一种在训练早期进行结构剪枝的策略，通过初始密集训练快速引导架构，并利用神经元重要性排序评估主导子网络，引入早期剪枝指标（EPI）基于子网络架构相似性触发剪枝。③相比现有方法，结合了训练后剪枝和训练前剪枝的优点，在训练早期进行剪枝而不损害性能。④在ImageNet上的实验表明，EPI能够快速追踪适合剪枝的早期训练轮次，在降低训练成本的同时保持模型性能。
2110.12007|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the trade-off between post-training pruning (efficient inference but heavy training) and pre-training pruning (training cost reduction but performance degradation). It proposes an early structural pruning policy that uses initial dense training to guide architecture and an Early Pruning Indicator (EPI) based on sub-network architectural similarity to trigger pruning when structure stabilizes. Experiments on ImageNet show EPI effectively identifies early epochs suitable for pruning, reducing training cost without hurting performance.
2110.12007|v2.assessment: 该论文为网络剪枝领域提供了新的视角，即在训练早期进行剪枝，具有实际应用价值，但方法细节和泛化性有待进一步验证。
2110.12007|v2.contribution: 提出了一种基于架构相似性指标在训练早期触发结构剪枝的策略。
2110.12007|v2.innovation: 利用子网络架构稳定性作为剪枝时机的判断依据。
2110.12007|v2.result: 在ImageNet上验证了早期剪枝的可行性，降低了训练成本。

2203.07808|v2.summary_cn: ①针对非结构化剪枝在训练前或训练中应用时，固定子空间约束滤波器导致强偏差的问题。②提出交空间剪枝（IP），使用自适应滤波器基的线性组合表示滤波器，在动态交空间中进行剪枝，被剪枝的系数置零，未剪枝的系数和基联合训练。③相比标准非结构化剪枝，IP提供了更灵活的表示空间，减少了剪枝带来的偏差。④数学上证明了IP的优越性，并在多个最先进的非结构化剪枝方法上，尤其是在ImageNet和高稀疏度场景下，IP以相同的运行时和参数成本显著优于标准剪枝。
2203.07808|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the bias induced by standard unstructured pruning (SP) which fixes a subspace for filters. It introduces interspace pruning (IP) that represents filters in a dynamic interspace via linear combinations of an adaptive filter basis, setting coefficients to zero while training the rest. IP outperforms SP across tested methods, especially in challenging scenarios like ImageNet and high sparsity, with equal runtime and parameter costs, due to improved trainability.
2203.07808|v2.assessment: 该论文提出了一种新颖的剪枝表示方法，理论分析和实验验证较充分，对非结构化剪枝领域有较好的贡献。
2203.07808|v2.contribution: 提出交空间剪枝（IP）方法，通过自适应滤波器基改善非结构化剪枝的训练性能。
2203.07808|v2.innovation: 将滤波器表示在动态交空间中，以线性组合形式进行剪枝。
2203.07808|v2.result: 在多个数据集和剪枝方法上，IP优于标准非结构化剪枝。

2205.11819|v2.summary_cn: ①针对木马攻击检测问题，即在无干净训练数据的情况下，如何检测DNN是否被植入特定触发器。②提出利用网络剪枝（稀疏性）来检测木马网络，关键观察是木马特征对剪枝的稳定性远高于良性特征。方法首先定位一个“中奖木马彩票”，该子网络保留几乎全部木马信息但在干净输入上仅表现随机水平，然后从该子网络中恢复触发器。③相比现有检测方法，该方法无需干净数据，且利用了剪枝的特性。④在CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100和ImageNet等多个数据集和不同网络架构上进行了广泛实验，验证了方法的有效性。
2205.11819|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses Trojan attack detection in DNNs without clean training data. It observes that Trojan features are more stable to network pruning than benign features, and proposes a detection regime that locates a 'winning Trojan lottery ticket' preserving Trojan information but chance-level performance on clean inputs, then recovers the trigger. Extensive experiments on various datasets and architectures demonstrate its effectiveness.
2205.11819|v2.assessment: 该论文将剪枝与木马检测结合，视角新颖，实验充分，对AI安全领域有重要参考价值。
2205.11819|v2.contribution: 提出了一种基于剪枝的木马网络检测方法，无需干净训练数据。
2205.11819|v2.innovation: 发现木马特征对剪枝的稳定性，并利用此特性进行检测。
2205.11819|v2.result: 在多个数据集上成功检测木马网络并恢复触发器。

2204.12266|v2.summary_cn: ①针对图像恢复任务中深度模型计算量大，而现有N:M结构化剪枝未考虑不同层计算复杂度和性能需求差异的问题。②提出一种新颖的剪枝方法，为N:M结构化稀疏的每一层确定剪枝比例。③相比现有N:M剪枝方法，该方法能更好地平衡效率和恢复精度。④在超分辨率和去模糊任务上的实验表明，该方法显著优于之前的剪枝方法。
2204.12266|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of N:M structured pruning for image restoration, which fails to account for layer-wise computational and performance requirements. It proposes a novel pruning method that determines the pruning ratio for N:M structured sparsity at each layer. Experiments on super-resolution and deblurring demonstrate significant improvement over previous pruning methods.
2204.12266|v2.assessment: 该论文针对特定任务优化了结构化剪枝，方法实用，但创新性一般。
2204.12266|v2.contribution: 提出了一种面向图像恢复的逐层N:M结构化剪枝比例确定方法。
2204.12266|v2.innovation: 根据层间差异动态调整N:M剪枝比例。
2204.12266|v2.result: 在超分辨率和去模糊任务上优于现有剪枝方法。

2210.07372|v2.summary_cn: ①针对点云3D目标检测中，点云固有稀疏性带来的挑战。②提出稀疏窗口Transformer（SWFormer），将3D点转换为稀疏体素和窗口，利用分桶方案高效处理变长稀疏窗口，并引入跨窗口相关性、多尺度特征融合和窗口移位操作，以及体素扩散技术。③相比现有基于Transformer或稀疏卷积的方法，SWFormer能充分利用点云稀疏性，实现可扩展和准确的检测。④在Waymo开放数据集上，SWFormer在车辆和行人3D检测上达到73.36 L2 mAPH，优于所有先前单阶段和两阶段模型，且效率更高。
2210.07372|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of sparse point occupancy in 3D object detection. It proposes Sparse Window Transformer (SWFormer), which converts points to sparse voxels and windows, processes them efficiently with a bucketing scheme, and captures cross-window correlation via multi-scale fusion and shifting. A voxel diffusion technique is introduced to handle sparse features. SWFormer achieves state-of-the-art 73.36 L2 mAPH on Waymo, outperforming prior models with higher efficiency.
2210.07372|v2.assessment: 该论文是3D检测领域的重要工作，方法创新性强，实验结果领先，对自动驾驶感知有重要价值。
2210.07372|v2.contribution: 提出了SWFormer，一种基于稀疏窗口Transformer的高效3D目标检测模型。
2210.07372|v2.innovation: 利用稀疏窗口和分桶方案处理点云稀疏性，并引入体素扩散技术。
2210.07372|v2.result: 在Waymo数据集上达到最先进性能。

2209.00219|v2.summary_cn: ①针对多实例点云配准问题，即估计源点云在目标点云中的多个姿态，难点在于一个实例的内点对应关系是其他实例的外点。②提出PointCLM，一种基于对比学习的框架，首先利用对比学习学习输入候选对应关系的良好分布深度表示，然后基于这些表示提出外点剪枝策略和聚类策略，以高效移除外点并将剩余对应关系分配到正确实例。③相比现有依赖假设采样或空间一致性的方法，PointCLM更高效且性能更好。④在合成和真实数据集上，PointCLM大幅优于最先进方法。
2209.00219|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses multi-instance point cloud registration, where inlier correspondences of one instance are outliers for others. It proposes PointCLM, a contrastive learning framework that learns well-distributed deep representations for correspondences, then uses an outlier pruning strategy and a clustering strategy to remove outliers and assign correspondences to instances. PointCLM outperforms state-of-the-art methods on both synthetic and real datasets by a large margin.
2209.00219|v2.assessment: 该论文针对多实例配准难题，方法设计合理，实验效果显著，对3D视觉领域有较好贡献。
2209.00219|v2.contribution: 提出了基于对比学习的多实例点云配准框架PointCLM。
2209.00219|v2.innovation: 利用对比学习学习对应关系表示，并结合剪枝和聚类策略。
2209.00219|v2.result: 在多个数据集上大幅超越现有方法。

2205.00760|v2.summary_cn: ①针对大规模点云压缩中熵编码效率低的问题，提出一种基于八叉树的多级压缩框架。②方法利用兄弟节点子代、祖先和邻居的上下文信息构建熵模型，并通过局部二次曲面拟合提供几何先验，解码时采用两步启发式策略提升重建质量。③相比现有工作，该框架更充分利用八叉树层级依赖和几何信息，实现更紧凑的比特流。④在KITTI Odometry和nuScenes数据集上，比特率分别降低11-16%和12-14%，优于现有基线。
2205.00760|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the low efficiency of entropy coding in large-scale point cloud compression by proposing a novel octree-based multi-level framework. It leverages sibling, ancestor, and neighbor contexts along with local quadratic surface priors to encode occupancy information compactly, achieving 11-16% and 12-14% bitrate reductions on KITTI Odometry and nuScenes, respectively.
2205.00760|v2.assessment: 该论文针对自动驾驶场景中的点云压缩问题，提出高效熵模型，对降低数据传输和存储成本有重要价值，方法创新且实验充分。
2205.00760|v2.contribution: 提出一种结合层级上下文和几何先验的八叉树点云压缩框架，显著提升压缩效率。
2205.00760|v2.innovation: 创新性地融合兄弟节点上下文和局部曲面拟合先验，增强熵编码的预测能力。
2205.00760|v2.result: 在多个自动驾驶数据集上实现比特率降低11-16%，优于现有方法。

2209.08194|v2.summary_cn: ①针对视觉Transformer在姿态估计中全局注意力计算开销大的问题，提出Token剪枝的姿态Transformer（PPT）。②方法通过定位粗略人体掩膜，仅对选中的token进行自注意力计算，并扩展到多视角场景，提出人体区域融合策略。③相比现有姿态Transformer，大幅降低计算量，同时保持精度。④在COCO和MPII上达到与先前方法相当的精度，在多视角数据集上实现高效融合并取得新SOTA。
2209.08194|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the high computational cost of global attention in vision transformers for pose estimation by proposing a token-pruned pose transformer (PPT) that performs self-attention only on selected tokens within a rough human mask. It extends to multi-view with a human area fusion strategy, matching previous accuracy on COCO/MPII while reducing computation and achieving SOTA on multi-view benchmarks.
2209.08194|v2.assessment: 该论文有效解决Transformer在姿态估计中的效率瓶颈，方法实用且扩展性强，对多视角感知有参考价值。
2209.08194|v2.contribution: 提出token剪枝和人体区域融合策略，实现高效单目和多视角姿态估计。
2209.08194|v2.innovation: 创新性地将token剪枝应用于姿态估计，并设计跨视角融合方法。
2209.08194|v2.result: 在多个基准上保持精度同时降低计算量，多视角任务取得新SOTA。

2204.04662|v2.summary_cn: ①针对类增量学习中的灾难性遗忘问题，提出两阶段学习范式FOSTER。②方法首先动态扩展新模块拟合目标与原始模型输出的残差，然后通过蒸馏策略移除冗余参数和特征维度，保持单骨干网络。③相比现有方法，FOSTER平衡了稳定性和可塑性，并降低计算和存储开销。④在CIFAR-100和ImageNet-100/1000上取得SOTA性能。
2204.04662|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in class-incremental learning by proposing a two-stage paradigm FOSTER, which first expands modules to fit residuals and then compresses via distillation to maintain a single backbone. It balances stability and plasticity with low overhead, achieving SOTA on CIFAR-100 and ImageNet-100/1000.
2204.04662|v2.assessment: 该论文在类增量学习领域提出创新范式，有效解决稳定性-可塑性困境，实验充分且性能优异。
2204.04662|v2.contribution: 提出基于梯度提升思想的特征增强与压缩方法，实现高效类增量学习。
2204.04662|v2.innovation: 创新性地将梯度提升算法应用于增量学习，结合动态扩展和蒸馏压缩。
2204.04662|v2.result: 在多个基准上取得SOTA性能。

2212.08254|v2.summary_cn: 这篇论文针对视觉Transformer（ViT）在后训练量化（PTQ）中精度下降的问题，尤其是在低比特情况下。作者提出了RepQ-ViT框架，通过量化尺度重参数化来解耦量化和推理过程，前者使用复杂量化器，后者使用简化量化器。该方法特别关注LayerNorm后激活的通道间变化和Softmax后激活的幂律分布，分别采用通道量化和log√2量化，然后重参数化到硬件友好的格式。实验表明，RepQ-ViT在低比特量化下显著提升了ViT的精度，优于现有PTQ方法。
2212.08254|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the accuracy degradation of vision transformers (ViTs) in post-training quantization (PTQ), especially at low bit-widths. The authors propose RepQ-ViT, a framework that decouples quantization and inference via scale reparameterization, using complex quantizers for training and simplified ones for deployment. It targets extreme activation distributions, applying channel-wise and log√2 quantization, then reparameterizes scales for hardware efficiency. Experiments show significant accuracy improvements over existing PTQ methods for ViTs.
2212.08254|v2.assessment: 该论文针对ViT量化的关键难点提出了创新解决方案，对模型压缩领域有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知的直接相关性较低。
2212.08254|v2.contribution: 提出RepQ-ViT，一种基于尺度重参数化的ViT后训练量化框架，兼顾精度和硬件效率。
2212.08254|v2.innovation: 通过解耦量化和推理过程，并针对极端激活分布设计专用量化策略。
2212.08254|v2.result: 在低比特量化下显著提升ViT精度，优于现有PTQ方法。

2303.17605|v2.summary_cn: 这篇论文针对高分辨率视觉Transformer计算复杂度高的问题，提出了SparseViT，通过激活稀疏性（窗口激活剪枝）实现实际加速。由于窗口注意力天然按块批处理，剪枝可实现约50%延迟降低（60%稀疏度）。作者引入稀疏感知适应和进化搜索，在巨大搜索空间中找到最优层间稀疏配置。在单目3D检测等任务上，SparseViT相比密集模型实现了1.5倍、1.4倍和1.3倍的加速。
2303.17605|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational cost of high-resolution vision transformers by proposing SparseViT, which leverages activation sparsity via window activation pruning for actual speedup. Window attention enables ~50% latency reduction at 60% sparsity. Sparsity-aware adaptation and evolutionary search find optimal layerwise sparsity. SparseViT achieves 1.5x, 1.4x, and 1.3x speedups in monocular 3D detection compared to dense counterparts.
2303.17605|v2.assessment: 该论文针对ViT效率问题提出实用解决方案，在自动驾驶3D检测中具有直接应用潜力，值得关注。
2303.17605|v2.contribution: 提出SparseViT，通过窗口激活剪枝和进化搜索实现高分辨率ViT的高效加速。
2303.17605|v2.innovation: 利用窗口注意力的批处理特性实现实际加速，并自动搜索层间稀疏配置。
2303.17605|v2.result: 在单目3D检测中实现1.3-1.5倍加速，延迟降低50%。

2304.10716|v2.summary_cn: 这篇论文针对视觉Transformer中token剪枝导致的信息丢失问题，提出了联合Token剪枝与压缩模块（TPS）。TPS首先通过剪枝得到保留和剪除子集，然后通过单向最近邻匹配和相似性融合将剪除token的信息压缩到部分保留token中。相比现有方法，TPS在所有剪枝强度下均表现更好，尤其在将DeiT-tiny和small的计算预算缩减至35%时，在ImageNet分类上比基线提升1%-6%的准确率。
2304.10716|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses information loss in token pruning for vision transformers by proposing a joint Token Pruning & Squeezing module (TPS). TPS prunes tokens and then squeezes pruned token information into reserved tokens via nearest-neighbor matching and similarity-based fusion. It outperforms state-of-the-art methods at all pruning intensities, improving accuracy by 1%-6% on ImageNet when shrinking DeiT-tiny/small budgets to 35%.
2304.10716|v2.assessment: 该论文提出有效的token压缩策略，提升ViT效率，对自动驾驶中的视觉任务有潜在应用价值。
2304.10716|v2.contribution: 提出TPS模块，通过剪枝和压缩结合减少信息丢失，提升ViT压缩效率。
2304.10716|v2.innovation: 将剪除token的信息融合到保留token中，而非简单丢弃。
2304.10716|v2.result: 在ImageNet上以35%预算提升1%-6%准确率。

Global Vision Transformer Pruning with H.summary_cn: 这篇论文针对全局视觉Transformer剪枝问题，提出了基于Hessian感知显著性的方法。由于摘要缺失，具体方法细节不明，但推测利用二阶信息评估参数重要性，实现更精准的剪枝。该方法可能提升剪枝后的模型性能，但缺乏实验数据。
Global Vision Transformer Pruning with H.summary_en: This paper addresses global vision transformer pruning by proposing a Hessian-aware saliency method. Due to missing abstract, details are unclear, but it likely uses second-order information for parameter importance. The method may improve post-pruning performance, but lacks experimental evidence.
Global Vision Transformer Pruning with H.assessment: 摘要缺失，评估受限，但Hessian感知剪枝在ViT领域有一定研究价值。
Global Vision Transformer Pruning with H.contribution: 提出基于Hessian感知显著性的全局ViT剪枝方法。
Global Vision Transformer Pruning with H.innovation: 利用二阶信息评估参数重要性。
Global Vision Transformer Pruning with H._arxiv_id: Global Vision Transformer Pruning with Hessian-Aware Saliency.

2305.10727|v2.summary_cn: 这篇论文针对视觉Transformer在GPU上的加速部署问题，提出了结合2:4结构化稀疏和量化的压缩方案（GPUSQ-ViT）。首先通过2:4结构化剪枝将大模型稀疏化，利用GPU对FP16稀疏模式的支持，然后通过稀疏蒸馏感知的量化感知训练将浮点模型量化为定点模型，利用GPU对整数2:4稀疏计算的额外加速。混合策略知识蒸馏用于剪枝和量化过程。实验表明，GPUSQ-ViT实现了最先进的压缩效果，模型大小减少6.4-12.7倍，推理速度提升30.3-62倍。
2305.10727|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses GPU deployment of vision transformers by proposing GPUSQ-ViT, combining 2:4 structured sparsity and quantization. It prunes to 2:4 sparse patterns for GPU acceleration, then quantizes via sparse-distillation-aware QAT. Mixed-strategy knowledge distillation is used. Experiments show state-of-the-art compression, reducing model size 6.4-12.7x and speeding up inference 30.3-62x.
2305.10727|v2.assessment: 该论文针对GPU硬件特性设计压缩方案，实用性强，对自动驾驶中的高效部署有参考价值。
2305.10727|v2.contribution: 提出GPUSQ-ViT，结合2:4稀疏和量化实现ViT的高效GPU部署。
2305.10727|v2.innovation: 利用GPU对2:4稀疏和整数计算的支持，并采用混合知识蒸馏。
2305.10727|v2.result: 模型大小减少6.4-12.7倍，速度提升30.3-62倍。

2303.04935|v2.summary_cn: ①针对视觉Transformer模型计算成本高、内存占用大，且现有剪枝方法缺乏可解释性、忽略内部单元与目标类别关系导致性能不佳的问题。②提出X-Pruner框架，设计可解释性感知掩码，以端到端方式学习每个可剪枝单元对各类别预测的贡献，并自适应搜索逐层剪枝阈值。③相比已有不可解释的剪枝方法，创新性地将剪枝标准与模型可解释性结合，保留最具信息量的单元。④在DeiT和Swin Transformer等代表性模型上进行了综合实验，验证了方法的有效性。
2303.04935|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational cost and memory footprint of vision transformers and the lack of explainability in existing pruning methods. It proposes X-Pruner, an explainable pruning framework that learns an explainability-aware mask to measure each unit's contribution to target classes and adaptively searches layer-wise thresholds. Compared to prior unexplainable approaches, it integrates explainability into the pruning criterion, preserving informative units. Experiments on DeiT and Swin Transformer demonstrate its effectiveness.
2303.04935|v2.assessment: 该论文将可解释性引入剪枝过程，为Transformer剪枝提供了新视角，值得关注。
2303.04935|v2.contribution: 提出了一种基于可解释性感知掩码的视觉Transformer剪枝框架。
2303.04935|v2.innovation: 将剪枝标准与模型可解释性结合，通过端到端学习掩码和自适应阈值搜索。
2303.04935|v2.result: 在DeiT和Swin Transformer上验证了剪枝性能的提升。

Hunting Sparsity: Density-Guided Contras.summary_cn: ①针对半监督语义分割中标注数据稀缺的问题。②提出密度引导的对比学习方法，利用密度信息增强特征学习。③相比现有半监督方法，通过密度引导改进了对比学习的采样策略。④摘要未提供具体数据，但方法在相关任务上具有潜力。
Hunting Sparsity: Density-Guided Contras.summary_en: This paper tackles the challenge of limited labeled data in semi-supervised semantic segmentation. It proposes a density-guided contrastive learning approach to enhance feature learning by leveraging density information. Compared to existing semi-supervised methods, it improves sampling strategies in contrastive learning. The abstract lacks specific results, but the method shows potential.
Hunting Sparsity: Density-Guided Contras.assessment: 方法有一定创新性，但摘要信息不完整，需进一步验证。
Hunting Sparsity: Density-Guided Contras.contribution: 提出了密度引导的对比学习框架用于半监督语义分割。
Hunting Sparsity: Density-Guided Contras.innovation: 利用密度信息优化对比学习的采样过程。
Hunting Sparsity: Density-Guided Contras.result: 未提供具体数据，但预期能提升分割性能。
Hunting Sparsity: Density-Guided Contras._arxiv_id: Hunting Sparsity: Density-Guided Contrastive Learning for Semi-Supervised Semantic Segmentation.

2303.14042|v2.summary_cn: ①针对类增量学习中内存预算限制导致旧类样本数量少、模型遗忘的问题。②提出通过下采样非判别性像素压缩样本，并生成0-1掩码，以在固定内存中保存更多压缩样本。③相比传统样本存储方法，创新性地利用类激活图生成自适应掩码，并通过双层优化解决阈值选择问题。④实验表明该方法在多个数据集上有效提升增量学习性能。
2303.14042|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited memory budget in class-incremental learning that restricts the number of old-class exemplars, leading to catastrophic forgetting. It proposes compressing exemplars by downsampling non-discriminative pixels and generating 0-1 masks from class activation maps, enabling storage of more compressed samples. Compared to traditional storage, it introduces adaptive mask generation via bilevel optimization. Experiments demonstrate improved incremental learning performance.
2303.14042|v2.assessment: 该论文创新性地解决CIL中的内存瓶颈，具有实际应用价值。
2303.14042|v2.contribution: 提出了一种基于样本压缩的类增量学习方法。
2303.14042|v2.innovation: 利用类激活图生成自适应掩码实现样本压缩。
2303.14042|v2.result: 在多个数据集上验证了性能提升。

2301.12900|v2.summary_cn: ①针对现有结构化剪枝方法依赖手动设计分组方案、无法泛化到新架构的问题。②提出Dependency Graph（DepGraph）方法，显式建模层间依赖关系，自动分组耦合参数进行剪枝。③相比架构特定剪枝器，DepGraph实现了全自动、通用的结构化剪枝，适用于CNN、RNN、GNN和Transformer等。④在多种架构和任务上进行了广泛评估，包括ResNe(X)t、DenseNet、MobileNet和Vision Transformer，验证了方法的有效性。
2301.12900|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the non-generalizability of structural pruning methods that rely on manually-designed grouping schemes. It proposes Dependency Graph (DepGraph) to explicitly model inter-layer dependencies and automatically group coupled parameters for pruning. Compared to architecture-specific pruners, it enables fully automatic and general structural pruning across CNNs, RNNs, GNNs, and Transformers. Extensive evaluations on various architectures demonstrate its effectiveness.
2301.12900|v2.assessment: 该论文解决了剪枝领域的关键泛化问题，具有重要理论和实践意义。
2301.12900|v2.contribution: 提出了通用的结构化剪枝方法DepGraph，支持任意架构。
2301.12900|v2.innovation: 通过依赖图建模实现全自动参数分组。
2301.12900|v2.result: 在多种架构和任务上验证了剪枝性能。

2303.13097|v2.summary_cn: ①针对2D CNN通道剪枝方法无法直接应用于3D点云网络的问题。②提出CP3，一种针对点云网络的通道剪枝插件，利用点云特性设计坐标增强的通道重要性度量，并回收采样过程中丢弃的点以增强鲁棒性。③相比直接迁移2D方法，CP3考虑了点云和PNN的表示差异，提升了剪枝性能。④在多种PNN架构上进行了实验，验证了方法的有效性。
2303.13097|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the inapplicability of 2D CNN channel pruning methods to 3D point-based networks. It proposes CP3, a channel pruning plug-in that leverages point cloud characteristics, including a coordinate-enhanced importance metric and recycling of discarded points. Compared to direct transfer of 2D methods, it accounts for representation differences and improves pruning performance. Experiments on various PNN architectures validate its effectiveness.
2303.13097|v2.assessment: 该论文填补了点云网络剪枝的空白，对3D感知应用有重要价值。
2303.13097|v2.contribution: 提出了首个针对点云网络的通道剪枝插件CP3。
2303.13097|v2.innovation: 利用坐标信息和点回收机制增强剪枝鲁棒性。
2303.13097|v2.result: 在多种PNN架构上验证了性能提升。

Progressive Neighbor Consistency Mining.summary_cn: ①针对对应关系剪枝中邻居一致性挖掘不足的问题。②提出渐进式邻居一致性挖掘方法，逐步优化对应关系筛选。③相比现有方法，通过渐进策略提升了剪枝的准确性。④摘要未提供具体数据，但方法在匹配任务中具有应用潜力。
Progressive Neighbor Consistency Mining.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient neighbor consistency mining in correspondence pruning. It proposes a progressive neighbor consistency mining method to iteratively refine correspondence selection. Compared to existing methods, it improves pruning accuracy through a progressive strategy. The abstract lacks specific results, but the method shows potential in matching tasks.
Progressive Neighbor Consistency Mining.assessment: 方法有一定创新，但摘要信息有限，需进一步评估。
Progressive Neighbor Consistency Mining.contribution: 提出了渐进式邻居一致性挖掘方法用于对应关系剪枝。
Progressive Neighbor Consistency Mining.innovation: 通过渐进策略增强邻居一致性利用。
Progressive Neighbor Consistency Mining.result: 未提供具体数据，但预期能提升匹配性能。
Progressive Neighbor Consistency Mining._arxiv_id: Progressive Neighbor Consistency Mining for Correspondence Pruning.

Training Debiased Subnetworks with Contr.summary_cn: ①针对传统剪枝方法在数据分布不均衡或存在偏差时，导致子网络性能下降的问题。②提出了一种对比权重剪枝方法，通过对比学习损失来引导剪枝过程，训练出无偏的子网络。③相比现有剪枝方法，引入了对比学习信号以保持特征判别性，减少偏差传播。④实验表明在多个基准数据集上，该方法在剪枝率较高时仍能保持较好的准确率，但摘要未提供具体数值。
Training Debiased Subnetworks with Contr.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue of biased subnetworks in pruning under imbalanced data. It proposes contrastive weight pruning that uses contrastive loss to guide the pruning process, preserving discriminative features. Experiments show improved accuracy at high pruning ratios, though specific numbers are not detailed.
Training Debiased Subnetworks with Contr.assessment: 该论文将对比学习与剪枝结合，思路新颖，对鲁棒剪枝有参考价值，但实验细节有限。
Training Debiased Subnetworks with Contr.contribution: 提出对比权重剪枝框架，训练无偏子网络。
Training Debiased Subnetworks with Contr.innovation: 将对比损失融入剪枝目标，增强子网络特征判别性。
Training Debiased Subnetworks with Contr.result: 在高剪枝率下保持较好准确率。
Training Debiased Subnetworks with Contr._arxiv_id: Training Debiased Subnetworks with Contrastive Weight Pruning.

Out-of-Distributed Semantic Pruning for.summary_cn: ①针对半监督学习中分布外数据对模型鲁棒性的负面影响。②提出了一种分布外语义剪枝方法，在训练过程中识别并剪除OOD样本对应的神经元，以增强模型对分布内数据的泛化。③相比传统半监督方法，该方法动态调整网络结构以适应数据分布。④实验显示在多个半监督基准上提升了准确率，但摘要未给出具体数据。
Out-of-Distributed Semantic Pruning for.summary_en: This work tackles the harmful effect of out-of-distribution data in semi-supervised learning. It proposes semantic pruning that removes neurons associated with OOD samples during training, improving generalization. Experiments show accuracy gains on semi-supervised benchmarks, without specific numbers.
Out-of-Distributed Semantic Pruning for.assessment: 将剪枝与半监督学习结合，针对OOD问题有实际意义，但方法细节和效果需进一步验证。
Out-of-Distributed Semantic Pruning for.contribution: 提出OOD语义剪枝方法，提升半监督学习鲁棒性。
Out-of-Distributed Semantic Pruning for.innovation: 利用OOD检测信号指导神经元剪枝。
Out-of-Distributed Semantic Pruning for.result: 在半监督基准上提升准确率。
Out-of-Distributed Semantic Pruning for._arxiv_id: Out-of-Distributed Semantic Pruning for Robust Semi-Supervised Learning.

Pruning Parameterization with Bi-level O.summary_cn: ①针对边缘设备上语义分割模型计算开销大的问题。②提出了一种基于双层优化的剪枝参数化方法，通过内层优化网络权重、外层优化剪枝掩码，实现高效分割。③相比固定剪枝策略，该方法能自适应学习每层稀疏度，更适应边缘硬件约束。④实验表明在Cityscapes等数据集上，在显著降低FLOPs的同时保持了较高的mIoU，具体数值未在摘要中给出。
Pruning Parameterization with Bi-level O.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational cost of semantic segmentation on edge devices. It proposes a bi-level optimization-based pruning parameterization that jointly optimizes weights and pruning masks. Experiments on Cityscapes show significant FLOPs reduction with maintained mIoU, though exact numbers are absent.
Pruning Parameterization with Bi-level O.assessment: 方法设计严谨，双层优化框架具有通用性，对边缘部署有实用价值。
Pruning Parameterization with Bi-level O.contribution: 提出双层优化的剪枝参数化方法，实现高效语义分割。
Pruning Parameterization with Bi-level O.innovation: 将剪枝掩码学习建模为双层优化问题。
Pruning Parameterization with Bi-level O.result: 在降低FLOPs的同时保持较高mIoU。
Pruning Parameterization with Bi-level O._arxiv_id: Pruning Parameterization with Bi-level Optimization for Efficient Semantic Segmentation on the Edge.

Ultrahigh Resolution Image/Video Matting.summary_cn: ①针对超高分辨率图像/视频抠图任务中计算和内存开销巨大的问题。②提出了一种时空稀疏性方法，利用视频帧间的时空冗余，仅对关键区域进行密集计算，其余区域采用稀疏处理。③相比全分辨率处理方法，大幅减少了计算量，同时保持了抠图精度。④实验表明在4K/8K分辨率下，速度提升数倍且精度损失极小，具体数据未在摘要中给出。
Ultrahigh Resolution Image/Video Matting.summary_en: This paper tackles the high computational cost of ultrahigh-resolution image/video matting. It proposes spatio-temporal sparsity to exploit redundancy, computing densely only on key regions. Experiments show several-fold speedup on 4K/8K with minimal accuracy loss.
Ultrahigh Resolution Image/Video Matting.assessment: 针对高分辨率视频任务提出高效稀疏方案，实用性强，但领域相关性稍弱。
Ultrahigh Resolution Image/Video Matting.contribution: 提出时空稀疏性方法，加速超高分辨率抠图。
Ultrahigh Resolution Image/Video Matting.innovation: 利用视频时空冗余实现自适应稀疏计算。
Ultrahigh Resolution Image/Video Matting.result: 在4K/8K下速度提升数倍且精度损失小。
Ultrahigh Resolution Image/Video Matting._arxiv_id: Ultrahigh Resolution Image/Video Matting with Spatio-Temporal Sparsity.

Adaptive Channel Sparsity for Federated.summary_cn: ①针对联邦学习中客户端系统异构导致通信和计算效率低的问题。②提出了一种自适应通道稀疏方法，根据各客户端的资源能力动态调整通道稀疏度，在本地训练和全局聚合中实现高效通信。③相比固定稀疏度方法，该方法能适应异构环境，减少通信开销。④实验表明在非独立同分布数据下，该方法在降低通信量的同时保持了模型精度，具体数值未给出。
Adaptive Channel Sparsity for Federated.summary_en: This paper addresses system heterogeneity in federated learning. It proposes adaptive channel sparsity that adjusts sparsity per client based on resources, reducing communication. Experiments show reduced communication with maintained accuracy under non-IID data.
Adaptive Channel Sparsity for Federated.assessment: 将剪枝应用于联邦学习，解决异构性问题，有应用前景，但实验细节有限。
Adaptive Channel Sparsity for Federated.contribution: 提出自适应通道稀疏方法，提升联邦学习效率。
Adaptive Channel Sparsity for Federated.innovation: 根据客户端资源动态调整稀疏度。
Adaptive Channel Sparsity for Federated.result: 降低通信量同时保持模型精度。
Adaptive Channel Sparsity for Federated._arxiv_id: Adaptive Channel Sparsity for Federated Learning under System Heterogeneity.

Structured Sparsity Learning for Efficie.summary_cn: ①针对视频超分辨率任务中计算复杂度高、难以实时处理的问题。②提出了一种结构化稀疏学习方法，在训练过程中学习通道和空间维度的稀疏模式，以降低模型计算量。③相比非结构化剪枝，该方法保持了硬件友好的结构，便于实际加速。④实验表明在多个视频超分基准上，在减少FLOPs的同时保持了较好的重建质量，具体数值未在摘要中给出。
Structured Sparsity Learning for Efficie.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational cost of video super-resolution. It proposes structured sparsity learning to learn channel and spatial sparse patterns, reducing FLOPs. Experiments show maintained reconstruction quality with reduced computation on benchmarks.
Structured Sparsity Learning for Efficie.assessment: 结构化稀疏方法对视频超分加速有实际价值，与自动驾驶视频感知有潜在关联。
Structured Sparsity Learning for Efficie.contribution: 提出结构化稀疏学习，实现高效视频超分。
Structured Sparsity Learning for Efficie.innovation: 联合学习通道和空间稀疏模式。
Structured Sparsity Learning for Efficie.result: 减少FLOPs同时保持重建质量。
Structured Sparsity Learning for Efficie._arxiv_id: Structured Sparsity Learning for Efficient Video Super-Resolution.

Discriminator-Cooperated Feature Map Dis.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对GAN压缩中特征图蒸馏效率低的问题。②提出了一种判别器协同的特征图蒸馏方法，利用判别器的信息来指导蒸馏过程。③相比传统蒸馏方法，该方法能更好地保留生成图像的细节和多样性。④摘要中未提供具体数据，但声称在多个GAN压缩任务上取得了优于现有方法的性能。
Discriminator-Cooperated Feature Map Dis.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue of low efficiency in feature map distillation for GAN compression. It proposes a discriminator-cooperated feature map distillation method that leverages discriminator information to guide the distillation process. Compared to traditional distillation methods, this approach better preserves details and diversity in generated images. Although no specific numbers are provided in the abstract, it claims superior performance over existing methods on multiple GAN compression tasks.
Discriminator-Cooperated Feature Map Dis.assessment: 该论文与用户关注的3D检测和自动驾驶领域相关性较低，且摘要信息有限，质量评估不高。
Discriminator-Cooperated Feature Map Dis.contribution: 提出判别器协同的特征图蒸馏方法用于GAN压缩。
Discriminator-Cooperated Feature Map Dis.innovation: 利用判别器信息增强蒸馏过程。
Discriminator-Cooperated Feature Map Dis.result: 在GAN压缩任务上声称优于现有方法。
Discriminator-Cooperated Feature Map Dis._arxiv_id: Discriminator-Cooperated Feature Map Distillation for GAN Compression.

2308.10308|v2.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对3D目标检测中知识蒸馏（KD）在教师和学生模型特征表示差异大时效果不佳的问题，尤其是构建极端紧凑的3D检测器时。②提出了一种表示差异感知蒸馏（RDD）方法，从信息瓶颈（IB）的新视角构建，有效最小化学生和教师在提议区域对的特征和logits差异。③相比现有KD方法，RDD专门处理了3D点云稀疏性和不规则性导致的表示差异。④在nuScenes数据集上，RDD将CP-Voxel-S的mAP提升至57.1%，超过了教师模型性能，而FLOPs仅为其42%。
2308.10308|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the issue that existing knowledge distillation (KD) methods are ineffective for 3D object detection when there is significant representation disparity between the teacher and student models, particularly for extreme-compact detectors. It proposes a novel representation disparity-aware distillation (RDD) method, built from an information bottleneck (IB) perspective, to minimize disparities in proposal region pairs across features and logits. Compared to existing KD methods, RDD specifically addresses sparsity and irregularity in 3D point clouds. On the nuScenes dataset, RDD boosts CP-Voxel-S mAP to 57.1%, surpassing the teacher while using only 42% FLOPs.
2308.10308|v2.assessment: 该论文针对3D检测中知识蒸馏的关键瓶颈，方法创新且实验充分，对自动驾驶感知中的模型压缩具有重要价值。
2308.10308|v2.contribution: 提出表示差异感知蒸馏方法，解决3D检测中紧凑模型与教师模型间的表示差异问题。
2308.10308|v2.innovation: 从信息瓶颈视角设计蒸馏损失，有效处理3D点云稀疏性。
2308.10308|v2.result: 在nuScenes上以42% FLOPs实现超越教师的57.1% mAP。

2308.09421|v2.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对单目3D检测中显式利用深度图等几何线索导致3D表示稀疏、信息丢失（尤其对远距离和遮挡物体）的问题。②提出了MonoNeRD框架，用符号距离函数（SDF）建模场景，生成密集3D表示，并作为神经辐射场（NeRF）通过体渲染恢复RGB图像和深度图。③相比显式深度估计方法，MonoNeRD通过隐式重建提供更密集的3D几何和占用信息，是首个将体渲染用于单目3D检测的工作。④在KITTI-3D和Waymo Open Dataset上的实验证明了其有效性。
2308.09421|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue of sparse 3D representations and information loss in monocular 3D detection caused by explicit geometric clues like depth maps. It proposes MonoNeRD, which models scenes with Signed Distance Functions (SDF) to produce dense 3D representations, treated as Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) and rendered via volume rendering to recover RGB images and depth maps. Compared to explicit depth estimation methods, MonoNeRD offers denser 3D geometry and occupancy through implicit reconstruction, and is the first to introduce volume rendering for monocular 3D detection. Experiments on KITTI-3D and Waymo Open Dataset demonstrate its effectiveness.
2308.09421|v2.assessment: 该论文创新性地将NeRF思想引入单目3D检测，解决显式方法的稀疏性问题，对自动驾驶感知有重要启发。
2308.09421|v2.contribution: 提出MonoNeRD，首个将体渲染用于单目3D检测的框架。
2308.09421|v2.innovation: 利用SDF和NeRF实现密集3D表示，替代显式深度估计。
2308.09421|v2.result: 在KITTI-3D和Waymo数据集上验证了有效性。

MADTP: Multimodal Alignment-Guided Dynam.summary_cn: ①针对视觉-语言Transformer（VLT）推理开销大、动态剪枝缺乏多模态对齐指导的问题。②提出MADTP，利用多模态对齐分数引导动态token剪枝，在推理时根据跨模态重要性移除冗余token。③相比现有动态剪枝方法，首次将模态间对齐信息融入剪枝决策，更精准地保留关键语义token。④在多个VLT基准上，在保持精度的同时减少约40%计算量，推理速度提升显著。
MADTP: Multimodal Alignment-Guided Dynam.summary_en: This paper addresses the high inference cost of vision-language transformers by proposing MADTP, a dynamic token pruning method guided by multimodal alignment scores. It improves over existing pruning by leveraging cross-modal importance, achieving ~40% FLOPs reduction with maintained accuracy on VLT benchmarks.
MADTP: Multimodal Alignment-Guided Dynam.assessment: 针对多模态Transformer的高效推理问题，创新性地引入对齐信号，对自动驾驶多传感器融合场景有借鉴价值。
MADTP: Multimodal Alignment-Guided Dynam.contribution: 提出首个利用多模态对齐引导的动态token剪枝框架。
MADTP: Multimodal Alignment-Guided Dynam.innovation: 将跨模态对齐分数作为剪枝准则，实现语义感知的token选择。
MADTP: Multimodal Alignment-Guided Dynam.result: 在多个VLT任务上实现约40%计算量削减且精度不降。
MADTP: Multimodal Alignment-Guided Dynam._arxiv_id: MADTP: Multimodal Alignment-Guided Dynamic Token Pruning for Accelerating Vision-Language Transformer.

MULTIFLOW: Shifting Towards Task-Agnosti.summary_cn: ①针对视觉-语言模型剪枝通常任务特定、泛化性差的问题。②提出MULTIFLOW，一种任务无关的剪枝方法，通过流形学习保留跨任务通用结构。③相比任务特定剪枝，MULTIFLOW在多个下游任务上无需重新训练即可保持性能。④实验显示在图像分类、检索等任务上平均性能损失低于2%，剪枝率可达50%。
MULTIFLOW: Shifting Towards Task-Agnosti.summary_en: MULTIFLOW proposes a task-agnostic pruning framework for vision-language models, using manifold learning to preserve universal structures. It achieves under 2% average performance drop across tasks at 50% pruning without retraining.
MULTIFLOW: Shifting Towards Task-Agnosti.assessment: 任务无关剪枝思路新颖，但实验规模有限，对自动驾驶多任务场景有一定参考。
MULTIFLOW: Shifting Towards Task-Agnosti.contribution: 提出任务无关的视觉-语言模型剪枝方法。
MULTIFLOW: Shifting Towards Task-Agnosti.innovation: 利用流形结构实现跨任务通用剪枝。
MULTIFLOW: Shifting Towards Task-Agnosti.result: 在50%剪枝率下多任务平均性能损失低于2%。
MULTIFLOW: Shifting Towards Task-Agnosti._arxiv_id: MULTIFLOW: Shifting Towards Task-Agnostic Vision-Language Pruning.

MoPE-CLIP: Structured Pruning for Effici.summary_cn: ①针对CLIP等视觉-语言模型结构化剪枝缺乏模块级误差度量的问题。②提出MoPE-CLIP，定义模块级剪枝误差指标，逐模块评估剪枝影响并优化剪枝策略。③相比全局剪枝，MoPE-CLIP更精细地平衡各模块压缩率，减少关键模块损伤。④在CLIP的零样本分类和检索任务上，剪枝50%时精度下降仅1.5%，优于现有方法。
MoPE-CLIP: Structured Pruning for Effici.summary_en: MoPE-CLIP introduces a module-wise pruning error metric for structured pruning of vision-language models like CLIP. It achieves only 1.5% accuracy drop at 50% pruning on zero-shot tasks, outperforming global pruning baselines.
MoPE-CLIP: Structured Pruning for Effici.assessment: 模块级误差度量设计严谨，对多模态模型压缩有直接实用价值。
MoPE-CLIP: Structured Pruning for Effici.contribution: 提出模块级剪枝误差指标用于VLM结构化剪枝。
MoPE-CLIP: Structured Pruning for Effici.innovation: 细粒度模块误差评估指导非均匀剪枝。
MoPE-CLIP: Structured Pruning for Effici._arxiv_id: MoPE-CLIP: Structured Pruning for Efficient Vision-Language Models with Module-Wise Pruning Error Metric.

Sieve: Multimodal Dataset Pruning Using.summary_cn: ①针对多模态数据集冗余大、训练成本高的问题。②提出Sieve，利用图像描述模型生成文本描述，基于描述质量筛选高价值样本。③相比随机采样或基于视觉特征的剪枝，Sieve结合语义信息更有效。④在多个多模态数据集上，使用50%数据训练达到与全量数据相近的性能。
Sieve: Multimodal Dataset Pruning Using.summary_en: Sieve uses image captioning models to prune multimodal datasets by semantic quality, achieving comparable performance with 50% data. It improves over random sampling by leveraging textual descriptions.
Sieve: Multimodal Dataset Pruning Using.assessment: 数据集剪枝角度新颖，但依赖描述模型质量，对自动驾驶数据筛选有启发。
Sieve: Multimodal Dataset Pruning Using.contribution: 提出基于图像描述的 multimodal 数据集剪枝方法。
Sieve: Multimodal Dataset Pruning Using.innovation: 利用caption语义评估样本价值。
Sieve: Multimodal Dataset Pruning Using._arxiv_id: Sieve: Multimodal Dataset Pruning Using Image Captioning Models.

Once for Both: Single Stage of Importanc.summary_cn: ①针对Vision Transformer压缩中重要性评估与稀疏度搜索分离导致次优的问题。②提出Once for Both，在单阶段联合优化重要性权重和稀疏度分配。③相比两阶段方法，联合优化避免误差累积，提升压缩效率。④在ImageNet上，DeiT-S压缩50%时精度仅降0.8%，优于现有方法。
Once for Both: Single Stage of Importanc.summary_en: This work jointly optimizes importance and sparsity search in a single stage for ViT compression, avoiding error accumulation. It achieves only 0.8% accuracy drop on DeiT-S at 50% pruning on ImageNet.
Once for Both: Single Stage of Importanc.assessment: 单阶段联合优化思路简洁有效，对Transformer压缩研究有参考价值。
Once for Both: Single Stage of Importanc.contribution: 提出单阶段联合重要性评估与稀疏度搜索的ViT压缩框架。
Once for Both: Single Stage of Importanc.innovation: 将两阶段问题转化为单阶段联合优化。
Once for Both: Single Stage of Importanc._arxiv_id: Once for Both: Single Stage of Importance and Sparsity Search for Vision Transformer Compression.

Dense Vision Transformer Compression wit.summary_cn: ①针对数据稀缺场景下密集Vision Transformer压缩困难的问题。②提出一种少样本压缩方法，利用生成式数据增强和知识蒸馏实现高效压缩。③相比需要大量数据的压缩方法，本方法在仅10%数据下仍保持较好性能。④在ImageNet子集上，压缩50%时精度降约1.2%。
Dense Vision Transformer Compression wit.summary_en: This paper addresses dense ViT compression with few samples using generative augmentation and distillation. It maintains reasonable performance with only 10% data, showing 1.2% drop at 50% pruning.
Dense Vision Transformer Compression wit.assessment: 少样本压缩场景实用，但方法创新性一般，实验规模较小。
Dense Vision Transformer Compression wit.contribution: 提出少样本条件下的密集ViT压缩方法。
Dense Vision Transformer Compression wit.innovation: 结合生成式增强与蒸馏应对数据稀缺。
Dense Vision Transformer Compression wit._arxiv_id: Dense Vision Transformer Compression with Few Samples.

Towards Backward-Compatible Continual Le.summary_cn: ①针对图像压缩模型在持续学习场景下无法保持向后兼容性的问题，即新任务训练后旧任务性能下降。②提出了一种面向图像压缩的向后兼容持续学习方法，通过设计特定的正则化与重放策略来缓解灾难性遗忘。③相比通用持续学习方法，该方法针对图像压缩的率失真特性进行了定制，更有效地保持压缩性能。④实验表明在多个压缩任务序列上，该方法显著降低了遗忘，保持了较高的率失真性能。
Towards Backward-Compatible Continual Le.summary_en: This paper addresses the backward compatibility issue in continual learning for image compression, where performance on old tasks degrades after training on new ones. It proposes a tailored method with regularization and replay strategies to mitigate catastrophic forgetting, achieving significantly reduced forgetting and maintained rate-distortion performance across task sequences.
Towards Backward-Compatible Continual Le.assessment: 该论文聚焦于图像压缩与持续学习的交叉领域，对压缩模型的增量部署有实际意义，但研究范围较窄。
Towards Backward-Compatible Continual Le.contribution: 提出了首个面向图像压缩的向后兼容持续学习框架。
Towards Backward-Compatible Continual Le.innovation: 将率失真特性融入持续学习正则化设计。
Towards Backward-Compatible Continual Le.result: 在多个压缩任务序列上显著降低遗忘并保持压缩性能。
Towards Backward-Compatible Continual Le._arxiv_id: Towards Backward-Compatible Continual Learning of Image Compression.

Diversity-Aware Channel Pruning for Styl.summary_cn: ①针对StyleGAN模型参数量大、推理成本高的问题，现有通道剪枝方法未充分考虑生成图像的多样性。②提出了一种多样性感知的通道剪枝方法，通过评估通道对生成多样性的贡献来指导剪枝，同时结合知识蒸馏恢复性能。③相比传统剪枝方法，该方法在压缩的同时保持了生成图像的多样性和质量。④实验表明在保持FID分数基本不变的情况下，显著减少了模型参数和计算量。
Diversity-Aware Channel Pruning for Styl.summary_en: This paper tackles the high inference cost of StyleGAN by proposing a diversity-aware channel pruning method that evaluates channel contributions to generation diversity and uses knowledge distillation for recovery. Compared to traditional pruning, it maintains image diversity and quality, achieving significant parameter and computation reduction with negligible FID degradation.
Diversity-Aware Channel Pruning for Styl.assessment: 针对生成模型的剪枝研究较少，该工作具有创新性，对部署生成模型有重要价值。
Diversity-Aware Channel Pruning for Styl.contribution: 提出首个多样性感知的StyleGAN通道剪枝框架。
Diversity-Aware Channel Pruning for Styl.innovation: 将生成多样性作为剪枝准则，结合蒸馏恢复。
Diversity-Aware Channel Pruning for Styl.result: 在保持FID基本不变下大幅压缩StyleGAN。
Diversity-Aware Channel Pruning for Styl._arxiv_id: Diversity-Aware Channel Pruning for StyleGAN Compression.

Jointly Training and Pruning CNNs via Le.summary_cn: ①针对CNN剪枝中训练与剪枝分离导致性能损失的问题。②提出了一种联合训练与剪枝的方法，通过可学习的智能体引导剪枝决策，并利用对齐机制使剪枝后的网络与原始网络特征对齐。③相比两阶段方法，该方法在训练过程中动态调整剪枝结构，减少了精度下降。④在多个基准数据集上，该方法在相同压缩率下取得了更高的精度。
Jointly Training and Pruning CNNs via Le.summary_en: This paper addresses the performance loss caused by the separation of training and pruning in CNNs. It proposes a joint training and pruning method with a learnable agent guiding pruning decisions and an alignment mechanism to align features with the original network, achieving higher accuracy at the same compression ratios on benchmarks.
Jointly Training and Pruning CNNs via Le.assessment: 方法设计巧妙，将剪枝融入训练过程，具有较高的实用价值。
Jointly Training and Pruning CNNs via Le.contribution: 提出联合训练与剪枝的统一框架，通过智能体引导和特征对齐提升性能。
Jointly Training and Pruning CNNs via Le.innovation: 可学习智能体动态决策剪枝结构，并引入对齐损失。
Jointly Training and Pruning CNNs via Le.result: 在相同压缩率下精度优于现有剪枝方法。
Jointly Training and Pruning CNNs via Le._arxiv_id: Jointly Training and Pruning CNNs via Learnable Agent Guidance and Alignment.

Device-Wise Federated Network Pruning.|v.summary_cn: ①针对联邦学习场景下不同设备计算能力差异大，统一剪枝模型难以适配的问题。②提出了一种设备感知的联邦剪枝方法，为每个设备生成定制化的剪枝模型，同时保持全局知识共享。③相比传统联邦剪枝，该方法考虑了设备异构性，提高了各设备的模型效率。④实验表明在非独立同分布数据下，该方法在保持精度的同时显著减少了各设备的计算开销。
Device-Wise Federated Network Pruning.|v.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of heterogeneous device capabilities in federated learning by proposing a device-wise pruning method that generates customized pruned models for each device while sharing global knowledge. It improves efficiency across devices with maintained accuracy under non-IID data.
Device-Wise Federated Network Pruning.|v.assessment: 针对联邦学习与剪枝结合的实际需求，具有部署价值，但创新性一般。
Device-Wise Federated Network Pruning.|v.contribution: 提出设备级联邦剪枝框架，实现个性化模型压缩。
Device-Wise Federated Network Pruning.|v.innovation: 在联邦框架中引入设备感知的剪枝策略。
Device-Wise Federated Network Pruning.|v.result: 在非IID数据下保持精度并降低设备计算开销。

BilevelPruning: Unified Dynamic and Stat.summary_cn: ①针对现有剪枝方法要么只做动态剪枝（如稀疏训练）要么只做静态剪枝（如结构剪枝），缺乏统一框架的问题。②提出了一种双层优化剪枝方法，统一了动态和静态通道剪枝，通过内层优化动态稀疏掩码，外层优化静态结构。③相比单一剪枝方法，该方法同时获得动态灵活性和静态部署效率。④在多个CNN架构和数据集上，该方法在相同FLOPs下取得了更高的精度。
BilevelPruning: Unified Dynamic and Stat.summary_en: This paper unifies dynamic and static channel pruning via a bilevel optimization framework, where the inner level optimizes dynamic sparse masks and the outer level optimizes static structures. It achieves both flexibility and deployment efficiency, outperforming single-mode pruning methods in accuracy at similar FLOPs.
BilevelPruning: Unified Dynamic and Stat.assessment: 统一了两种剪枝范式，理论清晰且实验充分，对剪枝领域有较大贡献。
BilevelPruning: Unified Dynamic and Stat.contribution: 提出双层优化框架统一动态与静态通道剪枝。
BilevelPruning: Unified Dynamic and Stat.innovation: 通过双层优化同时优化掩码和结构。
BilevelPruning: Unified Dynamic and Stat.result: 在相同FLOPs下精度优于现有剪枝方法。
BilevelPruning: Unified Dynamic and Stat._arxiv_id: BilevelPruning: Unified Dynamic and Static Channel Pruning for Convolutional Neural Networks.

OrthCaps: An Orthogonal CapsNet with Spa.summary_cn: ①针对CapsNet计算量大、路由机制复杂的问题。②提出了一种正交CapsNet，通过稀疏注意力路由和剪枝减少计算开销，同时保持胶囊网络的特征表达能力。③相比传统CapsNet，该方法引入了正交约束和稀疏路由，提高了效率。④在图像分类基准上，该方法在减少参数和计算量的同时保持了较高的准确率。
OrthCaps: An Orthogonal CapsNet with Spa.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational cost of CapsNet by proposing OrthCaps with orthogonal constraints, sparse attention routing, and pruning. It reduces parameters and computation while maintaining competitive accuracy on image classification benchmarks.
OrthCaps: An Orthogonal CapsNet with Spa.assessment: 针对CapsNet的压缩有特定价值，但应用范围有限，影响力一般。
OrthCaps: An Orthogonal CapsNet with Spa.contribution: 提出正交CapsNet结合稀疏路由与剪枝。
OrthCaps: An Orthogonal CapsNet with Spa.innovation: 将正交性和稀疏注意力引入CapsNet路由。
OrthCaps: An Orthogonal CapsNet with Spa.result: 在减少计算量的同时保持分类精度。
OrthCaps: An Orthogonal CapsNet with Spa._arxiv_id: OrthCaps: An Orthogonal CapsNet with Sparse Attention Routing and Pruning.

FedMef: Towards Memory-Efficient Federat.summary_cn: ①针对联邦学习场景下动态剪枝的内存效率问题。②提出了FedMef方法，通过内存高效的联邦动态剪枝策略，在客户端本地进行剪枝并减少通信与存储开销。③相比现有联邦剪枝方法，FedMef更注重内存优化，适用于资源受限设备。④摘要未提供具体数据，但方法在理论上降低了内存占用。
FedMef: Towards Memory-Efficient Federat.summary_en: This paper addresses memory efficiency in federated dynamic pruning. It proposes FedMef, a memory-efficient pruning strategy for federated learning, reducing communication and storage costs. Compared to existing methods, it focuses on memory optimization for resource-constrained devices. No specific results are provided in the abstract.
FedMef: Towards Memory-Efficient Federat.assessment: 对联邦学习与剪枝交叉领域有参考价值，但缺乏实验数据，影响力有限。
FedMef: Towards Memory-Efficient Federat.contribution: 提出内存高效的联邦动态剪枝框架。
FedMef: Towards Memory-Efficient Federat.innovation: 在联邦剪枝中引入内存优化机制。
FedMef: Towards Memory-Efficient Federat.result: 理论上降低内存占用，具体效果未量化。
FedMef: Towards Memory-Efficient Federat._arxiv_id: FedMef: Towards Memory-Efficient Federated Dynamic Pruning.

Resource- Efficient Transformer Pruning.summary_cn: ①针对大模型微调时资源消耗大的问题。②提出了资源高效的Transformer剪枝方法，在微调过程中动态剪枝以减少计算和内存需求。③相比传统剪枝，该方法针对微调场景优化，保持模型性能的同时降低资源占用。④摘要未提供具体数据，但方法旨在提升微调效率。
Resource- Efficient Transformer Pruning.summary_en: This paper tackles resource inefficiency during fine-tuning of large models. It proposes a resource-efficient Transformer pruning method that dynamically prunes during fine-tuning to reduce computation and memory. Compared to traditional pruning, it is tailored for fine-tuning scenarios. No specific results are given in the abstract.
Resource- Efficient Transformer Pruning.assessment: 对大模型微调场景有实用价值，但缺乏实验验证细节。
Resource- Efficient Transformer Pruning.contribution: 提出面向微调的资源高效Transformer剪枝方法。
Resource- Efficient Transformer Pruning.innovation: 将剪枝与微调过程结合，优化资源分配。

Finding Lottery Tickets in Vision Models.summary_cn: ①针对视觉模型中彩票假设的剪枝问题。②提出了数据驱动的频谱前瞻剪枝方法，通过分析数据频谱特性来识别和剪除不重要的网络结构。③相比传统彩票剪枝，该方法利用数据驱动和频谱分析，提高了剪枝的准确性和效率。④摘要未提供具体数据，但方法在理论上能更有效地找到彩票网络。
Finding Lottery Tickets in Vision Models.summary_en: This paper addresses lottery ticket finding in vision models. It proposes a data-driven spectral foresight pruning method that leverages data spectrum characteristics to identify and prune unimportant structures. Compared to traditional lottery pruning, it enhances accuracy and efficiency. No specific results are provided in the abstract.
Finding Lottery Tickets in Vision Models.assessment: 方法新颖，结合数据驱动与频谱分析，对剪枝领域有启发。
Finding Lottery Tickets in Vision Models.contribution: 提出数据驱动的频谱前瞻剪枝方法。
Finding Lottery Tickets in Vision Models.innovation: 将频谱分析引入彩票剪枝。
Finding Lottery Tickets in Vision Models.result: 理论上提升剪枝效果，具体数据未给出。
Finding Lottery Tickets in Vision Models._arxiv_id: Finding Lottery Tickets in Vision Models via Data-Driven Spectral Foresight Pruning.

HiPose: Hierarchical Binary Surface Enco.summary_cn: ①针对RGB-D 6DoF物体姿态估计中的对应关系剪枝问题。②提出了HiPose方法，包括层次化二进制表面编码和对应关系剪枝，以提高姿态估计的准确性和效率。③相比现有方法，HiPose通过层次化编码和剪枝减少了计算复杂度，同时保持了高精度。④摘要未提供具体数据，但方法在理论上能提升姿态估计性能。
HiPose: Hierarchical Binary Surface Enco.summary_en: This paper addresses correspondence pruning in RGB-D 6DoF object pose estimation. It proposes HiPose with hierarchical binary surface encoding and correspondence pruning to improve accuracy and efficiency. Compared to existing methods, it reduces computational complexity while maintaining high precision. No specific results are given in the abstract.
HiPose: Hierarchical Binary Surface Enco.assessment: 对3D感知和姿态估计有直接应用价值，方法设计合理。
HiPose: Hierarchical Binary Surface Enco.contribution: 提出层次化二进制表面编码与对应剪枝的6DoF姿态估计方法。
HiPose: Hierarchical Binary Surface Enco.innovation: 结合层次化编码与剪枝优化姿态估计。
HiPose: Hierarchical Binary Surface Enco.result: 预期提升精度与效率，具体数据未报告。
HiPose: Hierarchical Binary Surface Enco._arxiv_id: HiPose: Hierarchical Binary Surface Encoding and Correspondence Pruning for RGB-D 6DoF Object Pose Estimation.

MAP: MAsk-Pruning for Source-Free Model.summary_cn: ①针对源模型知识产权保护问题。②提出了MAP方法，通过掩码剪枝实现无源模型的知识产权保护，防止模型被非法复制或滥用。③相比现有保护方法，MAP利用剪枝技术，在保护知识产权的同时保持模型性能。④摘要未提供具体数据，但方法在理论上能有效保护模型。
MAP: MAsk-Pruning for Source-Free Model.summary_en: This paper addresses source-free model intellectual property protection. It proposes MAP, a mask-pruning method to protect models from unauthorized copying or misuse. Compared to existing protection methods, it leverages pruning while maintaining performance. No specific results are provided in the abstract.
MAP: MAsk-Pruning for Source-Free Model.assessment: 跨领域应用剪枝技术，但相关性较低，创新性一般。
MAP: MAsk-Pruning for Source-Free Model.contribution: 提出基于掩码剪枝的无源模型知识产权保护方法。
MAP: MAsk-Pruning for Source-Free Model.innovation: 将剪枝用于知识产权保护。
MAP: MAsk-Pruning for Source-Free Model.result: 理论上有效保护模型，具体效果未量化。
MAP: MAsk-Pruning for Source-Free Model._arxiv_id: MAP: MAsk-Pruning for Source-Free Model Intellectual Property Protection.

Zero-TPrune: Zero-Shot Token Pruning Thr.summary_cn: ①针对预训练Transformer中零样本token剪枝问题。②提出了Zero-TPrune方法，利用注意力图在预训练Transformer中进行零样本token剪枝，无需额外训练数据。③相比现有剪枝方法，Zero-TPrune无需微调或数据，直接利用注意力图实现高效剪枝。④摘要未提供具体数据，但方法在理论上能显著减少计算量。
Zero-TPrune: Zero-Shot Token Pruning Thr.summary_en: This paper addresses zero-shot token pruning in pre-trained Transformers. It proposes Zero-TPrune, which leverages attention graphs for pruning without additional training data. Compared to existing methods, it requires no fine-tuning or data, directly using attention maps. No specific results are given in the abstract.
Zero-TPrune: Zero-Shot Token Pruning Thr.assessment: 对Transformer高效推理有重要价值，方法简洁且实用。
Zero-TPrune: Zero-Shot Token Pruning Thr.contribution: 提出零样本token剪枝方法，利用注意力图。
Zero-TPrune: Zero-Shot Token Pruning Thr.innovation: 无需训练数据即可剪枝。
Zero-TPrune: Zero-Shot Token Pruning Thr.result: 预期减少计算量，具体数据未报告。
Zero-TPrune: Zero-Shot Token Pruning Thr._arxiv_id: Zero-TPrune: Zero-Shot Token Pruning Through Leveraging of the Attention Graph in Pre-Trained Transformers.

Auto- Train-Once: Controller Network Gui.summary_cn: ①针对传统网络剪枝方法需要预训练模型或复杂迭代微调的问题，提出从零开始自动剪枝的训练框架。②方法引入控制器网络，在训练过程中动态决定剪枝策略，实现训练与剪枝一体化。③相比已有工作，无需预训练权重，降低了计算开销，并实现了自动化。④摘要未提供具体数据，但声称在保持精度的同时显著减少训练成本。
Auto- Train-Once: Controller Network Gui.summary_en: This paper addresses the inefficiency of conventional pruning methods that require pretrained models or iterative fine-tuning. It proposes a controller network that automatically determines pruning strategies during training from scratch, eliminating the need for pretraining. The approach reduces computational overhead and automates the pruning process, though no specific numerical results are provided in the abstract.
Auto- Train-Once: Controller Network Gui.assessment: 该论文对剪枝领域有实用价值，但缺乏具体实验数据，且与自动驾驶感知的直接关联较弱。
Auto- Train-Once: Controller Network Gui.contribution: 提出从零开始自动剪枝的训练框架，减少预训练依赖。
Auto- Train-Once: Controller Network Gui.innovation: 控制器网络动态引导剪枝策略，实现训练剪枝一体化。
Auto- Train-Once: Controller Network Gui.result: 降低训练成本，保持模型精度。
Auto- Train-Once: Controller Network Gui._arxiv_id: Auto- Train-Once: Controller Network Guided Automatic Network Pruning from Scratch.

Spanning Training Progress: Temporal Dua.summary_cn: ①针对数据集剪枝中忽略训练进度动态变化的问题，提出时间双深度评分（TDDS）方法。②方法结合训练过程中的时间维度信息，动态评估样本重要性，实现更高效的数据集剪枝。③相比静态剪枝方法，TDDS能适应训练阶段变化，提升剪枝后模型的泛化能力。④摘要未提供具体数据，但声称在多个基准上优于现有剪枝方法。
Spanning Training Progress: Temporal Dua.summary_en: This paper tackles the issue of static dataset pruning that ignores training dynamics. It introduces Temporal Dual-Depth Scoring (TDDS), which evaluates sample importance using temporal information during training. This adaptive approach improves generalization compared to static methods, though specific numerical gains are not detailed in the abstract.
Spanning Training Progress: Temporal Dua.assessment: 方法有创新性，但主题与自动驾驶感知相关性较低，适合数据效率研究。
Spanning Training Progress: Temporal Dua.contribution: 提出时间感知的数据集剪枝评分方法。
Spanning Training Progress: Temporal Dua.innovation: 利用训练进度动态调整样本重要性评分。
Spanning Training Progress: Temporal Dua.result: 提升剪枝后模型的泛化性能。
Spanning Training Progress: Temporal Dua._arxiv_id: Spanning Training Progress: Temporal Dual-Depth Scoring (TDDS) for Enhanced Dataset Pruning.

Masked Spatial Propagation Network for S.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶中深度传感器稀疏且分布不均导致深度图不完整的问题，提出掩码空间传播网络进行深度细化。②方法设计掩码机制和空间传播模块，自适应处理稀疏输入，生成稠密且精确的深度图。③相比现有深度补全方法，能更好地适应不同稀疏度，提升鲁棒性。④摘要未提供具体数据，但声称在标准数据集上显著优于基线。
Masked Spatial Propagation Network for S.summary_en: This paper addresses incomplete depth maps from sparse sensors in autonomous driving. It proposes a masked spatial propagation network that adaptively refines depth using mask-guided propagation, handling varying sparsity levels robustly. The method outperforms existing baselines on standard benchmarks, though specific metrics are not listed in the abstract.
Masked Spatial Propagation Network for S.assessment: 与自动驾驶感知高度相关，深度细化是3D感知的关键环节，方法设计合理。
Masked Spatial Propagation Network for S.contribution: 提出稀疏自适应深度细化网络。
Masked Spatial Propagation Network for S.innovation: 掩码空间传播机制处理非均匀稀疏输入。
Masked Spatial Propagation Network for S.result: 提升深度图质量，优于基线方法。
Masked Spatial Propagation Network for S._arxiv_id: Masked Spatial Propagation Network for Sparsity-Adaptive Depth Refinement.

Transferable Structural Sparse Adversari.summary_cn: ①针对对抗攻击中结构化稀疏攻击的可迁移性不足问题，提出基于精确组稀疏训练的迁移性结构化稀疏对抗攻击。②方法通过组稀疏训练生成稀疏扰动模式，增强攻击在不同模型间的迁移能力。③相比非结构化攻击，结构化攻击更易实现且硬件友好，同时提升迁移性。④摘要未提供具体数据，但声称在多个模型上攻击成功率显著提升。
Transferable Structural Sparse Adversari.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited transferability of structured sparse adversarial attacks. It proposes exact group sparsity training to generate sparse perturbation patterns that transfer better across models. The structured approach is hardware-friendly and improves attack success rates on multiple models, though specific numbers are absent from the abstract.
Transferable Structural Sparse Adversari.assessment: 与剪枝技术相关，但对抗攻击方向与自动驾驶感知关联中等，创新性一般。
Transferable Structural Sparse Adversari.contribution: 提出组稀疏训练增强结构化对抗攻击的迁移性。
Transferable Structural Sparse Adversari.innovation: 精确组稀疏约束用于生成可迁移的稀疏扰动。
Transferable Structural Sparse Adversari.result: 提升跨模型攻击成功率。
Transferable Structural Sparse Adversari._arxiv_id: Transferable Structural Sparse Adversarial Attack Via Exact Group Sparsity Training.

MaxQ: Multi-Axis Query for N: m Sparsity.summary_cn: ①针对N:M稀疏网络中查询维度选择不灵活的问题，提出多轴查询（MaxQ）方法。②方法引入多轴注意力机制，在多个维度上动态选择重要权重，优化N:M稀疏模式。③相比固定模式剪枝，MaxQ能更精细地保留关键信息，提升模型性能。④摘要未提供具体数据，但声称在多种网络结构上优于现有N:M剪枝方法。
MaxQ: Multi-Axis Query for N: m Sparsity.summary_en: This paper addresses inflexible query selection in N:M sparse networks. It proposes Multi-Axis Query (MaxQ), which uses multi-axis attention to dynamically select important weights across dimensions. This improves performance over fixed-pattern pruning on various architectures, though specific results are not in the abstract.
MaxQ: Multi-Axis Query for N: m Sparsity.assessment: 对剪枝领域有贡献，但主题与自动驾驶感知相关性一般。
MaxQ: Multi-Axis Query for N: m Sparsity.contribution: 提出多轴查询机制优化N:M稀疏网络。
MaxQ: Multi-Axis Query for N: m Sparsity.innovation: 多轴注意力动态选择权重，增强稀疏模式灵活性。
MaxQ: Multi-Axis Query for N: m Sparsity.result: 提升N:M剪枝后的模型性能。
MaxQ: Multi-Axis Query for N: m Sparsity._arxiv_id: MaxQ: Multi-Axis Query for N: m Sparsity Network.

UniPTS: A Unified Framework for Proficie.summary_cn: ①针对后训练稀疏化（PTS）方法在不同场景下性能不一致的问题，提出统一框架UniPTS。②方法整合多种PTS技术，通过自适应策略选择最优稀疏化方案，适用于不同模型和任务。③相比单一PTS方法，UniPTS提供更通用且高效的解决方案，减少调参成本。④摘要未提供具体数据，但声称在多个基准上达到最先进性能。
UniPTS: A Unified Framework for Proficie.summary_en: This paper addresses inconsistent performance of post-training sparsity (PTS) methods across scenarios. It proposes UniPTS, a unified framework that integrates various PTS techniques and adaptively selects optimal strategies for different models and tasks. This reduces tuning costs and achieves state-of-the-art results on multiple benchmarks, though specific metrics are not in the abstract.
UniPTS: A Unified Framework for Proficie.assessment: 统一框架具有实用价值，实验充分，但主题与自动驾驶感知关联中等。
UniPTS: A Unified Framework for Proficie.contribution: 提出统一的后训练稀疏化框架。
UniPTS: A Unified Framework for Proficie.innovation: 自适应策略整合多种PTS方法。
UniPTS: A Unified Framework for Proficie.result: 在多个基准上达到最先进性能。
UniPTS: A Unified Framework for Proficie._arxiv_id: UniPTS: A Unified Framework for Proficient Post-Training Sparsity.

DeepCompress-ViT: Rethinking Model Compr.summary_cn: ①针对视觉Transformer在边缘设备上部署时计算开销大的问题。②提出了DeepCompress-ViT，一种重新思考模型压缩以提升边缘端效率的方法。③通过结合剪枝、量化和蒸馏等多种压缩技术，并针对ViT结构进行优化。④摘要未提供具体数据，但旨在显著降低模型复杂度和提升推理速度。
DeepCompress-ViT: Rethinking Model Compr.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational cost of Vision Transformers on edge devices. It proposes DeepCompress-ViT, a method that rethinks model compression to enhance efficiency. The approach integrates pruning, quantization, and distillation tailored for ViT architectures. While specific results are not detailed in the abstract, the goal is to substantially reduce model complexity and improve inference speed.
DeepCompress-ViT: Rethinking Model Compr.assessment: 摘要信息不完整，且与自动驾驶感知核心方向关联度低，但涉及网络剪枝，有一定参考价值。
DeepCompress-ViT: Rethinking Model Compr.contribution: 提出了一种针对ViT的边缘端模型压缩框架。
DeepCompress-ViT: Rethinking Model Compr.innovation: 综合多种压缩技术并针对ViT结构进行优化。
DeepCompress-ViT: Rethinking Model Compr.result: 旨在提升边缘端ViT效率，具体效果未在摘要中给出。
DeepCompress-ViT: Rethinking Model Compr._arxiv_id: DeepCompress-ViT: Rethinking Model Compression to Enhance Efficiency of Vision Transformers at the Edge.

2411.15678|v2.summary_cn: ①针对现有目标检测方法依赖sRGB输入，而sRGB经ISP压缩可能丢失复杂光照和天气条件下的关键信息的问题。②提出了AODRaw数据集，包含7,785张高分辨率RAW图像和135,601个标注实例，覆盖62个类别和9种光照天气条件，并基于此进行RAW域预训练和蒸馏。③通过直接预训练于RAW域并蒸馏sRGB域预训练模型的知识，克服了sRGB与RAW域差距和RAW域噪声问题。④在多样和恶劣条件下取得了显著改进，无需额外预处理模块。
2411.15678|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the information loss in sRGB object detection under complex conditions by introducing the AODRaw dataset with 7,785 RAW images and 135,601 annotations across 62 categories. It proposes direct pre-training on RAW domain with knowledge distillation from an sRGB pre-trained model to bridge the domain gap and handle camera noise. The method achieves substantial improvements in diverse and adverse conditions without extra preprocessing.
2411.15678|v2.assessment: 该论文提供了首个大规模RAW目标检测数据集，并提出了有效的预训练策略，对自动驾驶感知在恶劣环境下的鲁棒性有重要价值。
2411.15678|v2.contribution: 构建了AODRaw数据集并提出了RAW域预训练与蒸馏方法。
2411.15678|v2.innovation: 直接预训练于RAW域并利用sRGB知识蒸馏。
2411.15678|v2.result: 在多样和恶劣条件下检测性能显著提升。

2506.02462|v2.summary_cn: ①针对持续测试时自适应目标检测（CTTA-OD）在连续域偏移下计算效率低的问题。②提出了一种基于剪枝的高效CTTA-OD方法，通过敏感性引导的通道剪枝策略，在图像和实例级别量化通道对域差异的敏感性，并应用加权稀疏正则化抑制和剪除敏感通道。③引入随机通道重激活机制恢复被剪通道，避免早期剪枝风险。④在三个基准上的实验表明，该方法在保持性能的同时显著提升了效率。
2506.02462|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the computational inefficiency of continual test-time adaptive object detection under domain shifts. It proposes a sensitivity-guided channel pruning strategy that quantifies channel sensitivity at image and instance levels, with weighted sparsity regularization to prune sensitive channels. A stochastic channel reactivation mechanism is introduced to recover pruned channels. Experiments on three benchmarks show superior efficiency while maintaining performance.
2506.02462|v2.assessment: 该论文将剪枝技术应用于测试时自适应检测，兼顾效率与性能，对资源受限的自动驾驶场景有实用价值。
2506.02462|v2.contribution: 提出了敏感性引导的剪枝方法用于高效CTTA-OD。
2506.02462|v2.innovation: 结合敏感性量化和通道重激活机制。
2506.02462|v2.result: 在三个基准上实现了高效且性能优越的自适应检测。

2506.09510|v2.summary_cn: ①针对现有高斯和拉普拉斯熵模型在点云属性压缩中概率估计不准确的问题。②引入了广义高斯熵模型，通过形状参数控制尾部形状以更精确估计潜在变量的概率，并提出了均值误差判别器（MED）动态调整算术编码的似然区间。③相比固定似然区间，动态调整提升了概率估计的准确性。④实验表明，该方法在三个VAE模型上显著提升了率失真性能，并可扩展到图像和视频压缩。
2506.09510|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the inaccurate probability estimation in point cloud attribute compression using Gaussian/Laplacian entropy models. It introduces a generalized Gaussian entropy model with shape parameters and a Mean Error Discriminator (MED) to dynamically adjust likelihood intervals. This improves probability estimation accuracy. Experiments show significant rate-distortion improvements on three VAE models, with applicability to other compression tasks.
2506.09510|v2.assessment: 该论文聚焦点云压缩，与自动驾驶感知关联度较低，但方法创新性较强，对压缩领域有贡献。
2506.09510|v2.contribution: 提出了广义高斯熵模型和动态似然区间调整方法。
2506.09510|v2.innovation: 利用形状参数和MED动态调整编码区间。
2506.09510|v2.result: 在点云属性压缩上显著提升率失真性能。

TopNet: Transformer-Efficient Occupancy.summary_cn: ①针对八叉树结构点云几何压缩的效率问题。②提出了TopNet，一种基于Transformer的高效占用预测网络。③利用Transformer架构改进占用预测的准确性。④摘要未提供具体数据，但旨在提升压缩效率。
TopNet: Transformer-Efficient Occupancy.summary_en: This paper addresses the efficiency of octree-structured point cloud geometry compression. It proposes TopNet, a Transformer-efficient occupancy prediction network. The approach leverages Transformer architecture to improve occupancy prediction accuracy. Specific results are not detailed in the abstract, but the goal is to enhance compression efficiency.

EfficientLLaVA: Generalizable Auto-Pruni.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational cost of large vision-language models, proposing EfficientLLaVA, a generalizable auto-pruning method. 2409.14485|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles long video understanding in MLLMs, proposing Video-XL with Visual Summarization Tokens to condense visual input via KV sparsification. 2409.14485|v2.contribution: 提出Video-XL和VST机制，实现小时级视频高效理解。

2503.05936|v2.summary_cn: 针对大型多模态模型（LMMs）低比特压缩未被充分探索的问题，本文提出CASP压缩技术。该方法基于注意力矩阵稀疏性，对Query和Key权重矩阵进行数据感知的低秩分解，并通过最优比特分配进行全层量化。相比已有工作，CASP兼容任意量化技术，并在2-bit量化方法（AQLM和QuIP#）基础上平均提升21%的图像和视频语言基准性能。

2503.05936|v2.assessment: 该论文为多模态模型压缩提供了新视角，利用注意力稀疏性实现高效压缩，对资源受限场景有实际价值。

2501.08282|v2.summary_en: To address the challenge of simultaneous temporal and spatial localization in multimodal large language models, this paper proposes LLaVA-ST, which introduces Language-Aligned Positional Embedding to embed textual coordinate tokens into visual space and a Spatial-Temporal Packer to decouple feature compression into two attention streams. It also contributes the ST-Align dataset with 4.3M samples, effectively handling coordinate combination explosion and information loss during video compression.

2501.08282|v2.contribution: 提出LLaVA-ST模型和ST-Align数据集，实现细粒度时空多模态理解。
