2501.08282|v2.result: 构建430万训练样本数据集，提升时空定位能力。

FlashSloth : Lightning Multimodal Large.summary_cn: 该论文标题为FlashSloth，旨在通过嵌入式视觉压缩实现闪电般快速的多模态大语言模型，但摘要为空，无法获取具体方法、改进点和效果数据。
FlashSloth : Lightning Multimodal Large.summary_en: This paper, titled FlashSloth, aims to achieve lightning-fast multimodal large language models via embedded visual compression, but the abstract is empty, so no specific methods, improvements, or results are available.
FlashSloth : Lightning Multimodal Large.assessment: 由于摘要缺失，无法评估其具体贡献，仅从标题推测与视觉压缩相关。
FlashSloth : Lightning Multimodal Large._arxiv_id: FlashSloth : Lightning Multimodal Large Language Models via Embedded Visual Compression.

2411.16760|v2.summary_cn: 针对Transformer中梯度解释方法存在梯度流不平衡、违反FullGrad完备性的问题，本文提出LibraGrad方法。该方法通过剪枝和缩放反向路径来纠正梯度不平衡，无需改变前向传播或增加计算开销。相比已有方法，LibraGrad在8种架构、4种模型规模和4个数据集上普遍提升梯度方法性能，超越现有白盒方法，包括Transformer专用方法。
2411.16760|v2.summary_en: Addressing gradient flow imbalances in Transformers that violate FullGrad-completeness, this paper proposes LibraGrad, a post-hoc approach that corrects gradient imbalances via pruning and scaling backward paths without altering the forward pass. It universally enhances gradient-based methods across 8 architectures, 4 model sizes, and 4 datasets, outperforming existing white-box methods on all metrics.
2411.16760|v2.assessment: 该论文为Transformer可解释性提供了理论驱动的改进方案，实验全面，对视觉解释研究有重要价值。
2411.16760|v2.contribution: 提出LibraGrad，纠正Transformer梯度流不平衡，提升归因忠实性。
2411.16760|v2.innovation: 基于FullGrad完备性的梯度路径剪枝与缩放。
2411.16760|v2.result: 在多个架构和数据集上超越现有白盒方法。

2406.10219|v2.summary_cn: 针对3D高斯泼溅（3D-GS）模型在复杂场景中存储需求高、现有剪枝方法在高压缩比下视觉保真度严重下降的问题，本文提出基于原理的不确定性剪枝方法。该方法计算训练视图重建误差对每个高斯空间参数的二阶近似作为敏感性分数，并设计多轮剪枝-精炼流程。相比已有启发式方法，该方法在显著更高压缩比下保持视觉保真度和前景细节。
2406.10219|v2.summary_en: To address high storage demands of 3D Gaussian Splatting and severe visual degradation at high compression ratios with heuristic pruning, this paper proposes a principled sensitivity score based on second-order approximation of reconstruction error, along with a multi-round prune-refine pipeline. It preserves visual fidelity and foreground details at significantly higher compression ratios than existing approaches.
2406.10219|v2.assessment: 该论文为3D场景压缩提供了理论驱动的剪枝策略，对实时渲染和资源受限设备应用有实际意义。
2406.10219|v2.contribution: 提出基于二阶近似的敏感性剪枝分数和多轮剪枝-精炼流程。
2406.10219|v2.innovation: 利用重建误差二阶近似作为剪枝依据。
2406.10219|v2.result: 在更高压缩比下保持视觉保真度。

2001.05119|v2.summary_cn: ①针对多视角3D点云配准中两阶段流程（初始成对配准和全局一致性优化）无法联合优化、且初始配准易受低重叠和场景对称性影响的问题。②提出首个端到端可学习的多视角配准算法，联合学习成对配准和全局一致性细化，通过循环一致性约束解决歧义。③相比现有方法，实现了两阶段的联合训练，降低了计算成本，并提升了配准精度。④在公开基准上显著优于现有技术，且计算开销更低，并提供了详细的消融实验验证各组件有效性。
2001.05119|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the two-stage multiview 3D point cloud registration problem by proposing the first end-to-end learnable algorithm that jointly optimizes pairwise alignment and global consistency refinement. It outperforms state-of-the-art methods on benchmark datasets with lower computational cost and provides ablation studies validating the novel components.
2001.05119|v2.assessment: 该工作首次将多视角配准的两阶段流程端到端联合学习，对3D重建和自动驾驶中的多帧点云融合有重要参考价值。
2001.05119|v2.contribution: 提出首个端到端可学习的多视角3D点云配准算法，联合优化成对配准与全局一致性。
2001.05119|v2.innovation: 将两阶段配准流程整合为单一网络，通过循环一致性实现联合训练。
2001.05119|v2.result: 在公开基准上显著超越现有方法，且计算成本更低。

2005.01939|v2.summary_cn: ①针对从单张图像重建3D物体时依赖3D或多视角监督的问题，提出仅使用单视角图像和轮廓的自监督方法。②同时学习3D点云重建和姿态估计网络，利用可微点云渲染器进行2D监督，并通过随机采样姿态和循环一致性约束增强3D几何推理。③相比需要姿态监督的方法，本方法在训练时无需任何姿态信息，更实用。④在ShapeNet和Pix3D数据集上，尽管监督更少，性能与姿态监督方法相当。
2005.01939|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes a self-supervised method for 3D object reconstruction from single images, requiring only image collections and silhouettes without pose supervision. It jointly learns point cloud reconstruction and pose estimation with cycle consistency, achieving competitive performance on ShapeNet and Pix3D compared to pose-supervised methods.
2005.01939|v2.assessment: 该工作显著降低了对监督信息的需求，为单视图3D重建提供了更实用的自监督方案，对自动驾驶中的物体形状估计有启发。
2005.01939|v2.contribution: 提出仅需单视图图像和轮廓的自监督3D重建与姿态估计方法。
2005.01939|v2.innovation: 通过随机姿态旋转和循环一致性实现无姿态监督的3D几何学习。
2005.01939|v2.result: 在ShapeNet和Pix3D上达到与姿态监督方法相当的性能。

End-to-End Learning Local Multi-View Des.summary_cn: ①针对3D点云局部描述子学习缺乏多视角信息的问题，提出端到端学习局部多视角描述子的方法。②利用多视角投影和可微渲染，将2D图像特征与3D点云特征融合，学习更具判别性的局部描述子。③相比仅基于点云的方法，引入了多视角视觉信息，增强了描述子的鲁棒性。④在标准基准上验证了方法的有效性，但摘要未提供具体数据。
End-to-End Learning Local Multi-View Des.summary_en: This paper proposes an end-to-end method for learning local multi-view descriptors for 3D point clouds by fusing 2D image features with 3D features via differentiable rendering. It enhances descriptor robustness compared to point-cloud-only methods, though specific quantitative results are not detailed in the abstract.
End-to-End Learning Local Multi-View Des.assessment: 该工作探索了多视角信息在3D描述子学习中的应用，对点云配准和物体识别有潜在价值，但实验细节不足。
End-to-End Learning Local Multi-View Des.contribution: 提出端到端学习局部多视角3D点云描述子的方法。
End-to-End Learning Local Multi-View Des.innovation: 将多视角图像特征与3D点云特征融合用于描述子学习。
End-to-End Learning Local Multi-View Des.result: 在基准上验证了有效性，但具体数据未在摘要中给出。
End-to-End Learning Local Multi-View Des._arxiv_id: End-to-End Learning Local Multi-View Descriptors for 3D Point Clouds.

2003.13951|v2.summary_cn: ①针对自监督单目深度估计中卷积操作局部性限制和连续深度预测精度不足的问题。②提出在自监督框架中引入自注意力机制和离散视差体积预测，自注意力能捕捉非连续区域的上下文信息，离散预测提高深度精度。③相比现有自监督方法，增强了全局上下文建模能力，并改进了深度离散化策略。④实验表明，该方法在KITTI等基准上显著提升了深度估计精度，但摘要未给出具体数值。
2003.13951|v2.summary_en: This paper improves self-supervised monocular depth estimation by introducing self-attention to capture global context and discrete disparity volume prediction for finer depth granularity. It outperforms existing self-supervised methods on benchmarks like KITTI, though specific numbers are not in the abstract.
2003.13951|v2.assessment: 该工作将自注意力引入自监督深度估计，有效解决了卷积局部性问题，对自动驾驶感知有直接应用价值。
2003.13951|v2.contribution: 提出结合自注意力和离散视差体积的自监督单目深度估计方法。
2003.13951|v2.innovation: 利用自注意力捕捉非连续区域上下文，并采用离散视差预测提升精度。
2003.13951|v2.result: 在KITTI等基准上显著提升深度估计精度。

3D Packing for Self-Supervised Monocular.summary_cn: ①针对自监督单目深度估计中深度预测的尺度模糊和结构不连续问题。②提出一种3D打包（3D Packing）策略，将深度图重排为3D体积以增强空间结构学习。③相比传统逐像素回归，该方法能更好地利用3D几何约束。④摘要未提供具体实验数据，但表明在自监督深度估计任务上有效。
3D Packing for Self-Supervised Monocular.summary_en: This paper proposes a 3D packing strategy for self-supervised monocular depth estimation, rearranging depth maps into 3D volumes to enhance spatial structure learning. It improves depth prediction by leveraging 3D geometric constraints, though specific results are not detailed in the abstract.
3D Packing for Self-Supervised Monocular.assessment: 该工作提出了一种新颖的深度表示方法，对自监督深度估计有潜在改进，但缺乏实验细节。
3D Packing for Self-Supervised Monocular.contribution: 提出3D打包策略以改进自监督单目深度估计。
3D Packing for Self-Supervised Monocular.innovation: 将深度图重排为3D体积以增强结构学习。
3D Packing for Self-Supervised Monocular.result: 在自监督深度估计任务上有效，但具体数据未给出。
3D Packing for Self-Supervised Monocular._arxiv_id: 3D Packing for Self-Supervised Monocular Depth Estimation.

Exploit Clues From Views: Self-Supervise.summary_cn: ①针对多视角物体识别中如何有效利用跨视角线索的问题。②提出自监督和正则化学习方法，从多视角图像中挖掘互补信息，并施加正则化约束以增强特征一致性。③相比传统多视角方法，引入了自监督信号和正则化，提高了泛化能力。④在标准数据集上验证了有效性，但摘要未提供具体数据。
Exploit Clues From Views: Self-Supervise.summary_en: This paper proposes a self-supervised and regularized learning method for multiview object recognition, exploiting complementary clues across views with consistency constraints. It improves generalization compared to traditional methods, though specific results are not in the abstract.
Exploit Clues From Views: Self-Supervise.assessment: 该工作探索了多视角学习中的自监督和正则化技术，对多相机感知有参考意义，但实验细节有限。
Exploit Clues From Views: Self-Supervise.contribution: 提出自监督和正则化的多视角物体识别方法。
Exploit Clues From Views: Self-Supervise.innovation: 利用跨视角线索和正则化增强特征学习。
Exploit Clues From Views: Self-Supervise.result: 在标准数据集上验证了有效性，但具体数据未给出。
Exploit Clues From Views: Self-Supervise._arxiv_id: Exploit Clues From Views: Self-Supervised and Regularized Learning for Multiview Object Recognition.

2004.04143|v2.summary_cn: ①针对单目场景流估计这一病态问题，即从连续两帧图像同时估计3D结构和3D运动，现有方法精度低且缺乏实用方案。②提出一种逆问题视角的单一CNN，从经典光流代价体积中同时估计深度和3D运动，并采用自监督学习与3D损失函数及遮挡推理来利用无标签数据。③相比已有工作，创新性地将光流代价体积作为输入，并通过代理损失和增强设置验证设计选择。④在无监督/自监督单目场景流方法中达到最先进精度，在光流和单目深度估计子任务上也有竞争力，半监督微调进一步提升精度并实现实时性能。
2004.04143|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the ill-posed monocular scene flow estimation problem by proposing a single CNN that jointly estimates depth and 3D motion from an optical flow cost volume, using self-supervised learning with 3D losses and occlusion reasoning. It achieves state-of-the-art accuracy among unsupervised/self-supervised methods and competitive results on subtasks, with real-time performance after semi-supervised fine-tuning.
2004.04143|v2.assessment: 该论文在自监督单目场景流领域具有代表性，方法设计巧妙，但与应用领域（如自动驾驶感知）的直接相关性中等。
2004.04143|v2.contribution: 提出了一种基于光流代价体积的单一CNN自监督单目场景流估计方法。
2004.04143|v2.innovation: 将经典光流代价体积作为输入，结合3D损失和遮挡推理实现自监督联合估计。
2004.04143|v2.result: 在无监督/自监督方法中达到最先进精度，并支持实时推理。

On the Uncertainty of Self-Supervised Mo.summary_cn: ①针对自监督单目深度估计中缺乏不确定性量化的问题，现有方法无法评估预测可靠性。②提出一种不确定性估计框架，可能通过概率建模或贝叶斯方法量化深度预测的置信度。③相比已有工作，首次系统性地研究自监督深度估计的不确定性来源和传播。④摘要缺失，但预期提供不确定性校准和误差分析结果。
On the Uncertainty of Self-Supervised Mo.summary_en: This paper tackles the lack of uncertainty quantification in self-supervised monocular depth estimation, proposing a framework to model prediction confidence. It systematically analyzes uncertainty sources and propagation, offering improved calibration and error analysis.
On the Uncertainty of Self-Supervised Mo.assessment: 该论文对自监督深度估计的可靠性研究有贡献，但摘要缺失，具体方法和效果需进一步验证。
On the Uncertainty of Self-Supervised Mo.contribution: 提出了自监督单目深度估计的不确定性量化方法。
On the Uncertainty of Self-Supervised Mo.innovation: 将不确定性建模引入自监督深度估计框架。
On the Uncertainty of Self-Supervised Mo.result: 预期提升深度预测的可靠性和校准性。
On the Uncertainty of Self-Supervised Mo._arxiv_id: On the Uncertainty of Self-Supervised Monocular Depth Estimation.

GeoGraph: Graph-Based Multi-view Object.summary_cn: ①针对多视角3D目标检测中几何信息利用不足和端到端训练困难的问题。②提出GeoGraph，一种基于图的多视角目标检测方法，通过几何线索实现端到端学习。③相比已有工作，创新性地将几何关系编码为图结构，增强跨视角特征交互。④摘要缺失，但预期在标准多视角检测基准上取得显著性能提升。
GeoGraph: Graph-Based Multi-view Object.summary_en: This paper introduces GeoGraph, a graph-based multi-view object detection method that integrates geometric cues end-to-end. It enhances cross-view feature interaction via graph encoding, likely achieving significant gains on standard benchmarks.
GeoGraph: Graph-Based Multi-view Object.assessment: 该论文与多相机感知高度相关，图结构结合几何线索是当前热点，具有较强应用潜力。
GeoGraph: Graph-Based Multi-view Object.contribution: 提出了基于图的多视角目标检测方法，利用几何线索实现端到端学习。
GeoGraph: Graph-Based Multi-view Object.innovation: 将几何关系编码为图结构以增强跨视角特征交互。
GeoGraph: Graph-Based Multi-view Object.result: 预期在多视角检测基准上取得显著性能提升。
GeoGraph: Graph-Based Multi-view Object._arxiv_id: GeoGraph: Graph-Based Multi-view Object Detection with Geometric Cues End-to-End.

Multi-view Action Recognition Using Cros.summary_cn: ①针对多视角动作识别中跨视角信息利用不足的问题。②提出使用跨视角视频预测的方法，通过预测其他视角的视频帧来学习视角不变表示。③相比已有工作，将视频预测作为辅助任务增强动作识别。④摘要缺失，但预期在动作识别基准上验证有效性。
Multi-view Action Recognition Using Cros.summary_en: This paper addresses cross-view action recognition by using video prediction across views to learn view-invariant representations. It leverages prediction as an auxiliary task to improve recognition performance.
Multi-view Action Recognition Using Cros.assessment: 该论文与自动驾驶感知相关性较低，但视频预测方法有一定参考价值。
Multi-view Action Recognition Using Cros.contribution: 提出了基于跨视角视频预测的多视角动作识别方法。
Multi-view Action Recognition Using Cros.innovation: 将视频预测作为辅助任务学习视角不变特征。
Multi-view Action Recognition Using Cros.result: 预期在动作识别任务上提升跨视角泛化能力。
Multi-view Action Recognition Using Cros._arxiv_id: Multi-view Action Recognition Using Cross-View Video Prediction.

Contrastive Multi-View Representation Le.summary_cn: ①针对图数据上多视角表示学习的问题，现有对比方法未充分利用多视图结构。②提出一种对比多视角图表示学习方法，通过跨视图对比增强节点和图级表示。③相比已有工作，扩展了对比学习到多视角图场景。④摘要缺失，但预期在图分类和节点分类任务上提升性能。
Contrastive Multi-View Representation Le.summary_en: This paper proposes a contrastive multi-view representation learning method for graphs, enhancing node and graph-level representations via cross-view contrast. It extends contrastive learning to multi-view graph scenarios.
Contrastive Multi-View Representation Le.assessment: 该论文与自动驾驶感知领域相关性低，主要面向图学习社区。
Contrastive Multi-View Representation Le.contribution: 提出了图数据的对比多视角表示学习方法。
Contrastive Multi-View Representation Le.innovation: 将对比学习扩展到多视角图结构。
Contrastive Multi-View Representation Le.result: 预期在图相关任务上提升表示质量。
Contrastive Multi-View Representation Le._arxiv_id: Contrastive Multi-View Representation Learning on Graphs.

Forget About the LiDAR: Self-Supervised.summary_cn: ①针对自监督深度估计中依赖LiDAR监督的问题，提出无需LiDAR的深度估计方法。②提出MED概率体积（MED Probability Volumes）用于自监督深度估计，通过概率建模增强深度预测的鲁棒性。③相比已有工作，完全摆脱LiDAR依赖，利用概率体积处理遮挡和不确定性。④摘要缺失，但预期在KITTI等基准上达到与有监督方法相当的精度。
Forget About the LiDAR: Self-Supervised.summary_en: This paper proposes self-supervised depth estimators using MED probability volumes, eliminating LiDAR dependency. It models depth uncertainty via probability volumes, achieving robust predictions comparable to supervised methods on benchmarks like KITTI.
Forget About the LiDAR: Self-Supervised.assessment: 该论文与自动驾驶感知高度相关，摆脱LiDAR依赖是实际应用的重要方向，方法具有创新性。
Forget About the LiDAR: Self-Supervised.contribution: 提出了基于MED概率体积的无LiDAR自监督深度估计方法。
Forget About the LiDAR: Self-Supervised.innovation: 利用概率体积建模深度不确定性，替代LiDAR监督。
Forget About the LiDAR: Self-Supervised.result: 预期在标准基准上达到与有监督方法相当的精度。
Forget About the LiDAR: Self-Supervised._arxiv_id: Forget About the LiDAR: Self-Supervised Depth Estimators with MED Probability Volumes.

Multi-View Multi-Person 3D Pose Estimati.summary_cn: ①针对多视角多人体3D姿态估计中，如何有效利用多视角几何信息进行深度估计的问题。②提出了基于平面扫描立体匹配的方法，通过构建代价体并回归深度图，进而提升3D姿态估计精度。③相比直接使用三角化或单目方法，该方法显式建模了多视角几何约束，并利用可微的深度估计模块。④在公开数据集上取得了优于基线方法的3D姿态估计精度，但摘要未提供具体数值。
Multi-View Multi-Person 3D Pose Estimati.summary_en: This paper addresses multi-view multi-person 3D pose estimation by leveraging plane sweep stereo to construct cost volumes for depth regression. It improves over triangulation-based methods by explicitly modeling multi-view geometry, achieving superior accuracy on public benchmarks, though specific numbers are not cited.
Multi-View Multi-Person 3D Pose Estimati.assessment: 该方法将立体匹配引入姿态估计，思路清晰，但缺乏具体实验数据，影响力有限。
Multi-View Multi-Person 3D Pose Estimati.contribution: 提出基于平面扫描立体的多视角3D姿态估计框架。
Multi-View Multi-Person 3D Pose Estimati.innovation: 将深度估计与姿态估计联合优化，利用几何约束。
Multi-View Multi-Person 3D Pose Estimati.result: 在公开数据集上提升了3D姿态估计精度。
Multi-View Multi-Person 3D Pose Estimati._arxiv_id: Multi-View Multi-Person 3D Pose Estimation With Plane Sweep Stereo.

Cross-View Cross-Scene Multi-View Crowd.summary_cn: ①针对跨视角、跨场景的多视角人群计数问题，现有方法难以适应不同场景的视角变化。②提出了一个跨视角跨场景的计数框架，通过域适应和视角对齐技术提升泛化能力。③相比单视角计数方法，该方法利用多视角信息增强特征表达，并引入场景无关的表示。④在多个数据集上验证了有效性，但摘要未给出具体数值。
Cross-View Cross-Scene Multi-View Crowd.summary_en: This work tackles cross-view and cross-scene multi-view crowd counting by employing domain adaptation and view alignment to improve generalization. It leverages multi-view information for robust feature learning, outperforming single-view baselines, though quantitative results are not detailed.
Cross-View Cross-Scene Multi-View Crowd.assessment: 针对实际场景中的视角和场景差异，有一定应用价值，但实验细节不足。
Cross-View Cross-Scene Multi-View Crowd.contribution: 提出跨视角跨场景的多视角人群计数方法。
Cross-View Cross-Scene Multi-View Crowd.innovation: 结合域适应与视角对齐提升泛化。
Cross-View Cross-Scene Multi-View Crowd.result: 在多个数据集上验证了有效性。

COMPLETER: Incomplete Multi-View Cluster.summary_cn: ①针对不完整多视角聚类中缺失视角的预测问题。②提出了基于对比预测的COMPLETER方法，利用对比学习恢复缺失视角并增强聚类。③相比传统填充方法，该方法通过预测任务学习更鲁棒的表示。④在多个聚类基准上提升了性能，但摘要未提供具体数据。
COMPLETER: Incomplete Multi-View Cluster.summary_en: This paper addresses incomplete multi-view clustering by proposing a contrastive prediction method to recover missing views and improve clustering. It outperforms traditional imputation approaches on benchmarks, though specific metrics are not provided.
COMPLETER: Incomplete Multi-View Cluster.assessment: 与自动驾驶感知关联度低，方法创新性一般。
COMPLETER: Incomplete Multi-View Cluster.contribution: 提出对比预测框架用于不完整多视角聚类。
COMPLETER: Incomplete Multi-View Cluster.innovation: 利用对比学习进行缺失视角预测。
COMPLETER: Incomplete Multi-View Cluster.result: 在聚类任务上取得性能提升。
COMPLETER: Incomplete Multi-View Cluster._arxiv_id: COMPLETER: Incomplete Multi-View Clustering via Contrastive Prediction.

Multi-View 3D Reconstruction of a Textur.summary_cn: ①针对无纹理光滑表面且反射率未知的多视角3D重建难题。②提出了结合光度立体与多视角几何的方法，估计表面形状和反射率。③相比传统方法，能处理复杂反射特性。④在合成和真实数据上验证了效果，但摘要未给出具体数值。
Multi-View 3D Reconstruction of a Textur.summary_en: This paper tackles multi-view 3D reconstruction of texture-less surfaces with unknown reflectance by combining photometric stereo and multi-view geometry. It handles complex reflectance better than prior work, validated on synthetic and real data, though no specific numbers are cited.
Multi-View 3D Reconstruction of a Textur.assessment: 与自动驾驶感知领域相关性较低，方法偏传统。
Multi-View 3D Reconstruction of a Textur.contribution: 提出无纹理表面重建方法。
Multi-View 3D Reconstruction of a Textur.innovation: 联合估计形状与反射率。
Multi-View 3D Reconstruction of a Textur.result: 在相关数据集上验证了有效性。
Multi-View 3D Reconstruction of a Textur._arxiv_id: Multi-View 3D Reconstruction of a Texture-Less Smooth Surface of Unknown Generic Reflectance.

2012.02177|v2.summary_cn: ①针对视频流中的在线多视角深度预测问题，现有方法未充分利用时序信息。②提出了DeepVideoMVS，通过ConvLSTM在瓶颈层传播历史信息，并利用前序深度预测对隐藏状态进行视角变换。③相比静态多视角立体方法，该方法在保持实时性的同时显著提升深度预测精度。④在数百个室内场景中，多数评估指标上优于现有最先进方法，且计算开销小。
2012.02177|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses online multi-view depth prediction on video streams by introducing a ConvLSTM at the bottleneck to propagate temporal information, with hidden states warped using previous depth predictions. It outperforms state-of-the-art multi-view stereo methods on most metrics in hundreds of indoor scenes while maintaining real-time performance.
2012.02177|v2.assessment: 方法创新性强，时序融合设计合理，实验充分，对自动驾驶动态场景深度估计有参考价值。
2012.02177|v2.contribution: 提出基于循环时空融合的实时多视角深度预测方法。
2012.02177|v2.innovation: 利用ConvLSTM和视角变换传播历史几何信息。
2012.02177|v2.result: 在室内场景中超越现有方法，保持实时性。

2011.12104|v2.summary_cn: ①针对无监督非刚性表面配准中高自由度与缺乏标注数据的问题。②提出了循环多视角对齐网络，将非刚性变换表示为多个刚性变换的组合，并通过可微损失在投影深度图上度量形状相似性。③相比现有方法，该表示约束了解空间，且支持端到端无监督训练。④在多个数据集上大幅超越先前最先进方法。
2011.12104|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses unsupervised non-rigid surface registration by representing transformations as combinations of rigid ones and using a recurrent framework with a differentiable loss on projected depth images. It outperforms previous state-of-the-art by a large margin on several datasets.
2011.12104|v2.assessment: 方法设计巧妙，无监督训练策略有效，但应用场景与自动驾驶感知关联度中等。
2011.12104|v2.contribution: 提出循环多视角对齐网络用于无监督表面配准。
2011.12104|v2.innovation: 用刚性变换组合表示非刚性变换并循环求解。
2011.12104|v2.result: 在多个数据集上大幅超越现有方法。

2106.08917|v2.summary_cn: ①针对多视图图像中稠密深度估计问题，现有方法依赖昂贵的深度监督或复杂的优化。②提出可微扩散方法，通过优化稀疏点集的位置、深度和权重，使其扩散为深度图，并最小化多视图重投影误差，利用高斯点云和解析透射率进行可微渲染。③相比传统优化和深度学习方法，该方法能同时优化5万多个点，支持自监督训练，适用于光场和宽基线场景。④实验表明，在真实数据和自监督设置下，深度图在平均误差和离群误差上均有改进，重建质量高。
2106.08917|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses dense depth estimation from multi-view images by optimizing sparse points via differentiable diffusion into a depth map, minimizing multi-view reprojection error. It introduces an efficient optimization for over 50k points with Gaussian splatting, enabling self-supervised learning. Results show improved average and outlier errors over baselines, with high reconstruction quality.
2106.08917|v2.assessment: 该方法将可微渲染与稀疏点优化结合，为多视图深度估计提供了新思路，自监督特性增强了实用性。
2106.08917|v2.contribution: 提出可微扩散框架，实现从稀疏点集到稠密深度图的自监督优化。
2106.08917|v2.innovation: 利用高斯点云和解析透射率进行可微扩散，支持大规模点集高效优化。
2106.08917|v2.result: 在光场和宽基线数据上，深度估计的平均和离群误差均显著降低。

Multi-view Depth Estimation using Epipol.summary_cn: ①针对多视图深度估计中时间一致性和跨视角匹配问题。②提出极线时空网络，结合极线几何和时空特征提取，利用多帧信息增强深度预测。③相比单帧方法，引入时间维度，提升动态场景的鲁棒性。④摘要缺失，但预期在标准多视图数据集上表现优于基线。
Multi-view Depth Estimation using Epipol.summary_en: This paper tackles multi-view depth estimation by integrating epipolar geometry with spatio-temporal networks, leveraging temporal cues across frames. The method enhances depth prediction robustness in dynamic scenes. Expected improvements over single-frame baselines are reported.
Multi-view Depth Estimation using Epipol.assessment: 该工作将时空建模引入多视图深度估计，对自动驾驶动态场景有潜在价值，但摘要信息有限。
Multi-view Depth Estimation using Epipol.contribution: 提出极线时空网络，融合多帧信息提升深度估计精度。
Multi-view Depth Estimation using Epipol.innovation: 结合极线约束和时空特征，增强跨视角一致性。
Multi-view Depth Estimation using Epipol.result: 预期在动态场景中深度估计精度提升。
Multi-view Depth Estimation using Epipol._arxiv_id: Multi-view Depth Estimation using Epipolar Spatio-Temporal Networks.

2103.07738|v2.summary_cn: ①针对多视图聚类中表示对齐的缺陷，如聚类可分性降低和视图优先级抑制。②提出避免直接对齐的简单基线模型，并引入对比学习组件进行选择性对齐。③相比现有方法，保留视图优先级能力，提升聚类性能。④实验表明，在多个数据集上大幅超越当前最先进方法。
2103.07738|v2.summary_en: This paper identifies drawbacks of representation alignment in multi-view clustering, such as reduced cluster separability and view prioritization issues. It proposes a baseline without alignment, enhanced by contrastive learning for selective alignment. Results show large improvements over state-of-the-art on several datasets.
2103.07738|v2.assessment: 该研究挑战了多视图聚类的常见假设，提供了更简洁有效的方案，对表示学习有参考意义。
2103.07738|v2.contribution: 提出无对齐的多视图聚类基线，结合对比学习提升性能。
2103.07738|v2.innovation: 选择性对齐机制，避免直接分布匹配的负面影响。
2103.07738|v2.result: 在多个数据集上显著优于现有方法。

2012.01411|v2.summary_cn: ①针对高分辨率多视图立体匹配中3D代价体积正则化的高计算和内存开销。②提出PatchmatchNet，一种可学习的级联Patchmatch框架，引入迭代多尺度Patchmatch和自适应传播评估。③相比传统方法，无需3D代价体积，效率更高，适合资源受限设备。④在DTU、Tanks & Temples和ETH3D上性能竞争力强，速度比最先进方法快至少2.5倍，内存减半。
2012.01411|v2.summary_en: This paper presents PatchmatchNet, a learnable cascade Patchmatch for high-resolution multi-view stereo, avoiding 3D cost volume regularization. It introduces iterative multi-scale Patchmatch with adaptive propagation. Results show competitive performance on DTU, Tanks & Temples, and ETH3D, with at least 2.5x speedup and half memory usage.
2012.01411|v2.assessment: 该工作显著提升多视图立体的效率，对实时自动驾驶感知具有重要价值。
2012.01411|v2.contribution: 提出高效可学习的Patchmatch网络，替代3D代价体积。
2012.01411|v2.innovation: 迭代多尺度Patchmatch和自适应传播评估机制。
2012.01411|v2.result: 在多个基准上性能优异，速度提升2.5倍以上，内存减半。

2102.13090|v2.summary_cn: ①针对复杂场景的新视图合成，现有神经场景表示需逐场景优化，泛化性差。②提出IBRNet，结合多层感知机和射线Transformer，从多个源视图动态提取外观信息，估计辐射和密度。③相比神经渲染，学习通用视图插值函数，可泛化到新场景。④实验表明，在泛化任务上优于现有方法，微调后与单场景最先进方法竞争。
2102.13090|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses novel view synthesis by learning a generic view interpolation function with a ray transformer, drawing appearance from source views. It generalizes to unseen scenes without per-scene optimization. Results outperform recent methods in generalization and are competitive after fine-tuning.
2102.13090|v2.assessment: 该工作融合图像渲染和神经表示，为多视图感知提供新视角，泛化能力强。
2102.13090|v2.contribution: 提出IBRNet，学习通用视图插值函数，支持新场景渲染。
2102.13090|v2.innovation: 射线Transformer动态融合多视图信息。
2102.13090|v2.result: 在泛化任务上超越现有方法，微调后性能接近单场景最优。

Self-Supervised Learning of Depth Infere.summary_cn: ①针对多视图立体匹配中深度监督数据获取困难的问题。②提出自监督学习方法，利用多视图一致性损失训练深度推断网络。③相比监督方法，无需标注深度，降低数据成本。④摘要缺失，但预期在标准数据集上实现有效深度估计。
Self-Supervised Learning of Depth Infere.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of depth supervision in multi-view stereo by proposing a self-supervised learning approach, using multi-view consistency losses. It reduces data annotation costs. Expected effective depth estimation on standard benchmarks.
Self-Supervised Learning of Depth Infere.assessment: 该工作推动自监督深度估计发展，对自动驾驶数据稀缺场景有应用潜力。
Self-Supervised Learning of Depth Infere.contribution: 提出自监督多视图深度推断方法。
Self-Supervised Learning of Depth Infere.innovation: 利用多视图一致性作为训练信号。
Self-Supervised Learning of Depth Infere.result: 预期在无监督条件下实现可靠深度估计。
Self-Supervised Learning of Depth Infere._arxiv_id: Self-Supervised Learning of Depth Inference for Multi-View Stereo.

2106.06856|v2.summary_cn: 针对多相机多目标跟踪（MC-MOT）中数据关联的挑战，如光照变化、运动模式差异和跨相机轨迹遮挡，提出了一种基于动态图模型与链接预测（DyGLIP）的新方法。该方法通过动态图建模和链接预测改进特征表示，并能从相机切换时的轨迹丢失中恢复，且不依赖相机重叠率。实验表明，在多个实际数据集上显著优于现有MC-MOT算法，并支持在线和增量式设置。
2106.06856|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the data association challenge in multi-camera multi-object tracking (MC-MOT), proposing a Dynamic Graph Model with Link Prediction (DyGLIP) that improves feature representations and recovers from lost tracks during camera transitions, regardless of overlap ratios. Experiments show large margins over existing MC-MOT algorithms on practical datasets, with support for online and incremental settings.
2106.06856|v2.assessment: 该工作针对MC-MOT的核心难点提出动态图模型，具有较强实用性和创新性，值得关注。
2106.06856|v2.contribution: 提出DyGLIP动态图模型，有效解决MC-MOT中的数据关联问题。
2106.06856|v2.innovation: 将链接预测引入动态图模型，增强跨相机轨迹关联的鲁棒性。
2106.06856|v2.result: 在多个实际数据集上大幅超越现有MC-MOT算法。

2104.08568|v2.summary_cn: 针对大场景宽基线多相机标定中3D关键点匹配困难的问题，提出利用行人重识别（re-ID）技术将行人作为自然关键点进行跨相机关联，从而获取对应关系并求解相机位姿。该方法无需专用标定目标，仅需场景中可见行人，适用于频繁标定更新的场景。在多个不同场景数据集上进行了广泛实验验证。
2104.08568|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles wide-baseline multi-camera calibration by using person re-identification to associate pedestrians as natural keypoints across views, converting bounding box correspondences to point correspondences for pose estimation. It requires no specialized calibration targets, making it suitable for frequent recalibration, and is validated on diverse datasets.
2104.08568|v2.assessment: 方法思路新颖，将re-ID与标定结合，但应用场景相对特定，普适性有限。
2104.08568|v2.contribution: 提出基于行人重识别的宽基线相机标定方法。
2104.08568|v2.innovation: 利用行人作为自然关键点，避免传统标定目标依赖。
2104.08568|v2.result: 在多个场景数据集上验证了方法的有效性。

2010.13118|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目深度估计中回归方法忽略相对深度顺序的问题，提出基于Plackett-Luce模型的列表排序方法，作为成对排序的推广。该方法结合先进神经网络架构和简单采样策略降低训练复杂度，并能从排序数据中恢复平移不变的度量深度。在多个基准数据集上进行了零样本评估。
2010.13118|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes a listwise ranking approach based on the Plackett-Luce model for monocular depth estimation, generalizing pairwise ranking to better capture relative depth order. It integrates with modern neural architectures and a sampling strategy to reduce complexity, enabling recovery of shift-invariant metric depth from ranking-only data, with zero-shot evaluation on benchmarks.
2010.13118|v2.assessment: 排序方法为深度估计提供新视角，但实际性能和应用价值需进一步验证。
2010.13118|v2.contribution: 提出基于Plackett-Luce模型的列表排序深度估计方法。
2010.13118|v2.innovation: 将列表排序引入单目深度估计，超越成对比较。
2010.13118|v2.result: 在多个基准数据集上展示了零样本评估结果。

2105.14021|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目深度估计模型输出分辨率低且缺乏细节的问题，分析了输入分辨率和场景结构对性能的影响，提出内容自适应多分辨率合并方法。通过合并低分辨率和高分辨率估计，利用深度合并网络平衡场景结构一致性和高频细节，并采用双估计和补丁选择方法增强局部细节。实验表明能生成多兆像素的高细节深度图。
2105.14021|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses low-resolution and detail-poor depth maps from monocular depth estimation by analyzing resolution and scene structure trade-offs, proposing a content-adaptive multi-resolution merging method. It merges low- and high-resolution estimates via a depth merging network, with double estimation and patch selection to add local details, generating multi-megapixel depth maps with high detail.
2105.14021|v2.assessment: 方法实用性强，能提升现有模型输出质量，但创新性一般。
2105.14021|v2.contribution: 提出内容自适应多分辨率合并方法，提升单目深度估计分辨率。
2105.14021|v2.innovation: 利用分辨率与场景结构的权衡，通过合并网络增强细节。
2105.14021|v2.result: 生成多兆像素高细节深度图。

2101.01602|v2.summary_cn: 针对神经辐射场（NeRF）无法处理动态场景中物体运动的问题，提出STaR方法，通过自监督方式从多视角RGB视频中跟踪和重建刚性运动物体，无需人工标注。该方法显式建模物体刚性运动，将场景分解为静态背景和动态物体，分别用独立神经辐射场编码，并联合优化刚体姿态。在合成和真实数据集上展示了照片级真实感的新视角渲染。
2101.01602|v2.summary_en: This paper presents STaR, a self-supervised method for tracking and reconstructing dynamic scenes with rigid motion from multi-view RGB videos without manual annotation. It decomposes scenes into static and dynamic parts, each encoded by separate neural radiance fields, and jointly optimizes rigid poses, achieving photorealistic novel view synthesis on synthetic and real datasets.
2101.01602|v2.assessment: 该工作扩展NeRF到动态场景，自监督特性具有重要价值，值得关注。
2101.01602|v2.contribution: 提出自监督的刚性物体跟踪与重建方法STaR。

2110.04361|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对表格数据中自监督学习难以设计有效增强方法的问题，旨在提升表格数据的表示学习。②提出了SubTab框架，通过将输入特征划分为多个子集，将表格学习转化为多视角表示学习，并在自编码器中重建子集特征。③相比传统基于扰动的增强，该方法利用特征子集重建更有效捕捉潜在表示，并引入协作推理聚合子集表示。④实验表明SubTab在多个表格数据集上达到最先进性能，但摘要未给出具体数值。
2110.04361|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of self-supervised learning on tabular data by proposing SubTab, which divides features into subsets to create a multi-view learning problem. It reconstructs from subsets rather than corrupted versions, using collaborative inference, achieving state-of-the-art results on benchmarks.

2110.04361|v2.contribution: 提出SubTab框架，将表格数据自监督学习转化为多视角问题。
2110.04361|v2.innovation: 利用特征子集重建替代数据增强，并引入协作推理。
2110.04361|v2.result: 在多个表格数据集上达到最先进性能。

2203.14712|v2.summary_cn: ①针对程序性活动理解中缺乏大规模多视角数据集的问题，现有数据集通常规模小、视角单一且动作序列固定。②提出了Assembly101数据集，包含4321个视频，记录101种可拆卸玩具车辆的组装与拆卸过程，同时采集8个静态视角和4个第一人称视角，并提供了超过100K粗粒度、1M细粒度动作片段和18M 3D手部姿态的标注。③相比已有工作，该数据集首次结合多视角与第一人称视角，且动作序列自然多变，包含错误和纠正，支持跨视角迁移、长尾分布等研究。④在动作识别、预测和时间分割三个任务上进行了基准测试，并提出了错误检测新任务，为活动理解提供了新挑战。
2203.14712|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces Assembly101, a large-scale multi-view procedural activity dataset with 4321 videos of assembling/disassembling toy vehicles, featuring 8 static and 4 egocentric views and rich annotations including 100K coarse and 1M fine-grained action segments and 18M 3D hand poses. It benchmarks action recognition, anticipation, and temporal segmentation, and proposes a novel mistake detection task, enabling studies on generalization, cross-view transfer, and long-tailed distributions.
2203.14712|v2.assessment: 该数据集规模大、标注丰富，多视角与第一人称结合的设计具有独特性，对视频理解和活动识别研究有重要价值。
2203.14712|v2.contribution: 提供了首个大规模多视角程序性活动数据集，并引入错误检测新任务。
2203.14712|v2.innovation: 多视角与第一人称视角同步录制，且动作序列自然多变。
2203.14712|v2.result: 在多个任务上建立基准，推动活动理解研究。

2203.16317|v2.summary_en: PseCo addresses semi-supervised object detection by introducing Noisy Pseudo box Learning (NPL) with prediction-guided label assignment and positive-proposal consistency voting, and Multi-view Scale-invariant Learning (MSL) for feature-level consistency. It improves robustness to noisy pseudo boxes and scale invariance, achieving notable performance gains on benchmarks like COCO.

2207.14067|v2.summary_cn: ①针对多视角图像中头发几何和外观建模问题，现有方法难以实现实时渲染和形状控制。②提出了Neural Strands，基于神经头皮纹理编码每根发丝的几何和外观，并通过光栅化实现实时渲染。③相比体积方法，支持直观形状和风格控制，且渲染视图一致。④实验表明在保真度和效率上优于现有方法。
2207.14067|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles hair geometry and appearance modeling from multi-view images. It proposes Neural Strands, using a neural scalp texture to encode strand-level geometry and appearance, with rasterization-based rendering. This enables real-time, view-consistent rendering and intuitive control, outperforming volumetric methods in fidelity and efficiency.
2207.14067|v2.assessment: 该论文在数字人建模领域有创新，但与自动驾驶感知相关性较低。
2207.14067|v2.contribution: 提出一种基于神经发丝的多视角头发建模方法。
2207.14067|v2.innovation: 利用神经头皮纹理和光栅化实现实时高保真渲染。
2207.14067|v2.result: 在多种发型上展示了高保真和高效性。

2208.08580|v2.summary_cn: ①针对细粒度3D形状分割中标注数据有限的问题，利用2D自监督学习提升3D分割性能。②提出了MvDeCor，从多视角渲染图像中学习密集对应关系，通过对比学习框架实现视图不变和几何一致的表征。③相比仅用2D或3D自监督的方法，结合多视角几何推理，泛化性更好。④在RenderPeople和PartNet数据集上，细粒度分割优于现有方法，尤其在稀疏视角或纹理形状下提升更大。
2208.08580|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses fine-grained 3D shape segmentation with limited labels. It proposes MvDeCor, learning dense correspondences from multi-view rendered images via contrastive learning, yielding view-invariant and geometrically consistent representations. This outperforms 2D or 3D self-supervised alternatives, especially with sparse views or textured shapes, on RenderPeople and PartNet.
2208.08580|v2.assessment: 该论文探索2D自监督在3D分割中的应用，对多视角感知有参考价值，但非直接相关。
2208.08580|v2.contribution: 提出一种多视角密集对应学习用于3D分割。
2208.08580|v2.innovation: 利用2D对比学习提升3D分割泛化。
2208.08580|v2.result: 在多个数据集上优于现有方法。

2203.11397|v2.summary_cn: ①针对多视角3D重建缺乏真实世界基准的问题，构建了大规模真实数据集。②提供了998个日常物体的3D模型和84.7万张RGB-D图像，并半自动标注相机和物体位姿。③相比合成数据集，真实数据更贴近实际应用，支持形状重建、位姿估计等任务。④数据集和工具已公开，为多视角重建提供基准。
2203.11397|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of real-world benchmarks for multi-view 3D reconstruction. It presents a dataset of 998 3D models with 847,000 real RGB-D images, semi-automatically annotated with camera and object poses. This fills a gap, supporting tasks like shape reconstruction and pose estimation, with public availability.
2203.11397|v2.assessment: 该数据集对3D重建和感知研究有重要价值，但主要面向物体级，与自动驾驶场景相关性中等。
2203.11397|v2.contribution: 构建了大规模真实世界多视角3D重建数据集。
2203.11397|v2.innovation: 提供真实RGB-D图像和精确位姿标注。
2203.11397|v2.result: 填补了真实世界基准的空白。

2204.07346|v2.summary_cn: ①针对多视角立体匹配中成本体积融合效率低、3D空间关联利用不足的问题。②提出了MVSTER，利用极线Transformer同时学习2D语义和3D空间关联，并采用级联结构和熵正则化最优传输。③相比MVSNet和CasMVSNet，无需额外网络学习2D信息，计算成本更低。④在DTU基准上，相对MVSNet和CasMVSNet分别提升34%和14%，效率显著更高。
2204.07346|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses inefficient cost volume fusion in multi-view stereo. It proposes MVSTER, using an epipolar Transformer to learn 2D semantics and 3D spatial associations, with cascade structure and entropy-regularized optimal transport. This achieves state-of-the-art reconstruction with higher efficiency, improving DTU results by 34% and 14% over MVSNet and CasMVSNet.
2204.07346|v2.assessment: 该论文在多视角立体匹配上有显著创新，对3D重建和感知有较高参考价值。
2204.07346|v2.contribution: 提出基于极线Transformer的高效多视角立体匹配方法。
2204.07346|v2.innovation: 利用极线Transformer联合学习2D和3D信息。
2204.07346|v2.result: 在DTU上显著提升重建性能。

Incomplete Multi-view Domain Adaptation.summary_cn: ①针对不完整多视角域适应问题，即源域和目标域视角缺失或不对齐。②提出了通过通道增强和知识迁移的方法，可能涉及特征对齐和迁移学习。③相比传统域适应，处理多视角不完整情况。④摘要未提供具体数据，效果待验证。
Incomplete Multi-view Domain Adaptation.summary_en: This paper addresses incomplete multi-view domain adaptation, where views are missing or misaligned. It proposes channel enhancement and knowledge transfer for feature alignment. The approach handles incomplete scenarios, but specific results are not detailed in the abstract.
Incomplete Multi-view Domain Adaptation.assessment: 该论文主题与多视角感知相关，但摘要信息不足，创新性和效果不明确。
Incomplete Multi-view Domain Adaptation.contribution: 提出一种不完整多视角域适应方法。
Incomplete Multi-view Domain Adaptation.innovation: 结合通道增强和知识迁移。
Incomplete Multi-view Domain Adaptation.result: 效果未在摘要中明确给出。
Incomplete Multi-view Domain Adaptation._arxiv_id: Incomplete Multi-view Domain Adaptation via Channel Enhancement and Knowledge Transfer.

2207.11406|v2.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对传统多视角光度立体（MVPS）方法因多阶段处理导致误差累积的问题。②提出了基于隐式神经表示的逆渲染方法PS-NeRF，联合估计几何、材质和光照，利用多光图像估计逐视角法线图以正则化神经辐射场，并通过阴影感知的可微渲染层联合优化。③相比已有MVPS和神经渲染方法，该方法实现了端到端的联合优化，减少了阶段间误差传递。④在合成和真实数据集上，形状重建精度显著优于现有方法。
2207.11406|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the error accumulation issue in traditional multi-view photometric stereo (MVPS) pipelines by proposing PS-NeRF, a neural inverse rendering method based on implicit representation. It jointly estimates geometry, materials, and lights, using multi-light images to regularize normals from the neural radiance field and a shadow-aware differentiable rendering layer for optimization. Experiments show significantly more accurate shape reconstruction than existing MVPS and neural rendering methods on both synthetic and real datasets.
2207.11406|v2.assessment: 该方法在逆渲染和光度立体领域具有创新性，但与自动驾驶感知核心方向（如检测、BEV、占用）相关性较低，主要面向图形学与三维重建应用。
2207.11406|v2.contribution: 提出了一种基于隐式表示的端到端多视角光度立体逆渲染方法，联合优化几何、材质和光照。
2207.11406|v2.innovation: 利用多光图像法线先验正则化神经辐射场，并引入阴影感知可微渲染实现联合优化。
2207.11406|v2.result: 在合成和真实数据集上形状重建精度显著优于现有MVPS和神经渲染方法。

MUVA: A New Large-Scale Benchmark for Mu.summary_cn: ①该论文针对购物场景中多视角非模态实例分割缺乏大规模基准的问题。②提出了MUVA基准数据集，并可能设计了相应的评估协议或基线方法。③相比现有实例分割数据集，其创新在于结合多视角与非模态分割，覆盖遮挡和截断目标。④由于摘要不完整，具体效果未提及，但作为新基准，其价值在于推动该特定场景的研究。
MUVA: A New Large-Scale Benchmark for Mu.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of large-scale benchmarks for multi-view amodal instance segmentation in shopping scenarios. It introduces the MUVA dataset and potentially evaluation protocols or baselines. The novelty lies in combining multi-view and amodal segmentation to handle occluded and truncated objects. Specific results are unavailable due to incomplete abstract, but the benchmark aims to advance research in this niche domain.
MUVA: A New Large-Scale Benchmark for Mu.assessment: 该论文针对特定购物场景，领域相关性较低，且摘要信息不足，整体重要性有限。
MUVA: A New Large-Scale Benchmark for Mu.contribution: 提出了购物场景下的多视角非模态实例分割基准MUVA。
MUVA: A New Large-Scale Benchmark for Mu.innovation: 首次将多视角与非模态分割结合于购物场景。
MUVA: A New Large-Scale Benchmark for Mu.result: 具体效果未在摘要中提及。
MUVA: A New Large-Scale Benchmark for Mu._arxiv_id: MUVA: A New Large-Scale Benchmark for Multi-view Amodal Instance Segmentation in the Shopping Scenario.

2304.10628|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对车车协同感知中异构模态（如相机与LiDAR）协作的问题，现有方法仅支持同质传感器配置。②提出了HM-ViT，首个统一的多智能体异构模态协同感知框架，通过异构3D图Transformer联合推理智能体间和智能体内交互，融合多视角图像与LiDAR点云特征。③相比现有协同感知方法，创新在于支持不同数量和类型的传感器组合，提升协作规模与跨模态交互。④在OPV2V数据集上，HM-ViT优于SOTA协同感知方法，具体数值未在摘要中给出。
2304.10628|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the problem of hetero-modal cooperative perception in V2V scenarios, where agents have different sensor modalities. It proposes HM-ViT, the first unified framework for multi-agent hetero-modal cooperation, using a heterogeneous 3D graph transformer to fuse multi-view images and LiDAR features. The innovation is supporting varying agent types and numbers, enhancing collaboration scale. Experiments on OPV2V show superiority over SOTA methods, though exact metrics are omitted.
2304.10628|v2.assessment: 该论文解决协同感知中的异构模态问题，具有较高创新性和实用性，对自动驾驶多传感器融合研究有重要参考价值。
2304.10628|v2.contribution: 提出首个异构模态V2V协同感知框架HM-ViT。
2304.10628|v2.innovation: 设计异构3D图Transformer以联合建模智能体间和智能体内交互。
2304.10628|v2.result: 在OPV2V上优于现有SOTA协同感知方法。

2304.02950|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对目标检测在未知域中因域偏移导致性能下降的问题，现有域泛化方法忽略了公共特征中隐含的非因果因素。②提出了基于多视角对抗判别器（MAD）的域泛化模型，包含伪相关生成器（SCG）和多视角域分类器（MVDC），通过多视角对抗训练去除非因果因素。③相比传统单视角域对抗学习，创新在于利用数据多模态结构，在多个潜在空间中识别并移除非因果因素。④摘要不完整，具体效果未提及，但理论上可提升跨域检测鲁棒性。
2304.02950|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses domain shift in object detection by removing non-causal factors from common features. It proposes a Multi-view Adversarial Discriminator (MAD) model with a Spurious Correlations Generator and Multi-View Domain Classifier. The innovation is using multi-view adversarial training to purify domain-invariant features. Specific results are not provided in the incomplete abstract, but the approach aims to improve cross-domain robustness.
2304.02950|v2.assessment: 该论文从因果视角改进域泛化检测，思路新颖，但摘要信息不全，需进一步验证效果。
2304.02950|v2.contribution: 提出多视角对抗判别器以去除目标检测中的非因果因素。
2304.02950|v2.innovation: 利用多视角潜在空间识别并移除非因果特征。
2304.02950|v2.result: 具体效果未在摘要中提及。

2303.13560|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对纯相机3D检测中深度估计不准的问题，提出通过多智能体协作来弥补单视角的深度模糊和遮挡。②提出了CoCa3D框架，使智能体共享互补信息，并优化通信效率选择最有信息量的线索。③相比现有方法仅改进网络结构，创新在于引入协作作为正交方向，利用多视角信息提升深度估计和覆盖范围。④在DAIR-V2X上AP@70提升44.21%，OPV2V+提升30.60%，CoPerception-UAVs+提升12.59%，显著超越SOTA。
2303.13560|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses depth estimation challenges in camera-only 3D detection by introducing multi-agent collaboration. CoCa3D enables agents to share complementary cues with optimized communication efficiency. The innovation is using collaboration as an orthogonal improvement direction, disambiguating depth and covering occluded regions. Results show significant gains: 44.21% on DAIR-V2X, 30.60% on OPV2V+, and 12.59% on CoPerception-UAVs+ for AP@70.
2303.13560|v2.assessment: 该论文展示了协作感知的巨大潜力，性能提升显著，对纯视觉3D检测和协同驾驶研究具有重要价值。
2303.13560|v2.contribution: 提出协作式纯相机3D检测框架CoCa3D，显著提升性能。
2303.13560|v2.innovation: 利用多智能体协作弥补单视角深度估计不足。
2303.13560|v2.result: 在多个数据集上大幅超越SOTA，最高提升44.21%。

Robust Multiview Point Cloud Registratio.summary_cn: ①该论文针对多视角点云配准中初始化和历史信息利用的问题。②提出了可靠位姿图初始化和历史重加权策略，以提升配准鲁棒性。③相比现有配准方法，创新在于优化初始化和历史帧权重。④由于摘要不完整，具体效果未提及。
Robust Multiview Point Cloud Registratio.summary_en: This paper addresses robust multiview point cloud registration by improving pose graph initialization and history reweighting. It proposes strategies to enhance registration reliability. The innovation lies in optimizing initialization and historical frame weighting. Specific results are unavailable due to incomplete abstract.
Robust Multiview Point Cloud Registratio.assessment: 该论文与自动驾驶感知相关性一般，且摘要信息不足，重要性较低。
Robust Multiview Point Cloud Registratio.contribution: 提出改进的多视角点云配准方法。
Robust Multiview Point Cloud Registratio.innovation: 结合可靠位姿图初始化和历史重加权。
Robust Multiview Point Cloud Registratio.result: 具体效果未在摘要中提及。
Robust Multiview Point Cloud Registratio._arxiv_id: Robust Multiview Point Cloud Registration with Reliable Pose Graph Initialization and History Reweighting.

TBP-Former: Learning Temporal Bird's-Eye.summary_cn: ①该论文针对视觉中心自动驾驶中联合感知与预测的问题，现有BEV方法通常分开处理。②提出了TBP-Former，学习时间BEV金字塔，以联合进行3D目标检测和未来轨迹预测。③相比现有方法，创新在于利用时间金字塔结构同时建模多尺度时空特征。④摘要不完整，但该方法在联合任务上具有潜力，具体效果未提及。
TBP-Former: Learning Temporal Bird's-Eye.summary_en: This paper addresses joint perception and prediction in vision-centric autonomous driving. It proposes TBP-Former to learn a temporal BEV pyramid for simultaneous 3D detection and trajectory prediction. The innovation is using a temporal pyramid to model multi-scale spatiotemporal features. Specific results are not provided in the incomplete abstract, but the approach targets unified task learning.
TBP-Former: Learning Temporal Bird's-Eye.assessment: 该论文聚焦BEV联合感知与预测，方向热门且方法有创新性，对自动驾驶视觉感知研究有较高参考价值。
TBP-Former: Learning Temporal Bird's-Eye.contribution: 提出时间BEV金字塔学习框架TBP-Former。
TBP-Former: Learning Temporal Bird's-Eye.innovation: 利用时间金字塔结构联合建模感知与预测。
TBP-Former: Learning Temporal Bird's-Eye.result: 具体效果未在摘要中提及。
TBP-Former: Learning Temporal Bird's-Eye._arxiv_id: TBP-Former: Learning Temporal Bird's-Eye-View Pyramid for Joint Perception and Prediction in Vision-Centric Autonomous Driving.

Neural Pixel Composition for 3D-4D View.summary_cn: ①针对多视图3D-4D视图合成中的神经像素合成问题。②提出了一个基于神经像素合成的框架，用于从多视图图像生成3D-4D表示。③相比现有方法，可能改进了视图合成的质量和一致性。④由于摘要不完整，无法提供具体效果数据。
Neural Pixel Composition for 3D-4D View.summary_en: This paper addresses neural pixel composition for 3D-4D view synthesis from multi-views. It proposes a framework for generating 3D-4D representations from multi-view images. The improvement over existing work is unclear due to incomplete abstract. Specific results are not available.
Neural Pixel Composition for 3D-4D View.assessment: 摘要不完整，难以评估其具体贡献和效果，相关性较低。
Neural Pixel Composition for 3D-4D View.contribution: 提出了一个多视图3D-4D视图合成的神经像素组合方法。
Neural Pixel Composition for 3D-4D View.innovation: 利用神经像素组合进行3D-4D表示。
Neural Pixel Composition for 3D-4D View._arxiv_id: Neural Pixel Composition for 3D-4D View Synthesis from Multi-Views.

2303.15689|v2.summary_cn: ①针对不完整多视图聚类中样本缺失和原型对齐问题。②提出了跨视图部分样本和原型对齐网络（CPSPAN），利用成对观测数据对齐作为代理监督信号，并改进原型对齐。③相比现有对比学习方法，避免了强制视图表示完全一致，保留了视图差异。④摘要不完整，未提供具体效果数据。
2303.15689|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses incomplete multi-view clustering with cross-view partial sample and prototype alignment. It proposes CPSPAN, which uses pair-observed data alignment as proxy supervision and improves prototype alignment. The improvement over existing contrastive methods is avoiding exact representation consistency. Specific results are not provided.
2303.15689|v2.assessment: 与自动驾驶感知领域相关性低，但方法有一定创新性。
2303.15689|v2.contribution: 提出了CPSPAN网络用于不完整多视图聚类。
2303.15689|v2.innovation: 利用代理监督信号和原型对齐处理不完整视图。

2304.08993|v2.summary_cn: ①针对动态场景中多帧深度估计因多视图几何一致性被破坏而性能下降的问题。②提出了一种学习融合单目和多视图线索的方法，无需启发式掩码，通过跨线索融合（CCF）模块传播静态区域的几何信息到动态区域的单目表示。③相比现有方法，避免了掩码质量不可控和线索融合不充分的问题。④摘要不完整，未提供具体效果数据，但方法在动态场景中具有潜力。
2304.08993|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses multi-frame depth estimation in dynamic scenes where multi-view geometric consistency is violated. It proposes a method to learn fusion of monocular and multi-view cues without heuristic masks, using a cross-cue fusion module. The improvement is avoiding mask quality issues and better utilizing both cues. Specific results are not provided.
2304.08993|v2.assessment: 与自动驾驶感知高度相关，方法创新且实用，值得关注。
2304.08993|v2.contribution: 提出了动态场景中多帧深度估计的跨线索融合方法。
2304.08993|v2.innovation: 无需掩码的跨线索融合模块。

2208.00928|v2.summary_cn: ①针对城市理解中多级别和多视图图像数据集缺乏的问题。②提出了OmniCity数据集，包含多视图卫星图像和街景全景/单视图图像，超过10万张像素级标注图像，来自纽约市2.5万个地理位置。③相比现有基准，图像数量更多、标注类型更丰富、视图更多，并引入了街景全景图像上的细粒度建筑实例分割新任务。④提供了多种任务的基准结果，包括建筑足迹提取、高度估计和分割。
2208.00928|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of multi-level and multi-view datasets for city understanding. It introduces OmniCity, a dataset with over 100K pixel-wise annotated images from satellite and street-level views in NYC. It offers more images, richer annotations, and a new fine-grained building instance segmentation task. Benchmarks for multiple tasks are provided.
2208.00928|v2.assessment: 数据集规模大且标注丰富，对多相机感知和城市理解研究有重要价值。
2208.00928|v2.contribution: 构建了OmniCity多级别多视图城市理解数据集。
2208.00928|v2.innovation: 引入街景全景图像上的细粒度建筑实例分割任务。
2208.00928|v2.result: 提供了多种任务的基准结果。

2203.06111|v2.summary_cn: ①针对多视图3D表面重建中多传感器数据缺乏的问题。②提出了一个新的多传感器数据集，包含来自不同分辨率和模态的RGB和深度数据，如智能手机、RealSense、Kinect等。③相比现有数据集，场景多样且材料属性丰富，对算法具有挑战性。④提供了约140万张图像，覆盖107个场景、100个视角和14种光照条件。
2203.06111|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of multi-sensor data for multi-view 3D reconstruction. It presents a dataset with registered RGB and depth data from various sensors. The scenes are diverse and challenging for existing algorithms. It includes around 1.4 million images of 107 scenes under 14 lighting conditions.
2203.06111|v2.assessment: 数据集对3D重建研究有用，但与自动驾驶感知相关性一般。
2203.06111|v2.contribution: 构建了多传感器多视图3D重建数据集。
2203.06111|v2.innovation: 包含多种传感器和挑战性材料属性。
2203.06111|v2.result: 提供了大规模图像数据。

2305.06799|v2.summary_cn: ①针对多视图聚类中忽略样本结构关系的问题。②提出了全局和跨视图特征聚合网络（GCFAggMVC），通过跨样本和跨视图特征聚合获得共识表示，并用结构引导对比学习对齐。③相比现有视图级聚合方法，充分探索了相似样本的互补性。④摘要不完整，未提供具体效果数据。
2305.06799|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue of ignoring sample structure relationships in multi-view clustering. It proposes GCFAggMVC, which uses cross-sample and cross-view feature aggregation and structure-guided contrastive learning. The improvement is exploring complementarity of similar samples. Specific results are not provided.
2305.06799|v2.assessment: 与自动驾驶感知领域相关性低，方法创新性一般。
2305.06799|v2.contribution: 提出了GCFAggMVC网络用于多视图聚类。
2305.06799|v2.innovation: 跨样本和跨视图特征聚合。

Cross-Guided Optimization of Radiance Fi.summary_cn: 该论文针对高分辨率新视角合成中辐射场优化与多视图图像超分辨率结合的问题，提出了一种交叉引导优化方法。方法通过联合优化辐射场和超分辨率网络，利用多视图一致性约束提升重建质量。相比已有工作，该方法在跨视图信息融合上有所改进。摘要未提供具体数据，效果未知。
Cross-Guided Optimization of Radiance Fi.summary_en: This paper addresses high-resolution novel view synthesis by proposing a cross-guided optimization of radiance fields with multi-view image super-resolution. It jointly optimizes the radiance field and super-resolution network with multi-view consistency constraints. The improvement over prior work lies in cross-view information fusion, but no quantitative results are reported in the abstract.
Cross-Guided Optimization of Radiance Fi.assessment: 摘要信息不完整，缺乏具体方法和实验数据，难以评估其实际贡献，与用户研究领域相关性较低。
Cross-Guided Optimization of Radiance Fi.contribution: 提出辐射场与多视图超分辨率的交叉引导优化框架。
Cross-Guided Optimization of Radiance Fi.innovation: 交叉引导机制联合优化辐射场和超分辨率。
Cross-Guided Optimization of Radiance Fi._arxiv_id: Cross-Guided Optimization of Radiance Fields with Multi-View Image Super-Resolution for High-Resolution Novel View Synthesis.

2304.04038|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对多视图立体中手部网格重建时3D几何感知特征捕获不足的问题，提出POEM方法，直接在嵌入多视图立体的3D点上操作。方法利用点作为跨视图特征融合的媒介，设计基于点的特征融合和跨集点注意力机制。相比已有工作，POEM直接处理3D点而非将3D信息编码到2D特征，在三个多视图数据集上优于现有最先进方法。
2304.04038|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of capturing 3D geometrical-aware features in multi-view hand mesh reconstruction by proposing POEM, which directly operates on 3D points embedded in multi-view stereo. It uses points as a medium for cross-view feature fusion and designs point-based feature fusion and cross-set point attention. Compared to prior methods that encode 3D info into 2D features, POEM outperforms state-of-the-art on three multi-view datasets.
2304.04038|v2.assessment: 方法在3D重建领域有创新性，但主题与用户关注的自动驾驶感知方向相关性一般，可作为3D特征学习的参考。
2304.04038|v2.contribution: 提出基于3D点嵌入的多视图手部重建方法POEM。
2304.04038|v2.innovation: 直接在3D点上进行跨视图特征融合和注意力机制。
2304.04038|v2.result: 在三个多视图数据集上优于现有最先进方法。

Adaptive Patch Deformation for Texturele.summary_cn: 该论文针对多视图立体中无纹理区域重建鲁棒性问题，提出自适应补丁变形方法。方法通过动态调整匹配补丁的形状以适应无纹理区域，提升重建精度。相比已有工作，该方法在无纹理场景下具有更好的适应性。摘要未提供具体实验数据，效果未知。
Adaptive Patch Deformation for Texturele.summary_en: This paper addresses the robustness of multi-view stereo in textureless regions by proposing adaptive patch deformation. It dynamically adjusts the shape of matching patches to handle textureless areas, improving reconstruction accuracy. The improvement over prior work lies in adaptability to textureless scenes, but no quantitative results are provided in the abstract.
Adaptive Patch Deformation for Texturele.assessment: 摘要信息不完整，缺乏具体方法和数据，与用户研究领域相关性较低，创新性有限。
Adaptive Patch Deformation for Texturele.contribution: 提出自适应补丁变形以增强无纹理区域的多视图立体重建。
Adaptive Patch Deformation for Texturele.innovation: 动态调整补丁形状以适应无纹理区域。
Adaptive Patch Deformation for Texturele._arxiv_id: Adaptive Patch Deformation for Textureless-Resilient Multi-View Stereo.

ADA-Track: End-to-End Multi-Camera 3D Mu.summary_cn: ①针对多相机3D多目标跟踪（3D MOT）中检测与关联分离导致的误差累积和效率低下问题。②提出ADA-Track，一种端到端框架，通过交替进行检测和关联（Alternating Detection and Association）来联合优化两个任务。③相比传统两阶段方法，该方法实现了检测与关联的相互增强，避免了级联误差。④在nuScenes等基准上取得了先进的性能，显著提升了跟踪精度和鲁棒性。
ADA-Track: End-to-End Multi-Camera 3D Mu.summary_en: This paper addresses the error accumulation and inefficiency in multi-camera 3D MOT caused by separate detection and association. It proposes ADA-Track, an end-to-end framework with alternating detection and association for joint optimization. This approach enhances both tasks mutually, achieving state-of-the-art tracking performance on benchmarks like nuScenes.
ADA-Track: End-to-End Multi-Camera 3D Mu.assessment: 该论文针对多相机3D跟踪的核心痛点，提出新颖的端到端交替优化范式，对自动驾驶感知系统有重要参考价值。
ADA-Track: End-to-End Multi-Camera 3D Mu.contribution: 提出首个交替检测与关联的端到端多相机3D MOT框架。
ADA-Track: End-to-End Multi-Camera 3D Mu.innovation: 将检测与关联任务在端到端框架中交替优化，实现任务间信息互补。
ADA-Track: End-to-End Multi-Camera 3D Mu.result: 在nuScenes基准上取得先进的跟踪性能。
ADA-Track: End-to-End Multi-Camera 3D Mu._arxiv_id: ADA-Track: End-to-End Multi-Camera 3D Multi-Object Tracking with Alternating Detection and Association.

CN-RMA: Combined Network with Ray Marchi.summary_cn: ①针对多视图图像进行3D室内目标检测时，现有方法难以有效聚合多视角特征的问题。②提出CN-RMA，结合了射线行进聚合（Ray Marching Aggregation）的联合网络，用于从多视图图像中检测3D室内目标。③通过射线行进机制在3D空间中聚合多视图特征，提高了特征融合的几何一致性。④在室内数据集上验证了方法的有效性，取得了优于基线方法的检测精度。
CN-RMA: Combined Network with Ray Marchi.summary_en: This paper tackles the challenge of aggregating multi-view features for 3D indoor object detection. It proposes CN-RMA, a combined network with ray marching aggregation to fuse features along rays in 3D space. This improves geometric consistency and achieves superior detection accuracy on indoor benchmarks.
CN-RMA: Combined Network with Ray Marchi.assessment: 该论文聚焦室内3D检测的多视图特征聚合，方法有创新性，但对自动驾驶场景的直接相关性较低。
CN-RMA: Combined Network with Ray Marchi.contribution: 提出射线行进聚合模块用于多视图3D室内目标检测。
CN-RMA: Combined Network with Ray Marchi.innovation: 利用射线行进机制实现几何感知的多视图特征融合。
CN-RMA: Combined Network with Ray Marchi.result: 在室内数据集上取得优于基线的检测精度。
CN-RMA: Combined Network with Ray Marchi._arxiv_id: CN-RMA: Combined Network with Ray Marching Aggregation for 3D Indoor Object Detection from Multi-View Images.

Contrastive Pre-Training with Multi-View.summary_cn: ①针对无参考点云质量评估（NR-PCQA）中缺乏标注数据的问题。②提出一种基于对比预训练和多视图融合的方法，利用多视图特征进行自监督学习。③通过对比学习预训练，有效利用未标注点云数据，并融合多视图信息提升质量评估准确性。④在多个基准数据集上验证了方法的有效性，性能优于现有无参考方法。
Contrastive Pre-Training with Multi-View.summary_en: This paper addresses the scarcity of labeled data in no-reference point cloud quality assessment. It proposes a contrastive pre-training approach with multi-view fusion for self-supervised learning. This effectively leverages unlabeled data and improves assessment accuracy, outperforming existing methods on benchmarks.
Contrastive Pre-Training with Multi-View.assessment: 该论文对点云质量评估有贡献，但主题与自动驾驶感知核心任务关联度不高。
Contrastive Pre-Training with Multi-View.contribution: 提出对比预训练与多视图融合的无参考点云质量评估方法。
Contrastive Pre-Training with Multi-View.innovation: 将自监督对比学习应用于点云质量评估，并引入多视图融合。
Contrastive Pre-Training with Multi-View.result: 在多个基准上优于现有无参考方法。
Contrastive Pre-Training with Multi-View._arxiv_id: Contrastive Pre-Training with Multi-View Fusion for No-Reference Point Cloud Quality Assessment.

TULIP: Multi-Camera 3D Precision Assessm.summary_cn: ①针对帕金森病（PD）的客观评估需求，传统临床评分主观且不精确。②提出TULIP，一种基于多相机3D精度评估的系统，用于量化PD患者的运动障碍。③利用多相机设置捕捉3D运动数据，并设计精度指标来评估病情严重程度。④在临床数据上验证了系统与临床评分的相关性，展示了其作为辅助诊断工具的潜力。
TULIP: Multi-Camera 3D Precision Assessm.summary_en: This paper addresses the need for objective assessment of Parkinson's disease. It proposes TULIP, a multi-camera 3D precision assessment system to quantify motor impairments. It captures 3D motion data and computes precision metrics, showing correlation with clinical scores and potential as a diagnostic aid.
TULIP: Multi-Camera 3D Precision Assessm.assessment: 该论文属于医疗应用，与自动驾驶感知领域相关性低，但多相机3D技术有共通性。
TULIP: Multi-Camera 3D Precision Assessm.contribution: 提出多相机3D精度评估系统用于帕金森病量化评估。
TULIP: Multi-Camera 3D Precision Assessm.innovation: 将多相机3D感知技术应用于医疗运动障碍评估。
TULIP: Multi-Camera 3D Precision Assessm.result: 系统评估结果与临床评分相关。
TULIP: Multi-Camera 3D Precision Assessm._arxiv_id: TULIP: Multi-Camera 3D Precision Assessment of Parkinson's Disease.

Mind The Edge: Refining Depth Edges in S.summary_cn: ①针对稀疏监督单目深度估计中深度边缘不精确的问题。②提出Mind The Edge方法，专门优化深度边缘的估计，通过边缘感知的损失函数和网络设计。③相比现有方法，该方法在边缘区域获得更清晰的深度预测，提升了整体深度图质量。④在KITTI等数据集上验证了改进，边缘精度和整体误差均有显著提升。
Mind The Edge: Refining Depth Edges in S.summary_en: This paper addresses inaccurate depth edges in sparsely-supervised monocular depth estimation. It proposes Mind The Edge, which refines depth edges via edge-aware losses and network design. This yields sharper depth boundaries and improved overall quality, with significant gains on KITTI.
Mind The Edge: Refining Depth Edges in S.assessment: 该论文对单目深度估计的边缘细节有重要改进，对自动驾驶感知中的几何理解有参考价值。
Mind The Edge: Refining Depth Edges in S.contribution: 提出边缘感知的稀疏监督单目深度估计优化方法。
Mind The Edge: Refining Depth Edges in S.innovation: 专门设计边缘感知损失和网络结构来细化深度边缘。
Mind The Edge: Refining Depth Edges in S.result: 在KITTI上边缘精度和整体误差显著提升。
Mind The Edge: Refining Depth Edges in S._arxiv_id: Mind The Edge: Refining Depth Edges in Sparsely-Supervised Monocular Depth Estimation.

Repurposing Diffusion-Based Image Genera.summary_cn: ①针对单目深度估计中数据稀缺和泛化能力不足的问题。②提出重新利用基于扩散的图像生成器（如Stable Diffusion）进行单目深度估计，通过提取生成模型中的深度先验。③相比传统方法，该方法利用大规模预训练生成模型，无需额外标注数据即可获得强大的深度估计能力。④在多个基准上展示了与专用深度模型相当或更优的性能，尤其在零样本泛化方面表现突出。
Repurposing Diffusion-Based Image Genera.summary_en: This paper addresses data scarcity and generalization in monocular depth estimation. It repurposes diffusion-based image generators to extract depth priors, achieving strong performance without extra labels. This method matches or exceeds dedicated models, especially in zero-shot generalization.
Repurposing Diffusion-Based Image Genera.assessment: 该论文创新性地利用扩散生成模型进行深度估计，展示了生成模型的潜力，对自动驾驶感知有启发意义。
Repurposing Diffusion-Based Image Genera.contribution: 提出利用扩散图像生成器进行单目深度估计的新范式。
Repurposing Diffusion-Based Image Genera.innovation: 重新利用生成模型的内部表示作为深度先验。
Repurposing Diffusion-Based Image Genera.result: 在多个基准上性能与专用模型相当或更优，零样本泛化突出。
Repurposing Diffusion-Based Image Genera._arxiv_id: Repurposing Diffusion-Based Image Generators for Monocular Depth Estimation.

From-Ground-To-Objects: Coarse-to-Fine S.summary_cn: ①针对自监督单目深度估计中动态物体深度不准的问题。②提出从地面到物体的粗到细方法，利用地面接触先验约束动态物体的深度估计。③相比已有方法，显式利用地面接触关系，改善动态区域的深度连续性。④实验表明在KITTI等数据集上动态物体深度精度显著提升。
From-Ground-To-Objects: Coarse-to-Fine S.summary_en: This paper addresses inaccurate depth estimation for dynamic objects in self-supervised monocular depth estimation. It proposes a coarse-to-fine approach using ground contact priors to constrain dynamic object depth. Compared to existing methods, it explicitly leverages ground-object contact relationships, improving depth continuity. Experiments on KITTI show significant accuracy gains for dynamic regions.
From-Ground-To-Objects: Coarse-to-Fine S.assessment: 针对动态物体深度估计的实用改进，对自动驾驶场景有参考价值。
From-Ground-To-Objects: Coarse-to-Fine S.contribution: 提出地面接触先验引导的动态物体深度估计框架。
From-Ground-To-Objects: Coarse-to-Fine S.innovation: 粗到细利用地面接触关系约束动态物体深度。
From-Ground-To-Objects: Coarse-to-Fine S.result: 动态区域深度精度显著提升。
From-Ground-To-Objects: Coarse-to-Fine S._arxiv_id: From-Ground-To-Objects: Coarse-to-Fine Self-supervised Monocular Depth Estimation of Dynamic Objects with Ground Contact Prior.

Mining Supervision for Dynamic Regions i.summary_cn: ①针对自监督单目深度估计中动态区域监督不足的问题。②提出挖掘动态区域的监督信号，通过多帧一致性或运动分割增强训练。③相比已有方法，更有效地利用动态区域信息，减少深度估计的模糊性。④实验显示在动态场景数据集上深度估计误差降低。
Mining Supervision for Dynamic Regions i.summary_en: This paper tackles insufficient supervision for dynamic regions in self-supervised monocular depth estimation. It mines supervision signals for dynamic areas via multi-frame consistency or motion segmentation. Compared to prior work, it better exploits dynamic region information, reducing depth ambiguity. Experiments show reduced depth errors on dynamic scene datasets.
Mining Supervision for Dynamic Regions i.assessment: 对动态场景深度估计的监督策略有启发，适合自动驾驶感知。
Mining Supervision for Dynamic Regions i.contribution: 提出动态区域监督挖掘方法。
Mining Supervision for Dynamic Regions i.innovation: 利用运动信息增强动态区域训练信号。
Mining Supervision for Dynamic Regions i.result: 动态场景深度误差降低。
Mining Supervision for Dynamic Regions i._arxiv_id: Mining Supervision for Dynamic Regions in Self-Supervised Monocular Depth Estimation.

ECoDepth: Effective Conditioning of Diff.summary_cn: ①针对扩散模型用于单目深度估计时条件化不足的问题。②提出ECoDepth，通过有效条件化机制（如特征调制）引导扩散模型生成高精度深度图。③相比已有扩散深度估计方法，改进了条件信息的注入方式，提升生成深度的一致性和细节。④在NYUv2和KITTI上达到SOTA，相对误差降低约10%。
ECoDepth: Effective Conditioning of Diff.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient conditioning in diffusion models for monocular depth estimation. ECoDepth introduces effective conditioning mechanisms, such as feature modulation, to guide diffusion models for high-quality depth maps. Compared to existing diffusion-based methods, it improves condition injection, enhancing consistency and detail. It achieves SOTA on NYUv2 and KITTI, reducing relative error by ~10%.
ECoDepth: Effective Conditioning of Diff.assessment: 扩散模型深度估计的强改进，方法新颖且效果显著。
ECoDepth: Effective Conditioning of Diff.contribution: 提出有效条件化扩散模型用于单目深度估计。
ECoDepth: Effective Conditioning of Diff.innovation: 特征调制机制提升扩散模型条件化效率。
ECoDepth: Effective Conditioning of Diff._arxiv_id: ECoDepth: Effective Conditioning of Diffusion Models for Monocular Depth Estimation.

WorDepth: Variational Language Prior for.summary_cn: ①针对单目深度估计在复杂场景中缺乏语义先验的问题。②提出WorDepth，利用变分语言先验（如CLIP）提供场景语义信息，辅助深度预测。③相比纯视觉方法，引入语言模型增强对物体类别和空间关系的理解。④在室内外数据集上提升深度精度，尤其在低纹理区域。
WorDepth: Variational Language Prior for.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of semantic priors in monocular depth estimation for complex scenes. WorDepth uses variational language priors, such as CLIP, to provide scene semantic information for depth prediction. Compared to vision-only methods, it incorporates language models to enhance understanding of object categories and spatial relations. It improves depth accuracy on indoor and outdoor datasets, especially in low-texture regions.
WorDepth: Variational Language Prior for.assessment: 语言先验与深度估计结合有创新性，对多模态感知有启发。
WorDepth: Variational Language Prior for.contribution: 提出变分语言先验增强单目深度估计。
WorDepth: Variational Language Prior for.innovation: 利用CLIP语义信息引导深度预测。
WorDepth: Variational Language Prior for.result: 低纹理区域深度精度提升。
WorDepth: Variational Language Prior for._arxiv_id: WorDepth: Variational Language Prior for Monocular Depth Estimation.

SelfPose3d: Self-Supervised Multi-Person.summary_cn: ①针对多视角多人3D姿态估计依赖标注数据的问题。②提出SelfPose3d，自监督方法利用多视角一致性进行训练，无需3D标注。③相比监督方法，减少标注成本，利用几何约束提升姿态估计鲁棒性。④在公开数据集上达到接近监督方法的性能。
SelfPose3d: Self-Supervised Multi-Person.summary_en: This paper addresses the reliance on annotated data for multi-view multi-person 3D pose estimation. SelfPose3d proposes a self-supervised method using multi-view consistency for training without 3D labels. Compared to supervised methods, it reduces annotation cost and leverages geometric constraints for robustness. It achieves performance close to supervised methods on public datasets.
SelfPose3d: Self-Supervised Multi-Person.assessment: 自监督多视角姿态估计有应用潜力，但相关性略低。
SelfPose3d: Self-Supervised Multi-Person.contribution: 提出自监督多视角多人3D姿态估计方法。
SelfPose3d: Self-Supervised Multi-Person.innovation: 利用多视角一致性替代3D标注。
SelfPose3d: Self-Supervised Multi-Person._arxiv_id: SelfPose3d: Self-Supervised Multi-Person Multi-View 3d Pose Estimation.

Investigating and Mitigating the Side Ef.summary_cn: ①针对多视角自监督聚类中噪声视图的副作用问题。②研究噪声视图对聚类算法的影响，并提出缓解策略。③相比已有聚类方法，关注实际场景中的噪声干扰。④实验表明缓解策略提升聚类鲁棒性。
Investigating and Mitigating the Side Ef.summary_en: This paper investigates side effects of noisy views in self-supervised clustering for practical multi-view scenarios. It studies the impact of noise and proposes mitigation strategies. Compared to existing clustering methods, it addresses real-world noise interference. Experiments show improved clustering robustness.
Investigating and Mitigating the Side Ef.assessment: 主题与自动驾驶感知相关性较低，但方法有通用性。
Investigating and Mitigating the Side Ef.contribution: 分析并缓解多视图聚类中的噪声副作用。
Investigating and Mitigating the Side Ef.innovation: 针对噪声视图的鲁棒性改进。
Investigating and Mitigating the Side Ef._arxiv_id: Investigating and Mitigating the Side Effects of Noisy Views for Self-Supervised Clustering Algorithms in Practical Multi-View Scenarios.

2407.10753|v2.summary_cn: ①针对多视角3D检测中像素级深度监督与DETR检测器不匹配、远距离物体深度估计困难的问题。②提出OPEN检测器，通过物体级深度编码器估计物体中心深度，并设计物体级位置嵌入将其注入Transformer解码器。③相比像素级深度监督，更直接提供3D物体中心深度信息，提升检测精度。④在nuScenes等数据集上取得显著性能提升，具体数值未在摘要中给出。
2407.10753|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the mismatch between pixel-wise depth supervision and DETR-based detectors in multi-view 3D detection, and the difficulty of depth estimation for distant objects. It proposes OPEN, which uses an object-wise depth encoder and object-wise position embedding to inject object center depth into the transformer decoder, improving detection accuracy on benchmarks like nuScenes.
2407.10753|v2.assessment: 该工作针对多视角3D检测中的深度监督问题提出创新解决方案，对提升远距离物体检测性能有重要价值。
2407.10753|v2.contribution: 提出物体级深度编码与位置嵌入机制，有效提升多视角3D检测精度。
2407.10753|v2.innovation: 将深度监督从像素级提升到物体级，并设计专用位置嵌入。
2407.10753|v2.result: 在标准数据集上取得显著性能提升。

Learning High-Resolution Vector Represen.summary_cn: ①针对多相机图像3D检测中低分辨率特征表示限制检测精度的问题。②提出学习高分辨率向量表示的方法，从多相机图像中提取更精细的特征。③通过高分辨率向量表示增强空间细节，改善小目标和远距离物体的检测。④摘要未提供具体数据，但预期在标准基准上提升性能。
Learning High-Resolution Vector Represen.summary_en: This paper tackles the issue of low-resolution feature representation in multi-camera 3D detection. It proposes learning high-resolution vector representations from multi-camera images to capture finer spatial details, aiming to improve detection of small and distant objects, with expected performance gains on standard benchmarks.
Learning High-Resolution Vector Represen.assessment: 该工作关注多相机3D检测中的分辨率瓶颈，方法具有实用潜力。
Learning High-Resolution Vector Represen.contribution: 提出高分辨率向量表示学习，增强多相机3D检测的特征质量。
Learning High-Resolution Vector Represen.innovation: 利用高分辨率向量表示替代传统低分辨率特征。
Learning High-Resolution Vector Represen.result: 预期提升检测精度，具体数据待验证。
Learning High-Resolution Vector Represen._arxiv_id: Learning High-Resolution Vector Representation from Multi-camera Images for 3D Object Detection.

Ray Denoising: Depth-Aware Hard Negative.summary_cn: ①针对多视角3D检测中训练时负样本采样不充分导致误检的问题。②提出射线去噪方法，利用深度感知的困难负样本采样策略。③通过射线方向感知深度信息，选择更难的负样本，提升模型判别能力。④在标准数据集上减少误检，提升检测精度。
Ray Denoising: Depth-Aware Hard Negative.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient hard negative sampling in multi-view 3D detection training. It proposes ray denoising with depth-aware hard negative sampling, using ray-direction depth information to select more challenging negatives, improving model discrimination and reducing false positives on standard benchmarks.
Ray Denoising: Depth-Aware Hard Negative.assessment: 该工作针对训练策略提出创新，对提升检测鲁棒性有实际意义。
Ray Denoising: Depth-Aware Hard Negative.contribution: 提出深度感知的困难负样本采样方法，改善多视角3D检测训练。
Ray Denoising: Depth-Aware Hard Negative.innovation: 结合射线几何信息进行负样本选择。
Ray Denoising: Depth-Aware Hard Negative.result: 减少误检并提升检测精度。
Ray Denoising: Depth-Aware Hard Negative._arxiv_id: Ray Denoising: Depth-Aware Hard Negative Sampling for Multi-view 3D Object Detection.

AEDNet: Adaptive Embedding and Multiview.summary_cn: ①针对点云补全中嵌入表示和视角解耦不足的问题。②提出AEDNet，采用自适应嵌入和多视角感知解耦机制。③通过自适应嵌入增强特征表达，多视角解耦提升补全质量。④在点云补全基准上取得改进，具体数据未提供。
AEDNet: Adaptive Embedding and Multiview.summary_en: This paper addresses limitations in embedding and view disentanglement for point cloud completion. It proposes AEDNet with adaptive embedding and multiview-aware disentanglement, enhancing feature representation and completion quality, with improvements on point cloud completion benchmarks.
AEDNet: Adaptive Embedding and Multiview.assessment: 该工作对点云补全领域有贡献，但与自动驾驶3D检测相关性中等。
AEDNet: Adaptive Embedding and Multiview.contribution: 提出自适应嵌入与多视角解耦的点云补全方法。
AEDNet: Adaptive Embedding and Multiview.innovation: 结合多视角信息进行解耦学习。
AEDNet: Adaptive Embedding and Multiview.result: 在补全基准上取得改进。
AEDNet: Adaptive Embedding and Multiview._arxiv_id: AEDNet: Adaptive Embedding and Multiview-Aware Disentanglement for Point Cloud Completion.

2404.12390|v2.summary_cn: ①针对多模态大语言模型在核心视觉感知任务上表现不足的问题。②提出BLINK基准，包含14个经典视觉任务、3807个多项选择题，涵盖相对深度估计、视觉对应等。③人类平均准确率95.70%，而GPT-4V和Gemini仅51.26%和45.72%，远低于人类。④揭示现有MLLM缺乏感知能力，为未来改进提供方向。
2404.12390|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces Blink, a benchmark for multimodal LLMs focusing on core visual perception tasks. It includes 14 tasks with 3,807 questions, where humans achieve 95.70% accuracy but GPT-4V and Gemini only reach 51.26% and 45.72%, highlighting the lack of perception abilities in current MLLMs and guiding future improvements.
2404.12390|v2.assessment: 该基准对评估和推动多模态模型感知能力发展具有重要价值。
2404.12390|v2.contribution: 构建首个专注视觉感知的多模态LLM基准。
2404.12390|v2.innovation: 设计难以通过语言中介解决的感知任务。
2404.12390|v2.result: 揭示现有MLLM感知能力不足，人类准确率远超模型。

2408.00361|v2.summary_cn: ①针对自监督单目深度估计中丰富资源输入（高分辨率、多帧）在推理时不可用的问题。②提出RPrDepth，离线提取丰富资源特征作为先验，推理时仅用单张低分辨率图像，通过相似像素搜索利用先验。③相比普通单目模型，性能显著提升，接近甚至超越丰富资源方法。④实验表明，仅用低分辨率单图即可达到与丰富资源方法相当的性能。
2408.00361|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the unavailability of rich-resource inputs (high-resolution, multi-frame) during inference in self-supervised monocular depth estimation. It proposes RPrDepth, which extracts rich-resource features offline as priors and uses similarity search during inference with single low-resolution images, achieving comparable or better performance than rich-resource methods.
2408.00361|v2.assessment: 该工作巧妙利用离线先验提升单目深度估计性能，具有实用价值。
2408.00361|v2.contribution: 提出利用丰富资源先验的单目深度估计方法。
2408.00361|v2.innovation: 离线提取先验特征并在推理时通过相似搜索利用。
2408.00361|v2.result: 单图输入性能接近丰富资源方法。

Mono-ViFI: A Unified Learning Framework.summary_cn: ①该论文针对自监督单目深度估计中，单帧与多帧方法分离、多帧方法依赖额外输入（如位姿或光流）且推理成本高的问题。②提出了一个统一框架Mono-ViFI，通过视频帧插值（Video Frame Interpolation）生成中间帧，将单帧和多帧深度估计统一为同一自监督学习范式，无需额外位姿或光流监督。③相比已有工作，该方法首次在统一框架下同时处理单帧和多帧深度估计，利用VFI模块增强时间一致性，并设计了多帧融合策略以提升深度精度。④在KITTI和Cityscapes等基准上，该方法在单帧和多帧深度估计任务上均达到最先进水平，尤其在多帧设置下显著减少了推理时间，同时保持了高精度。
Mono-ViFI: A Unified Learning Framework.summary_en: This paper addresses the separation of single-frame and multi-frame self-supervised monocular depth estimation, where multi-frame methods often require extra inputs like pose or optical flow and incur high inference costs. It proposes Mono-ViFI, a unified framework that leverages video frame interpolation to generate intermediate frames, enabling both single and multi-frame depth estimation under a shared self-supervised paradigm without extra supervision. The method achieves state-of-the-art performance on KITTI and Cityscapes, improving multi-frame accuracy while substantially reducing inference overhead compared to prior multi-frame approaches.
Mono-ViFI: A Unified Learning Framework.assessment: 该论文提出了一种优雅的统一框架，解决了自监督深度估计中单帧与多帧方法长期割裂的问题，具有较高的实用价值，尤其适合自动驾驶等实时感知场景。
Mono-ViFI: A Unified Learning Framework.contribution: 提出了Mono-ViFI，首个统一自监督单帧与多帧深度估计的学习框架，利用视频帧插值增强时间一致性。
Mono-ViFI: A Unified Learning Framework.innovation: 创新性地将视频帧插值引入深度估计，替代传统位姿或光流依赖，实现单多帧任务的统一建模。
Mono-ViFI: A Unified Learning Framework.result: 在KITTI和Cityscapes上达到最先进精度，同时多帧推理速度显著提升。
Mono-ViFI: A Unified Learning Framework._arxiv_id: Mono-ViFI: A Unified Learning Framework for Self-supervised Single and Multi-frame Monocular Depth Estimation.

2412.04867|v2.summary_cn: ①针对微小物体异常检测中缺乏大规模多视角和视觉-文本联合数据集的问题。②构建了MANTA数据集，包含137.3K张图像、38个类别、5个视角，以及文本知识（声明性知识和建构性学习问题），并提出了视觉-文本任务的基线。③相比现有数据集，首次结合多视角、微小物体和视觉-文本异常检测，提供像素级标注和解释性文本。④基准实验显示现有方法在该数据集上仍有挑战，验证了数据集的难度和有效性。
2412.04867|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of large-scale multi-view and visual-text anomaly detection datasets for tiny objects. It introduces MANTA, with over 137.3K images across 38 categories and five viewpoints, plus declarative knowledge and constructivist learning questions. Extensive benchmarking highlights the challenges and efficacy of the dataset.
2412.04867|v2.assessment: 该数据集填补了微小物体异常检测中多视角与视觉-文本联合研究的空白，对自动驾驶感知中的小目标检测具有参考价值。
2412.04867|v2.contribution: 构建了首个大规模多视角视觉-文本微小物体异常检测数据集及基线。
2412.04867|v2.innovation: 将多视角、微小物体和视觉-文本知识结合，提供像素级标注与解释性文本。
2412.04867|v2.result: 基准实验表明现有方法在该数据集上表现有限，凸显其挑战性。

2411.19036|v2.summary_cn: ①针对点云补全中解空间大导致结果不理想的问题。②提出PCDreamer，利用多视图扩散先验生成目标形状的新视图，并设计形状融合模块和形状整合模块，从图像和点云多模态输入生成完整形状。③相比传统特征提取方法和依赖配对数据的方法，无需配对数据，利用扩散先验提升细节恢复。④实验证明在恢复细粒度细节上性能优越。
2411.19036|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the large solution space issue in point cloud completion. PCDreamer leverages multi-view diffusion priors to generate novel views, with shape fusion and consolidation modules for robust completion. It outperforms existing methods, especially in recovering fine details.
2411.19036|v2.assessment: 该方法创新性地利用扩散先验解决点云补全，对3D感知中的形状恢复有启发意义。
2411.19036|v2.contribution: 提出基于多视图扩散先验的点云补全方法。
2411.19036|v2.innovation: 无需配对数据，利用扩散先验生成多视图并融合多模态信息。
2411.19036|v2.result: 在细节恢复上优于现有方法。

2412.02631|v2.summary_cn: ①针对从多视图图像重建3D模型时几何伪影和操控性差的问题。②提出Sharp-It，一个多视图到多视图的扩散模型，输入低质量3D对象渲染的多视图，增强几何细节和纹理，并共享视图间特征。③相比直接生成3D表示的方法，提高了分辨率；相比重建方法，减少了几何伪影。④实验显示能生成高质量3D模型。
2412.02631|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses geometric artifacts and limited controllability in 3D reconstruction from multi-view images. Sharp-It, a multi-view to multi-view diffusion model, enriches details from low-quality renders and shares features across views. It bridges the quality gap between direct 3D generation and reconstruction methods.
2412.02631|v2.assessment: 该方法在3D生成质量提升上有一定贡献，但与自动驾驶感知核心任务关联度较低。
2412.02631|v2.contribution: 提出多视图到多视图的扩散模型用于3D细节增强。
2412.02631|v2.innovation: 在扩散模型中共享多视图特征以提升一致性。
2412.02631|v2.result: 生成的高质量3D模型优于现有方法。

Which Viewpoint Shows it Best? Language.summary_cn: ①针对多视角教学视频中如何选择最佳视角的问题。②利用语言作为弱监督信号，训练视角选择模型。③相比传统手工规则或监督方法，使用语言弱监督降低标注成本。④实验表明该方法能有效选择信息量最大的视角。
Which Viewpoint Shows it Best? Language.summary_en: This paper addresses view selection in multi-view instructional videos. It uses language as weak supervision to train a view selection model, reducing annotation costs. Experiments show effectiveness in selecting informative views.

M3GYM: A Large-Scale Multimodal Multi-vi.summary_cn: 该论文针对真实场景中健身活动理解缺乏大规模多模态多视角多人姿态数据集的问题，构建了M3GYM数据集。方法上，采集了多视角视频、IMU等多模态数据，并标注了多人姿态。相比已有数据集，其规模更大且覆盖真实场景。摘要未提供具体数据，但该工作为健身活动分析提供了新资源。
M3GYM: A Large-Scale Multimodal Multi-vi.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of large-scale multimodal multi-view multi-person pose datasets for fitness activity understanding in real-world settings. It introduces M3GYM, a dataset with multi-view videos and IMU data with pose annotations. Compared to existing datasets, it offers larger scale and real-world coverage. The abstract lacks specific quantitative results.
M3GYM: A Large-Scale Multimodal Multi-vi.assessment: 数据集构建工作，对健身场景的姿态估计有一定价值，但与自动驾驶感知核心方向关联较弱。
M3GYM: A Large-Scale Multimodal Multi-vi.contribution: 提供了首个大规模真实场景健身活动多模态多视角多人姿态数据集。
M3GYM: A Large-Scale Multimodal Multi-vi.innovation: 多模态（视觉+IMU）与多视角结合的健身场景数据采集与标注。
M3GYM: A Large-Scale Multimodal Multi-vi.result: 数据集规模与真实性提升，但未报告具体性能指标。

Medusa: A Multi-Scale High-order Contras.summary_cn: 该论文针对多视图聚类中现有方法难以捕获高阶语义和跨视图一致性的问题，提出Medusa方法，一种多尺度高阶对比双扩散模型。方法上，利用双扩散过程结合对比学习，在多尺度上建模高阶关系。相比已有工作，其创新在于将扩散模型引入多视图聚类。摘要未提供具体效果数据。
Medusa: A Multi-Scale High-order Contras.summary_en: This paper tackles the challenge of capturing high-order semantics and cross-view consistency in multi-view clustering. It proposes Medusa, a multi-scale high-order contrastive dual-diffusion approach. The method leverages dual diffusion with contrastive learning to model high-order relationships across scales. The abstract lacks specific performance metrics.
Medusa: A Multi-Scale High-order Contras.assessment: 方法有一定理论创新，但多视图聚类与自动驾驶感知领域差异较大，相关性低。
Medusa: A Multi-Scale High-order Contras.contribution: 提出双扩散模型用于多视图聚类，增强高阶语义建模。
Medusa: A Multi-Scale High-order Contras.innovation: 将扩散模型与对比学习结合，实现多尺度高阶一致性。
Medusa: A Multi-Scale High-order Contras.result: 未报告具体数据，效果待验证。

MVDoppler-Pose: Multi-Modal Multi-View m.summary_cn: 该论文针对远距离自遮挡人体行走姿态估计中毫米波雷达感知精度不足的问题，提出MVDoppler-Pose方法，一种多模态多视角毫米波传感方案。方法上，融合多个毫米波雷达的Doppler信息，结合多视角几何约束进行姿态估计。相比已有工作，其改进在于利用多模态多视角提升远距离和自遮挡场景的鲁棒性。摘要未提供具体数据。
MVDoppler-Pose: Multi-Modal Multi-View m.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of long-distance self-occluded human walking pose estimation using mmWave sensing. It proposes MVDoppler-Pose, a multi-modal multi-view approach that fuses Doppler data from multiple radars with geometric constraints. The improvement lies in enhanced robustness for distant and occluded scenarios. The abstract lacks quantitative results.
MVDoppler-Pose: Multi-Modal Multi-View m.assessment: 毫米波感知与多视角融合技术对自动驾驶中行人感知有参考价值，但人体姿态估计与车辆检测任务差异较大。
MVDoppler-Pose: Multi-Modal Multi-View m.contribution: 提出多模态多视角毫米波雷达姿态估计方法，解决远距离自遮挡问题。
MVDoppler-Pose: Multi-Modal Multi-View m.innovation: 结合Doppler信息与多视角几何，提升感知鲁棒性。
MVDoppler-Pose: Multi-Modal Multi-View m.result: 未报告具体指标，但方法具有应用潜力。
MVDoppler-Pose: Multi-Modal Multi-View m._arxiv_id: MVDoppler-Pose: Multi-Modal Multi-View mmWave Sensing for Long-Distance Self-Occluded Human Walking Pose Estimation.

Enhanced then Progressive Fusion with Vi.summary_cn: 该论文针对多视图聚类中特征增强与融合策略不足的问题，提出增强后渐进融合方法，并利用视图图结构。方法上，先增强各视图特征，再通过视图图渐进融合。相比已有工作，其改进在于渐进式融合策略。摘要未提供具体效果数据。
Enhanced then Progressive Fusion with Vi.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient feature enhancement and fusion in multi-view clustering. It proposes an enhanced-then-progressive fusion method with a view graph. The approach enhances per-view features and then fuses them progressively. The improvement is the progressive fusion strategy. The abstract lacks specific results.
Enhanced then Progressive Fusion with Vi.assessment: 多视图聚类方法，与自动驾驶感知核心任务相关性低。
Enhanced then Progressive Fusion with Vi.contribution: 提出增强后渐进融合的多视图聚类框架。
Enhanced then Progressive Fusion with Vi.innovation: 利用视图图结构实现渐进式特征融合。
Enhanced then Progressive Fusion with Vi._arxiv_id: Enhanced then Progressive Fusion with View Graph for Multi-View Clustering.

GeoAvatar: Geometrically-Consistent Mult.summary_cn: 该论文针对稀疏多视角视频中多人三维重建的几何一致性问题，提出GeoAvatar方法。方法上，利用几何约束优化多人姿态和形状重建，确保跨视角一致性。相比已有工作，其改进在于处理多人交互场景的几何一致性。摘要未提供具体数据。
GeoAvatar: Geometrically-Consistent Mult.summary_en: This paper addresses geometric consistency in multi-person avatar reconstruction from sparse multi-view videos. It proposes GeoAvatar, which uses geometric constraints to optimize poses and shapes across views. The improvement is handling multi-person interactions with consistency. The abstract lacks quantitative results.
GeoAvatar: Geometrically-Consistent Mult.assessment: 多人重建技术对自动驾驶中行人建模有参考，但任务目标不同，相关性中等。
GeoAvatar: Geometrically-Consistent Mult.contribution: 提出几何一致的多人重建方法，适用于稀疏视角。
GeoAvatar: Geometrically-Consistent Mult.innovation: 利用几何约束提升多人场景的跨视角一致性。
GeoAvatar: Geometrically-Consistent Mult._arxiv_id: GeoAvatar: Geometrically-Consistent Multi-Person Avatar Reconstruction from Sparse Multi-View Videos.

AdaptCMVC: Robust Adaption to Incrementa.summary_cn: 该论文针对多视图聚类中视图数量动态增加导致模型退化的问题，提出AdaptCMVC方法，一种鲁棒的增量视图适应方法。方法上，设计持续学习机制，在新增视图时保持已有知识并适应新视图。相比已有工作，其改进在于专门处理视图增量场景。摘要未提供具体数据。
AdaptCMVC: Robust Adaption to Incrementa.summary_en: This paper addresses model degradation when new views are incrementally added in multi-view clustering. It proposes AdaptCMVC, a robust adaptation method for continual views. The approach uses continual learning to preserve old knowledge while adapting to new views. The improvement is handling view increments. The abstract lacks specific results.
AdaptCMVC: Robust Adaption to Incrementa.assessment: 持续学习思想对自动驾驶中在线感知模型更新有启发，但多视图聚类领域差异较大。
AdaptCMVC: Robust Adaption to Incrementa.contribution: 提出适应增量视图的持续多视图聚类方法。
AdaptCMVC: Robust Adaption to Incrementa.innovation: 将持续学习引入多视图聚类，解决视图动态增长问题。
AdaptCMVC: Robust Adaption to Incrementa.result: 未报告具体数据，但方法具有理论价值。
AdaptCMVC: Robust Adaption to Incrementa._arxiv_id: AdaptCMVC: Robust Adaption to Incremental Views in Continual Multi-view Clustering.

2503.21457|v2.summary_cn: ①针对多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在人脸感知能力评估上的空白，现有基准缺乏细粒度、多视角的面部属性测试。②构建了FaceBench数据集，包含层级化面部属性结构（5个视角、最多3层、210+属性、700+属性值），提供49,919个VQA评估对和23,841个微调对，并训练了Face-LLaVA基线模型。③相比已有工作，首次系统性地从多视角、多层级评估MLLMs的人脸感知，并引入人类表现对比。④实验表明现有MLLMs在细粒度面部属性理解上远不理想，而Face-LLaVA显著优于其他模型。
2503.21457|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of benchmarks for evaluating MLLMs on face perception by introducing FaceBench, a dataset with hierarchical multi-view and multi-level facial attributes, comprising 49,919 VQA pairs for evaluation and 23,841 for fine-tuning. They also propose Face-LLaVA, a robust baseline trained on this data. Experiments show existing MLLMs perform poorly on fine-grained face understanding, while Face-LLaVA significantly outperforms them.
2503.21457|v2.assessment: 该工作填补了MLLMs人脸感知评估的空白，数据集设计细致，但领域与自动驾驶感知相关性较低。
2503.21457|v2.contribution: 构建了首个多视角多层级人脸属性VQA基准数据集FaceBench及基线模型Face-LLaVA。
2503.21457|v2.innovation: 提出层级化面部属性结构，实现多视角多层级的人脸感知评估。
2503.21457|v2.result: Face-LLaVA显著优于现有MLLMs，揭示了现有模型在细粒度人脸理解上的不足。

Incomplete Multi-View Multi-label Learni.summary_cn: ①针对不完整多视图多标签学习问题，即数据中部分视图或标签缺失，影响分类性能。②提出基于解耦表示和标签语义嵌入的方法，通过分离视图共享与特有特征，并利用标签语义信息增强学习。③相比已有方法，更有效地处理不完整性和标签相关性。④摘要未提供具体数据，但方法在理论上具有优势。
Incomplete Multi-View Multi-label Learni.summary_en: This paper tackles incomplete multi-view multi-label learning by proposing a method based on disentangled representation and label semantic embedding, which separates shared and view-specific features and leverages label semantics. It improves handling of missing views/labels compared to prior work, though no quantitative results are provided in the abstract.
Incomplete Multi-View Multi-label Learni.assessment: 方法有一定理论价值，但与自动驾驶感知领域关联度低，且摘要信息不足。
Incomplete Multi-View Multi-label Learni.contribution: 提出解耦表示与标签语义嵌入结合的不完整多视图多标签学习框架。
Incomplete Multi-View Multi-label Learni.innovation: 将解耦表示和标签语义嵌入融合以应对数据不完整性。
Incomplete Multi-View Multi-label Learni.result: 理论上提升不完整数据下的分类性能，但缺乏实验数据支持。
Incomplete Multi-View Multi-label Learni._arxiv_id: Incomplete Multi-View Multi-label Learning via Disentangled Representation and Label Semantic Embedding.

Large-scale Multi-view Tensor Clustering.summary_cn: ①针对大规模多视图张量聚类问题，传统方法计算复杂度高，难以扩展。②提出使用隐式线性核的方法，通过核技巧避免显式构造高维特征，提高效率。③相比已有方法，在保持聚类性能的同时降低计算和存储开销。④摘要未提供具体实验数据。
Large-scale Multi-view Tensor Clustering.summary_en: This paper addresses large-scale multi-view tensor clustering by introducing implicit linear kernels to avoid explicit high-dimensional feature construction, improving scalability. It reduces computational and storage costs while maintaining clustering performance, though no specific results are given.
Large-scale Multi-view Tensor Clustering.assessment: 聚类方法虽与多视角相关，但面向通用数据，与自动驾驶感知场景差异大。
Large-scale Multi-view Tensor Clustering.contribution: 提出基于隐式线性核的大规模多视图张量聚类方法。
Large-scale Multi-view Tensor Clustering.innovation: 利用隐式核技巧提升多视图聚类的可扩展性。
Large-scale Multi-view Tensor Clustering.result: 理论上降低复杂度，但缺乏实证数据。
Large-scale Multi-view Tensor Clustering._arxiv_id: Large-scale Multi-view Tensor Clustering with Implicit Linear Kernels.

SeqMvRL: A Sequential Fusion Framework f.summary_cn: ①针对多视图表示学习中如何有效融合不同视图信息的问题。②提出SeqMvRL，一种顺序融合框架，逐步整合多视图特征以增强表示。③相比并行融合方法，顺序融合能更好地捕捉视图间依赖关系。④摘要未提供具体性能数据。
SeqMvRL: A Sequential Fusion Framework f.summary_en: This paper proposes SeqMvRL, a sequential fusion framework for multi-view representation learning, which integrates features progressively to capture inter-view dependencies better than parallel fusion. No quantitative results are reported in the abstract.
SeqMvRL: A Sequential Fusion Framework f.assessment: 顺序融合思路有一定新意，但缺乏实验验证，且与自动驾驶多相机感知的关联需进一步明确。
SeqMvRL: A Sequential Fusion Framework f.contribution: 提出顺序融合框架SeqMvRL用于多视图表示学习。
SeqMvRL: A Sequential Fusion Framework f.innovation: 采用顺序融合策略以建模视图间依赖。
SeqMvRL: A Sequential Fusion Framework f._arxiv_id: SeqMvRL: A Sequential Fusion Framework for Multi-view Representation Learning.
