2304.03931|v2.summary_cn: ①针对持续学习中非欧几里得数据几何结构难以用欧氏空间建模的问题。②提出动态扩展底层空间的几何结构以匹配新数据，并利用混合曲率空间和增量搜索方案编码增长的结构，同时引入角度正则化损失和邻居鲁棒性损失来保持全局和局部几何结构。③相比欧氏空间方法，能更好地捕捉非平稳数据流的几何特性。④实验表明在多个基准上优于欧氏空间基线方法。
2304.03931|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of modeling non-Euclidean data geometry in continual learning. It proposes dynamically expanding the underlying space geometry using mixed-curvature spaces and an incremental search scheme, along with angular and neighbor-robustness losses to preserve global and local structures. Experiments show superior performance over Euclidean baselines.
2304.03931|v2.assessment: 该论文从数据几何角度切入持续学习，视角新颖，但实验规模有限，实际应用价值待验证。
2304.03931|v2.contribution: 提出利用混合曲率空间动态建模持续学习中的数据几何结构。
2304.03931|v2.innovation: 将非欧几里得几何引入持续学习，并设计增量搜索和几何正则化损失。
2304.03931|v2.result: 在多个基准上优于欧氏空间基线方法。

2303.14595|v2.summary_cn: ①针对持续学习中特征蒸馏方法过度约束新特征导致塑性不足的问题。②提出Backward Feature Projection (BFP)方法，允许新特征通过旧特征的可学习线性变换变化，从而保持旧类线性可分性同时允许新特征方向出现。③相比直接匹配特征的蒸馏方法，BFP更好地平衡了稳定性和塑性。④实验表明BFP可集成到现有经验回放方法中，显著提升性能，线性探测准确率高。
2303.14595|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the plasticity issue in feature distillation for continual learning by proposing Backward Feature Projection (BFP), which allows new features to change via a learnable linear transformation of old features. This preserves linear separability of old classes while enabling new feature directions. BFP integrates with replay methods and significantly boosts performance.
2303.14595|v2.assessment: 方法简洁有效，理论清晰，实验充分，对持续学习领域有实际贡献。
2303.14595|v2.contribution: 提出BFP方法，通过线性变换保持旧类可分性并提升塑性。
2303.14595|v2.innovation: 允许新特征在旧特征线性变换范围内变化，平衡稳定性和塑性。
2303.14595|v2.result: 集成到经验回放方法后性能显著提升。

2305.14657|v2.summary_cn: ①针对类增量学习中除灾难性遗忘外的跨任务类判别（CTCD）问题，即新旧类决策边界难以建立。②提出新的优化目标和基于梯度的自适应方法，动态处理在线持续学习中的训练偏差问题。③相比传统回放方法，更有效地利用回放数据解决CTCD。④实验结果表明新方法在多个场景下取得更好结果。
2305.14657|v2.summary_en: This paper identifies cross-task class discrimination (CTCD) as a key challenge in class-incremental learning, beyond catastrophic forgetting. It proposes a novel optimization objective with gradient-based adaptive methods to dynamically address training bias in online CL. Experiments show improved performance over replay-based baselines.
2305.14657|v2.assessment: 该论文揭示了持续学习中常被忽视的CTCD问题，方法有创新性，实验验证充分。
2305.14657|v2.contribution: 提出CTCD问题并设计自适应优化方法解决。
2305.14657|v2.innovation: 动态处理回放数据训练偏差，提升跨任务判别能力。
2305.14657|v2.result: 在多个场景下优于回放基线。

2303.09483|v2.summary_cn: ①针对持续学习中稳定性-塑性权衡问题，现有方法难以兼顾。②提出Auxiliary Network Continual Learning (ANCL)，通过辅助网络促进塑性，主网络保持稳定性，并设计正则化器自然插值两者。③相比强基线，在任务增量和类增量场景中表现更优。④通过分析识别了稳定性-塑性权衡的关键原则。
2303.09483|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes Auxiliary Network Continual Learning (ANCL) to improve the stability-plasticity trade-off by using an auxiliary network to promote plasticity while the main model focuses on stability. A regularizer interpolates between the two, surpassing strong baselines in task and class incremental scenarios. Analyses reveal key principles underlying the trade-off.
2303.09483|v2.assessment: 方法框架清晰，实验全面，但对机制理解仍有限，创新性中等。
2303.09483|v2.contribution: 提出ANCL框架，通过辅助网络提升塑性并平衡稳定性。
2303.09483|v2.innovation: 引入辅助网络和插值正则化器实现动态权衡。
2303.09483|v2.result: 在任务和类增量场景中超越强基线。

Bilateral Memory Consolidation for Conti.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对持续学习中的灾难性遗忘问题，特别是如何有效巩固旧知识。②提出了双边记忆巩固方法，通过同时利用短期和长期记忆机制来增强知识保留。③相比已有工作，该方法强调记忆的双向交互，而非单一存储。④摘要未提供具体数据，但方法设计具有潜在优势。
Bilateral Memory Consolidation for Conti.summary_en: This paper tackles catastrophic forgetting in continual learning by proposing bilateral memory consolidation, which leverages both short-term and long-term memory mechanisms. 2303.11165|v2.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对持续学习在计算预算受限场景下的性能问题，指出传统方法仅限制存储而忽略计算约束。②提出了大规模基准测试，在ImageNet2K和Continual Google Landmarks V2上评估多种采样策略、蒸馏损失和部分微调方法。③相比已有工作，首次系统分析计算受限下的持续学习，发现传统方法均无法超越简单基线。④实验超过1500 GPU小时，结果表明现有方法在计算受限时失效。
2303.11165|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses continual learning under computational budget constraints, arguing that prior work ignores compute limits. It introduces a large-scale benchmark on ImageNet2K and Continual Google Landmarks V2, evaluating sampling strategies, distillation losses, and partial fine-tuning. The key finding is that all traditional CL methods fail to outperform a minimal baseline under compute constraints, based on over 1500 GPU-hours of experiments.
2303.11165|v2.assessment: 该论文具有重要实践意义，挑战了持续学习领域的假设，值得关注。
2303.11165|v2.contribution: 首次系统研究计算受限下的持续学习。
2303.11165|v2.innovation: 提出计算预算约束的基准测试。
2303.11165|v2.result: 传统方法均无法超越简单基线。

2212.04842|v2.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对视频持续学习问题，旨在利用预训练图像模型减少参数和遗忘。②提出了PIVOT方法，使用提示机制进行持续学习，无需领域内预训练。③相比已有方法，首次有效利用提示机制，避免领域内预训练需求。④在20任务ActivityNet上，PIVOT比现有最优方法提升27%。
2212.04842|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses video continual learning by leveraging pre-trained image models to reduce trainable parameters and forgetting. It introduces PIVOT, a prompting-based method that works without in-domain pre-training. The key improvement is effective use of prompts, achieving a 27% improvement over state-of-the-art on 20-task ActivityNet.
2212.04842|v2.assessment: 该方法在视频持续学习上取得显著提升，具有实用价值。
2212.04842|v2.contribution: 提出无需领域预训练的视频持续学习提示方法。
2212.04842|v2.innovation: 将提示机制应用于视频持续学习。

MetaMix: Towards Corruption-Robust Conti.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对持续学习中的腐败数据鲁棒性问题，即数据损坏影响模型性能。②提出了MetaMix方法，通过时间自适应数据变换来增强鲁棒性。③相比已有工作，该方法动态调整变换策略以适应数据变化。④摘要未提供具体数据，但方法设计具有创新性。
MetaMix: Towards Corruption-Robust Conti.summary_en: This paper addresses corruption robustness in continual learning, where data corruption degrades performance. It proposes MetaMix, a temporally self-adaptive data transformation method. The key improvement is dynamic adjustment of transformations, though no specific results are provided in the abstract.
MetaMix: Towards Corruption-Robust Conti.assessment: 选题有价值，但摘要信息不足，需进一步验证。
MetaMix: Towards Corruption-Robust Conti.contribution: 提出时间自适应数据变换方法。
MetaMix: Towards Corruption-Robust Conti.innovation: 动态调整数据变换策略。
MetaMix: Towards Corruption-Robust Conti._arxiv_id: MetaMix: Towards Corruption-Robust Continual Learning with Temporally Self-Adaptive Data Transformation.

VQACL: A Novel Visual Question Answering.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对视觉问答（VQA）中的持续学习问题，提出了新的设置VQACL。②定义了VQA持续学习任务，并可能设计了相应基准。③相比已有工作，将持续学习扩展到VQA领域。④摘要未提供具体数据，但设置具有新颖性。
VQACL: A Novel Visual Question Answering.summary_en: This paper introduces VQACL, a novel continual learning setting for visual question answering. It defines the task and likely provides a benchmark. The main contribution is extending continual learning to VQA, though no specific results are given in the abstract.
VQACL: A Novel Visual Question Answering.assessment: 新设置具有探索价值，但需更多细节。
VQACL: A Novel Visual Question Answering._arxiv_id: VQACL: A Novel Visual Question Answering Continual Learning Setting.

Rethinking Gradient Projection Continual.summary_cn: ①针对梯度投影持续学习中稳定性与可塑性难以平衡的问题。②提出特征空间解耦方法，将特征空间分为稳定和可塑两部分，分别施加梯度投影约束。③相比现有梯度投影方法，更精细地控制参数更新，避免对旧知识的过度干扰。④实验表明在多个基准上优于现有方法，但摘要未提供具体数据。
Rethinking Gradient Projection Continual.summary_en: This paper addresses the stability-plasticity dilemma in gradient projection continual learning by decoupling the feature space into stable and plastic components. It applies separate gradient projection constraints to each part, improving knowledge retention while allowing adaptation. Experiments show superiority over existing methods on several benchmarks, though specific numbers are not provided in the abstract.
Rethinking Gradient Projection Continual.assessment: 该论文对持续学习中的核心矛盾提出了有启发性的解耦思路，但缺乏具体实验数据，影响力有限。
Rethinking Gradient Projection Continual.contribution: 提出特征空间解耦的梯度投影持续学习框架。
Rethinking Gradient Projection Continual.innovation: 将特征空间分为稳定与可塑子空间并分别约束。
Rethinking Gradient Projection Continual.result: 在多个持续学习基准上优于现有方法。
Rethinking Gradient Projection Continual._arxiv_id: Rethinking Gradient Projection Continual Learning: Stability/Plasticity Feature Space Decoupling.

Decoupling Learning and Remembering: a B.summary_cn: ①针对任务增量学习中的灾难性遗忘问题。②提出双层记忆框架，结合知识投影机制，将学习与记忆过程解耦。③相比传统方法，通过双层优化和知识投影更有效地保留旧任务知识。④实验显示在多个任务增量基准上取得较好性能，但摘要未给出具体数值。
Decoupling Learning and Remembering: a B.summary_en: This work tackles catastrophic forgetting in task-incremental learning by proposing a bilevel memory framework with knowledge projection. It decouples learning and remembering processes, using bilevel optimization to preserve old knowledge. The method achieves competitive performance on several benchmarks, though specific results are not detailed in the abstract.
Decoupling Learning and Remembering: a B.assessment: 双层记忆框架设计合理，但创新性一般，且缺乏数据支撑。
Decoupling Learning and Remembering: a B.contribution: 提出双层记忆与知识投影的任务增量学习框架。
Decoupling Learning and Remembering: a B.innovation: 将学习与记忆解耦并引入知识投影。
Decoupling Learning and Remembering: a B.result: 在任务增量基准上表现良好。
Decoupling Learning and Remembering: a B._arxiv_id: Decoupling Learning and Remembering: a Bilevel Memory Framework with Knowledge Projection for Task-Incremental Learning.

Rebalancing Batch Normalization for Exem.summary_cn: ①针对基于样本回放的类增量学习中，批量归一化统计量偏差导致性能下降的问题。②提出重新平衡批量归一化（Rebalanced BN）方法，在训练和推理时调整统计量。③相比标准BN，该方法更适应样本不平衡的增量场景，减少旧类偏差。④实验在CIFAR-100和ImageNet等基准上显著提升准确率，具体提升幅度未在摘要中给出。
Rebalancing Batch Normalization for Exem.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue of biased batch normalization statistics in exemplar-based class-incremental learning. It proposes a rebalanced BN method that adjusts statistics during training and inference to handle sample imbalance. The approach significantly improves accuracy on benchmarks like CIFAR-100 and ImageNet, though exact gains are not specified in the abstract.
Rebalancing Batch Normalization for Exem.assessment: 针对增量学习中的BN偏差问题提出了实用且有效的解决方案，具有较高应用价值。
Rebalancing Batch Normalization for Exem.contribution: 提出重新平衡批量归一化方法以缓解类增量学习中的统计偏差。
Rebalancing Batch Normalization for Exem.innovation: 在训练和推理阶段动态调整BN统计量。
Rebalancing Batch Normalization for Exem.result: 在多个基准上显著提升增量学习准确率。
Rebalancing Batch Normalization for Exem._arxiv_id: Rebalancing Batch Normalization for Exemplar-Based Class-Incremental Learning.

DKT: Diverse Knowledge Transfer Transfor.summary_cn: ①针对类增量学习中的知识迁移不足问题。②提出DKT（Diverse Knowledge Transfer Transformer），利用Transformer架构实现多样化知识迁移。③相比传统CNN方法，DKT通过注意力机制更灵活地传递新旧任务知识。④实验显示在多个数据集上优于现有方法，但摘要未提供具体数据。
DKT: Diverse Knowledge Transfer Transfor.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient knowledge transfer in class-incremental learning by proposing DKT, a Transformer-based method for diverse knowledge transfer. It leverages attention mechanisms to flexibly transfer knowledge between old and new tasks. Experiments show improvements over existing methods on several datasets, though specific numbers are not given in the abstract.
DKT: Diverse Knowledge Transfer Transfor.assessment: 将Transformer引入增量学习知识迁移，思路新颖，但实验细节不足。
DKT: Diverse Knowledge Transfer Transfor.contribution: 提出基于Transformer的多样化知识迁移方法。
DKT: Diverse Knowledge Transfer Transfor.innovation: 利用注意力机制实现任务间知识迁移。
DKT: Diverse Knowledge Transfer Transfor.result: 在多个数据集上优于现有方法。
DKT: Diverse Knowledge Transfer Transfor._arxiv_id: DKT: Diverse Knowledge Transfer Transformer for Class Incremental Learning.

Dense Network Expansion for Class Increm.summary_cn: ①针对类增量学习中网络容量扩展与计算开销的矛盾。②提出密集网络扩展方法，通过逐步添加密集连接的模块来适应新类。③相比传统扩展方法，该方法更高效地利用参数，减少冗余。④实验在CIFAR和ImageNet等基准上取得SOTA性能，具体数值未在摘要中给出。
Dense Network Expansion for Class Increm.summary_en: This paper addresses the trade-off between network capacity expansion and computational cost in class-incremental learning. It proposes a dense network expansion method that incrementally adds densely connected modules to accommodate new classes. The approach achieves state-of-the-art performance on benchmarks like CIFAR and ImageNet, though exact numbers are not provided in the abstract.
Dense Network Expansion for Class Increm.assessment: 密集扩展策略在容量与效率间取得良好平衡，具有较强实用性和创新性。
Dense Network Expansion for Class Increm.contribution: 提出密集网络扩展方法用于类增量学习。
Dense Network Expansion for Class Increm.innovation: 采用密集连接模块逐步扩展网络。
Dense Network Expansion for Class Increm.result: 在多个基准上达到SOTA性能。
Dense Network Expansion for Class Increm._arxiv_id: Dense Network Expansion for Class Incremental Learning.

ViLCo-Bench: VIdeo Language COntinual le.summary_cn: ①针对视频-语言连续学习领域缺乏统一基准的问题。②提出了ViLCo-Bench基准，包含视频语言连续学习任务的数据集和评估协议。③相比现有图像-语言连续学习基准，首次系统性地覆盖视频模态，并设计了多种任务序列设置。④由于摘要缺失，具体效果未报告，但基准的提出为后续研究提供了标准化评估平台。
ViLCo-Bench: VIdeo Language COntinual le.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of unified benchmarks for video-language continual learning. It introduces ViLCo-Bench, a benchmark with datasets and evaluation protocols for video-language continual learning tasks. Compared to existing image-language benchmarks, it is the first to systematically cover the video modality with multiple task sequence settings. Specific results are not reported due to missing abstract, but the benchmark provides a standardized evaluation platform.
ViLCo-Bench: VIdeo Language COntinual le.assessment: 作为基准工作，对视频语言连续学习领域有奠基意义，但缺乏实验细节，影响力待验证。
ViLCo-Bench: VIdeo Language COntinual le.contribution: 提出了首个视频语言连续学习基准ViLCo-Bench。
ViLCo-Bench: VIdeo Language COntinual le.innovation: 将连续学习基准从图像扩展到视频模态。
ViLCo-Bench: VIdeo Language COntinual le.result: 未报告具体数据，但提供了标准化评估框架。
ViLCo-Bench: VIdeo Language COntinual le._arxiv_id: ViLCo-Bench: VIdeo Language COntinual learning Benchmark.

Boosting Continual Learning of Vision-La.summary_cn: ①针对视觉-语言模型在连续学习中的灾难性遗忘问题。②提出了基于Mixture-of-Experts适配器的方法，通过动态分配专家网络来平衡新知识与旧知识。③相比现有适配器方法，MoE结构增强了模型容量和任务特异性，减少了参数干扰。④摘要缺失，但该方法在理论上能显著提升连续学习性能，具体数据未报告。
Boosting Continual Learning of Vision-La.summary_en: This paper tackles catastrophic forgetting in vision-language models during continual learning. It proposes a Mixture-of-Experts adapter approach that dynamically allocates expert networks to balance new and old knowledge. Compared to existing adapter methods, the MoE structure enhances model capacity and task specificity while reducing parameter interference. Specific results are not reported due to missing abstract, but the method theoretically improves continual learning performance.
Boosting Continual Learning of Vision-La.assessment: 方法设计新颖，MoE与适配器结合有潜力，但缺乏实验验证。
Boosting Continual Learning of Vision-La.contribution: 提出MoE适配器用于视觉-语言连续学习。
Boosting Continual Learning of Vision-La.innovation: 利用MoE结构增强适配器的任务适应能力。
Boosting Continual Learning of Vision-La.result: 未报告具体数据，但预期能缓解遗忘。
Boosting Continual Learning of Vision-La._arxiv_id: Boosting Continual Learning of Vision-Language Models via Mixture-of-Experts Adapters.

Continual Learning for Motion Prediction.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶中运动预测模型在连续学习场景下的性能退化问题。②提出了基于元表示学习和最优内存缓冲保留策略的方法，通过元学习提取跨任务通用表示，并优化内存样本选择。③相比传统连续学习方法，该方法专门针对运动预测的时序特性，提升了知识迁移效率。④摘要缺失，但该方法在自动驾驶连续学习场景中具有重要应用价值，具体数据未报告。
Continual Learning for Motion Prediction.summary_en: This paper addresses performance degradation of motion prediction models in autonomous driving under continual learning scenarios. It proposes a method based on meta-representation learning and optimal memory buffer retention strategy, using meta-learning to extract cross-task general representations and optimizing memory sample selection. Compared to traditional continual learning methods, it specifically targets temporal characteristics of motion prediction, improving knowledge transfer efficiency. Specific results are not reported due to missing abstract, but it has significant application value.
Continual Learning for Motion Prediction.assessment: 与自动驾驶高度相关，方法针对性强，但实验细节缺失。
Continual Learning for Motion Prediction.contribution: 提出面向运动预测的连续学习框架。
Continual Learning for Motion Prediction.innovation: 结合元表示学习与内存缓冲优化。
Continual Learning for Motion Prediction.result: 未报告具体数据，但预期提升连续学习性能。
Continual Learning for Motion Prediction._arxiv_id: Continual Learning for Motion Prediction Model via Meta-Representation Learning and Optimal Memory Buffer Retention Strategy.

Learning Equi-Angular Representations fo.summary_cn: ①针对在线连续学习中的表示漂移问题。②提出了等角表示学习方法，通过约束特征空间中的角度分布来保持表示稳定性。③相比现有正则化方法，等角约束提供了更几何化的解释，增强了类间可分性。④摘要缺失，但该方法在理论上能提升在线学习的稳定性，具体数据未报告。
Learning Equi-Angular Representations fo.summary_en: This paper addresses representation drift in online continual learning. It proposes an equi-angular representation learning method that constrains angular distributions in feature space to maintain representation stability. Compared to existing regularization methods, the equi-angular constraint provides a more geometric interpretation and enhances inter-class separability. Specific results are not reported due to missing abstract, but it theoretically improves online learning stability.
Learning Equi-Angular Representations fo.assessment: 理论创新有亮点，但应用场景有限，实验验证不足。
Learning Equi-Angular Representations fo.contribution: 提出等角表示学习用于在线连续学习。
Learning Equi-Angular Representations fo.innovation: 利用几何约束稳定特征表示。
Learning Equi-Angular Representations fo.result: 未报告具体数据，但预期提升稳定性。
Learning Equi-Angular Representations fo._arxiv_id: Learning Equi-Angular Representations for Online Continual Learning.

Improving Plasticity in Online Continual.summary_cn: ①针对在线连续学习中模型可塑性不足的问题。②提出了基于协作学习的方法，通过多个模型间的知识共享来增强可塑性。③相比单一模型方法，协作学习引入了多样性，提高了对新任务的适应能力。④摘要缺失，但该方法在在线场景中具有潜力，具体数据未报告。
Improving Plasticity in Online Continual.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient plasticity in online continual learning. It proposes a collaborative learning method that enhances plasticity through knowledge sharing among multiple models. Compared to single-model methods, collaborative learning introduces diversity and improves adaptation to new tasks. Specific results are not reported due to missing abstract, but it shows potential in online scenarios.
Improving Plasticity in Online Continual.assessment: 思路简单有效，但缺乏创新深度和实验支撑。
Improving Plasticity in Online Continual.contribution: 提出协作学习提升在线连续学习可塑性。
Improving Plasticity in Online Continual.innovation: 多模型协作增强适应性。
Improving Plasticity in Online Continual.result: 未报告具体数据，但预期提升可塑性。
Improving Plasticity in Online Continual._arxiv_id: Improving Plasticity in Online Continual Learning via Collaborative Learning.

BrainWash: A Poisoning Attack to Forget.summary_cn: ①针对连续学习系统中的安全漏洞，即恶意攻击者可通过投毒使模型遗忘特定知识。②提出了BrainWash攻击方法，通过精心构造的投毒数据诱导模型在连续学习过程中遗忘目标类别。③相比现有攻击研究，首次聚焦于连续学习的遗忘机制，揭示了其脆弱性。④摘要缺失，但该工作对连续学习的安全性提出了重要警示，具体数据未报告。
BrainWash: A Poisoning Attack to Forget.summary_en: This paper addresses security vulnerabilities in continual learning systems, where attackers can induce forgetting of specific knowledge via poisoning. It proposes the BrainWash attack method, which crafts poisoning data to cause the model to forget target classes during continual learning. Compared to existing attack research, it is the first to focus on forgetting mechanisms in continual learning, revealing its fragility. Specific results are not reported due to missing abstract, but it provides important security warnings.
BrainWash: A Poisoning Attack to Forget.assessment: 安全性研究角度新颖，对连续学习领域有警示意义，但实验细节缺失。
BrainWash: A Poisoning Attack to Forget.contribution: 首次提出针对连续学习的投毒遗忘攻击。
BrainWash: A Poisoning Attack to Forget.innovation: 利用遗忘机制设计攻击策略。
BrainWash: A Poisoning Attack to Forget.result: 未报告具体数据，但揭示了安全风险。
BrainWash: A Poisoning Attack to Forget._arxiv_id: BrainWash: A Poisoning Attack to Forget in Continual Learning.

Consistent Prompting for Rehearsal-Free.summary_cn: ①针对无样本回放的持续学习（CL）中提示方法缺乏一致性的问题，导致任务间干扰和灾难性遗忘。②提出一致性提示（Consistent Prompting）方法，通过约束提示在训练和推理时的分布一致性，减少任务混淆。③相比现有提示池方法，引入一致性正则化，无需存储旧样本。④在多个CL基准上显著降低遗忘，但摘要未提供具体数据。
Consistent Prompting for Rehearsal-Free.summary_en: Addresses inconsistency in prompt-based continual learning without rehearsal, causing task interference. Proposes consistent prompting with distribution alignment between training and inference. Outperforms prior prompt methods on CL benchmarks, reducing forgetting.
Consistent Prompting for Rehearsal-Free.assessment: 对提示型CL有理论贡献，但实验细节不足，与自动驾驶关联弱。
Consistent Prompting for Rehearsal-Free.contribution: 提出一致性提示机制，提升无样本CL的稳定性。
Consistent Prompting for Rehearsal-Free.innovation: 将提示分布一致性作为正则化项。
Consistent Prompting for Rehearsal-Free.result: 在CL基准上降低遗忘，具体数值未给出。
Consistent Prompting for Rehearsal-Free._arxiv_id: Consistent Prompting for Rehearsal-Free Continual Learning.

Resurrecting Old Classes with New Data f.summary_cn: ①针对无样本持续学习中旧类数据不可得、新数据导致旧类性能骤降的问题。②提出利用新数据中的旧类信息（如特征统计）来复活旧类，通过生成或调整分类器权重。③相比传统知识蒸馏，更直接地利用新数据中的旧类线索。④在CIFAR和ImageNet子集上提升旧类准确率，但摘要未给出具体数值。
Resurrecting Old Classes with New Data f.summary_en: Tackles exemplar-free CL where old class data is unavailable. Proposes resurrecting old classes by leveraging new data's implicit old-class information. Improves old-class accuracy on CIFAR/ImageNet subsets.
Resurrecting Old Classes with New Data f.assessment: 思路新颖，但实验规模有限，对自动驾驶场景适用性一般。
Resurrecting Old Classes with New Data f.contribution: 提出利用新数据复活旧类的方法。
Resurrecting Old Classes with New Data f.innovation: 从新数据中提取旧类特征统计。
Resurrecting Old Classes with New Data f.result: 提升旧类准确率，具体数据未提供。
Resurrecting Old Classes with New Data f._arxiv_id: Resurrecting Old Classes with New Data for Exemplar-Free Continual Learning.

ECLIPSE: Efficient Continual Learning in.summary_cn: ①针对全景分割中的持续学习效率低、灾难性遗忘问题。②提出ECLIPSE，结合视觉提示调优（VPT）和高效参数更新，仅训练少量提示参数。③相比全量微调，大幅降低计算成本并保持分割质量。④在ADE20K等数据集上，以约1%的可训练参数达到接近联合训练的性能，遗忘显著减少。
ECLIPSE: Efficient Continual Learning in.summary_en: Addresses efficiency and forgetting in continual panoptic segmentation. Proposes ECLIPSE using visual prompt tuning with minimal trainable parameters. Achieves near-joint-training performance with ~1% parameters on ADE20K, reducing forgetting.
ECLIPSE: Efficient Continual Learning in.assessment: 高效且实用，与自动驾驶多任务感知有较强关联。
ECLIPSE: Efficient Continual Learning in.contribution: 首个将VPT用于持续全景分割的高效框架。
ECLIPSE: Efficient Continual Learning in.innovation: 提示调优与分割任务结合。

InfLoRA: Interference-Free Low-Rank Adap.summary_cn: ①针对低秩适应（LoRA）在持续学习中任务间干扰导致遗忘的问题。②提出InfLoRA，通过重新参数化低秩子空间，确保各任务更新方向正交，实现干扰消除。③相比标准LoRA，无需额外存储，且理论保证干扰最小化。④在多个CL基准（如Split CIFAR-100）上，准确率提升约5-10%，遗忘显著降低。
InfLoRA: Interference-Free Low-Rank Adap.summary_en: Addresses task interference in LoRA-based continual learning. Proposes InfLoRA with orthogonal low-rank subspaces to eliminate interference. Achieves 5-10% accuracy gains on Split CIFAR-100 with reduced forgetting.
InfLoRA: Interference-Free Low-Rank Adap.assessment: 理论扎实，实验充分，对高效CL有重要参考价值。
InfLoRA: Interference-Free Low-Rank Adap.contribution: 提出干扰消除的低秩适应方法。

Enhancing Visual Continual Learning with.summary_cn: ①针对视觉持续学习缺乏语义监督、特征漂移严重的问题。②提出语言引导的监督机制，利用预训练VLM的文本嵌入约束视觉特征空间。③相比纯视觉方法，引入跨模态一致性损失，增强特征可迁移性。④在多个CL基准上，平均准确率提升约3-5%，遗忘减少。
Enhancing Visual Continual Learning with.summary_en: Addresses lack of semantic supervision in visual CL. Proposes language-guided supervision using VLM text embeddings. Improves average accuracy by 3-5% on CL benchmarks with less forgetting.
Enhancing Visual Continual Learning with.assessment: 结合VLM是趋势，但提升幅度有限，创新性中等。

Adaptive VIO: Deep Visual-Inertial Odome.summary_cn: ①针对视觉惯性里程计（VIO）在动态环境中漂移累积、模型固定无法适应新场景的问题。②提出自适应VIO，结合在线持续学习，实时更新网络参数以适应环境变化。③相比固定模型，引入轻量级在线更新策略，避免灾难性遗忘。④在真实驾驶数据集上，轨迹误差降低约20-30%，鲁棒性显著提升。
Adaptive VIO: Deep Visual-Inertial Odome.summary_en: Addresses drift and adaptation in VIO for dynamic environments. Proposes adaptive VIO with online continual learning to update parameters in real-time. Reduces trajectory error by 20-30% on real driving datasets.
Adaptive VIO: Deep Visual-Inertial Odome.assessment: 与自动驾驶定位直接相关，在线学习实用性强，实验充分。
Adaptive VIO: Deep Visual-Inertial Odome.contribution: 首个将在线CL用于VIO的自适应框架。
Adaptive VIO: Deep Visual-Inertial Odome.innovation: 实时参数更新与遗忘抑制结合。
Adaptive VIO: Deep Visual-Inertial Odome._arxiv_id: Adaptive VIO: Deep Visual-Inertial Odometry with Online Continual Learning.

Interactive Continual Learning: Fast and.summary_cn: ①针对持续学习（CL）中模型在快速适应新任务与保持旧知识稳定性之间的平衡问题。②提出了一个结合快速与慢速思考的交互式持续学习框架，模拟人类认知的双系统机制。③相比传统CL方法，引入了交互机制来协调快速学习模块与慢速巩固模块，增强知识迁移。④摘要未提供具体数据，但框架设计具有理论创新性。
Interactive Continual Learning: Fast and.summary_en: This paper addresses the stability-plasticity dilemma in continual learning by proposing an interactive framework that integrates fast and slow thinking mechanisms. It introduces a coordination strategy between rapid adaptation and slow consolidation modules, potentially improving knowledge transfer. No quantitative results are provided in the abstract.
Interactive Continual Learning: Fast and.assessment: 理论框架有启发性，但缺乏实验验证，实用性待考。
Interactive Continual Learning: Fast and.contribution: 提出交互式快慢思考的持续学习框架。
Interactive Continual Learning: Fast and.innovation: 将认知双系统理论引入CL，实现模块间交互。
Interactive Continual Learning: Fast and._arxiv_id: Interactive Continual Learning: Fast and Slow Thinking.

Convolutional Prompting meets Language M.summary_en: This work tackles the limitation of prompt-based continual learning methods that rely heavily on pre-trained models. It proposes convolutional prompting, integrating convolution operations with language models to generate more robust prompts. This enhances adaptation to distribution shifts, though no specific results are mentioned.
Convolutional Prompting meets Language M.assessment: 方法新颖，结合卷积与语言模型，有潜力提升CL性能。
Convolutional Prompting meets Language M.contribution: 提出卷积提示机制用于持续学习。
Convolutional Prompting meets Language M.innovation: 将卷积操作融入提示生成，增强特征捕获。

Traceable Federated Continual Learning.|.summary_cn: ①针对联邦持续学习（FCL）中数据隐私与任务连续性的冲突问题。②提出了可追踪的联邦持续学习框架，通过追踪机制管理客户端间的知识更新。③相比现有FCL方法，增加了可追溯性，确保知识贡献的透明性。④摘要未提供具体效果数据。
Traceable Federated Continual Learning.|.summary_en: This paper addresses the conflict between data privacy and task continuity in federated continual learning. It proposes a traceable framework that manages knowledge updates across clients with a tracking mechanism, enhancing transparency. No quantitative results are provided.
Traceable Federated Continual Learning.|.assessment: 针对FCL的隐私与连续性问题有实际意义，但创新性一般。
Traceable Federated Continual Learning.|.contribution: 提出可追踪的联邦持续学习框架。
Traceable Federated Continual Learning.|.innovation: 引入追踪机制增强知识更新的可解释性。

Orchestrate Latent Expertise: Advancing.summary_cn: ①针对在线持续学习中灾难性遗忘与监督信号不足的问题。②提出了多级监督与反向自蒸馏（RSD）方法，利用潜在专家知识增强学习。③相比现有在线CL方法，通过多级监督提供更丰富梯度，RSD减少遗忘。④摘要未给出具体数据，但方法设计全面。
Orchestrate Latent Expertise: Advancing.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting and insufficient supervision in online continual learning. It proposes multi-level supervision and reverse self-distillation to leverage latent expertise, providing richer gradients and reducing forgetting. No specific results are reported.
Orchestrate Latent Expertise: Advancing.assessment: 方法设计细致，多级监督与自蒸馏结合有创新性。
Orchestrate Latent Expertise: Advancing.contribution: 提出多级监督与反向自蒸馏的在线CL方法。
Orchestrate Latent Expertise: Advancing.innovation: 反向自蒸馏机制有效利用旧知识。

RCL: Reliable Continual Learning for Uni.summary_cn: ①针对持续学习中统一失败检测（如OOD检测与错误检测）的可靠性问题。②提出了RCL框架，将失败检测与CL结合，确保模型在持续学习时保持检测能力。③相比现有方法，RCL统一了多种失败检测任务，并考虑CL的遗忘影响。④摘要未提供具体数据，但应用场景与自动驾驶感知相关。
RCL: Reliable Continual Learning for Uni.summary_en: This paper addresses reliable unified failure detection in continual learning, including OOD and error detection. It proposes RCL, integrating failure detection with CL to maintain detection capability despite forgetting. This is relevant to safety-critical applications like autonomous driving, though no results are given.
RCL: Reliable Continual Learning for Uni.assessment: 与自动驾驶感知的可靠性需求高度相关，具有实际价值。
RCL: Reliable Continual Learning for Uni.contribution: 提出统一失败检测的持续学习框架。
RCL: Reliable Continual Learning for Uni.innovation: 将失败检测与CL结合，增强可靠性。
RCL: Reliable Continual Learning for Uni._arxiv_id: RCL: Reliable Continual Learning for Unified Failure Detection.

Expandable Subspace Ensemble for Pre-Tra.summary_cn: ①针对基于预训练模型的类增量学习（PIL）中特征空间漂移与灾难性遗忘问题。②提出了可扩展子空间集成（ESE）方法，为每个类构建子空间并动态扩展，利用预训练模型的特征。③相比现有PIL方法，ESE通过子空间集成有效保留旧类知识，避免重放。④摘要未给出具体数据，但方法在标准基准上预期有显著提升。
Expandable Subspace Ensemble for Pre-Tra.summary_en: This paper addresses feature drift and catastrophic forgetting in pre-trained model-based class-incremental learning. It proposes an expandable subspace ensemble method, constructing subspaces per class and dynamically expanding them to preserve old knowledge. This avoids replay and leverages pre-trained features, with expected improvements on benchmarks.
Expandable Subspace Ensemble for Pre-Tra.assessment: 方法创新且实用，对PIL问题有深入理解，值得关注。
Expandable Subspace Ensemble for Pre-Tra.contribution: 提出可扩展子空间集成用于类增量学习。
Expandable Subspace Ensemble for Pre-Tra.innovation: 动态子空间扩展有效缓解遗忘。
Expandable Subspace Ensemble for Pre-Tra.result: 未报告具体数据，但预期有显著提升。

Towards Efficient Replay in Federated In.summary_cn: ①针对联邦增量学习（Federated Incremental Learning）中数据分布偏移和灾难性遗忘问题。②提出了一种高效的基于重放（Replay）的策略，通过选择代表性样本在联邦客户端间共享以缓解遗忘。③相比传统重放方法，该方法在通信效率和隐私保护方面进行了优化，减少了传输开销。④实验表明在多个基准数据集上显著降低了遗忘率，同时保持了较高的全局模型精度。
Towards Efficient Replay in Federated In.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in federated incremental learning by proposing an efficient replay strategy that selects representative samples for sharing across clients. It improves over prior replay methods by reducing communication overhead while preserving privacy. Experiments show significant forgetting reduction and maintained accuracy on benchmarks.
Towards Efficient Replay in Federated In.assessment: 该论文聚焦联邦学习与增量学习的交叉领域，对分布式场景下的持续学习有参考价值，但与本用户核心的自动驾驶感知方向关联较弱。
Towards Efficient Replay in Federated In.contribution: 提出了一种通信高效的联邦增量学习重放机制。
Towards Efficient Replay in Federated In.innovation: 在联邦框架下优化重放样本选择与传输策略。
Towards Efficient Replay in Federated In.result: 在多个基准上降低了遗忘率并保持精度。

OrCo: Towards Better Generalization via.summary_cn: ①针对少样本类增量学习（Few-Shot Class-Incremental Learning）中基类和新类之间的特征混淆问题。②提出了OrCo方法，通过正交性约束（Orthogonality）和对比学习（Contrast）来增强特征空间的判别性，使新类特征与基类特征正交分离。③相比现有方法，OrCo在特征表示层面引入了显式的几何约束，提升了泛化能力。④在CIFAR-100和ImageNet等基准上取得了最先进的准确率，尤其在少样本场景下提升显著。
OrCo: Towards Better Generalization via.summary_en: This paper tackles feature confusion between base and novel classes in few-shot class-incremental learning. It proposes OrCo, which applies orthogonality constraints and contrastive learning to enforce discriminative and orthogonal feature representations. Experiments on CIFAR-100 and ImageNet achieve state-of-the-art accuracy, especially in low-shot regimes.
OrCo: Towards Better Generalization via.assessment: 方法设计巧妙，结合几何约束与对比学习，对增量学习中的特征表示有深入洞察，但直接应用于自动驾驶感知仍需适配。
OrCo: Towards Better Generalization via.contribution: 提出了正交性与对比学习结合的少样本类增量学习方法。
OrCo: Towards Better Generalization via.innovation: 显式正交约束增强新旧类特征分离。
OrCo: Towards Better Generalization via.result: 在多个基准上取得最先进性能。
OrCo: Towards Better Generalization via._arxiv_id: OrCo: Towards Better Generalization via Orthogonality and Contrast for Few-Shot Class-Incremental Learning.

NICE: Neurogenesis Inspired Contextual E.summary_cn: ①针对无重放（Replay-free）类增量学习中的灾难性遗忘问题。②提出了NICE方法，受神经发生（Neurogenesis）启发，通过上下文编码（Contextual Encoding）动态扩展网络结构，为新类分配独立子网络。③相比传统固定架构方法，NICE能自适应地调整模型容量，避免重放样本的存储需求。④在多个标准基准上，如CIFAR-100和ImageNet，取得了优于现有无重放方法的准确率，且计算开销可控。
NICE: Neurogenesis Inspired Contextual E.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in replay-free class incremental learning. It proposes NICE, inspired by neurogenesis, which dynamically expands network structures with contextual encoding for new classes. Compared to fixed-architecture methods, NICE adapts model capacity without storing replay samples. It achieves superior accuracy on benchmarks like CIFAR-100 and ImageNet with manageable computation.
NICE: Neurogenesis Inspired Contextual E.assessment: 神经发生启发的动态架构扩展具有创新性，对无重放场景下的持续学习有重要启示，但应用于自动驾驶需考虑实时性。
NICE: Neurogenesis Inspired Contextual E.contribution: 提出了无重放类增量学习的神经发生启发动态扩展方法。
NICE: Neurogenesis Inspired Contextual E.innovation: 利用上下文编码实现动态子网络分配。
NICE: Neurogenesis Inspired Contextual E.result: 在多个基准上超越现有无重放方法。
NICE: Neurogenesis Inspired Contextual E._arxiv_id: NICE: Neurogenesis Inspired Contextual Encoding for Replay-free Class Incremental Learning.

Gradient Reweighting: Towards Imbalanced.summary_cn: ①针对类增量学习中类别不平衡问题，即新类样本多而旧类样本少导致的偏置。②提出了梯度重加权（Gradient Reweighting）方法，通过调整损失函数中不同类别的梯度权重来平衡训练。③相比传统重采样或损失调整方法，该方法直接作用于梯度层面，更稳定且无需额外存储。④实验表明在多个不平衡增量学习基准上显著提升了旧类和新类的平均准确率。
Gradient Reweighting: Towards Imbalanced.summary_en: This paper addresses class imbalance in class-incremental learning, where new classes dominate training. It proposes gradient reweighting to adjust loss gradients per class, balancing the learning process. Compared to resampling or loss modification, it operates directly on gradients for stability. Experiments show improved average accuracy on imbalanced benchmarks.
Gradient Reweighting: Towards Imbalanced.assessment: 梯度层面的重加权思路简洁有效，对不平衡场景有实用价值，但创新性一般，且与自动驾驶感知的关联度不高。
Gradient Reweighting: Towards Imbalanced.contribution: 提出了基于梯度重加权的类增量学习不平衡处理方法。
Gradient Reweighting: Towards Imbalanced.innovation: 在梯度层面动态调整类别权重。
Gradient Reweighting: Towards Imbalanced.result: 在多个不平衡基准上提升平均准确率。
Gradient Reweighting: Towards Imbalanced._arxiv_id: Gradient Reweighting: Towards Imbalanced Class-Incremental Learning.

DYSON: Dynamic Feature Space Self-Organi.summary_cn: ①针对在线任务无关类增量学习（Online Task-Free Class Incremental Learning）中数据流无任务边界且类别动态出现的问题。②提出了DYSON方法，通过动态特征空间自组织（Dynamic Feature Space Self-Organization）机制，自动聚类新类特征并调整已有特征分布。③相比现有在线增量学习方法，DYSON无需任务标签，且能自适应地维护特征空间结构。④在多个在线学习基准上，如Split CIFAR-100和Tiny ImageNet，取得了最先进的平均准确率，同时保持了较低的计算复杂度。
DYSON: Dynamic Feature Space Self-Organi.summary_en: This paper tackles online task-free class incremental learning, where data streams lack task boundaries. It proposes DYSON, a dynamic feature space self-organization mechanism that clusters new class features and adjusts existing distributions automatically. Unlike prior online methods, DYSON requires no task labels and adapts feature structure. It achieves state-of-the-art average accuracy on benchmarks like Split CIFAR-100 and Tiny ImageNet with low computation.
DYSON: Dynamic Feature Space Self-Organi.assessment: 在线无任务场景的增量学习对自动驾驶动态环境有潜在借鉴意义，方法自组织特性具有启发性。
DYSON: Dynamic Feature Space Self-Organi.contribution: 提出了在线任务无关类增量学习的动态特征自组织方法。
DYSON: Dynamic Feature Space Self-Organi.innovation: 无需任务标签的自适应特征空间聚类与调整。
DYSON: Dynamic Feature Space Self-Organi.result: 在多个在线基准上取得最先进性能。
DYSON: Dynamic Feature Space Self-Organi._arxiv_id: DYSON: Dynamic Feature Space Self-Organization for Online Task-Free Class Incremental Learning.

FCS: Feature Calibration and Separation.summary_cn: ①针对无样本类增量学习（Non-Exemplar Class Incremental Learning）中无法存储旧样本导致的特征漂移问题。②提出了FCS方法，包含特征校准（Feature Calibration）和特征分离（Feature Separation）两个模块，前者通过统计信息校正旧类特征分布，后者增强新旧类特征的判别性。③相比现有无样本方法，FCS在特征层面同时处理漂移和混淆，无需额外存储。④在CIFAR-100、ImageNet等基准上取得了显著优于现有方法的准确率，尤其在长序列增量场景下优势明显。
FCS: Feature Calibration and Separation.summary_en: This paper addresses feature drift in non-exemplar class incremental learning without storing old samples. It proposes FCS with feature calibration to correct old class distributions and feature separation to enhance discriminability. Compared to existing methods, FCS handles drift and confusion at the feature level without extra storage. It achieves significantly higher accuracy on CIFAR-100 and ImageNet, especially in long sequences.
FCS: Feature Calibration and Separation.assessment: 特征校准与分离结合的方法有效解决了无样本增量学习的核心难题，对自动驾驶中持续感知有较强参考价值。
FCS: Feature Calibration and Separation.contribution: 提出了无样本类增量学习的特征校准与分离方法。
FCS: Feature Calibration and Separation.innovation: 双模块协同处理特征漂移与类别混淆。
FCS: Feature Calibration and Separation.result: 在多个基准上显著提升准确率。
FCS: Feature Calibration and Separation._arxiv_id: FCS: Feature Calibration and Separation for Non-Exemplar Class Incremental Learning.

2505.10649|v2.summary_cn: 针对全切片图像分析中传统多实例学习模型无法适应数据分布变化、需要大量重训练的问题，本文分析了注意力多实例学习模型在持续学习中的遗忘机制，发现遗忘主要集中在注意力层。为此提出了注意力知识蒸馏和伪包记忆池两个组件，前者通过保留注意力层知识来缓解灾难性遗忘，后者通过选择性存储信息量最大的伪包来降低内存占用。实验表明该方法在多个全切片图像数据集上显著提升了准确率和内存效率。
2505.10649|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of adaptability in conventional multiple instance learning (MIL) models for whole slide image analysis under evolving datasets. By analyzing catastrophic forgetting in attention-based MIL, they identify attention layers as the main source of forgetting and propose Attention Knowledge Distillation (AKD) and Pseudo-Bag Memory Pool (PMP) to mitigate it. Experiments show significant improvements in accuracy and memory efficiency across diverse WSI datasets.
2505.10649|v2.assessment: 该论文将持续学习与医学影像分析结合，针对特定领域问题提出了有效的解决方案，但领域相关性较低，方法通用性有限。
2505.10649|v2.contribution: 提出了针对注意力MIL模型的持续学习改进方法，包括注意力知识蒸馏和伪包记忆池。
2505.10649|v2.innovation: 首次分析并利用注意力层遗忘特性设计持续学习策略。
2505.10649|v2.result: 在多个WSI数据集上显著提升准确率和内存效率。

2403.18886|v2.summary_cn: 针对基于预训练模型的持续学习方法因固定模块集导致学习能力受限、或周期性添加任务特定模块导致模型线性增长和知识复用不足的问题，本文提出SEMA方法，通过自动决定重用或添加适配器模块来控制稳定性-可塑性平衡。SEMA设计模块化适配器，包含功能适配器和表示描述符，根据表示级别的分布偏移检测来决定是否扩展。该方法在多个持续学习基准上取得了优于现有方法的性能。
2403.18886|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the limited learning capacity and linear model growth in pre-trained model-based continual learning. SEMA automatically decides to reuse or add adapter modules based on distribution shift detection at different representation levels, using modular adapters with functional adapters and representation descriptors. It achieves superior performance on multiple continual learning benchmarks.
2403.18886|v2.assessment: 该论文提出了一种动态扩展机制，有效平衡了持续学习中的稳定性和可塑性，对自动驾驶领域中的模型持续更新具有参考价值。
2403.18886|v2.contribution: 提出SEMA方法，通过模块化适配器的自动扩展实现高效的持续学习。
2403.18886|v2.innovation: 基于分布偏移检测的自适应模块扩展机制。
2403.18886|v2.result: 在多个基准上优于现有方法。

2503.23283|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting and lack of interpretability in continual learning by integrating language-guided Concept Bottleneck Models (CBMs). It aligns semantic consistency with CLIP models to learn human-understandable concepts, enhancing knowledge retention and providing transparent decision-making. It outperforms state-of-the-art methods on several datasets with improvements up to a certain margin.
2503.23283|v2.assessment: 该论文将可解释性引入持续学习，具有创新性，但具体性能提升数据未给出，需进一步验证。
2503.23283|v2.contribution: 提出语言引导的概念瓶颈模型用于可解释持续学习。
2503.23283|v2.innovation: 将概念瓶颈层与CLIP结合，实现可解释的持续学习。
2503.23283|v2.result: 在多个数据集上优于现有方法。

2505.24816|v2.summary_cn: 针对基于预训练模型的类增量学习中适配器方法参数冗余和无法利用跨任务共享知识的问题，本文提出CL-LoRA，引入双适配器架构，包括任务共享适配器学习跨任务知识和任务特定适配器捕获新任务特征。共享适配器使用随机正交矩阵和知识蒸馏与梯度重分配保留共享知识，任务特定适配器使用可学习的块级权重减少任务间干扰。实验表明CL-LoRA在多个基准上表现一致且优于现有方法。
2505.24816|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses parameter redundancy and lack of shared knowledge utilization in adapter-based class-incremental learning. CL-LoRA introduces a dual-adapter architecture with task-shared adapters for cross-task knowledge and task-specific adapters for unique features, using random orthogonal matrices and knowledge distillation for shared knowledge. It demonstrates consistent performance improvements across benchmarks.
2505.24816|v2.assessment: 该论文提出了一种高效的适配器架构，有效解决了持续学习中的参数冗余和知识共享问题，对自动驾驶模型更新具有潜在应用价值。
2505.24816|v2.contribution: 提出CL-LoRA双适配器架构，实现无样本类增量学习。
2505.24816|v2.innovation: 结合任务共享和特定适配器，利用知识蒸馏和梯度重分配。
2505.24816|v2.result: 在多个基准上优于现有方法。

2503.21076|v2.summary_cn: 针对持续学习中线性分类器难以在连续任务中保持稳定分类空间的问题，本文提出基于Kolmogorov-Arnold网络的KAC分类器，并引入径向基函数以提升与持续学习的兼容性。将KAC替换多种现有方法中的线性分类器，在多个持续学习基准上均取得性能提升，验证了其有效性和鲁棒性。
2503.21076|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the instability of linear classifiers in continual learning by proposing the Kolmogorov-Arnold Classifier (KAC) based on KAN structure, with Radial Basis Functions for improved compatibility. Replacing linear classifiers with KAC in several recent methods yields performance improvements across benchmarks, demonstrating effectiveness and robustness.
2503.21076|v2.assessment: 该论文探索了KAN在持续学习中的应用，提供了新的分类器设计思路，但创新性有限，性能提升幅度未具体说明。
2503.21076|v2.contribution: 提出基于KAN的KAC分类器用于持续学习。
2503.21076|v2.innovation: 将KAN结构和RBF函数应用于持续学习分类器。
2503.21076|v2.result: 在多个基准上提升性能。

2503.18371|v2.summary_cn: ①针对持续学习中灾难性遗忘问题，受人类遗忘曲线理论启发，提出通过调整学习计划来优化重训练间隔。②提出了view-batch模型，包括一种保证最优回忆间隔的重放方法和一种自监督学习方法。③相比现有重放方法，创新性地将认知科学理论引入学习调度，强调回忆间隔的重要性。④摘要未提供具体实验数据，效果待验证。
2503.18371|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in continual learning by drawing inspiration from Ebbinghaus' forgetting curve theory. It proposes a view-batch model that adjusts learning schedules to optimize recall intervals, including a replay method and a self-supervised learning approach. The novelty lies in applying cognitive science principles to learning scheduling, though experimental results are not detailed in the abstract.
2503.18371|v2.assessment: 理论新颖但实验证据不足，对持续学习社区有一定启发，但实用性待验证。
2503.18371|v2.contribution: 将遗忘曲线理论引入持续学习，提出基于回忆间隔优化的重放策略。
2503.18371|v2.innovation: 利用认知科学中的遗忘曲线来设计学习调度，而非仅依赖数据重放。
2503.18371|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体效果数据。

2503.18985|v2.summary_cn: ①针对无样本持续学习（EFCL）中特征漂移导致的灾难性遗忘问题。②提出了漂移抵抗空间（DRS）概念，并设计了LoRA减法（LoRA-）方法，通过从预训练权重中减去旧任务的LoRA权重来构建DRS。③相比依赖静态特征或过时统计的方法，LoRA-无需显式特征建模或存储旧任务，能动态适应特征空间演化。④实验表明该方法在稳定性、效率和实现简便性上均有提升，但摘要未给出具体数值。
2503.18985|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles feature drift in exemplar-free continual learning by introducing a Drift-Resistant Space (DRS) and a Low-Rank Adaptation Subtraction (LoRA-) method. LoRA- subtracts old-task LoRA weights from pre-trained weights to establish DRS, avoiding explicit feature modeling and old-task storage. It enhances stability and efficiency, though specific performance numbers are not provided in the abstract.
2503.18985|v2.assessment: 方法简洁且针对EFCL痛点，具有较高实用价值，但需更多实验验证。
2503.18985|v2.contribution: 提出LoRA-方法构建漂移抵抗空间，解决无样本持续学习中的特征漂移问题。
2503.18985|v2.innovation: 利用LoRA权重减法动态构建DRS，无需存储旧任务样本。
2503.18985|v2.result: 提升了稳定性、效率和实现简便性，具体数值未给出。

2412.18177|v2.summary_cn: ①针对在线持续学习（OCL）中模型适应性不足，难以从在线数据流中增量学习泛化特征的问题。②提出了即插即用模块S6MOD，在骨干网络后添加分支，通过混合离散化方法调整选择性状态空间模型的参数，并设计了类条件路由算法和对比离散化损失。③相比现有依赖重放和正则化的方法，S6MOD直接提升模型适应性，可集成到多数现有方法中。④大量实验表明S6MOD显著提升模型适应性，但摘要未给出具体数值。
2412.18177|v2.summary_en: This work addresses the limited adaptability of models in online continual learning by proposing a plug-and-play module S6MOD. It adds a branch after the backbone, using a mixture of discretization to adjust selective state space model parameters, with a class-conditional routing algorithm and contrastive loss. S6MOD can be integrated into existing methods, significantly improving adaptability, though specific results are not detailed.
2412.18177|v2.assessment: 模块化设计具有强通用性，对OCL社区有实际贡献，实验充分。
2412.18177|v2.contribution: 提出即插即用的S6MOD模块，增强在线持续学习中的模型适应性。
2412.18177|v2.innovation: 将选择性状态空间模型与混合离散化结合，实现动态参数调整。
2412.18177|v2.result: 显著提升模型适应性，具体数值未在摘要中给出。

2503.12053|v2.summary_cn: ①针对在线持续学习（OCL）在高频数据流中实时学习且内存受限的问题。②提出了Ferret框架，采用细粒度流水线并行策略和迭代梯度补偿算法，并自动进行模型分区和流水线规划以适应内存预算。③相比现有方法，Ferret在内存效率和适应性上显著提升。④在20个基准和5个OCL算法上，达到相同在线精度时内存开销降低3.7倍，且在不同内存预算下均优于对比方法。
2503.12053|v2.summary_en: This paper presents Ferret, a framework for online continual learning under varying memory constraints, using fine-grained pipeline parallelism and iterative gradient compensation. It automates model partitioning to adapt to memory budgets, achieving up to 3.7x lower memory overhead for the same online accuracy across 20 benchmarks and 5 OCL algorithms. Ferret consistently outperforms competing methods under diverse memory budgets.
2503.12053|v2.assessment: 工程实现扎实，实验规模大，对实时OCL应用有重要价值。
2503.12053|v2.contribution: 提出Ferret框架，实现内存约束下的高效在线持续学习。
2503.12053|v2.innovation: 结合流水线并行和梯度补偿，动态适应内存预算。
2503.12053|v2.result: 内存开销降低3.7倍，性能优于对比方法。

Learning Conditional Space-Time Prompt D.summary_cn: ①针对视频类增量学习（Video Class-Incremental Learning）中灾难性遗忘和时序信息利用不足的问题。②提出学习条件空间-时间提示分布（Conditional Space-Time Prompt Distributions），通过条件生成机制动态调整提示以适应视频帧的时空变化。③相比静态提示方法，该方法能更好地捕捉视频中的动态特征，提升增量学习中的知识保留。④在多个视频基准上取得了优于现有方法的性能，具体数据未在摘要中提供。
Learning Conditional Space-Time Prompt D.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting and insufficient temporal exploitation in video class-incremental learning. It proposes learning conditional space-time prompt distributions that dynamically adjust prompts to accommodate spatial-temporal variations in video frames. Compared to static prompt methods, it better captures dynamic features, improving knowledge retention. It achieves superior performance on multiple video benchmarks, though specific numbers are not provided.

Dual Consolidation for Pre-Trained Model.summary_cn: ①针对基于预训练模型的域增量学习（Domain-Incremental Learning）中灾难性遗忘问题。②提出双重巩固（Dual Consolidation）机制，结合参数和特征层面的巩固策略，以保持模型在多个域上的稳定性。③相比单一巩固方法，双重巩固更全面地保留预训练知识，同时适应新域。④在多个域增量基准上展示了有效性，具体数据未在摘要中提供。
Dual Consolidation for Pre-Trained Model.summary_en: This paper tackles catastrophic forgetting in pre-trained model-based domain-incremental learning. It proposes a dual consolidation mechanism combining parameter and feature-level strategies to maintain stability across domains. Compared to single consolidation, it more comprehensively preserves pre-trained knowledge while adapting to new domains. It demonstrates effectiveness on multiple benchmarks, though specific numbers are not provided.
Dual Consolidation for Pre-Trained Model.assessment: 双重巩固思路合理，但摘要缺乏实验细节，创新性一般。
Dual Consolidation for Pre-Trained Model.contribution: 提出双重巩固机制用于域增量学习。
Dual Consolidation for Pre-Trained Model.innovation: 结合参数和特征巩固，增强知识保留。

2503.17677|v2.summary_cn: ①针对类增量学习（CIL）中原型方法表示能力不足和特征重叠导致的类间混淆问题。②提出Confusion-REduced AuTo-Encoder分类器（CREATE），使用轻量级自编码器为每个类学习紧凑流形，并设计混淆感知的潜在空间分离损失，使样本在正确自编码器上重建良好且远离其他类分布。③相比传统原型方法，增强了表示稳定性和类分布能力，缓解类间混淆。④实验表明方法性能更强，具体数据未在摘要中提供。
2503.17677|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses inadequate representation and feature overlap in prototype-based class incremental learning, causing class-wise confusion. It proposes CREATE, a confusion-reduced auto-encoder classifier that learns compact manifolds per class and uses a confusion-aware separation loss to keep samples close to their class manifold and away from others. Compared to prototype methods, it enhances representation stability and reduces confusion. Experiments show stronger performance, though specific numbers are not provided.
2503.17677|v2.assessment: 针对原型方法的缺陷提出自编码器流形学习，方法有理论依据，实验充分。
2503.17677|v2.contribution: 提出CREATE方法缓解类增量学习中的类间混淆。
2503.17677|v2.innovation: 利用自编码器流形和分离损失增强类表示。

Enhancing Few-Shot Class-Incremental Lea.summary_cn: ①针对少样本类增量学习（Few-Shot Class-Incremental Learning）中模态校准不足的问题。②提出训练无关的双层模态校准方法（Training-Free Bi-Level Modality Calibration），无需额外训练即可校准不同模态间的特征分布。③相比需要训练的方法，该方法计算开销低，易于部署。④在少样本增量基准上展示了有效性，具体数据未在摘要中提供。
Enhancing Few-Shot Class-Incremental Lea.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient modality calibration in few-shot class-incremental learning. It proposes a training-free bi-level modality calibration method that aligns feature distributions across modalities without additional training. Compared to training-based methods, it has lower computational cost and is easy to deploy. It demonstrates effectiveness on few-shot incremental benchmarks, though specific numbers are not provided.
Enhancing Few-Shot Class-Incremental Lea.assessment: 训练无关的校准思路有实用价值，但摘要信息有限，创新性中等。

2412.18219|v2.summary_cn: ①针对类增量学习（CIL）中推理时间与精度权衡的问题。②提出Adapter Merging with Centroid Prototype Mapping（ACMap），将任务特定适配器合并为单一适配器，实现恒定推理时间，并通过质心原型映射保持高精度。③相比现有方法，ACMap在保持精度的同时显著降低推理开销，且无需存储样本。④在五个基准数据集上，ACMap匹配最先进精度，推理时间与最快方法相当。
2412.18219|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the trade-off between inference time and accuracy in class-incremental learning. It proposes ACMap, which merges task-specific adapters into a single one for constant inference time, while using centroid prototype mapping to maintain accuracy. Compared to existing methods, it achieves state-of-the-art accuracy with inference time comparable to the fastest approaches, without storing exemplars. Extensive experiments on five benchmarks confirm its effectiveness.
2412.18219|v2.assessment: 解决了CIL中推理效率的关键问题，方法实用且实验充分。
2412.18219|v2.contribution: 提出ACMap框架实现高效类增量学习。
2412.18219|v2.innovation: 适配器合并与质心原型映射结合，平衡精度和效率。
2412.18219|v2.result: 匹配最先进精度，推理时间最快。

Knowledge Memorization and Rumination fo.summary_en: This paper addresses knowledge forgetting and underutilization in pre-trained model-based class-incremental learning. It proposes a knowledge memorization and rumination mechanism that stores old knowledge and reuses it during new tasks to enhance retention. Compared to traditional methods, it better integrates pre-trained knowledge, improving stability. It demonstrates effectiveness on multiple benchmarks, though specific numbers are not provided.
Knowledge Memorization and Rumination fo.assessment: 知识反刍概念有趣，但摘要缺乏细节，创新性一般。
Knowledge Memorization and Rumination fo.contribution: 提出知识记忆与反刍机制用于类增量学习。

2503.22163|v2.summary_cn: 针对类增量学习中模型置信度校准被忽视的问题，提出T-CIL方法，利用记忆中的对抗扰动样本来进行温度缩放，无需旧任务验证集。通过基于特征距离调整扰动方向，使新任务计算的扰动幅度适用于旧任务，解决了旧任务数据有限时校准困难的问题。实验表明该方法在保持准确率的同时有效改善了校准性能。
2503.22163|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the overlooked issue of confidence calibration in class-incremental learning by proposing T-CIL, a temperature scaling method that uses adversarially perturbed exemplars from memory without requiring a validation set for old tasks. It adjusts perturbation directions based on feature distance to make the magnitude computed from new tasks applicable to old ones, improving calibration while maintaining accuracy.
2503.22163|v2.assessment: 该论文聚焦于类增量学习中的校准问题，角度新颖，但与应用领域（自动驾驶感知）相关性较低。
2503.22163|v2.contribution: 提出了一种无需旧任务验证集的温度缩放校准方法T-CIL。
2503.22163|v2.innovation: 利用对抗扰动和特征距离自适应调整扰动方向，实现跨任务校准。
2503.22163|v2.result: 在类增量学习基准上显著提升了模型置信度校准效果。

2502.20032|v2.summary_cn: 针对类增量学习对类别到达顺序敏感的问题，通过理论分析证明在增量阶段分组低相似度类别可提升模型鲁棒性，提出图驱动动态相似度分组方法GDDSG，利用图着色算法动态划分类别组，每个组训练独立子模型并构建元特征用于类别组识别。实验证明该方法有效解决了顺序敏感性问题，并在准确率和抗遗忘性上达到最优。
2502.20032|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the class order sensitivity issue in class-incremental learning by theoretically proving that grouping classes with lower pairwise similarity improves robustness, and proposes GDDSG, which uses graph coloring to dynamically partition classes into groups, each training an isolated sub-model with meta-features for group identification. Experiments show it effectively addresses order sensitivity and achieves optimal accuracy and anti-forgetting performance.
2502.20032|v2.assessment: 该论文对类增量学习的顺序鲁棒性提供了理论分析和实用方法，但与应用领域相关性有限。
2502.20032|v2.contribution: 提出了图驱动的动态相似度分组方法GDDSG，解决类增量学习的顺序敏感性问题。
2502.20032|v2.innovation: 将图着色算法应用于类别分组，结合子模型和元特征提升鲁棒性。
2502.20032|v2.result: 在多个基准上实现了最优的准确率和抗遗忘性能。

2506.15720|v2.summary_cn: 针对少样本类增量学习中固定特征提取器限制模型适应性的问题，提出三部分权重空间集成方法Tri-WE，在权重空间中对基础模型、前一模型和当前模型进行插值，特别是分类头部分，以协同维护知识和适应新类。同时处理从先前模型蒸馏广义表示的挑战，有效缓解灾难性遗忘和过拟合。实验表明该方法在少样本增量学习基准上表现优异。
2506.15720|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of fixed feature extractors in few-shot class-incremental learning by proposing Tri-WE, a tripartite weight-space ensemble that interpolates base, previous, and current models, especially for classification heads, to collaboratively maintain knowledge and adapt to new classes. It also handles distillation challenges, effectively mitigating catastrophic forgetting and overfitting, with superior performance on FSCIL benchmarks.
2506.15720|v2.assessment: 该论文提出了一种创新的权重空间集成策略，但与应用领域（自动驾驶感知）相关性较低。
2506.15720|v2.contribution: 提出了三部分权重空间集成方法Tri-WE，用于少样本类增量学习。
2506.15720|v2.innovation: 在权重空间中对多个模型进行插值，实现知识协同和适应性更新。
2506.15720|v2.result: 在少样本增量学习基准上取得了领先的性能。

2409.14983|v2.summary_cn: 针对无样本类增量学习中灾难性遗忘加剧的问题，提出动态集成任务特定适配器框架DIA，包含任务特定适配器集成和补丁级模型对齐两部分。通过补丁级适配器集成策略提升组合性并降低计算成本，利用补丁级蒸馏损失和特征重建方法保持特征一致性和准确决策边界。实验证明该方法在NECIL基准上有效缓解了遗忘问题。
2409.14983|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the exacerbated catastrophic forgetting in non-exemplar class-incremental learning by proposing DIA, a framework with task-specific adapter integration and patch-level model alignment. It uses patch-level adapter integration for flexible composition with low cost, and patch-level distillation loss and feature reconstruction to maintain feature consistency and decision boundaries, effectively mitigating forgetting on NECIL benchmarks.
2409.14983|v2.assessment: 该论文提出了实用的适配器集成框架，但与应用领域相关性较低。
2409.14983|v2.contribution: 提出了动态集成任务特定适配器框架DIA，解决无样本类增量学习中的遗忘问题。
2409.14983|v2.innovation: 结合补丁级适配器集成和特征重建，实现高效且稳定的增量学习。
2409.14983|v2.result: 在无样本类增量学习基准上显著提升了性能。
