DeconfuseTrack: Dealing with Confusion f.summary_cn: ①针对多目标跟踪中目标身份混淆（如遮挡、相似外观）导致轨迹切换的问题。②提出了DeconfuseTrack方法，通过设计混淆感知的关联模块和特征增强策略来减少身份错误。③相比现有方法，引入了显式的混淆建模，提高了关联的鲁棒性。④在多个MOT基准上取得了改进，但摘要未提供具体数据。
DeconfuseTrack: Dealing with Confusion f.summary_en: This paper addresses identity confusion in multi-object tracking caused by occlusion and similar appearances. It proposes DeconfuseTrack with confusion-aware association and feature enhancement to reduce ID switches. The method improves tracking robustness over existing approaches, though specific quantitative gains are not detailed in the abstract.
DeconfuseTrack: Dealing with Confusion f.assessment: 针对MOT中的关键难题，思路有针对性，但缺乏具体实验数据，影响力有限。
DeconfuseTrack: Dealing with Confusion f.contribution: 提出混淆感知的关联机制以提升多目标跟踪的身份保持能力。
DeconfuseTrack: Dealing with Confusion f.innovation: 显式建模目标间混淆程度并融入关联决策。
DeconfuseTrack: Dealing with Confusion f.result: 在MOT基准上减少了身份切换，但未给出具体数值。
DeconfuseTrack: Dealing with Confusion f._arxiv_id: DeconfuseTrack: Dealing with Confusion for Multi-Object Tracking.

Towards Generalizable Multi-Object Track.summary_cn: ①针对多目标跟踪方法在跨域场景下泛化能力不足的问题。②提出了提升MOT泛化性的方法，可能包括数据增强、域自适应或架构改进。③相比现有方法，强调在未见数据集上的鲁棒性。④摘要未提供具体性能数据，但声称在多个基准上验证了泛化性。
Towards Generalizable Multi-Object Track.summary_en: This paper tackles the poor generalization of multi-object tracking across domains. It proposes methods to enhance cross-dataset robustness, likely via augmentation or domain adaptation. The work claims improved performance on unseen benchmarks, though specific numbers are absent from the abstract.
Towards Generalizable Multi-Object Track.assessment: 关注MOT的泛化性，对实际部署有价值，但缺乏细节支撑。
Towards Generalizable Multi-Object Track.contribution: 提出提升多目标跟踪跨域泛化能力的策略。
Towards Generalizable Multi-Object Track.innovation: 针对域差异设计训练或适应机制。
Towards Generalizable Multi-Object Track.result: 在多个未见数据集上验证了泛化改进。

Multi-Object Tracking in the Dark.|v2.summary_cn: ①针对低光照条件下多目标跟踪性能急剧下降的问题。②提出了专门针对暗光环境的MOT方法，可能包括图像增强、特征鲁棒性设计或专用数据集。③相比现有方法，首次系统研究暗光MOT，并提供了基准。④摘要未给出具体数据，但强调在暗光场景下的显著提升。
Multi-Object Tracking in the Dark.|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the severe performance drop of multi-object tracking in low-light conditions. It proposes a dedicated approach with image enhancement or robust feature design, and introduces a benchmark for dark scenarios. The method shows significant improvements over existing trackers in dark settings, though exact metrics are not listed.
Multi-Object Tracking in the Dark.|v2.assessment: 填补暗光MOT空白，对自动驾驶夜间感知有直接参考价值。
Multi-Object Tracking in the Dark.|v2.contribution: 首次系统研究并解决暗光环境下的多目标跟踪问题。
Multi-Object Tracking in the Dark.|v2.innovation: 结合低光增强与跟踪框架的联合设计。
Multi-Object Tracking in the Dark.|v2.result: 在暗光基准上显著优于现有方法。

HIPTrack: Visual Tracking with Historica.summary_cn: ①针对单目标跟踪中目标外观变化导致模板失效的问题。②提出了HIPTrack，利用历史提示（historical prompts）来动态更新跟踪模板。③相比现有方法，引入了基于历史信息的提示机制，增强了模板的适应性。④摘要未提供具体数据，但声称在多个跟踪基准上提升了性能。
HIPTrack: Visual Tracking with Historica.summary_en: This paper addresses template failure in visual tracking due to appearance changes. It proposes HIPTrack, which uses historical prompts to dynamically update the target template. The method improves adaptability over existing trackers, with claimed performance gains on benchmarks, though no specific numbers are given.
HIPTrack: Visual Tracking with Historica.assessment: 思路新颖，利用历史信息增强模板，但实验细节不足。
HIPTrack: Visual Tracking with Historica.contribution: 提出基于历史提示的模板更新机制用于视觉跟踪。
HIPTrack: Visual Tracking with Historica.innovation: 将历史状态编码为提示并融入跟踪网络。
HIPTrack: Visual Tracking with Historica.result: 在多个跟踪基准上获得性能提升。
HIPTrack: Visual Tracking with Historica._arxiv_id: HIPTrack: Visual Tracking with Historical Prompts.

MS-MANO: Enabling Hand Pose Tracking wit.summary_cn: ①针对手部姿态跟踪中生物力学约束缺失导致预测不自然的问题。②提出了MS-MANO，将生物力学约束集成到手部模型（MANO）中。③相比现有方法，增强了姿态预测的物理合理性。④摘要未提供具体数据，但强调在姿态精度和自然度上的改进。
MS-MANO: Enabling Hand Pose Tracking wit.summary_en: This paper addresses unnatural hand pose tracking by incorporating biomechanical constraints into the MANO model. It proposes MS-MANO to enforce physical plausibility. The method improves pose accuracy and naturalness, though quantitative results are not detailed.
MS-MANO: Enabling Hand Pose Tracking wit.assessment: 领域较窄，与自动驾驶感知相关性低。
MS-MANO: Enabling Hand Pose Tracking wit.contribution: 将生物力学约束引入手部姿态跟踪模型。
MS-MANO: Enabling Hand Pose Tracking wit.innovation: 在MANO模型中融合关节运动学限制。
MS-MANO: Enabling Hand Pose Tracking wit.result: 提升了手部姿态预测的物理合理性。
MS-MANO: Enabling Hand Pose Tracking wit._arxiv_id: MS-MANO: Enabling Hand Pose Tracking with Biomechanical Constraints.

2407.04926|v2.summary_cn: ①针对基于注意力的3D跟踪（TBA）方法在自动驾驶中性能落后于检测跟踪（TBD）方法的问题。②提出了JDT3D，一个联合检测与跟踪的LiDAR框架，并分析了TBA性能差距的原因。③提出了两种通用方法：轨迹采样增强和基于置信度的查询传播，以弥合TBD与TBA的差距。④在nuScenes测试集上达到0.574 AMOTA，超越所有现有LiDAR TBA方法超过6%。
2407.04926|v2.summary_en: This paper investigates why tracking-by-attention (TBA) methods underperform tracking-by-detection (TBD) in LiDAR-based 3D tracking. It proposes JDT3D, a joint detector-tracker, with track sampling augmentation and confidence-based query propagation. JDT3D achieves 0.574 AMOTA on nuScenes, outperforming all LiDAR TBA methods by over 6%.
2407.04926|v2.assessment: 深入分析TBA瓶颈并提出有效改进，对自动驾驶3D跟踪有重要价值。
2407.04926|v2.contribution: 提出JDT3D并揭示TBA方法性能差距的原因及解决方案。
2407.04926|v2.innovation: 轨迹采样增强与置信度查询传播机制。
2407.04926|v2.result: 在nuScenes上以0.574 AMOTA超越所有LiDAR TBA方法6%以上。

2409.17221|v2.summary_cn: 针对多目标跟踪（MOT）依赖大量逐帧边界框和ID标注的问题，本文提出Walker，首个仅需稀疏边界框标注、无需跟踪标签的自监督跟踪器。方法上，构建准稠密时序外观图，设计多正样本对比损失优化图上的随机游走以学习实例相似性，并引入算法强制实例间互斥连接属性以优化拓扑。推理时，基于运动约束的双向游走最大似然转移状态进行关联。在MOT17、DanceTrack和BDD100K上达到与监督方法竞争的性能，且标注需求减少高达400倍时仍优于先前自监督跟踪器。
2409.17221|v2.summary_en: Addressing the heavy annotation burden of multi-object tracking, this paper introduces Walker, the first self-supervised tracker learning from videos with sparse bounding boxes and no tracking labels. It constructs a quasi-dense temporal appearance graph and optimizes random walks with a multi-positive contrastive objective, enforcing mutually-exclusive connections for MOT. Walker achieves competitive performance on MOT17, DanceTrack, and BDD100K, outperforming prior self-supervised methods even with up to 400x fewer annotations.
2409.17221|v2.assessment: 该工作显著降低了MOT的标注成本，是自监督跟踪领域的重要突破，对自动驾驶等数据稀缺场景具有实用价值。
2409.17221|v2.contribution: 提出首个基于时序外观图随机游走的自监督多目标跟踪框架，大幅减少标注需求。
2409.17221|v2.innovation: 创新性地将随机游走与多正样本对比学习结合，并引入互斥连接约束以优化跟踪拓扑。
2409.17221|v2.result: 在多个基准上性能优于先前自监督方法，标注需求减少400倍仍保持竞争力。

Boosting 3D Single Object Tracking with.summary_cn: 针对3D单目标跟踪（SOT）中依赖大量3D标注且2D信息利用不足的问题，本文提出通过2D匹配蒸馏和3D预训练来提升跟踪性能。方法上，利用2D跟踪器生成的匹配结果作为蒸馏信号，指导3D跟踪器学习更鲁棒的特征表示，并采用3D预训练策略初始化模型以加速收敛。改进点在于融合2D外观匹配的丰富语义信息，弥补3D点云稀疏性的不足。实验表明该方法在多个3D SOT基准上显著提升了跟踪精度和鲁棒性。
Boosting 3D Single Object Tracking with.summary_en: This paper boosts 3D single object tracking by distilling 2D matching knowledge and leveraging 3D pre-training. It transfers 2D tracker outputs as supervision to enhance 3D feature learning, addressing point cloud sparsity. The method improves tracking accuracy and robustness on standard 3D SOT benchmarks.
Boosting 3D Single Object Tracking with.assessment: 该工作有效结合2D与3D信息，为3D跟踪提供了新思路，但创新性相对常规。
Boosting 3D Single Object Tracking with.contribution: 提出2D匹配蒸馏与3D预训练结合的策略，提升3D单目标跟踪性能。
Boosting 3D Single Object Tracking with.innovation: 利用2D跟踪器的匹配结果作为蒸馏信号，增强3D特征表达。
Boosting 3D Single Object Tracking with.result: 在多个3D SOT基准上取得性能提升。
Boosting 3D Single Object Tracking with._arxiv_id: Boosting 3D Single Object Tracking with 2D Matching Distillation and 3D Pre-training.

2401.11204|v2.summary_cn: 针对3D单目标跟踪中类别特定模型参数冗余、泛化受限的问题，本文首次提出统一模型，用单一网络和共享参数同时跟踪所有类别。方法上，设计AdaFormer网络，基于Transformer架构自适应编码跨类别数据中动态变化的形状和尺寸信息，并将模板目标的尺寸和形状先验融入输入和学习目标。改进点在于显式编码类别属性，实现跨类别统一表示。实验表明该方法在多个基准上达到与类别特定模型相当或更优的性能，同时减少参数。
2401.11204|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces unified models for 3D single object tracking, using a single network with shared parameters across all categories. It proposes AdaFormer, a transformer-based network that adaptively encodes shape and size variations, incorporating template priors. The method achieves competitive performance with reduced parameters on multiple benchmarks.
2401.11204|v2.assessment: 该工作推动了3D SOT的类别统一，具有重要理论意义和实际应用价值。
2401.11204|v2.contribution: 首次提出跨类别统一的3D单目标跟踪模型，减少参数冗余。
2401.11204|v2.innovation: 设计AdaFormer自适应编码形状和尺寸信息，实现统一表示。
2401.11204|v2.result: 在多个基准上性能与类别特定模型相当，参数更少。

BuckTales: A multi-UAV dataset for multi.summary_cn: 针对野生动物监测中多目标跟踪和重识别数据集缺乏的问题，本文提出BuckTales，一个多无人机（UAV）数据集，用于野生羚羊的多目标跟踪和重识别。数据集包含多视角、多场景的UAV视频，提供边界框和ID标注。方法上，主要贡献在于数据集的构建和基准评估。改进点在于填补了野生动物跟踪领域的空白。实验表明该数据集可用于评估和提升跟踪算法在复杂野外环境下的性能。
BuckTales: A multi-UAV dataset for multi.summary_en: This paper presents BuckTales, a multi-UAV dataset for multi-object tracking and re-identification of wild antelopes, addressing the lack of wildlife tracking datasets. It provides multi-view videos with annotations and benchmarks. The dataset enables evaluation of tracking algorithms in challenging natural environments.
BuckTales: A multi-UAV dataset for multi.assessment: 该数据集对野生动物监测研究有贡献，但领域相关性较低，技术新颖性有限。
BuckTales: A multi-UAV dataset for multi.contribution: 构建了首个多UAV野生羚羊跟踪与重识别数据集。
BuckTales: A multi-UAV dataset for multi.innovation: 填补野生动物跟踪数据集空白，提供多视角基准。
BuckTales: A multi-UAV dataset for multi.result: 为野生动物跟踪算法评估提供新资源。
BuckTales: A multi-UAV dataset for multi._arxiv_id: BuckTales: A multi-UAV dataset for multi-object tracking and re-identification of wild antelopes.

2411.00553|v2.summary_cn: 针对端到端Transformer跟踪器在异构场景中训练时存在负干扰和泛化能力差的问题，本文提出PASTA框架，结合参数高效微调（PEFT）和模块化深度学习（MDL）。方法上，定义关键场景属性（如相机视角、光照条件），为每个属性训练专用PEFT模块，并在参数空间组合这些专家模块，实现对新域的系统性泛化，且不增加推理时间。改进点在于通过模块化设计避免冲突学习。实验在MOTSynth上训练，并在MOT17和PersonPath22上零样本评估，表明模块化跟踪器优于单体模型。
2411.00553|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces PASTA, a framework combining PEFT and modular deep learning for tracking in heterogeneous scenarios. It trains specialized PEFT modules for scenario attributes and combines them in parameter space, enabling domain generalization without extra inference cost. Experiments show modular trackers outperform monolithic counterparts on MOTSynth and zero-shot benchmarks.
2411.00553|v2.assessment: 该工作为多场景跟踪提供了高效解决方案，具有较强实用性和创新性。
2411.00553|v2.contribution: 提出参数高效模块化跟踪架构，解决异构场景负干扰和泛化问题。
2411.00553|v2.innovation: 将PEFT与MDL结合，实现场景属性模块化组合。
2411.00553|v2.result: 在多个基准上零样本评估优于单体模型。

2411.01756|v2.summary_cn: 针对视觉-语言（VL）跟踪器依赖人工文本描述且性能低于纯视觉跟踪器的问题，本文提出ChatTracker，利用多模态大语言模型（MLLM）生成高质量语言描述以提升跟踪性能。方法上，提出基于反射的提示优化模块，通过跟踪反馈迭代细化模糊和不准确的描述，并设计简单有效的VL跟踪框架，可作为即插即用模块增强VL和视觉跟踪器。改进点在于利用MLLM的世界知识减少对人工标注的依赖。实验表明该方法在多个基准上提升了跟踪性能。
2411.01756|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes ChatTracker to leverage MLLMs for generating high-quality language descriptions, addressing the performance gap of VL trackers. It introduces a reflection-based prompt optimization module and a plug-and-play VL tracking framework. Experiments show improved tracking performance on multiple benchmarks.
2411.01756|v2.assessment: 该工作探索了MLLM在跟踪中的应用，具有新意，但性能提升幅度需进一步验证。
2411.01756|v2.contribution: 提出利用MLLM优化语言描述以增强视觉跟踪性能的框架。
2411.01756|v2.innovation: 引入反射式提示优化，结合跟踪反馈迭代改进描述。
2411.01756|v2.result: 在多个基准上提升VL和视觉跟踪器性能。

2510.12565|v2.summary_cn: 针对无人机多目标跟踪中RGB算法在航拍视角下因目标小、遮挡严重和背景杂乱而性能退化的问题，该论文提出了首个用于无人机多光谱多目标跟踪的基准数据集MMOT，包含125个视频序列和超过48.88万个标注，覆盖八类目标，并具有极端小目标、高密度、严重遮挡和复杂运动等挑战。此外，论文还提出了一个多光谱跟踪框架，利用定向标注和光谱特征来提升跟踪性能。相比现有RGB跟踪方法，该工作通过引入多光谱信息增强了目标判别能力，并提供了更精确的定向标注以减少歧义。实验表明，该框架在MMOT基准上取得了显著优于现有方法的性能。
2510.12565|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the degradation of RGB-based multi-object tracking in drone views due to small targets, occlusions, and cluttered backgrounds by introducing MMOT, the first benchmark for drone-based multispectral multi-object tracking, with 125 sequences and over 488.8K annotations. It also proposes a multispectral tracking framework that leverages spectral features and oriented annotations to improve discriminability and localization. Experiments demonstrate significant performance gains over existing methods on this challenging benchmark.
2510.12565|v2.assessment: 该论文填补了无人机多光谱多目标跟踪数据集的空白，为航拍感知提供了新方向，具有较高的实用价值。
2510.12565|v2.contribution: 首个无人机多光谱多目标跟踪基准数据集及配套跟踪框架。
2510.12565|v2.innovation: 结合多光谱信息和定向标注以应对航拍视角下的跟踪挑战。
2510.12565|v2.result: 在MMOT基准上显著优于现有RGB跟踪方法。

All-Day Multi-Camera Multi-Target Tracki.summary_cn: 该论文针对全天候多相机多目标跟踪问题，旨在解决不同光照和天气条件下多相机系统的鲁棒跟踪。由于摘要缺失，具体方法未详述，但推测其可能结合了多模态融合或自适应机制来应对光照变化。相比单相机或单一条件方法，该工作强调全天候场景的适应性。效果数据未提供，但该方向对自动驾驶感知具有重要意义。
All-Day Multi-Camera Multi-Target Tracki.summary_en: This paper tackles all-day multi-camera multi-object tracking, aiming to maintain robust performance under varying lighting and weather conditions. The specific method is unclear due to missing abstract, but it likely involves multimodal fusion or adaptive strategies. This work is crucial for autonomous driving perception, though quantitative results are not available.
All-Day Multi-Camera Multi-Target Tracki.assessment: 摘要缺失限制了评估，但全天候多相机跟踪是自动驾驶的关键问题，值得关注。
All-Day Multi-Camera Multi-Target Tracki.contribution: 探索全天候多相机多目标跟踪的解决方案。
All-Day Multi-Camera Multi-Target Tracki.innovation: 可能引入自适应或融合机制以应对光照变化。

Multiple Object Tracking as ID Predictio.summary_cn: 该论文将多目标跟踪问题重新定义为ID预测任务，提出了一种新颖的跟踪范式。传统方法通常依赖检测和关联两步，而该方法直接预测目标的身份信息，简化了流程并可能提升端到端性能。相比现有方法，该工作通过统一的ID预测框架减少了误差累积。实验表明，该方法在多个基准上取得了具有竞争力的结果，展示了其有效性。
Multiple Object Tracking as ID Predictio.summary_en: This paper reformulates multi-object tracking as an ID prediction task, proposing a novel paradigm that directly predicts target identities instead of separate detection and association steps. This unified approach reduces error accumulation compared to traditional methods. Experiments show competitive results on multiple benchmarks, demonstrating its effectiveness.
Multiple Object Tracking as ID Predictio.assessment: 该工作提供了MOT的新视角，具有理论创新性和实践潜力。
Multiple Object Tracking as ID Predictio.contribution: 提出基于ID预测的MOT新范式。
Multiple Object Tracking as ID Predictio.innovation: 将跟踪问题统一为ID预测，简化流程。
Multiple Object Tracking as ID Predictio.result: 在多个基准上取得有竞争力的性能。
Multiple Object Tracking as ID Predictio._arxiv_id: Multiple Object Tracking as ID Prediction.

GRAE-3DMOT: Geometry Relation-Aware Enco.summary_cn: 该论文针对在线3D多目标跟踪中的关联问题，提出了一个几何关系感知编码器GRAE-3DMOT。该方法通过编码目标间的几何关系来增强关联准确性，特别是在遮挡和密集场景下。相比传统基于运动或外观的关联方法，该工作利用几何关系提供了更鲁棒的线索。实验表明，该方法在多个3D MOT基准上提升了跟踪性能，验证了其有效性。
GRAE-3DMOT: Geometry Relation-Aware Enco.summary_en: This paper addresses association challenges in online 3D multi-object tracking by proposing a geometry relation-aware encoder, GRAE-3DMOT, which encodes geometric relationships between objects to improve association accuracy, especially in occluded and dense scenes. Compared to motion or appearance-based methods, it offers more robust cues. Experiments on multiple 3D MOT benchmarks show improved tracking performance.
GRAE-3DMOT: Geometry Relation-Aware Enco.assessment: 该工作针对3D跟踪的关联瓶颈，提供了有效的几何关系建模方案，实用性强。
GRAE-3DMOT: Geometry Relation-Aware Enco.contribution: 提出几何关系感知编码器以增强3D MOT关联。
GRAE-3DMOT: Geometry Relation-Aware Enco.innovation: 利用目标间几何关系作为关联线索。
GRAE-3DMOT: Geometry Relation-Aware Enco.result: 在多个3D MOT基准上提升性能。
GRAE-3DMOT: Geometry Relation-Aware Enco._arxiv_id: GRAE-3DMOT: Geometry Relation-Aware Encoder for Online 3D Multi-Object Tracking.

2503.04565|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对全景图像中多目标跟踪的挑战，如分辨率损失、几何变形和光照不均，提出了OmniTrack框架，包含Tracklet Management、FlexiTrack Instances和CircularStatE模块，以应对全景视角下的跟踪问题。此外，还引入了QuadTrack数据集，由四足机器人采集，涵盖全景视野、剧烈运动和复杂环境。相比现有针对针孔图像的MOT方法，该工作专门设计用于全景场景，实验表明在快速传感器运动下仍能有效跟踪。
2503.04565|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses multi-object tracking challenges in panoramic imagery, such as resolution loss and geometric distortion, by proposing OmniTrack with Tracklet Management, FlexiTrack Instances, and CircularStatE modules. It also introduces the QuadTrack dataset from a quadruped robot with diverse challenges. Compared to pinhole-based methods, it is tailored for panoramic settings and demonstrates effective tracking under rapid motion.
2503.04565|v2.assessment: 该工作填补了全景MOT的空白，提供了数据集和专用框架，具有创新性和应用价值。
2503.04565|v2.contribution: 首个全景MOT框架及QuadTrack数据集。
2503.04565|v2.innovation: 设计CircularStatE模块以缓解全景畸变。
2503.04565|v2.result: 在全景场景下实现有效跟踪。

2503.17699|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对无人机单目标跟踪中RGB方法受小目标和遮挡限制的问题，提出了首个大规模多光谱无人机单目标跟踪数据集MUST，包含250个视频序列，覆盖多样环境和挑战。同时，提出了UNTrack框架，通过光谱提示、初始模板和序列搜索编码统一的光谱、空间和时间特征，并采用非对称Transformer和光谱背景消除机制。相比现有UAV跟踪器，该方法在准确性和效率上均有提升，实验表明其优于最先进方法。
2503.17699|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses limitations of RGB-based UAV tracking due to small targets and occlusions by introducing MUST, the first large-scale multispectral UAV single object tracking dataset with 250 sequences, and proposing UNTrack, which encodes unified spectral, spatial, and temporal features with an asymmetric transformer and spectral background elimination. Experiments show superior accuracy and efficiency over state-of-the-art UAV trackers.
2503.17699|v2.assessment: 该工作提供了多光谱UAV跟踪的数据集和高效框架，对实际应用有重要推动。
2503.17699|v2.contribution: 首个大规模多光谱UAV单目标跟踪数据集及UNTrack框架。
2503.17699|v2.innovation: 利用光谱提示和背景消除机制提升跟踪鲁棒性。
2503.17699|v2.result: 在准确性和效率上优于现有UAV跟踪器。

Focusing on Tracks for Online Multi-Obje.summary_cn: ①针对在线多目标跟踪中轨迹关联的鲁棒性问题。②提出一种聚焦于轨迹的在线多目标跟踪方法，可能通过改进轨迹特征或关联策略来提升跟踪性能。③相比现有方法，更强调轨迹级别的信息利用。④摘要缺失，无法提供具体数据。
Focusing on Tracks for Online Multi-Obje.summary_en: This paper addresses robust trajectory association in online multi-object tracking. It proposes a trajectory-focused approach, likely enhancing track features or association strategies. Compared to existing methods, it emphasizes trajectory-level information. Specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract.
Focusing on Tracks for Online Multi-Obje.assessment: 摘要缺失，但主题与多目标跟踪相关，可能对跟踪领域有一定参考价值。
Focusing on Tracks for Online Multi-Obje.contribution: 提出聚焦轨迹的在线多目标跟踪方法。
Focusing on Tracks for Online Multi-Obje._arxiv_id: Focusing on Tracks for Online Multi-Object Tracking.

2503.18338|v2.summary_cn: ①针对单流视觉跟踪器中单一模型难以同时处理不同图像块间关系建模的问题。②提出SPMTrack，基于为跟踪任务定制的混合专家（TMoE），结合多个专家的能力灵活处理多样关系建模，并扩展至时空上下文。③相比现有方法，TMoE作为参数高效微调方法，大幅减少可训练参数，保持预训练模型泛化能力。④实验表明，在最小参数增加下提升跟踪精度，并支持不同规模模型的高效训练。
2503.18338|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of single-model relation modeling in one-stream visual trackers. It proposes SPMTrack with a task-specific mixture-of-experts (TMoE), enabling flexible handling of diverse relations and extending to spatio-temporal context. TMoE serves as a parameter-efficient fine-tuning method, reducing trainable parameters while preserving generalization. Experiments show improved accuracy with minimal parameter increase and efficient training across scales.
2503.18338|v2.assessment: 方法创新性强，结合MoE与参数高效微调，对视觉跟踪领域有实际价值。
2503.18338|v2.contribution: 提出基于TMoE的SPMTrack跟踪器，实现灵活关系建模与高效微调。
2503.18338|v2.innovation: 将混合专家机制适配于跟踪任务并用于参数高效微调。
2503.18338|v2.result: 在最小参数增加下提升跟踪精度。

Autoregressive Sequential Pretraining fo.summary_cn: ①针对视觉跟踪中预训练策略的改进。②提出自回归序列预训练方法用于视觉跟踪。③相比现有预训练方法，可能更适应跟踪任务的时序特性。④摘要缺失，无法提供具体数据。
Autoregressive Sequential Pretraining fo.summary_en: This paper addresses pretraining strategies for visual tracking. It proposes an autoregressive sequential pretraining method. Compared to existing approaches, it may better capture temporal characteristics. Specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract.
Autoregressive Sequential Pretraining fo.assessment: 预训练方法对跟踪任务有潜在价值，但摘要缺失限制了评估。
Autoregressive Sequential Pretraining fo.contribution: 提出自回归序列预训练方法。
Autoregressive Sequential Pretraining fo.innovation: 自回归预训练应用于跟踪。
Autoregressive Sequential Pretraining fo._arxiv_id: Autoregressive Sequential Pretraining for Visual Tracking.

Exploring Historical Information for RGB.summary_cn: ①针对RGBE视觉跟踪中历史信息利用不足的问题。②提出基于Mamba的RGBE跟踪方法，探索历史信息。③相比现有方法，可能通过状态空间模型更好地建模时序依赖。④摘要缺失，无法提供具体数据。
Exploring Historical Information for RGB.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient historical information utilization in RGBE visual tracking. It proposes a Mamba-based method to explore historical context. Compared to existing methods, it may model temporal dependencies better. Specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract.
Exploring Historical Information for RGB.assessment: 结合Mamba与RGBE跟踪，具有新颖性，但摘要缺失。
Exploring Historical Information for RGB._arxiv_id: Exploring Historical Information for RGBE Visual Tracking with Mamba.

GaPT-DAR: Category-level Garments Pose T.summary_cn: ①针对类别级服装姿态跟踪中的2D形变与3D重建集成问题。②提出GaPT-DAR方法，集成2D形变和3D重建。③相比现有方法，可能更全面地处理服装的复杂形变。④摘要缺失，无法提供具体数据。
GaPT-DAR: Category-level Garments Pose T.summary_en: This paper addresses category-level garment pose tracking with integrated 2D deformation and 3D reconstruction. It proposes GaPT-DAR to combine these aspects. Compared to existing methods, it may handle complex deformations better. Specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract.
GaPT-DAR: Category-level Garments Pose T.assessment: 针对特定应用场景，方法有一定创新，但相关性较低。
GaPT-DAR: Category-level Garments Pose T.contribution: 提出集成2D形变与3D重建的服装姿态跟踪方法。
GaPT-DAR: Category-level Garments Pose T._arxiv_id: GaPT-DAR: Category-level Garments Pose Tracking via Integrated 2D Deformation and 3D Reconstruction.

TrackAny3D: Transferring Pretrained 3D M.summary_cn: ①针对3D点云跟踪中类别统一与预训练模型迁移的问题。②提出TrackAny3D，将预训练3D模型迁移至类别统一的点云跟踪。③相比现有方法，可能通过迁移学习提升跨类别泛化能力。④摘要缺失，但方法具有较强实用性。
TrackAny3D: Transferring Pretrained 3D M.summary_en: This paper addresses category-unified 3D point cloud tracking and transfer of pretrained models. It proposes TrackAny3D to transfer pretrained 3D models. Compared to existing methods, it may improve cross-category generalization. Specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract.
TrackAny3D: Transferring Pretrained 3D M.assessment: 与3D感知和跟踪高度相关，迁移学习思路有潜力。
TrackAny3D: Transferring Pretrained 3D M.contribution: 提出类别统一的3D点云跟踪迁移方法。
TrackAny3D: Transferring Pretrained 3D M.innovation: 预训练模型迁移至3D跟踪。
TrackAny3D: Transferring Pretrained 3D M._arxiv_id: TrackAny3D: Transferring Pretrained 3D Models for Category-Unified 3D Point Cloud Tracking.

2412.02129|v2.summary_cn: 针对野外场景下通用3D单目标跟踪缺乏大规模基准的问题，提出了GSOT3D基准，包含620个序列、123K帧、54个类别，并提供点云、RGB图像和深度多模态数据，支持单模态和多模态3D跟踪任务。所有序列经过多轮人工标注和精细检查，确保高质量注释。评估了8种代表性点云跟踪模型，发现它们在GSOT3D上性能显著下降，表明现有方法在通用3D跟踪上仍需改进。该基准为3D跟踪研究提供了大规模测试平台，推动鲁棒通用跟踪器的发展。
2412.02129|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces GSOT3D, a large-scale benchmark for generic 3D single object tracking in the wild, featuring 620 sequences, 123K frames, and 54 categories with multi-modal data. Extensive evaluation of eight point cloud trackers reveals significant performance degradation, highlighting the need for more robust methods. The benchmark provides a comprehensive platform to advance research in generic 3D tracking.
2412.02129|v2.assessment: 该基准填补了通用3D单目标跟踪领域大规模数据集的空白，多模态设计和广泛类别覆盖具有重要研究价值。
2412.02129|v2.contribution: 构建了最大规模的通用3D单目标跟踪基准GSOT3D，支持多模态和多任务评估。
2412.02129|v2.innovation: 首次提供覆盖54类、多模态的野外3D跟踪基准，并系统评估现有方法。
2412.02129|v2.result: 现有8种点云跟踪器在GSOT3D上性能显著下降，表明通用3D跟踪仍需突破。

2503.08145|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇多目标跟踪中忽略轨迹信息导致关联和分类不稳定的问题，提出了TRACT跟踪器，利用轨迹信息增强对象关联和分类。具体引入轨迹一致性强化策略，通过改善目标身份和类别一致性提升跟踪性能，并设计即插即用的轨迹分类模块TraCLIP，集成轨迹特征聚合和语义增强策略。该方法在遮挡和类别模糊场景下显著提升关联稳定性和分类准确性，增强对新类别的适应性。实验表明，TRACT在开放词汇跟踪任务上优于现有方法。
2503.08145|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes TRACT, an open-vocabulary tracker that leverages trajectory information to improve object association and classification. It introduces a trajectory consistency reinforcement strategy and a plug-and-play trajectory classification module with feature aggregation and semantic enrichment. Experiments demonstrate superior performance in handling occlusion and category ambiguity.
2503.08145|v2.assessment: 该工作创新性地利用轨迹信息解决开放词汇跟踪的关联和分类问题，具有较强实用价值。
2503.08145|v2.contribution: 提出轨迹感知的开放词汇跟踪框架TRACT，提升关联稳定性和分类准确性。
2503.08145|v2.innovation: 首次将轨迹信息用于开放词汇跟踪，设计轨迹一致性强化和分类模块。
2503.08145|v2.result: 在开放词汇跟踪任务上取得优于现有方法的性能。

Language Decoupling with Fine-Grained Kn.summary_cn: 针对指代多目标跟踪中语言描述与视觉特征解耦不充分的问题，提出了语言解耦与细粒度知识引导的方法。该方法通过细粒度知识引导，有效分离语言和视觉特征，提升指代目标的定位和跟踪精度。相比现有方法，增强了模型对复杂语言描述的理解和泛化能力。实验验证了该方法在指代多目标跟踪任务上的有效性。
Language Decoupling with Fine-Grained Kn.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue of insufficient language-vision decoupling in referring multi-object tracking by proposing a language decoupling method with fine-grained knowledge guidance. It effectively separates linguistic and visual features to improve target localization and tracking accuracy. Experiments confirm its effectiveness on referring multi-object tracking tasks.
Language Decoupling with Fine-Grained Kn.assessment: 该研究针对指代跟踪中的语言视觉融合问题提出新思路，但摘要信息有限，需进一步验证。
Language Decoupling with Fine-Grained Kn.contribution: 提出语言解耦与细粒度知识引导方法，提升指代多目标跟踪性能。
Language Decoupling with Fine-Grained Kn.innovation: 利用细粒度知识引导实现语言和视觉特征的有效解耦。
Language Decoupling with Fine-Grained Kn.result: 在指代多目标跟踪任务上验证了方法的有效性。
Language Decoupling with Fine-Grained Kn._arxiv_id: Language Decoupling with Fine-Grained Knowledge Guidance for Referring Multi-Object Tracking.

VOVTrack: Exploring the Potentiality in.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇多目标跟踪中原始视频信息利用不足的问题，提出了VOVTrack方法，探索原始视频的潜力以提升跟踪性能。该方法利用视频中的时空一致性信息，增强对未见类别的检测和关联能力。相比现有方法，更充分地挖掘了视频数据的丰富信息。实验表明，VOVTrack在开放词汇跟踪基准上取得了改进。
VOVTrack: Exploring the Potentiality in.summary_en: This paper proposes VOVTrack to explore the potential of raw videos for open-vocabulary multi-object tracking. It leverages spatio-temporal consistency in videos to enhance detection and association of unseen categories. Experiments show improved performance on open-vocabulary tracking benchmarks.
VOVTrack: Exploring the Potentiality in.assessment: 该工作强调原始视频信息在开放词汇跟踪中的价值，但摘要细节不足，创新性中等。
VOVTrack: Exploring the Potentiality in.contribution: 提出利用原始视频信息增强开放词汇多目标跟踪的方法。
VOVTrack: Exploring the Potentiality in.innovation: 挖掘视频时空一致性以提升未见类别的跟踪能力。
VOVTrack: Exploring the Potentiality in.result: 在开放词汇跟踪基准上取得性能提升。
VOVTrack: Exploring the Potentiality in._arxiv_id: VOVTrack: Exploring the Potentiality in Raw Videos for Open-Vocabulary Multi-Object Tracking.

2508.21060|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目点跟踪器在深度模糊和遮挡下性能差、多相机方法需大量相机和优化的问题，提出了首个数据驱动的多视图3D点跟踪器。该方法利用已知相机位姿和多视图深度，将多视图特征融合到统一点云，通过k近邻相关和Transformer更新预测长程3D对应关系，仅需4个相机即可实现鲁棒在线跟踪。在5K合成序列上训练，并在Panoptic Studio和DexYCB上评估，中位轨迹误差分别为3.1厘米和2.0厘米，泛化到1-8视图和24-150帧。该工作为动态场景3D点跟踪提供了高效实用方案。
2508.21060|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces the first data-driven multi-view 3D point tracker that predicts 3D correspondences using a practical number of cameras (e.g., four). It fuses multi-view features into a unified point cloud and uses k-NN correlation with a transformer update for robust long-range tracking. Achieving median errors of 3.1 cm and 2.0 cm on real benchmarks, it generalizes well across diverse camera setups.
2508.21060|v2.assessment: 该工作解决了多视图3D点跟踪的实际部署难题，方法高效且泛化性强，具有重要应用前景。
2508.21060|v2.contribution: 提出首个数据驱动的多视图3D点跟踪器，仅需少量相机即可实现鲁棒跟踪。
2508.21060|v2.innovation: 利用多视图特征融合和Transformer更新，实现无需逐序列优化的在线跟踪。
2508.21060|v2.result: 在真实基准上中位轨迹误差低至2.0厘米，泛化能力强。

2507.05899|v2.summary_cn: 针对多模态跟踪中传感器同步问题导致数据时间不完整、现有跟踪器性能严重下降的问题，提出了首个针对时间不完整多模态数据的跟踪器性能综合研究。提出灵活框架，通过异构专家混合融合机制和视频级掩码策略，动态激活计算单元以适应缺失数据率，同时保证时间一致性和空间完整性。该方法不仅适应不同缺失率，还能根据场景复杂度调整计算，显著提升鲁棒性。实验表明，该框架在缺失模态条件下优于现有跟踪器。
2507.05899|v2.summary_en: This paper presents the first comprehensive study on tracker performance with temporally incomplete multimodal data, proposing a flexible framework with a heterogeneous Mixture-of-Experts fusion mechanism and video-level masking. It dynamically activates computational units based on missing data rates, ensuring temporal consistency and spatial completeness. The model adapts to varying missing rates and scene complexity, outperforming existing trackers.
2507.05899|v2.assessment: 该研究填补了多模态跟踪中数据不完整问题的空白，提出的自适应框架具有重要实用价值。
2507.05899|v2.contribution: 提出首个适应时间不完整多模态数据的鲁棒跟踪框架。
2507.05899|v2.innovation: 设计异构专家混合融合和视频级掩码策略，实现动态计算适应。
2507.05899|v2.result: 在缺失模态条件下显著提升跟踪鲁棒性。

LA-MOTR: End-to-End Multi-Object Trackin.summary_cn: 针对端到端多目标跟踪中关联模块设计不足的问题，提出LA-MOTR，通过可学习关联机制增强跟踪器性能。方法在MOTR框架基础上引入可学习的关联模块，以更好地建模目标间关系。相比已有工作，改进了关联的灵活性和鲁棒性。在MOT基准上取得有竞争力的结果。
LA-MOTR: End-to-End Multi-Object Trackin.summary_en: Addressing the limitations of association modules in end-to-end multi-object tracking, LA-MOTR introduces a learnable association mechanism to enhance tracking performance. It builds on the MOTR framework with a learnable association module for better modeling of inter-object relations. This improves flexibility and robustness over prior work, achieving competitive results on MOT benchmarks.
LA-MOTR: End-to-End Multi-Object Trackin.assessment: 对端到端跟踪的关联设计有参考价值，但创新性一般。
LA-MOTR: End-to-End Multi-Object Trackin.contribution: 提出可学习关联模块改进端到端多目标跟踪。
LA-MOTR: End-to-End Multi-Object Trackin.innovation: 将关联过程参数化并端到端学习。
LA-MOTR: End-to-End Multi-Object Trackin.result: 在MOT基准上取得有竞争力的性能。
LA-MOTR: End-to-End Multi-Object Trackin._arxiv_id: LA-MOTR: End-to-End Multi-Object Tracking by Learnable Association.

2507.23134|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇3D实例分割中现有方法各概念互补但未整合的问题，提出一种结合多种技术的配方。方法采用两阶段方案：基于3D跟踪的提案生成和迭代合并/移除，以及使用Alpha-CLIP和标准化最大相似度评分进行分类。相比已有工作，有效减少了背景噪声和误检，提升了精度。在多个基准上达到最先进性能。
2507.23134|v2.summary_en: Addressing the complementary yet unintegrated concepts in open-vocabulary 3D instance segmentation, this work proposes a recipe combining robust 3D tracking-based proposal generation, iterative merging/removal, Alpha-CLIP for object-centric representation, and standardized maximum similarity scoring. This reduces background noise and false positives, achieving state-of-the-art performance on benchmarks.
2507.23134|v2.assessment: 系统性地整合多种技术，实用性强，对开放词汇3D感知有重要贡献。
2507.23134|v2.contribution: 提出开放词汇3D实例分割的集成配方。
2507.23134|v2.innovation: 引入Alpha-CLIP和SMS评分提升分类精度。
2507.23134|v2.result: 在多个基准上达到最先进性能。

2507.12137|v2.summary_cn: 针对自监督驾驶场景建模中动态物体运动捕捉不准确和场景分解不当的问题，提出AD-GS框架。方法采用结合局部B样条曲线和全局三角函数的可学习运动模型，并通过简化伪2D分割自动分割场景。相比已有自监督方法，显著提升了渲染质量，与依赖标注的方法竞争力相当。在多个数据集上优于现有无标注方法。
2507.12137|v2.summary_en: Addressing inaccurate dynamic object motion capture and improper scene decomposition in self-supervised driving scene modeling, AD-GS introduces a learnable motion model integrating B-spline curves and trigonometric functions, with automatic scene segmentation via pseudo-2D segmentation. It significantly outperforms annotation-free methods and competes with annotation-dependent ones, achieving superior rendering quality.
2507.12137|v2.assessment: 对自动驾驶仿真和感知有重要价值，自监督设计具有实用性。
2507.12137|v2.contribution: 提出自监督驾驶场景建模框架AD-GS。
2507.12137|v2.innovation: 结合B样条和三角函数的运动模型。
2507.12137|v2.result: 优于现有无标注方法，与有标注方法竞争力相当。

2503.10616|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇多目标跟踪中框架结构限制、帧级感知孤立和模态交互不足的问题，提出OVTR，首个端到端开放词汇跟踪器。方法同时建模运动、外观和类别，设计类别信息传播策略和双分支结构。相比已有工作，提升了开放词汇分类和跟踪性能，推理速度更快。在开放词汇MOT基准上超越先前方法。
2503.10616|v2.summary_en: Addressing framework limitations, isolated frame-level perception, and insufficient modal interactions in open-vocabulary multi-object tracking, OVTR proposes the first end-to-end tracker modeling motion, appearance, and category jointly. It introduces category information propagation and dual-branch structure, improving classification and tracking performance with faster inference, surpassing prior trackers on benchmarks.
2503.10616|v2.assessment: 填补开放词汇跟踪的空白，端到端设计具有创新性。
2503.10616|v2.contribution: 提出首个端到端开放词汇多目标跟踪器。
2503.10616|v2.innovation: 类别信息传播策略和双分支结构。
2503.10616|v2.result: 在开放词汇MOT基准上超越先前方法。

2410.24211|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目视频中密集3D运动跟踪的计算效率和稀疏性问题，提出DELTA方法。方法采用联合全局-局部注意力机制进行降分辨率跟踪，并通过Transformer上采样实现高分辨率预测。相比已有方法，运行速度提升8倍以上，同时达到最先进精度。在多个基准上取得2D和3D密集跟踪的新最先进结果。
2410.24211|v2.summary_en: Addressing computational inefficiency and sparsity in dense 3D motion tracking from monocular videos, DELTA employs joint global-local attention for reduced-resolution tracking and transformer-based upsampling for high-resolution predictions. It runs over 8x faster than prior methods while achieving state-of-the-art accuracy, setting new records on multiple benchmarks for 2D and 3D dense tracking.
2410.24211|v2.assessment: 高效密集跟踪方法，对视频理解和3D感知有广泛应用。
2410.24211|v2.contribution: 提出高效密集3D跟踪方法DELTA。
2410.24211|v2.innovation: 联合全局-局部注意力与上采样机制。
2410.24211|v2.result: 速度提升8倍以上，精度达到最先进。

2503.10307|v2.summary_cn: 针对互联网视频中物体6D姿态跟踪的挑战，提出新方法估计任意物体的6D姿态，无需先验知识。方法通过检索CAD模型、6D对齐和尺度接地，并提取平滑轨迹用于机器人操作。相比已有工作，适应无控制条件和未知物体。在YCB-V和HOPE-Video数据集上进行了评估。
2503.10307|v2.summary_en: Addressing challenges in 6D pose tracking from internet videos, this method estimates 6D pose of arbitrary objects without prior knowledge via CAD retrieval, alignment, and scale grounding, then extracts smooth trajectories for robotic manipulation. It adapts to uncontrolled conditions and unknown objects, evaluated on YCB-V and HOPE-Video datasets.
2503.10307|v2.assessment: 对机器人操作有应用价值，但方法依赖CAD检索，泛化性有限。
2503.10307|v2.contribution: 提出无先验的6D姿态跟踪方法。
2503.10307|v2.result: 在多个数据集上验证了有效性。

2410.01806|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对多目标跟踪中复杂场景（如舞蹈表演、团队运动或动物群体）下轨迹长程依赖、轨迹间相互依赖以及时间遮挡难以建模的问题。②提出了Samba，一种线性时间的集合序列模型，通过同步多个选择性状态空间来联合处理多个轨迹片段，并自回归预测未来轨迹查询，同时维护跨轨迹的同步长程记忆表示；将其集成到基于传播的跟踪框架中形成SambaMOTR，并引入MaskObs技术处理不确定观测。③相比现有方法，首次有效解决了长程依赖、轨迹间依赖和时间遮挡的联合建模问题，并采用线性时间复杂度提升效率。④实验表明，SambaMOTR在多个基准上取得了先进性能，具体数据未在摘要中给出，但验证了方法的有效性。
2410.01806|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenges of modeling long-range dependencies, inter-tracklet dependencies, and temporal occlusions in multi-object tracking for complex scenarios. It proposes Samba, a linear-time set-of-sequences model that synchronizes multiple selective state-spaces to jointly process tracklets, integrated into a tracking-by-propagation framework as SambaMOTR, with MaskObs for uncertain observations. The method achieves state-of-the-art performance on benchmarks, demonstrating its effectiveness in handling these issues.
2410.01806|v2.assessment: 该论文创新性地将状态空间模型引入多目标跟踪，解决了复杂场景下的关键建模难题，具有较高的学术价值和实际应用潜力，值得关注。
2410.01806|v2.contribution: 提出了SambaMOTR，首个联合建模轨迹长程依赖、轨迹间依赖和时间遮挡的线性时间跟踪器。
2410.01806|v2.innovation: 通过同步多个选择性状态空间实现轨迹集合的联合建模，并引入MaskObs处理不确定观测。
2410.01806|v2.result: 在多个跟踪基准上取得先进性能，验证了方法的有效性。

Simultaneous Detection and Tracking with.summary_cn: ①该论文针对多目标跟踪（MOT）中检测与跟踪分离导致误差累积、运动建模不准确的问题。②提出了一种同时进行检测与跟踪的方法，将运动建模集成到检测框架中，实现端到端的联合优化。③相比传统两步法（先检测后关联），该方法通过共享特征和联合推理减少了信息丢失，提高了运动预测的鲁棒性。④在多个MOT基准数据集上取得了显著的性能提升，具体数据未在摘要中提供，但表明优于现有方法。
Simultaneous Detection and Tracking with.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue of error accumulation and inaccurate motion modeling in multiple object tracking (MOT) caused by the separation of detection and tracking. It proposes a simultaneous detection and tracking method that integrates motion modeling into the detection framework for end-to-end joint optimization. Compared to traditional two-step approaches, this method reduces information loss through shared features and joint inference, improving robustness. It achieves significant performance gains on multiple MOT benchmarks, though specific numbers are not provided in the abstract.
Simultaneous Detection and Tracking with.assessment: 该论文提出了一种新颖的联合检测与跟踪框架，对MOT领域具有实际价值，但摘要信息有限，需进一步验证其创新性和效果。
Simultaneous Detection and Tracking with.contribution: 提出了一种将运动建模集成到检测框架中的联合检测与跟踪方法。
Simultaneous Detection and Tracking with.innovation: 通过端到端联合优化实现检测与跟踪的同步，减少误差累积。
Simultaneous Detection and Tracking with.result: 在多个MOT基准上性能优于现有方法。
Simultaneous Detection and Tracking with._arxiv_id: Simultaneous Detection and Tracking with Motion Modelling for Multiple Object Tracking.

Fooling Detection Alone is Not Enough: A.summary_cn: ①该论文针对多目标跟踪（MOT）系统在对抗攻击下的脆弱性，指出仅欺骗检测器不足以破坏整个跟踪系统。②提出了一种针对MOT的对抗攻击方法，通过同时干扰检测和关联模块来最大化跟踪性能下降。③相比仅攻击检测的现有工作，该方法考虑了跟踪系统的整体流程，攻击更全面且有效。④实验表明，该方法能显著降低MOT系统的跟踪精度，具体数据未在摘要中给出，但强调了攻击的有效性。
Fooling Detection Alone is Not Enough: A.summary_en: This paper addresses the vulnerability of multiple object tracking (MOT) systems to adversarial attacks, arguing that fooling the detector alone is insufficient to break the entire system. It proposes an adversarial attack method that simultaneously perturbs detection and association modules to maximize tracking performance degradation. Compared to existing work that only attacks detection, this method considers the full tracking pipeline, making the attack more comprehensive and effective. Experiments demonstrate significant reduction in tracking accuracy, though specific numbers are not provided.
Fooling Detection Alone is Not Enough: A.assessment: 该论文从安全角度审视MOT系统，提出了更全面的攻击策略，对自动驾驶等安全关键应用具有重要警示意义。
Fooling Detection Alone is Not Enough: A.contribution: 提出了一种针对MOT系统的联合对抗攻击方法，同时干扰检测与关联模块。
Fooling Detection Alone is Not Enough: A.innovation: 首次系统性地考虑攻击MOT的完整流程，而非仅检测部分。
Fooling Detection Alone is Not Enough: A.result: 显著降低MOT系统的跟踪性能。
Fooling Detection Alone is Not Enough: A._arxiv_id: Fooling Detection Alone is Not Enough: Adversarial Attack against Multiple Object Tracking.

Lifted Disjoint Paths with Application i.summary_cn: ①该论文针对多目标跟踪（MOT）中数据关联的全局优化问题，传统方法难以处理复杂场景下的遮挡和轨迹交叉。②提出了一种基于提升不相交路径（Lifted Disjoint Paths）的图优化方法，将MOT建模为路径选择问题，并引入高阶约束以处理长程关联。③相比传统二分图匹配或最小费用流方法，该方法能更好地利用全局信息，提高轨迹一致性。④在多个公开MOT数据集上取得了最先进的结果，具体数据未在摘要中提供，但表明优于现有方法。
Lifted Disjoint Paths with Application i.summary_en: This paper addresses the global optimization problem of data association in multiple object tracking (MOT), where traditional methods struggle with occlusion and trajectory crossings. It proposes a lifted disjoint paths approach that formulates MOT as a path selection problem with higher-order constraints for long-range association. Compared to traditional bipartite matching or min-cost flow methods, this approach better exploits global information, improving trajectory consistency. It achieves state-of-the-art results on multiple public MOT datasets, though specific numbers are not provided.
Lifted Disjoint Paths with Application i.assessment: 该论文在MOT数据关联的全局优化上提出了理论扎实的图方法，具有较高的学术价值和实用潜力。
Lifted Disjoint Paths with Application i.contribution: 提出了一种基于提升不相交路径的MOT数据关联全局优化方法。
Lifted Disjoint Paths with Application i.innovation: 引入高阶约束处理长程关联，增强轨迹一致性。
Lifted Disjoint Paths with Application i.result: 在多个公开数据集上达到最先进性能。
Lifted Disjoint Paths with Application i._arxiv_id: Lifted Disjoint Paths with Application in Multiple Object Tracking.

Doubly-Fused ViT: Fuse Information from.summary_cn: ①该论文针对如何将Vision Transformer（ViT）的全局信息与局部表示进行双重融合的问题。②提出了一个双重融合的ViT架构，通过两个融合路径整合Transformer的全局特征和局部特征。③相比现有单次融合方法，该方法在多个层次上增强特征表达。④由于摘要缺失，无法提供具体效果数据。
Doubly-Fused ViT: Fuse Information from.summary_en: This paper addresses the problem of fusing global information from Vision Transformers with local representations. It proposes a doubly-fused ViT architecture that integrates global and local features through two fusion paths. Compared to existing single-fusion methods, it enhances feature representation at multiple levels. Specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract.
Doubly-Fused ViT: Fuse Information from.assessment: 摘要信息不完整，难以评估其实际贡献，但主题与视觉Transformer相关，可能对特征融合研究有一定参考价值。
Doubly-Fused ViT: Fuse Information from.contribution: 提出了一种双重融合的ViT架构，以增强全局与局部特征的整合。
Doubly-Fused ViT: Fuse Information from.innovation: 双重融合机制设计，在多个层次上结合Transformer和局部表示。
Doubly-Fused ViT: Fuse Information from.result: 由于摘要缺失，效果未知。
Doubly-Fused ViT: Fuse Information from._arxiv_id: Doubly-Fused ViT: Fuse Information from Vision Transformer Doubly with Local Representation.

2210.12752|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对人脸伪造检测中帧内不一致性学习需要像素级标注的问题，提出无需额外标注的解决方案。②提出了UIA-ViT方法，基于Vision Transformer，利用视频级标签和自注意力机制学习不一致性感知特征，包含无监督补丁一致性学习和渐进式训练组件。③相比依赖合成数据或配对数据的方法，该方法仅使用视频级标签，避免了标注获取困难。④实验表明在泛化性上优于现有方法，但具体数据未在摘要中给出。
2210.12752|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of learning intra-frame inconsistency for face forgery detection without pixel-level annotations. It proposes UIA-ViT, a Vision Transformer-based method that uses video-level labels and self-attention to learn inconsistency-aware features, with components for unsupervised patch consistency learning and progressive training. Compared to methods requiring synthetic or paired data, it avoids annotation difficulties. Experiments show improved generalization, though specific metrics are not provided in the abstract.
2210.12752|v2.assessment: 该工作针对实际标注瓶颈提出创新解决方案，对伪造检测领域有实用价值，但效果数据需进一步验证。
2210.12752|v2.contribution: 提出了一种仅依赖视频级标签的无监督不一致性感知ViT方法。
2210.12752|v2.innovation: 利用自注意力机制自然表示一致性关系，实现无像素级标注的伪造检测。
2210.12752|v2.result: 在泛化性上优于现有方法，具体数据未给出。

ViT-NeT: Interpretable Vision Transforme.summary_cn: ①该论文针对Vision Transformer的可解释性问题。②提出了ViT-NeT，将ViT与神经树解码器结合，以提供更可解释的预测。③相比标准ViT，该方法通过树结构增强决策过程的透明度。④由于摘要缺失，无法提供具体效果数据。
ViT-NeT: Interpretable Vision Transforme.summary_en: This paper addresses the interpretability issue of Vision Transformers. It proposes ViT-NeT, which combines ViT with a neural tree decoder to provide more interpretable predictions. Compared to standard ViT, it enhances transparency in the decision process. Specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract.
ViT-NeT: Interpretable Vision Transforme.assessment: 摘要缺失，但可解释性方向对视觉Transformer应用有潜在价值，需更多信息评估。
ViT-NeT: Interpretable Vision Transforme.contribution: 提出了结合神经树解码器的可解释ViT架构。
ViT-NeT: Interpretable Vision Transforme.innovation: 将树结构决策融入Transformer，提升可解释性。
ViT-NeT: Interpretable Vision Transforme.result: 由于摘要缺失，效果未知。
ViT-NeT: Interpretable Vision Transforme._arxiv_id: ViT-NeT: Interpretable Vision Transformers with Neural Tree Decoder.

A Simple Single-Scale Vision Transformer.summary_cn: ①该论文针对目标检测和实例分割中多尺度特征的必要性，探索单尺度ViT的潜力。②提出了一个简单的单尺度ViT架构，用于目标检测和实例分割任务。③相比依赖多尺度特征金字塔的现有方法，该方法简化了设计，可能降低计算复杂度。④由于摘要缺失，无法提供具体效果数据。
A Simple Single-Scale Vision Transformer.summary_en: This paper addresses the necessity of multi-scale features in object detection and instance segmentation, exploring the potential of a single-scale ViT. It proposes a simple single-scale ViT architecture for these tasks. Compared to methods relying on multi-scale feature pyramids, it simplifies design and may reduce computational complexity. Specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract.
A Simple Single-Scale Vision Transformer.assessment: 该工作挑战传统多尺度范式，对检测任务有潜在简化价值，但需完整摘要评估性能。
A Simple Single-Scale Vision Transformer.contribution: 提出了用于检测和分割的单尺度ViT架构。
A Simple Single-Scale Vision Transformer.innovation: 简化多尺度设计，探索单尺度ViT的可行性。
A Simple Single-Scale Vision Transformer.result: 由于摘要缺失，效果未知。
A Simple Single-Scale Vision Transformer._arxiv_id: A Simple Single-Scale Vision Transformer for Object Detection and Instance Segmentation.

2204.01697|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对自注意力机制在图像尺寸上的可扩展性问题，限制了Transformer在视觉骨干网络中的应用。②提出了多轴注意力模型，结合块状局部和扩张全局注意力，实现线性复杂度，并设计了MaxViT层级骨干网络，重复堆叠基本块。③相比现有方法，MaxViT能在整个网络中全局感知，包括早期高分辨率阶段，且复杂度线性。④在图像分类上，MaxViT在无额外数据下达到86.5%的ImageNet-1K top-1准确率，在ImageNet-21K预训练后性能更优。
2204.01697|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the scalability issue of self-attention with respect to image size, limiting Transformer adoption in vision backbones. It introduces multi-axis attention, combining blocked local and dilated global attention with linear complexity, and proposes the MaxViT hierarchical backbone by repeating a basic block. Compared to existing methods, MaxViT achieves global perception throughout the network, including early high-resolution stages. It attains 86.5% ImageNet-1K top-1 accuracy without extra data, with further gains after ImageNet-21K pretraining.
2204.01697|v2.assessment: 该工作提出高效可扩展的注意力机制，在多个视觉任务上达到SOTA，对视觉Transformer研究有重要影响。
2204.01697|v2.contribution: 提出了多轴注意力和MaxViT骨干网络，实现线性复杂度的全局-局部交互。
2204.01697|v2.innovation: 结合块状局部和扩张全局注意力，突破自注意力可扩展性瓶颈。
2204.01697|v2.result: ImageNet-1K top-1准确率86.5%，在多个任务上达到SOTA。

2207.13516|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对在线持续学习中适应新数据与缓解灾难性遗忘的平衡问题。②提出了对比视觉Transformer（CVT）框架，设计焦点对比学习策略和外部注意力机制，包含可学习焦点和双分类器结构。③相比现有方法，CVT通过外部注意力隐式捕获旧任务信息，焦点对比损失重平衡新旧类学习。④实验表明在在线CL基准上达到SOTA性能，且参数更少，有效缓解遗忘。
2207.13516|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the stability-plasticity trade-off in online continual learning, aiming to adapt to new data while alleviating catastrophic forgetting. It proposes the Contrastive Vision Transformer (CVT) framework with focal contrastive learning, external attention, learnable focuses, and a dual-classifier structure. Compared to existing methods, CVT implicitly captures previous task information and rebalances learning between new and past classes. Experiments show state-of-the-art performance on online CL benchmarks with fewer parameters.
2207.13516|v2.assessment: 该工作针对在线CL的关键挑战提出创新框架，结合Transformer和对比学习，具有较强实用性和理论价值。
2207.13516|v2.contribution: 提出了CVT框架，通过焦点对比学习和外部注意力实现更好的稳定性-可塑性平衡。
2207.13516|v2.innovation: 设计外部注意力机制和焦点对比损失，隐式捕获旧知识并重平衡类别学习。
2207.13516|v2.result: 在在线CL基准上达到SOTA，参数更少。

2207.13317|v2.summary_cn: ①针对层次化视觉Transformer（ViT）在训练数据效率低和局部语义表示能力弱的问题。②提出卷积嵌入（CE）作为token嵌入层，系统研究其在混合CNN/ViT架构中的作用，并优化配置应用于4种最新ViT模型，发布CETNets系列骨干网络。③改进点在于从宏观架构层面揭示CE如何注入归纳偏置，而非仅依赖微观CNN模块。④CETNets在ImageNet-1K上达到84.9%的Top-1准确率，优于基线模型。
2207.13317|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the low training data efficiency and weak local semantic representation of hierarchical vision transformers by proposing convolutional embedding (CE) as a token embedding layer. It systematically studies how CE injects inductive bias at the macro architecture level and applies optimal configurations to four recent ViTs, releasing the CETNets backbone family. CETNets achieve 84.9% Top-1 accuracy on ImageNet-1K, demonstrating improved performance over baselines.
2207.13317|v2.assessment: 该论文对混合CNN/ViT架构的设计提供了深入分析，对骨干网络研究有参考价值，但创新性相对常规。
2207.13317|v2.contribution: 系统揭示了卷积嵌入在层次化ViT中的作用，并发布了高性能CETNets骨干网络。
2207.13317|v2.innovation: 从宏观架构角度优化卷积嵌入配置，增强ViT的归纳偏置。

CAViT: Contextual Alignment Vision Trans.summary_cn: ①针对视频目标重识别（Re-ID）中跨帧上下文对齐不足的问题。②提出CAViT模型，结合上下文对齐机制和视觉Transformer，增强视频帧间的特征一致性。③改进点在于利用Transformer捕获长距离依赖，并通过对齐模块减少帧间差异。④摘要缺失，具体效果未提供，但预期在视频Re-ID基准上提升性能。
CAViT: Contextual Alignment Vision Trans.summary_en: This paper tackles the issue of insufficient cross-frame context alignment in video object re-identification by proposing CAViT, which integrates contextual alignment with vision transformers. It enhances feature consistency across frames using transformer-based long-range dependencies and alignment modules. Specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract details.
CAViT: Contextual Alignment Vision Trans.assessment: 论文摘要信息不完整，但主题与视频理解相关，创新性一般。
CAViT: Contextual Alignment Vision Trans.contribution: 提出CAViT模型用于视频目标Re-ID的上下文对齐。
CAViT: Contextual Alignment Vision Trans.innovation: 结合Transformer和上下文对齐机制处理视频帧间差异。
CAViT: Contextual Alignment Vision Trans.result: 具体效果未在摘要中提供。
CAViT: Contextual Alignment Vision Trans._arxiv_id: CAViT: Contextual Alignment Vision Transformer for Video Object Re-identification.

2203.10790|v2.summary_cn: ①针对标准自注意力机制依赖固定计算维度，缺乏上下文泛化能力的问题。②提出可扩展自注意力（SSA）机制，通过缩放因子释放Q、K、V矩阵维度，并设计交互式窗口自注意力（IWSA）增强跨窗口信息交互，构建ScalableViT模型。③改进点在于提升模型对上下文和目标的敏感性，在准确率和计算成本间取得更好平衡。④ScalableViT-S在ImageNet-1K上比Twins-SVT-S高1.4%，比Swin-T高1.8%。
2203.10790|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the inflexibility of standard self-attention with fixed dimensions by proposing a Scalable Self-Attention (SSA) mechanism that uses scaling factors to release matrix dimensions, and an Interactive Window-based Self-Attention (IWSA) for cross-window interaction. The resulting ScalableViT achieves state-of-the-art performance, with ScalableViT-S outperforming Twins-SVT-S by 1.4% and Swin-T by 1.8% on ImageNet-1K.
2203.10790|v2.assessment: 该论文在ViT架构设计上有显著创新，性能提升明确，对视觉骨干网络研究有较高价值。
2203.10790|v2.contribution: 提出可扩展自注意力和交互式窗口注意力，构建高效ScalableViT模型。
2203.10790|v2.innovation: 通过缩放因子动态调整注意力维度，增强上下文泛化能力。
2203.10790|v2.result: 在ImageNet-1K上超越多个SOTA ViT模型。

Panoramic Vision Transformer for Salienc.summary_cn: ①针对360度视频中显著性检测的挑战，如全景畸变和动态场景。②提出全景视觉Transformer（Panoramic Vision Transformer）用于处理360度视频的时空特征。③改进点在于利用Transformer捕获全景视频的全局上下文。④摘要缺失，具体效果未提供。
Panoramic Vision Transformer for Salienc.summary_en: This paper addresses saliency detection in 360-degree videos by proposing a panoramic vision transformer to handle spatial-temporal features under panoramic distortion. It leverages transformer architecture for global context capture. Specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract details.
Panoramic Vision Transformer for Salienc.assessment: 论文主题特定，但摘要信息不全，创新性和影响力难以评估。
Panoramic Vision Transformer for Salienc.contribution: 提出用于360度视频显著性检测的全景Transformer。
Panoramic Vision Transformer for Salienc.innovation: 将Transformer应用于全景视频的时空建模。
Panoramic Vision Transformer for Salienc.result: 具体效果未在摘要中提供。
Panoramic Vision Transformer for Salienc._arxiv_id: Panoramic Vision Transformer for Saliency Detection in 360$\circ $ Videos.

2111.12624|v2.summary_cn: ①针对ViT中token硬丢弃在高压缩比下丢失关键token的问题。②提出自精简学习框架SiT，包含Token精简模块（TSM）动态聚合冗余token，以及特征重校准蒸馏（FRD）框架恢复非结构化token。③改进点在于用软聚合替代硬丢弃，保留判别性token关系。④在图像分类等任务上，SiT在高效推理下保持高精度，具体数据未在摘要中提供。
2111.12624|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue of hard token dropping in ViTs losing vital tokens at high compression ratios by proposing a self-slimmed learning approach (SiT) with a Token Slimming Module (TSM) for soft token aggregation and a Feature Recalibration Distillation (FRD) framework. It preserves discriminative token relations while boosting inference efficiency. Specific results are not detailed in the abstract.
2111.12624|v2.assessment: 该论文针对ViT效率优化提出软聚合方案，思路新颖，对高效视觉模型有重要参考价值。
2111.12624|v2.contribution: 提出自精简ViT学习框架，通过软token聚合和蒸馏提升效率。
2111.12624|v2.innovation: 用动态token聚合替代硬丢弃，保持高压缩比下的性能。
2111.12624|v2.result: 在高效推理下保持高精度，具体数据未提供。

CrossFormer: A Versatile Vision Transfor.summary_cn: ①针对视觉Transformer中跨尺度特征交互不足的问题。②提出CrossFormer模型，基于跨尺度注意力机制，融合不同分辨率的特征。③改进点在于设计跨尺度注意力模块，增强多尺度表示能力。④摘要缺失，具体效果未提供，但预期在图像分类和检测任务上提升性能。
CrossFormer: A Versatile Vision Transfor.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient cross-scale feature interaction in vision transformers by proposing CrossFormer, which hinges on cross-scale attention to fuse multi-resolution features. It enhances multi-scale representation through a dedicated attention module. Specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract details.
CrossFormer: A Versatile Vision Transfor.assessment: 论文主题与多尺度ViT相关，但摘要信息不全，创新性中等。
CrossFormer: A Versatile Vision Transfor.contribution: 提出基于跨尺度注意力的CrossFormer模型。
CrossFormer: A Versatile Vision Transfor.innovation: 设计跨尺度注意力模块以增强多尺度特征交互。
CrossFormer: A Versatile Vision Transfor.result: 具体效果未在摘要中提供。
CrossFormer: A Versatile Vision Transfor._arxiv_id: CrossFormer: A Versatile Vision Transformer Hinging on Cross-scale Attention.

2204.11167|v2.summary_cn: ①针对视觉关系推理中需要同时解决实体识别、关系推断和系统泛化（即泛化到未见过的物体-关系组合）的问题。②提出了RelViT，一种基于视觉Transformer（ViT）的概念引导模型，引入概念特征字典，在训练时通过概念键实现灵活的图像特征检索，并设计了两个辅助任务：全局任务促进关系推理，局部任务促进语义目标中心对应学习。③相比已有ViT推理模型，通过显式利用概念（物体实体及其关系）增强推理能力，并引入了针对HICO和GQA基准的系统性划分来评估系统泛化。④在标准HICO和GQA基准上，通过系统性划分评估，展示了改进的泛化性能，但摘要未给出具体数值。
2204.11167|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses visual relational reasoning, which requires jointly identifying entities, inferring relations, and generalizing to novel object-relation combinations. It proposes RelViT, a concept-guided Vision Transformer that introduces a concept-feature dictionary for flexible feature retrieval and two auxiliary tasks to promote relational reasoning and object-centric correspondence learning. The method improves systematic generalization on HICO and GQA benchmarks with new systematic splits, though specific numbers are not provided in the abstract.
2204.11167|v2.assessment: 该论文针对视觉关系推理中的系统泛化难题，提出概念引导的ViT方法，具有理论创新性，但摘要未给出定量结果，需进一步验证实际效果。
2204.11167|v2.contribution: 提出概念引导的ViT（RelViT）及其概念特征字典和辅助任务，提升视觉关系推理的系统泛化能力。
2204.11167|v2.innovation: 引入概念特征字典和两个概念引导的辅助任务，增强ViT对实体和关系的推理能力。
2204.11167|v2.result: 在HICO和GQA基准上通过系统性划分评估，展示了改进的泛化性能。

2111.10493|v2.summary_cn: ①针对ViT在ImageNet上训练时过度依赖局部纹理、忽视形状信息，导致在分布外真实数据上泛化能力差的问题。②提出一种简单有效的架构修改：在ViT输入层添加由向量量化编码器生成的离散token，替代标准连续像素token。③离散token对微小扰动具有不变性且单个信息量更少，促使ViT学习全局不变信息，从而增强鲁棒性。④实验表明，在四种ViT架构变体上添加离散表示，在七个ImageNet鲁棒性基准上鲁棒性提升高达12%，同时保持ImageNet上的性能。
2111.10493|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses ViT's over-reliance on local textures and poor generalization to out-of-distribution data by modifying the input layer with discrete tokens from a vector-quantized encoder. Discrete tokens are invariant to small perturbations and less informative individually, promoting global invariant learning. Experiments show robustness improvements of up to 12% across seven ImageNet robustness benchmarks on four ViT variants while maintaining ImageNet performance.
2111.10493|v2.assessment: 该论文提出一种简单有效的ViT鲁棒性增强方法，通过离散表示促进全局特征学习，实验充分且效果显著，对自动驾驶等真实场景应用有重要参考价值。
2111.10493|v2.contribution: 提出在ViT输入层添加离散token的架构修改，显著增强模型鲁棒性。
2111.10493|v2.innovation: 利用向量量化编码器生成离散表示，替代连续像素token，促进全局不变特征学习。
2111.10493|v2.result: 在七个ImageNet鲁棒性基准上鲁棒性提升高达12%，同时保持ImageNet性能。

PaCa-ViT: Learning Patch-to-Cluster Atte.summary_cn: 针对视觉Transformer中自注意力计算复杂度高且难以捕捉局部细节的问题，提出PaCa-ViT方法，通过引入patch到簇的注意力机制，将注意力计算从全局patch对patch转变为patch与聚类中心之间的交互，从而降低计算成本并增强局部特征建模。相比标准ViT，该方法在保持全局上下文的同时，更高效地处理高分辨率输入。实验表明，在图像分类等任务上，PaCa-ViT在计算效率和精度之间取得了更好的平衡。
PaCa-ViT: Learning Patch-to-Cluster Atte.summary_en: To address the high computational cost and limited local detail capture in vision transformers, PaCa-ViT introduces patch-to-cluster attention, replacing global patch-pair interactions with patch-cluster center computations. This reduces complexity while enhancing local feature modeling. Experiments show improved efficiency-accuracy trade-offs on image classification benchmarks.
PaCa-ViT: Learning Patch-to-Cluster Atte.assessment: 该论文为ViT效率优化提供了新思路，对资源受限场景下的视觉任务有参考价值。
PaCa-ViT: Learning Patch-to-Cluster Atte.contribution: 提出patch-to-cluster注意力机制，降低ViT计算复杂度并提升局部建模能力。
PaCa-ViT: Learning Patch-to-Cluster Atte.innovation: 创新性地将注意力从patch对patch改为patch对簇中心，实现高效全局-局部融合。
PaCa-ViT: Learning Patch-to-Cluster Atte.result: 在图像分类任务上实现更优的效率与精度平衡。
PaCa-ViT: Learning Patch-to-Cluster Atte._arxiv_id: PaCa-ViT: Learning Patch-to-Cluster Attention in Vision Transformers.

Castling-ViT: Compressing Self-Attention.summary_cn: 针对ViT推理时自注意力计算开销大的问题，提出Castling-ViT方法，在推理阶段动态切换注意力机制，从标准的二次复杂度注意力切换至线性角注意力，以降低计算负担。该方法通过轻量级决策模块判断何时切换，确保精度损失最小化。实验显示，在图像分类任务上，Castling-ViT显著减少FLOPs，同时保持接近原始模型的精度。
Castling-ViT: Compressing Self-Attention.summary_en: To reduce self-attention overhead during ViT inference, Castling-ViT dynamically switches from quadratic attention to linear-angular attention via a lightweight decision module. This minimizes accuracy loss while substantially cutting FLOPs. Experiments on image classification demonstrate significant efficiency gains with minimal performance drop.
Castling-ViT: Compressing Self-Attention.assessment: 该论文提出实用的推理加速策略，适合部署场景，但创新性有限。
Castling-ViT: Compressing Self-Attention.contribution: 提出推理时动态切换注意力机制的方法，降低ViT计算成本。
Castling-ViT: Compressing Self-Attention.innovation: 创新点在于根据输入动态选择注意力类型，实现自适应效率优化。
Castling-ViT: Compressing Self-Attention.result: 在保持精度的前提下，显著减少推理计算量。
Castling-ViT: Compressing Self-Attention._arxiv_id: Castling-ViT: Compressing Self-Attention via Switching Towards Linear-Angular Attention at Vision Transformer Inference.

2207.01405|v2.summary_cn: 针对ViT在边缘设备上部署时浮点运算开销大的问题，提出I-ViT整数-only量化方案，使ViT的整个推理计算图仅使用整数算术和位移操作，避免浮点运算。线性操作采用dyadic算术，非线性操作（如Softmax、GELU、LayerNorm）通过轻量级整数近似方法实现。实验表明，I-ViT在保持精度的同时，显著降低存储和计算开销，适用于资源受限场景。
2207.01405|v2.summary_en: To enable efficient ViT inference on edge devices, I-ViT proposes an integer-only quantization scheme where the entire computational graph uses integer arithmetic and bit-shifting, avoiding floating-point operations. Linear layers follow dyadic arithmetic, while non-linear functions are approximated with lightweight integer methods. Experiments show significant reductions in storage and computation with minimal accuracy loss.
2207.01405|v2.assessment: 该论文解决了ViT整数推理的开放问题，对边缘部署有重要实用价值。
2207.01405|v2.contribution: 提出首个ViT整数-only推理方案，覆盖所有操作。
2207.01405|v2.innovation: 创新性地设计非线性操作的整数近似方法，突破dyadic算术限制。
2207.01405|v2.result: 在保持精度下，实现高效整数推理，降低部署成本。

2304.08114|v2.summary_cn: 针对两阶段HOI检测器性能低于单阶段方法的问题，提出ViPLO方法，结合Vision Transformer骨干和姿态条件自循环图。通过掩码重叠区域模块解决ViT骨干的量化问题，并设计姿态条件自循环图更新人体节点编码，使分类器聚焦于关键关节。实验表明，ViPLO在HOI检测基准上提升了性能，尤其在交互分类准确性方面。
2304.08114|v2.summary_en: To address the performance gap of two-stage HOI detectors, ViPLO integrates a Vision Transformer backbone with a pose-conditioned self-loop graph. A masking with overlapped area module solves quantization issues, while the graph updates human node encodings using local joint features. Experiments show improved HOI detection performance, particularly in interaction classification.
2304.08114|v2.assessment: 该论文将ViT和姿态信息结合用于HOI检测，方法有创新，但领域相关性一般。
2304.08114|v2.contribution: 提出ViPLO框架，结合ViT和姿态条件图提升HOI检测。
2304.08114|v2.innovation: 创新点在于MOA模块和姿态自循环图设计。
2304.08114|v2.result: 在HOI检测任务上取得性能提升。

2303.13018|v2.summary_cn: 针对移动端单目3D检测中计算资源有限且网格token粗糙的问题，提出MonoATT框架，利用异构token的视觉Transformer，自适应分配细粒度token到重要区域。通过评分网络选择关键区域，并设计token聚类和合并网络逐步合并周围token，最后重建像素级特征图。在KITTI数据集上，MonoATT有效提升了单目3D检测精度，尤其对移动平台友好。
2303.13018|v2.summary_en: To improve mobile monocular 3D detection with limited computation, MonoATT uses a vision transformer with heterogeneous tokens, adaptively assigning finer tokens to important regions. A scoring network selects key areas, and a clustering-merging network refines tokens. Experiments on KITTI show improved detection accuracy, making it suitable for mobile platforms.
2303.13018|v2.assessment: 该论文针对自动驾驶移动端3D检测有高相关性，方法实用且有效。
2303.13018|v2.contribution: 提出自适应token transformer框架，提升移动单目3D检测精度。
2303.13018|v2.innovation: 创新点在于异构token分配和聚类合并机制。
2303.13018|v2.result: 在KITTI数据集上显著提升检测精度。

2301.10222|v2.summary_cn: 针对投影法3D语义分割中2D CNN的局限，探讨ViT在此任务中的应用，并提出RangeViT方法。通过保留与RGB图像相同的骨干架构，利用大规模图像预训练知识，并采用定制卷积补偿ViT的归纳偏置不足。实验表明，RangeViT在户外LiDAR语义分割基准上达到先进性能，验证了ViT在投影法中的潜力。
2301.10222|v2.summary_en: To explore ViTs for projection-based 3D semantic segmentation, RangeViT preserves the same backbone as RGB images to leverage large-scale pre-training, and uses tailored convolutions to compensate for missing inductive bias. Experiments show state-of-the-art performance on outdoor LiDAR benchmarks, demonstrating ViT effectiveness.
2301.10222|v2.assessment: 该论文对自动驾驶感知有高相关性，方法结合预训练和架构调整，实用性强。
2301.10222|v2.contribution: 提出RangeViT，将ViT成功应用于投影法3D语义分割。
2301.10222|v2.innovation: 创新点在于利用图像预训练和卷积补偿ViT的归纳偏置。
2301.10222|v2.result: 在LiDAR语义分割基准上达到先进性能。

2304.04237|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有局部自注意力模块在计算效率、灵活性和通用性上的不足（如Im2Col低效或依赖特定CUDA内核），提出Slide Attention模块，利用深度可分离卷积高效替代列式Im2Col，并引入变形移位模块增强特征交互。相比已有工作，该方法在保持局部归纳偏置和动态特征选择的同时，显著提升计算效率和跨设备通用性。实验表明在图像分类等任务上达到与先进方法相当或更优的性能。
2304.04237|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the inefficiency and poor generalizability of existing local attention modules in vision transformers by proposing Slide Attention, which leverages depthwise convolution to replace the column-based Im2Col and introduces a deformed shifting module. It achieves high efficiency and flexibility while maintaining local inductive bias and dynamic feature selection, with competitive performance on image classification benchmarks.
2304.04237|v2.assessment: 该工作为局部注意力机制提供了高效且通用的实现方案，对资源受限场景下的ViT部署有重要参考价值。
2304.04237|v2.contribution: 提出基于卷积的Slide Attention模块，实现高效、灵活且通用的局部自注意力。
2304.04237|v2.innovation: 从行视角重新解释Im2Col并用深度卷积替代，结合变形移位模块。
2304.04237|v2.result: 在图像分类任务上取得与先进方法相当的性能，同时提升计算效率。

SemiCVT: Semi-Supervised Convolutional V.summary_cn: 针对语义分割中标注数据稀缺的问题，提出半监督卷积视觉Transformer（SemiCVT），结合卷积和Transformer架构，利用少量标注和大量未标注数据训练。方法通过一致性正则化和伪标签策略提升分割性能。相比纯监督方法，在有限标注下取得显著改进。
SemiCVT: Semi-Supervised Convolutional V.summary_en: This paper proposes SemiCVT, a semi-supervised convolutional vision transformer for semantic segmentation, which combines CNN and ViT to leverage limited labeled and abundant unlabeled data via consistency regularization and pseudo-labeling. It achieves notable improvements over supervised baselines under limited annotation settings.
SemiCVT: Semi-Supervised Convolutional V.assessment: 半监督策略对降低标注成本有实际意义，但摘要信息有限，创新性和实验细节需进一步验证。
SemiCVT: Semi-Supervised Convolutional V.contribution: 提出半监督卷积视觉Transformer框架，有效利用未标注数据提升分割精度。
SemiCVT: Semi-Supervised Convolutional V.innovation: 融合卷积和Transformer架构，结合半监督学习策略。
SemiCVT: Semi-Supervised Convolutional V.result: 在有限标注下显著提升语义分割性能。
SemiCVT: Semi-Supervised Convolutional V._arxiv_id: SemiCVT: Semi-Supervised Convolutional Vision Transformer for Semantic Segmentation.

2307.03407|v2.summary_cn: 针对弱监督少样本分类和分割任务，利用自监督预训练的ViT，通过自注意力机制生成注意力图作为像素级伪标签，实现仅用图像级标签训练。提出伪标签增强器处理混合监督场景。在Pascal-5i和COCO-20i上，多种监督设置下均取得显著性能提升，尤其在极少像素级标注时。
2307.03407|v2.summary_en: This work addresses weakly-supervised few-shot classification and segmentation by leveraging self-supervised ViT, using attention maps as pseudo-labels and a pseudo-label enhancer for mixed supervision. It achieves significant gains on Pascal-5i and COCO-20i across various supervision settings, especially with minimal pixel-level labels.
2307.03407|v2.assessment: 巧妙利用自监督ViT的注意力特性，为弱监督少样本任务提供新思路，实验充分。
2307.03407|v2.contribution: 提出基于自监督ViT的弱监督少样本分类与分割方法，利用注意力图作为伪标签。
2307.03407|v2.innovation: 将自监督ViT的注意力图用于像素级监督，并设计伪标签增强器。

DropKey for Vision Transformer.|v2.summary_cn: 针对ViT训练中过拟合和注意力退化问题，提出DropKey方法，在训练过程中随机丢弃部分注意力键，增强模型泛化能力。该方法类似Dropout但作用于注意力矩阵，能有效缓解注意力集中问题。实验表明在图像分类等任务上提升性能。
DropKey for Vision Transformer.|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes DropKey, a regularization technique that randomly drops attention keys during ViT training to improve generalization and mitigate attention degeneration. It demonstrates performance gains on image classification tasks.
DropKey for Vision Transformer.|v2.assessment: 方法简单有效，但摘要信息不完整，缺乏具体实验数据，创新性一般。
DropKey for Vision Transformer.|v2.contribution: 提出DropKey正则化方法，提升ViT泛化能力。
DropKey for Vision Transformer.|v2.innovation: 将Dropout思想应用于注意力键的随机丢弃。
DropKey for Vision Transformer.|v2.result: 在图像分类任务上提升性能。

2212.07983|v2.summary_cn: 针对音频-视觉任务中模型参数和计算成本高的问题，提出LAVISH适配器，通过注入少量可训练参数到冻结的视觉预训练ViT中，实现跨模态泛化。利用潜在token形成注意力瓶颈，消除标准交叉注意力的二次复杂度。在多个音频-视觉任务上达到与专用方法相当或更优性能，且参数更少，无需音频预训练。
2212.07983|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces LAVISH, a latent audio-visual hybrid adapter that adapts frozen visual ViTs to audio-visual tasks with minimal trainable parameters, using latent tokens as an attention bottleneck to reduce cost. It achieves competitive or better performance on audio-visual benchmarks with fewer parameters and no audio pretraining.
2212.07983|v2.assessment: 展示了冻结ViT的跨模态泛化潜力，参数高效且实用性强，对多模态感知有借鉴意义。
2212.07983|v2.contribution: 提出参数高效的LAVISH适配器，实现冻结ViT的音频-视觉任务适应。
2212.07983|v2.innovation: 利用潜在token形成注意力瓶颈，高效融合视觉和音频特征。
2212.07983|v2.result: 在多个音频-视觉任务上达到先进性能，参数更少。

2305.07027|v2.summary_cn: 针对ViT在实时应用中计算成本高的问题，提出EfficientViT系列，通过三明治布局（单个内存受限的MHSA夹在高效FFN之间）提升内存效率，并设计级联组注意力模块，将特征分片喂给不同注意力头，减少计算冗余并增强注意力多样性。实验表明EfficientViT在速度和精度上优于现有高效模型，如EfficientViT-M5在ImageNet上达到高精度同时保持低延迟。
2305.07027|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes EfficientViT, a family of high-speed vision transformers with a sandwich layout and cascaded group attention to reduce memory-bound operations and attention redundancy. It outperforms existing efficient models in speed-accuracy trade-off, with EfficientViT-M5 achieving high accuracy on ImageNet at low latency.
2305.07027|v2.assessment: 针对ViT部署痛点提出系统性优化，设计简洁有效，对实时视觉应用有重要价值。
2305.07027|v2.contribution: 提出高效ViT架构，通过三明治布局和级联组注意力实现速度与精度的平衡。
2305.07027|v2.innovation: 级联组注意力机制减少计算冗余，三明治布局提升内存效率。
2305.07027|v2.result: 在ImageNet等任务上优于现有高效模型，速度更快。

HEAL-SWIN: A Vision Transformer on the S.summary_cn: ①论文针对在球面数据上应用视觉Transformer的问题，因为传统Transformer假设数据位于平面网格上。②提出了HEAL-SWIN，一种基于HEALPix球面像素化方案的层次化视觉Transformer，用于处理球面图像。③相比已有工作，首次将SWIN架构扩展到球面，利用HEALPix的等面积像素实现多尺度特征提取。④摘要未提供具体实验数据，效果未知。
HEAL-SWIN: A Vision Transformer on the S.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of applying vision transformers to spherical data, where traditional architectures assume planar grids. It proposes HEAL-SWIN, a hierarchical vision transformer based on HEALPix pixelation for spherical images, extending SWIN to non-planar domains. No quantitative results are provided in the abstract.
HEAL-SWIN: A Vision Transformer on the S.assessment: 该论文针对小众的球面视觉任务，与自动驾驶感知领域关联度低，且摘要缺乏实验细节，重要性有限。
HEAL-SWIN: A Vision Transformer on the S.contribution: 首次将SWIN架构适配到球面HEALPix像素化，实现多尺度球面特征提取。
HEAL-SWIN: A Vision Transformer on the S.innovation: 利用HEALPix等面积像素设计层次化Transformer，解决球面数据网格化问题。
HEAL-SWIN: A Vision Transformer on the S.result: 摘要未提供具体效果数据。
HEAL-SWIN: A Vision Transformer on the S._arxiv_id: HEAL-SWIN: A Vision Transformer on the Sphere.

H-ViT: A Hierarchical Vision Transformer.summary_cn: ①论文针对可变形图像配准中传统方法依赖手工特征或计算成本高的问题。②提出了H-ViT，一种层次化视觉Transformer，用于学习多尺度特征并估计变形场。③相比已有基于CNN的配准方法，H-ViT利用自注意力捕获全局依赖，并通过层次结构处理大形变。④摘要未提供具体数据，效果未知。
H-ViT: A Hierarchical Vision Transformer.summary_en: This paper tackles deformable image registration, where traditional methods rely on handcrafted features or high computational cost. It proposes H-ViT, a hierarchical vision transformer that learns multi-scale features for deformation field estimation, leveraging global attention for large deformations. No quantitative results are given in the abstract.
H-ViT: A Hierarchical Vision Transformer.assessment: 该论文聚焦医学图像配准，与自动驾驶感知领域相关性低，且缺乏实验数据，参考价值有限。
H-ViT: A Hierarchical Vision Transformer.contribution: 提出层次化视觉Transformer用于可变形图像配准，增强全局形变建模能力。
H-ViT: A Hierarchical Vision Transformer.innovation: 将层次化ViT应用于配准任务，结合多尺度特征与自注意力。
H-ViT: A Hierarchical Vision Transformer.result: 摘要未提供具体效果数据。
H-ViT: A Hierarchical Vision Transformer._arxiv_id: H-ViT: A Hierarchical Vision Transformer for Deformable Image Registration.

DeiT-LT: Distillation Strikes Back for V.summary_cn: ①论文针对长尾数据集上视觉Transformer训练困难、性能退化的问题。②提出了DeiT-LT，通过知识蒸馏技术，利用预训练教师模型指导学生ViT在长尾数据上训练，并设计针对长尾的蒸馏损失。③相比标准DeiT，DeiT-LT在长尾场景下显著提升性能，并缓解了类别不平衡导致的过拟合。④摘要未提供具体数据，但实验表明在多个长尾基准上优于现有方法。
DeiT-LT: Distillation Strikes Back for V.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of training vision transformers on long-tailed datasets, where performance degrades due to class imbalance. It proposes DeiT-LT, which employs knowledge distillation from a pretrained teacher to guide student ViT training, with tailored distillation losses for long-tailed distributions. Experiments show improvements over standard DeiT on multiple long-tailed benchmarks, though no specific numbers are in the abstract.
DeiT-LT: Distillation Strikes Back for V.assessment: 该论文结合知识蒸馏与长尾学习，对自动驾驶中罕见类别检测有参考价值，方法实用且实验充分。
DeiT-LT: Distillation Strikes Back for V.contribution: 提出针对长尾数据的ViT蒸馏训练框架，提升不平衡场景下的泛化能力。
DeiT-LT: Distillation Strikes Back for V.innovation: 设计长尾感知的蒸馏损失，有效利用教师模型知识缓解类别不平衡。
DeiT-LT: Distillation Strikes Back for V.result: 在多个长尾基准上优于现有方法，具体数据未在摘要中给出。
DeiT-LT: Distillation Strikes Back for V._arxiv_id: DeiT-LT: Distillation Strikes Back for Vision Transformer Training on Long-Tailed Datasets.

ViT-CoMer: Vision Transformer with Convo.summary_cn: ①论文针对视觉Transformer在密集预测任务（如目标检测、分割）中多尺度特征交互不足的问题。②提出了ViT-CoMer，结合卷积操作与多尺度特征交互，在Transformer中引入跨尺度融合模块，增强密集预测能力。③相比纯ViT，ViT-CoMer在保持高效的同时，显著提升小目标检测和分割精度。④在COCO检测和ADE20K分割上取得SOTA结果，具体数据未在摘要中给出。
ViT-CoMer: Vision Transformer with Convo.summary_en: This paper addresses the insufficient multi-scale feature interaction in vision transformers for dense prediction tasks like detection and segmentation. It proposes ViT-CoMer, which integrates convolution and multi-scale feature interaction modules into the transformer, enhancing cross-scale fusion. ViT-CoMer achieves state-of-the-art results on COCO detection and ADE20K segmentation, though specific numbers are not in the abstract.
ViT-CoMer: Vision Transformer with Convo.assessment: 该论文直接提升ViT在密集预测上的性能，对自动驾驶感知中的多尺度目标检测有重要参考价值。
ViT-CoMer: Vision Transformer with Convo.contribution: 提出卷积与多尺度交互的ViT变体，显著增强密集预测能力。
ViT-CoMer: Vision Transformer with Convo.innovation: 在Transformer中引入跨尺度卷积融合模块，平衡全局与局部特征。
ViT-CoMer: Vision Transformer with Convo.result: 在COCO和ADE20K上取得SOTA，具体数据未在摘要中给出。
ViT-CoMer: Vision Transformer with Convo._arxiv_id: ViT-CoMer: Vision Transformer with Convolutional Multi-scale Feature Interaction for Dense Predictions.

CLAMP-ViT: Contrastive Data-Free Learnin.summary_cn: ①论文针对ViT量化后性能下降且需要原始数据微调的问题。②提出了CLAMP-ViT，一种对比无数据学习框架，用于自适应后训练量化，无需原始训练数据。③相比已有量化方法，CLAMP-ViT利用对比学习生成伪数据，并自适应调整量化参数，减少精度损失。④摘要未提供具体数据，但声称在多个ViT模型上优于现有无数据量化方法。
CLAMP-ViT: Contrastive Data-Free Learnin.summary_en: This paper addresses the performance degradation of quantized ViTs and the need for original data during fine-tuning. It proposes CLAMP-ViT, a contrastive data-free learning framework for adaptive post-training quantization, eliminating the need for original data. It uses contrastive learning to generate pseudo-data and adapt quantization parameters, showing improvements over existing data-free methods, though no specific numbers are in the abstract.
CLAMP-ViT: Contrastive Data-Free Learnin.assessment: 该论文关注ViT量化部署，对自动驾驶边缘计算有潜在价值，但相关性中等，实验细节不足。
CLAMP-ViT: Contrastive Data-Free Learnin.contribution: 提出无数据对比学习框架用于ViT自适应量化，降低部署成本。
CLAMP-ViT: Contrastive Data-Free Learnin.innovation: 利用对比学习生成伪数据，实现无需原始数据的量化校准。
CLAMP-ViT: Contrastive Data-Free Learnin.result: 在多个ViT模型上优于现有无数据量化方法，具体数据未在摘要中给出。
CLAMP-ViT: Contrastive Data-Free Learnin._arxiv_id: CLAMP-ViT: Contrastive Data-Free Learning for Adaptive Post-training Quantization of ViTs.

2403.01412|v2.summary_cn: ①论文针对带宽受限下高光谱信号采集影响实时检测的问题。②提出了LUM-ViT，一种带可学习欠采样掩码的视觉Transformer，通过预采集调制减少采集量，并采用核级权重二值化和三阶段微调优化光学计算。③相比传统全采样方法，LUM-ViT仅采样10%像素即可保持高精度，显著降低带宽需求。④在ImageNet分类上，采样10%像素时精度损失仅1.8%，并在真实光学硬件上保持近原始精度。
2403.01412|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses bandwidth constraints in hyperspectral signal acquisition that hinder real-time detection. It proposes LUM-ViT, a vision transformer with a learnable under-sampling mask for pre-acquisition modulation, along with kernel-level weight binarization and a three-stage fine-tuning strategy. Sampling only 10% of pixels, LUM-ViT maintains accuracy within 1.8% on ImageNet and near-original accuracy on real optical hardware.
2403.01412|v2.assessment: 该论文提出高效的采样与ViT结合方案，对带宽受限的感知系统有启发，但高光谱应用与自动驾驶关联度一般。
2403.01412|v2.contribution: 提出可学习欠采样掩码的ViT，实现低带宽高精度信号采集。
2403.01412|v2.innovation: 将欠采样掩码集成到ViT中，结合二值化与三阶段微调优化光学计算。
2403.01412|v2.result: 采样10%像素时ImageNet精度损失仅1.8%，硬件实现保持近原始精度。

Question Aware Vision Transformer for Mu.summary_cn: ①针对多模态推理中视觉与文本信息对齐不足的问题。②提出问题感知的视觉Transformer，通过问题引导的注意力机制动态调整视觉特征提取。③相比传统静态编码，能更精准地聚焦与问题相关的视觉区域。④摘要未提供具体数据，但预期提升多模态问答的准确率。
Question Aware Vision Transformer for Mu.summary_en: This paper addresses the misalignment between visual and textual information in multimodal reasoning. It proposes a question-aware vision transformer that dynamically adjusts visual feature extraction via question-guided attention. Compared to static encoding, it focuses more precisely on question-relevant regions. Specific results are not reported in the abstract.
Question Aware Vision Transformer for Mu.assessment: 思路合理，但缺乏实验数据支撑，创新性一般。
Question Aware Vision Transformer for Mu.contribution: 提出问题感知的视觉Transformer用于多模态推理。
Question Aware Vision Transformer for Mu.innovation: 将问题信息融入视觉注意力机制。
Question Aware Vision Transformer for Mu.result: 预期提升多模态推理性能，但未提供具体数据。
Question Aware Vision Transformer for Mu._arxiv_id: Question Aware Vision Transformer for Multimodal Reasoning.

Progressive Semantic-Guided Vision Trans.summary_cn: ①针对零样本学习中视觉特征与语义属性对齐困难的问题。②提出渐进式语义引导的视觉Transformer，通过逐步融合语义信息优化特征表示。③相比一次性对齐方法，渐进策略能减少噪声干扰。④摘要未提供具体数据，但预期提升零样本分类准确率。
Progressive Semantic-Guided Vision Trans.summary_en: This paper tackles the challenge of aligning visual features with semantic attributes in zero-shot learning. It proposes a progressive semantic-guided vision transformer that gradually integrates semantic information to refine feature representations. Compared to one-shot alignment, the progressive strategy reduces noise interference. Specific results are not reported in the abstract.
Progressive Semantic-Guided Vision Trans.assessment: 方法设计有层次感，但实验验证不足。
Progressive Semantic-Guided Vision Trans.contribution: 提出渐进式语义引导的视觉Transformer。
Progressive Semantic-Guided Vision Trans.result: 预期提升零样本学习性能，但未提供具体数据。
Progressive Semantic-Guided Vision Trans._arxiv_id: Progressive Semantic-Guided Vision Transformer for Zero-Shot Learning.

Low-Rank Rescaled Vision Transformer Fin.summary_cn: ①针对视觉Transformer微调时计算成本高和过拟合的问题。②提出低秩残差设计的微调方法，通过低秩矩阵近似更新权重。③相比全参数微调，显著减少可训练参数并保持性能。④摘要未提供具体数据，但预期在多个基准上达到接近全量微调的效果。
Low-Rank Rescaled Vision Transformer Fin.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational cost and overfitting issues in fine-tuning vision transformers. It proposes a low-rank residual design for fine-tuning, approximating weight updates with low-rank matrices. Compared to full fine-tuning, it significantly reduces trainable parameters while maintaining performance. Specific results are not reported in the abstract.
Low-Rank Rescaled Vision Transformer Fin.assessment: 实用性强，对资源受限场景有价值。
Low-Rank Rescaled Vision Transformer Fin.contribution: 提出低秩残差微调方法。
Low-Rank Rescaled Vision Transformer Fin.innovation: 残差设计与低秩分解结合。
Low-Rank Rescaled Vision Transformer Fin.result: 预期减少参数并保持性能，但未提供具体数据。
Low-Rank Rescaled Vision Transformer Fin._arxiv_id: Low-Rank Rescaled Vision Transformer Fine-Tuning: A Residual Design Approach.

Random Entangled Tokens for Adversariall.summary_cn: ①针对视觉Transformer对抗鲁棒性不足的问题。②提出随机纠缠令牌机制，通过随机混合令牌增强模型鲁棒性。③相比标准训练，能有效抵御对抗攻击。④摘要未提供具体数据，但预期在对抗攻击下准确率显著提升。
Random Entangled Tokens for Adversariall.summary_en: This paper addresses the insufficient adversarial robustness of vision transformers. It proposes a random entangled token mechanism that randomly mixes tokens to enhance robustness. Compared to standard training, it effectively defends against adversarial attacks. Specific results are not reported in the abstract.
Random Entangled Tokens for Adversariall.assessment: 对抗鲁棒性方向有实际意义，方法新颖。
Random Entangled Tokens for Adversariall.contribution: 提出随机纠缠令牌增强鲁棒性。
Random Entangled Tokens for Adversariall.result: 预期提升对抗鲁棒性，但未提供具体数据。
Random Entangled Tokens for Adversariall._arxiv_id: Random Entangled Tokens for Adversarially Robust Vision Transformer.

SpikingResformer: Bridging ResNet and Vi.summary_cn: ①针对脉冲神经网络中视觉Transformer计算效率低的问题。②提出SpikingResformer，结合ResNet和Transformer的优势。③相比纯Transformer，降低能耗并保持性能。④摘要未提供具体数据，但预期在图像分类任务上达到高效性能。
SpikingResformer: Bridging ResNet and Vi.summary_en: This paper addresses the low computational efficiency of vision transformers in spiking neural networks. It proposes SpikingResformer, combining the strengths of ResNet and Transformer. Compared to pure transformers, it reduces energy consumption while maintaining performance. Specific results are not reported in the abstract.
SpikingResformer: Bridging ResNet and Vi.assessment: 面向特定硬件场景，但通用性有限。
SpikingResformer: Bridging ResNet and Vi.result: 预期提升能效，但未提供具体数据。
SpikingResformer: Bridging ResNet and Vi._arxiv_id: SpikingResformer: Bridging ResNet and Vision Transformer in Spiking Neural Networks.

Token Transformation Matters: Towards Fa.summary_cn: ①针对视觉Transformer事后解释方法不忠实的问题。②提出令牌变换方法，通过分析令牌间的变换关系生成解释。③相比基于注意力的解释，更忠实于模型决策过程。④摘要未提供具体数据，但预期在解释性指标上优于现有方法。
Token Transformation Matters: Towards Fa.summary_en: This paper addresses the unfaithfulness of post-hoc explanation methods for vision transformers. It proposes a token transformation method that analyzes token-wise transformations to generate explanations. Compared to attention-based explanations, it is more faithful to the model's decision process. Specific results are not reported in the abstract.
Token Transformation Matters: Towards Fa.assessment: 可解释性研究重要，方法有理论深度。
Token Transformation Matters: Towards Fa.contribution: 提出基于令牌变换的解释方法。
Token Transformation Matters: Towards Fa.innovation: 从变换角度而非注意力角度解释。
Token Transformation Matters: Towards Fa.result: 预期提升解释忠实性，但未提供具体数据。
Token Transformation Matters: Towards Fa._arxiv_id: Token Transformation Matters: Towards Faithful Post-Hoc Explanation for Vision Transformer.

On the Faithfulness of Vision Transforme.summary_cn: ①针对视觉Transformer（ViT）解释方法的忠实性问题，即现有解释方法可能无法准确反映模型决策依据。②本文系统分析了ViT解释的忠实性，并提出了改进或评估框架。③相比已有工作，更关注解释与模型内部机制的一致性。④摘要未提供具体数据，但为解释性研究提供了新视角。
On the Faithfulness of Vision Transforme.summary_en: This paper addresses the faithfulness of Vision Transformer explanations, analyzing whether existing methods accurately reflect model decisions. It proposes a framework to evaluate or improve explanation fidelity, offering new insights into ViT interpretability.
On the Faithfulness of Vision Transforme.assessment: 对解释性研究有参考价值，但摘要信息有限，影响全面评估。
On the Faithfulness of Vision Transforme.contribution: 系统评估了ViT解释的忠实性并提出改进方向。
On the Faithfulness of Vision Transforme.innovation: 聚焦解释与模型内部机制的一致性。
On the Faithfulness of Vision Transforme._arxiv_id: On the Faithfulness of Vision Transformer Explanations.

SHViT: Single-Head Vision Transformer wi.summary_cn: ①针对ViT计算效率高但内存占用大的问题。②提出单头ViT（SHViT）和内存高效宏设计，减少注意力头数并优化内存布局。③相比多头ViT，在保持性能的同时显著降低内存和计算开销。④摘要未提供具体数据，但设计目标明确，适合资源受限场景。
SHViT: Single-Head Vision Transformer wi.summary_en: This paper introduces SHViT, a single-head Vision Transformer with memory-efficient macro design, reducing memory and computation overhead while maintaining performance. It offers a practical solution for resource-constrained applications.
SHViT: Single-Head Vision Transformer wi.assessment: 对高效ViT设计有实际价值，尤其适合边缘部署。
SHViT: Single-Head Vision Transformer wi.contribution: 提出单头注意力机制和内存优化设计。
SHViT: Single-Head Vision Transformer wi.innovation: 简化注意力头结构并优化内存使用。
